article.articleHeadline: Ebola Darurat Kesehatan Global, Epidemiolog Minta RI Perketat Pintu Masuk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Global Health Emergency, Epidemiologist Urges Indonesia to Tighten Entry Points.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the World Health Organization designated Ebola outbreaks in the Congo and Uganda as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The decision followed reports of 246 suspected Ebola cases and 80 deaths. The PHEIC label signals high global risk but is not equivalent to a pandemic like COVID-19. Indonesian epidemiologist Dicky Budiman of Griffith University urged Indonesia not to impose a total border lockdown, but to tighten screening at international entry points. He recommended reinforced surveillance at airports, seaports, migrant worker corridors, and during Hajj and Umrah travel. The article underscores the need for precautionary measures to prevent cross-border transmission while avoiding drastic restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが世界保健上の緊急事態、疫学者がインドネシアに入国管理強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WHOがPHEICを宣言したエボラアウトブレイク。アフリカ地域での複数国での発生と国際的懸念が確認されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域に Uganda (226074) が含まれているが、対象国リストに該当しないため除外。DRC はコンゴでのエボラ発生の主要地として記事で明確に言及。インドネシアは発生国ではなく関心国として言及されているが、地域的なリスク評価対象として国境対策が言及されているため含める。WHOによるPHEIC宣言（246例、80死亡）は国際的懸念を示す。

article.articleHeadline: WHO '에볼라 비상사태' 선언...美, 의료진 감염에 아프리카 3개국 입국 제한
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO declares Ebola emergency... U.S. imposes entry restrictions on three African countries due to infections among healthcare workers.
article.articleSummary: Ebola, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, spreads from the Democratic Republic of the Congo to Uganda, prompting WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026. The outbreak is expanding across districts with simultaneous suspected cases and healthcare worker deaths; four healthcare workers have died. As of May 17, the CDC reports 10 confirmed, 336 suspected cases, and 88 deaths in the DRC; Uganda has 2 confirmed cases and 1 death. Transmission links between distant clusters remain unclear, with concern over ongoing insecurity, humanitarian crises, high mobility, urban-centered spread, and widespread informal health facilities. The United States imposed entry restrictions on non-U.S. passport holders who visited DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan within 21 days, plus enhanced screening for travelers from those countries. One American infected in the DRC tested positive May 17; six others and the patient were evacuated to Germany for treatment, identities undisclosed.

triage.headline_ja: WHO「エボラ緊急事態」宣言...米、医療従事者感染により アフリカ3カ国への入国制限
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みのエボラ感染症で、複数国への拡大、医療従事者死亡、米国による入国制限など明確なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC およびウガンダでの発生を明記しているが、対象国リストにおいてはDRCのみ該当。ウガンダ、スーダン、ドイツは対象国外のため excluded。WHO PHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）、米国による21日以内の入国制限、複数国への患者移送など、極めて高いアラート値を示す。医療従事者含む死亡症例あり。

article.articleHeadline: Centre closely monitoring Ebola situation in Central Africa; Public health measures being strengthened: Sources
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease caused by Bundibugyo virus is spreading in parts of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with the World Health Organization declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). As of May 19, 2026, nearly 100 deaths have been reported in Ituri province, eastern DRC, along with several suspected cases. India reports no imported cases and minimal current risk; authorities are strengthening surveillance and preparedness at points of entry. Key measures include review and enhancement of SOPs for screening, surveillance, quarantine, and case management; laboratory readiness with NIV Pune designated for testing and additional labs onboarded. There is enhanced coordination with ministries to monitor international travel from affected regions and readiness of isolation/quarantine facilities at major airports and ports. Public advised not to panic; India’s One Health surveillance system is being expanded to monitor animal-to-human transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカのエボラ状況を厳密に監視中。公衆衛生対策が強化されている：情報筋
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みで、インドを含む複数国での対策が進行中。フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行を主題としているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはIndia（1269750）のみ。インドは国内での輸入症例なし・リスク最小と記載されているが、監視・準備体制強化が進行中。Bundibugyo virus種によるEBOV流行は国際的に重要。DRC（203312）はBluedot APIが付与した発生地域に含まれるが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には入れていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola risk to Aussies 'still low' as death toll soars
article.articleSummary: Australia is monitoring the latest deadly Ebola outbreak in central and eastern Africa 'very closely,' Health Minister Mark Butler said, as the death toll climbs. More than 100 deaths have been linked to the Congo- and Uganda-based outbreak since the first case was detected in late April. International health authorities reported almost 400 suspected cases as of Tuesday morning, with the World Health Organization declaring a public health emergency of international concern. The Bundibugyo variant is a rare strain not responsive to vaccines or treatments. There are no approved vaccines or therapeutic treatments. Symptoms start as flu-like before swiftly progressing to vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach pain, rashes, and sometimes internal and external bleeding. The risk to Australia is still low, but monitored closely due to rising case numbers and the strain's lack of treatment options.

triage.headline_ja: 豪州への伝染病リスク「依然低い」とされる一方、死亡者数が急増
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言により、深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航制限リスクが全て存在する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでの発生を述べているが、Uganda（1327865）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsではDRCのみを含める。WHOが国際関心事態（PHEIC）を宣言している高リスクイベント。ワクチン・治療法が現在利用不可能なBundibugyo株の希少性により、管理可能性に課題あり。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）伊波拉疫情扩散 116起疑似病例死亡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreads in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; 116 suspected cases have died.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's eastern Ituri Province is facing a renewed Ebola outbreak, with 116 suspected deaths and 435 suspected cases under observation and treatment; laboratories and epidemiological investigations are ongoing. The Ituri region and nearby North Kivu Province have reported cases. As of May 15, the health ministry recorded 80 nationwide deaths, of which 4 were laboratory-confirmed Ebola. Africa CDC declared the Ituri outbreak an Ebola event; Uganda reported an imported laboratory-confirmed Ebola death. On May 17, the World Health Organization designated the situation as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Neighboring countries—including Rwanda, Zambia, and Tanzania—have stepped up border health surveillance, entry screening, and outbreak preparedness. Ebola Virus Disease spreads through contact with the blood, body fluids, or secretions of an infected person or animal, causing fever, bleeding, multi-organ damage, and a high mortality rate of 50–90%.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（金）のエボラ疫情が拡散、116件の疑似死亡例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病はアフリカ地域での深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大リスク、WHOによる国際的懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言に該当し、複数国への波及が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（特にIturi州とNorth Kivu州）での疫情を主題としており、ウガンダでの輸入例、ルワンダ・ザンビア・タンザニアでの国境警戒体制が言及されている。対象国リスト内ではDRCとZambiaが実際の疫情発生地として確認されるため、verified_locationsはこの2カ国に限定。PHEICの公式宣言により国際的な懸念が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫：伊波拉汉坦病毒是这个危险分裂时代最新危机
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola-Hantaan virus is the latest crisis in this dangerous era of division
article.articleSummary: At the opening of the WHO's 79th World Health Assembly in Geneva, Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that deadly Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and a rare Hantaan virus outbreak aboard the Hondius cruise ship are the latest crises in a 'dangerous and divided' era. He told health ministers that war, economic crises, climate change, and aid cuts amplify risk, and he will deliver a keynote on Tuesday detailing these threats. Last week, Spain evacuated passengers and crew from the Hondius at the Canary Islands, an operation Sánchez praised as solidarity. Swiss health minister Baume-Schneider noted WHO budget cuts of about 21%, nearly US$1 billion (roughly SGD 1.278 billion), leading to hundreds of job losses and program reductions.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: エボラ-ハンタウイルスは分裂の時代における最新の危機
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。コンゴでのエボラ流行とクルーズ船でのハンタウイルスアウトブレイク、複数国への波及が確認されており、WHO総会での警告という国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 複数のアウトブレイク・イベントが報告されている（コンゴでのエボラ、クルーズ船でのハンタウイルス）。スペインとスイスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ジュネーブはWHO本部所在地だが、実際の疾患流行地はコンゴが唯一の対象国。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak in DR Congo and Uganda: Public Health Emergency - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17, 2026, for an Ebola outbreak spanning the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific medical countermeasure. In the absence of a targeted vaccine, containment relies on rapid detection, strict infection control, and intensive supportive care, alongside community engagement. The crisis unfolds amid severe hunger and displacement in the DRC, with population movement hindering contact tracing and isolation efforts. Widespread food insecurity and malnutrition may worsen illness severity and recovery. The PHEIC aims to mobilize international funding, supplies, and expertise. Until a Bundibugyo-specific vaccine is developed, global response focuses on surveillance, safe isolation, and stabilizing humanitarian conditions in DR Congo and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのエボラ出血熱の流行：公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事態
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱のPHEIC宣言、複数国への拡大、ワクチン不在、および国際的な支援動員が必要な重篤な国際感染症事象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRC（Democratic Republic of the Congo）とウガンダでのエボラ流行が述べられているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。WHOがPHEICを宣言した重篤な国際感染症事象。Bundibugyo virus株であり、既存ワクチンが効果的でない点が特に懸念される。食糧不安や人口移動がコントロール困難性を増加させている。

article.articleHeadline: アフリカのエボラ流行、死者100人超す　米国人1人も感染　戦闘激化で対応出遅れ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Africa: death toll tops 100; one American has been infected; response delayed by intensified fighting
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with Africa CDC reporting a death toll over 100. As of May 18, 395 suspected Ebola cases and 106 related deaths have been recorded across the DR Congo and Uganda. One American is confirmed EBOV positive in the DRC; Dr. Peter Stafford, an American Christian evangelist physician, is infected. His wife and another physician who treated patients are under observation and asymptomatic; their four children are also monitored. International aid groups warn that prolonged conflict and aid reductions have deepened a massive humanitarian crisis, with thousands dead since January and many displaced. Monitoring systems have been hampered by intensified fighting, delaying outbreak detection. The United States activated Title 42 for at least 30 days to restrict entry, while U.S. health authorities are arranging the transfer of seven individuals, including the infected American, from Congo to Germany for care.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ流行、死者100人超す　米国人1人も感染　戦闘激化で対応出遅れ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は高い致死率を持つ公衆衛生的深刻な脅威であり、複数国への拡大、死亡者100人超、米国人感染による国際的関心、渡航制限発動など全ての要素を満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでエボラ発生が明確に述べられているため検証が必要。ただし対象国リストにウガンダ（GeoNames ID: 226074）は含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。米国やドイツは症例発生地ではなく、症例搬送/対応国として扱い除外。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情扩散 116例疑似病例死亡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreads in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; 116 suspected cases have died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is expanding in eastern Ituri Province, with 116 suspected deaths and 435 suspected cases under observation or treatment as of May 18, according to the government. Cases have been reported in Ituri and neighboring North Kivu; laboratory confirmation and epidemiological investigations are ongoing to verify Ebola involvement. On May 15, the DRC health ministry reported 80 nationwide deaths, with four confirmed Ebola infections. The Africa CDC announced the Ituri outbreak on May 15, and Uganda reported a laboratory-confirmed imported Ebola death the same day. The WHO on May 17 declared the outbreak in DRC and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Rwanda, Zambia, Tanzania, and other neighbors have heightened border surveillance and entry screening. Ebola spreads via contact with blood, body fluids, secretions, or excretions of infected humans or animals; case fatality rate can reach 50-90%.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱疫情が拡大 116例の疑似患者が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱という高い病原性、国際的な広がりのリスク、複数国への波及、WHO公開保健衛生上の緊急事態宣言を受けており、緊急対応が必要。
triage.notes: WHOが2026年5月17日にDRCおよびウガンダのエボラ疫情を国際保健衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）として宣言。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Rwanda、Tanzaniaもサマリーに言及されているが対象国ではないため除外。DRC（Ituri州）とZambiaが対象国内で確認される実際の発生地。

article.articleHeadline: OMS alerta sobre una "época peligrosa" ante brotes de ébola y hantavirus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of a 'dangerous era' ahead of Ebola and hantavirus outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the World Health Organization warns of a 'dangerous era' for global health amid Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and hantavirus concerns, noted during the 79th World Health Assembly in Geneva. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus links rising risks to armed conflict, economic crises, climate change, and shrinking international aid, all hampering rapid emergency responses. Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez called for stronger multilateral cooperation, following the evacuation of over 120 passengers from the MV Hondius to Tenerife. Delegates prioritize reforms to the global health architecture—enhanced cooperation, scientific exchange, and equitable access to medical products—and advance negotiations on a pandemic treaty to accelerate sharing of viruses, genetic data, vaccines, treatments, and diagnostics, including for potential imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが「危険な時代」を警告 エボラとハンタウイルスの流行を前に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当し、DRC（対象国）でのエボラ流行が確認され、国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限のリスク・重症度が認識される。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目該当。
triage.notes: DRC内でのエボラ流行が報告される対象国。スペイン領カナリア諸島への乗客疎開（MV Hondius）は事例としては対象国外だが、国際的拡大リスクの文脈。WHOの公式警告（79th World Health Assembly）により高い社会的・政治的関心が確認される。ハンタウイルスは主にスイス・スペイン領域で言及されており、対象国内では確認されていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Congo opens more centers to treat rare virus that killed 110
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo prompts three new treatment centers in Ituri's Bunia as the World Health Organization deploys experts. The rare Bundibugyo strain has killed more than 110 people, with over 118 confirmed deaths and about 300 suspected cases reported in Ituri and North Kivu, and one death and one suspected case in neighboring Uganda. Confirmed cases have appeared in Bunia, Mongbwalu, Butembo, Nyakunde and in Goma, the rebel-held capital of North Kivu, with the first death on April 24 in Bunia and the first case confirmed May 14 (Bundibugyo confirmed May 15). An American doctor treating patients in Bunia, Dr. Peter Stafford, tested positive; seven Americans including him are being moved to Germany for monitoring. The CDC issued travel advisories and a 30-day entry ban for foreign nationals who visited Congo, Uganda or South Sudan. Early testing errors delayed detection, complicating containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ、110人の死亡者が出た稀なウイルスを治療するための治療センターを追加開設
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限既発生）。WPROスクリーニング基準も4項目該当。ブンディブギョ・エボラの東部コンゴ流行は国際対応レベルのシグナル。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス（稀な株）による流行。北キブ州とイトゥリ州で118確定例、約300疑似例。ウガンダでも1確定例1疑似例。米国人医師を含む複数患者がドイツへ移送。CDCが30日間の入国禁止令を発令。初期検査エラーにより検出が遅延。WHOが専門家を派遣。

article.articleHeadline: EUA confirmam primeiro caso de americano infectado pelo vírus Ebola no Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. confirms the first case of an American infected with the Ebola virus in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is confirmed in a United States citizen infected while working in a hospital in Congo. The patient’s identity has not been disclosed, and symptoms began over the weekend of May 17–18, 2026. Five other Americans were exposed and are under monitoring in Africa. The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) states that the risk of spread within the United States is low. This represents the first documented case of an American infected with the Ebola virus in Congo. Authorities are conducting contact tracing and reinforcing infection-control measures in the hospital and surrounding area. The case underscores vigilance for imported infections and cross-border exposure, though no ongoing U.S. transmission is indicated.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がコンゴでエボラウイルスに感染した米国人の初例を確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの確認症例であり、IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）を満たす。また対象国DRCでの発生かつ米国への輸入症例であるため、複数のWPRO基準にも該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは米国での輸入症例と米国市民のコンゴでの感染を報告しており、DRCが疾病発生の主要な地理的焦点である。米国の発生地域リストへの掲載は輸入例の文脈であり、DRCが実際の感染地点である。エボラウイルス疾患の確認例、特に国際的な露出と複数の接触者監視が伴うため、シグナルとしてピックアップが正当化される。

article.articleHeadline: Mỹ chuẩn bị sàng lọc Ebola tại sân bay, một người Mỹ bị nhiễm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. preparing to screen for Ebola at airports, one American infected.
article.articleSummary: WHO declared the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The CDC announced strengthened precautions to prevent cross-border spread, including airport screening for travelers from Uganda, DRC and South Sudan within 21 days and potential entry restrictions for non-U.S. passport holders with recent travel to those countries. The U.S. Embassy in Kampala suspended all U.S. visa services. An American linked to field operations in DRC tested positive for Ebola; symptoms appeared late last weekend and the result was reported on May 16. The patient is being transported to Germany for treatment, and six more Americans are evacuated for health surveillance. DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak has caused about 80 deaths. About 25 Americans work at a U.S. field office there; the CDC is sending a senior technical coordinator. Officials say the immediate risk to the U.S. public remains low, with ongoing monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、空港でのエボラスクリーニング準備、米国人1人感染
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病のPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）宣言、複数国での国際的拡大の具体的リスク、米国人感染例の発生により、IHR基準3項目以上かつWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ発生・拡大が主題であるが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。米国、ドイツ、ウガンダは対象国に含まれないため除外。WHO PHEC宣言、米国人感染、複数国への拡大リスク、国際的な渡航制限実施など、複数のIHR・WPRO基準を満たす重大なシグナル。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Chủ động phòng chống dịch bệnh nguy hiểm xâm nhập
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Proactive Prevention and Control of Dangerous Infectious Diseases Entering the Country.
article.articleSummary: The World Health Organization has raised an international alert for Ebola caused by the Bundibugyo strain, classifying the outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. As of May 16, the DRC’s Ituri Province reports 8 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases, 246 suspected cases, and 80 deaths among those suspected related contacts. Uganda has 2 confirmed cases, with both patients having traveled from Congo, indicating imported infections. Ebola transmits mainly via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids of infected individuals or contaminated items; incubation ranges 2–21 days. Common symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache, muscle and throat pain, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and sometimes hemorrhage. In response, the Ministry of Health urges strengthened surveillance, border screening, enhanced healthcare facility readiness, and public vigilance; returnees from affected areas should seek medical care promptly with symptom onset.

triage.headline_ja: 危険な感染症の国内侵入に対する積極的な予防・防止対策
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）がWHOにより国際的保健上の緊急事態（PHEIC）として宣言されており、IHR基準の4項目全てが該当。DRC及びウガンダでの確定患者・疑い患者の多数報告、国際的な感染拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダの2例は「DRCから渡航してきた輸入感染」と明記されており、ウガンダは対象国リストに未含有のため verified_locations から除外。DRCのIturi州での8例の確定患者、246例の疑い患者、80例の死亡が報告されており、WHOがPHEIC宣言を実施。ベトナム発のニュース報道であるが、評価対象は感染症イベントそのもの。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : les États-Unis renforcent les contrôles sanitaires au...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The United States Strengthens Health Checks at the....
article.articleSummary: Ebola resurges in Central Africa, with the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as a focal point, prompting the United States to strengthen border health checks and impose temporary visa restrictions on travelers from affected areas. The measures follow a confirmed Ebola infection in a U.S. national who contracted the virus during a work assignment in the DRC and was treated after symptom onset, then transferred to a European facility. U.S. health authorities say the immediate population risk remains low but will maintain heightened surveillance and ongoing evaluation. The World Health Organization has declared the resurgence a public health emergency of international concern due to rapid spread and a rising number of suspected cases. The outbreak has resulted in more than 90 deaths and several hundred suspected cases, predominantly among young adults. The U.S. is deploying health personnel to affected regions to bolster surveillance, contact tracing, and diagnostic capacity.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：米国、国境での衛生検査を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。DRCでの流行が確認され、米国での症例報告と国際的拡大のリスクが存在する。
triage.notes: サマリーにはDRCでの流行が主題である。米国の措置は対応策として記述されているが、実際の感染拡大はDRCが中心。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、90人以上の死亡、数百の疑い例が報告されており、緊急性が高い。フルRRA実施を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola risk to Aussies 'still low' as death toll soars
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in central and eastern Africa (Congo and Uganda) continues to escalate, with more than 100 deaths and almost 400 suspected cases since the first case was detected in late April. The World Health Organization has declared a public health emergency of international concern. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo variant, a rare strain for which there are no approved vaccines or therapeutics. Symptoms begin flu-like and rapidly progress to severe vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach pain, rashes, and sometimes internal or external bleeding. The current risk to Australia remains low, though Health Minister Mark Butler says Australia is monitoring the situation very closely because case numbers are rising nearly daily and the strain is not responsive to existing vaccines or treatments. Ebola has never been reported in Australia.

triage.headline_ja: 死者数が急増する中、オーストラリア国民への'エボラ'リスクは'依然低い'
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の大規模流行が中央・東部アフリカで発生し、100名以上の死亡と400近い疑い症例が報告されており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言し、ワクチン/治療法のない稀な変異株（Bundibugyo株）であるため、国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで具体的に言及されている発生国はコンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。オーストラリアは発生地域として列挙されているが、記事本文でリスク評価の対象国として言及されているのみで、実際のエボラ発生地ではないため除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、100+死亡、ワクチン・治療法のない稀な変異株という要素から極めて高いリスク。

article.articleHeadline: US passenger on hantavirus-hit cruise blocked from leaving federal quarantine
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus outbreak onboard the MV Hondius prompted federal quarantine of 18 American passengers, now under observation at the National Quarantine Unit in Omaha, Nebraska. Angela Perryman, 47, and other US travelers exposed to Andes hantavirus—carried by rodents and capable of person-to-person transmission in close contact—have at least three deaths reported on the ship and several more ill. Perryman, who lives in Ecuador and has a Florida home, tested negative and is asymptomatic but faces a mandatory 21-day quarantine in Nebraska, expiring May 31, after arriving a week ago; leaving would risk infection to others, officials say. The order, authorized by CDC acting director Dr. Jay Bhattacharya, allows for a medical review within 72 hours and potential appeal. The National Quarantine Unit has 20 rooms with special air-pressure systems; some passengers previously left the cruise for commercial flights and are being monitored by state health departments. The last federal quarantine occurred in January 2020 for Wuhan evacuees.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス感染の船舶から米国乗客が連邦隔離から出ることを禁止される
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス集団感染による3人以上の死亡、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性、複数国への拡散リスク、および連邦隔離措置の発令により、IHR基準3項目以上該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、重症度）。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは船舶での集団感染を中心に記述。発生地域リストには中国（武漢）が含まれているが、サマリーにおける実際の感染イベントは船舶上（MV Hondius）で発生。米国（ネブラスカ州オマハ）はクルーズ船からの乗客隔離場所であり、イベント発生地ではない。船舶の乗客にはエクアドル在住者も含まれ、国際的な乗客構成を持つ。武漢は2020年COVID-19からの隔離引き比較として言及されているのみで、本イベント発生地ではない。ただし、船舶事案の性質上、複数国への拡散リスクが高く、CDCによる連邦隔離命令が発令されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola watch  --  Thailand stays on high guard against imported cases
article.articleSummary: Thailand maintains heightened Ebola virus disease surveillance to prevent imported infections from countries with ongoing outbreaks, notably the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, after the WHO declared the Bundibugyo outbreak an international emergency. The Department of Disease Control reports Ebola spreads via direct contact with an infected person's blood, bodily fluids or organs, and via contaminated surfaces, with natural animal reservoirs including bats and primates; it is not airborne. Early symptoms include high fever, fatigue, headache, muscle pain and sore throat, potentially followed by diarrhea, vomiting, rash, kidney or liver problems, and bleeding. Incubation is two to 21 days and the disease has a high case-fatality rate. Thailand has not detected any cases, but travellers from DRC, Uganda and other high-risk areas are monitored for 21 days; hospitals screen and investigate suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警戒 — タイは輸入症例に対し厳重態勢を維持
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）。進行中のアウトブレイク国（DRC・ウガンダ）からの輸入症例防止を目的とした積極的な監視体制であり、WHO国際緊急宣言背景を有するため、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC・ウガンダでの進行中アウトブレイクが主題であり、タイは輸入防止体制を構築している状況。Uganda（226074）はBluedot APIが付与しているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。WHO Bundibugyo outbreak国際緊急宣言あり、対象国内での監視強化は重要シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Từ vụ nam bệnh nhân 32 tuổi nhiễm trùng phổi, bác sĩ cảnh báo sai lầm khi dùng điều hòa, nhiều người mắc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Case of a 32-year-old man with pneumonia prompts doctors to warn against misusing air conditioning; many people infected.
article.articleSummary: Case in Wuhan, China involves a 32-year-old man hospitalized after three days of continuous air conditioner use following six months of non-use. He presented with high fever, myalgia, and dry cough, later developing chest tightness and dyspnea. CT revealed a focal left-lung infection; laboratory tests confirmed Legionella pneumonia (Legionnaires' disease). Health authorities warn this deadly infection can progress rapidly to respiratory failure if not treated promptly. The risk arises when a poorly maintained AC system—accumulated dust, dead skin cells, moisture and residues in filters, evaporator, fans, and drip tray—suddenly disperses contaminated aerosols when switched on. Elderly, children, pregnant women, and immunocompromised individuals are especially at risk. Experts recommend thorough, internal cleaning of units (not just outer filters) before first use; periodic disinfection; open windows to ventilate 15 minutes after 2-3 hours of operation; keep room around 26°C and avoid direct cold air; avoid prolonged sealed indoor cooling. Many people infected.

triage.headline_ja: 武漢の32歳男性が肺炎で入院、医師がエアコン誤使用の警告。多くの人が感染
triage.triage_reason: レジオネラ菌肺炎の集団発生が報告され、中国（武漢）で複数患者が確認されている。重症度が高く（呼吸不全進展の危険性）、人口密集地での拡大リスク、公衆衛生への重大な影響が考えられるため、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに『多くの人が感染』との明記があり、単一症例ではなく集団発生の可能性が高い。武漢はCOVID-19パンデミックの発生地でもあり、感染症サーベイランスの関心も高い。ただし『多くの人が感染』の具体的な患者数が記載されていないため、全体として不明な点が残る。WUHAN地域での局地的拡大の可能性を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Warga AS Tertular Ebola di Kongo, Skrining di Bandara Diperketat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American citizen contracted Ebola in Congo, airport screening tightened.
article.articleSummary: An American citizen has contracted Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) after occupational exposure at a U.S. field office in the DRC. The patient developed symptoms over the weekend and tested positive on Sunday night; plans are underway to relocate the individual to Germany for treatment. CDC officials are evacuating six more people for health monitoring and will deploy a senior technical coordinator as about 25 U.S. staff work in the DRC field office. The CDC says direct risk to the U.S. public remains low but will be reassessed as more information becomes available. In response, airport screening has tightened and entry is restricted for non-U.S. passport holders who traveled to Uganda, the DRC, or South Sudan in the past 21 days. The U.S. Embassy in Kampala has suspended visa services. The WHO has declared Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: 米国民がコンゴでエボラに感染、空港スクリーニング強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確定患者発生（米国職員の職業曝露による感染）、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、国際的な移動制限・スクリーニング強化が実施されており、IHR基準3項目以上該当、WPRO基準複数項目該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは米国職員のDRCでの感染が主題。ウガンダ、南スーダンは渡航制限の対象地域として言及されているのみで、実際の患者発生地はDRCが確認される。WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。ドイツへの治療搬送計画により国際的な対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: COE aponta que houve 8.655 notificações de Chikungunya com 3.948 confirmações
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COE notes that there were 8,655 Chikungunya case notifications, with 3,948 confirmations.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya remains a public health concern in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil. As of May 18, 2026, the Center for Public Health Emergency Operations (COE) reported 8,655 notifications: 5,146 probable and 3,509 confirmed, with a 52.9% test-positivity rate, signaling intense transmission in both the urban area and the Dourados Indigenous Reserve. The epidemiological bulletin will be issued three times weekly (Mondays, Wednesdays, Fridays) to improve notification detail and national data input. In the Indigenous population, 3,189 cases were notified: 2,420 probable, 2,121 confirmed, 769 discarded, and 299 under investigation. Hospitalizations total 28 beds occupied, down from a peak of 52; Porta da Esperança Indigenous Hospital has no inpatients, while HU-UFGD holds 19 beds, Regional Hospital 1, Unimed 2, Vida 3, and Mackenzie 3. Deaths: 11 confirmed (9 Indigenous, 2 non-Indigenous) and 3 under investigation, including a 12-year-old Indigenous child, an 84-year-old non-Indigenous with coronary artery disease, and a 50-year-old man with no chronic diseases who died in the emergency department on 27/04/2026.

triage.headline_ja: COEはチクングニアの8,655件の通知と3,948件の確認を指摘
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでチクングニアの大規模な流行が発生しており、確認症例数が多く、死亡者が報告されている。IHR基準（重症度、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）を複数満たし、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象国ではなく、アメリカ地域に属するが、チクングニア流行の規模・重症度からシグナルとして識別。確認症例3,948件、死亡者11名（うち9名は先住民）、特に先住民人口での感染が深刻。持続的な人-蚊-人感染が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Gia Phú: Ứng dụng công nghệ số, nâng cao chăn nuôi an toàn sinh học và giám sát dịch bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gia Phú: Applying digital technology to enhance biosecure livestock farming and disease surveillance.
article.articleSummary: Gia Phu Commune, in collaboration with the Vietnam National Institute of Livestock and Veterinary Medicine, carried out a biosecure livestock farming and disease-surveillance program for 56 households across 12 hamlets (Tan Loi, Hop Giao, Chan, Hung Xuan 1-2, Cu Ha, Mo, Muong 1-2, Giao Binh, Vang, Peo). The initiative delivered training on biosecure husbandry and disease-prevention barriers, and piloted digital livestock management tools, including a mobile app for remote technical consultations and enhanced surveillance. Biological samples from cattle, pigs, and chickens were collected for laboratory screening to detect infectious diseases and zoonoses. Feedback interviews assessed farmers' awareness and practices to tailor future support. Led by the Vietnam Institute of Livestock and Veterinary Medicine and Gia Phu Commune's Center for General Services, the program seeks to expand to more households and strengthen regional disease control and biosecurity, aligning with sustainable local development.

triage.headline_ja: ジアフー：デジタル技術を応用した生物安全性畜産と疾病監視
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は動物疾病監視プログラムの実施報告であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク、異常な疾病発生、または公衆衛生危機を報告していない。IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症シグナルではなく、予防的な畜産衛生プログラムの実施報告である。疾病サーベイランス能力の強化を目的とした能力構築活動であり、実際の患者や動物の疾病発生、異常事象の報告ではない。「Unknown Illness」というカテゴリで拾われているが、記事内容に具体的な疾患名や患者報告はなく、シグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: El nuevo brote del ébola es un peligro real y la culpa es de Trump y Kennedy: cerraron el laboratorio que podría frenarlo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The new Ebola outbreak is a real threat, and the blame lies with Trump and Kennedy: they shut down the laboratory that could contain it.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri, DR Congo, with about 350 cases and 89 deaths; two cases detected in Uganda and one in South Sudan. The Bundibugro variant has no licensed vaccines or treatments; Zaire-based vaccines are unlikely to help. WHO has declared an international public health emergency, urging coordinated action, enhanced surveillance, funding, and equitable access to treatments. Bundibugyo fatality is estimated at 20–30%, lower than Zaire’s ~75%. Critical research capacity rests on the US NIAID Integrated Research Center, one of a few facilities able to study Ebola, which was shut down last year by Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. The CDC has relocated a small number of Americans and activated Title 42 for 30 days. Europe’s ECDC says Europe faces very low transmission risk for now.

triage.headline_ja: 新型エボラの流行は現実的な危険であり、その責任はトランプとケネディーにある：彼らが流行を抑制できる研究所を閉鎖した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常なBundibugyo変異体、複数国への国際的拡大、渡航制限実施中）。WHOが国際的公衆衛生緊急事態を宣言しており、スクリーニング基準も全て満たす。
triage.notes: 記事では、コンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州）での約350症例および89人の死亡、ウガンダおよび南スーダンでの確認が述べられている。WPROスクリーニング対象国としてはDRCのみが該当。国際的公衆衛生緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言済み。Bundibugyo変異体は標準的なザイール型ワクチン効果が限定的であることが指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: อีโบลาสายพันธุ์หายากระบาดหนักในแอฟริกา ดับแล้วกว่า 100 ราย มีคนอเมริกันป่วยด้วย | เดลินิวส์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rare Ebola strain triggers major outbreak in Africa; more than 100 have died, with Americans among the infected.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugy oeblovirus outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda have killed at least 105 people and infected nearly 400 since first confirmation on 15 May 2026. Most fatalities occur in the DRC amid an ongoing outbreak; the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern because there was no vaccine or officially approved therapy for this strain, though vaccines are now available to help control it. The U.S. CDC confirms at least one American from a missionary group in the DRC has been infected, with arrangements to transfer the patient to Germany for treatment. Incubation is 2–21 days; early symptoms resemble influenza (fever, headache, fatigue) and can progress to vomiting, diarrhea, organ failure, and bleeding. Bundibugyo outbreaks previously occurred in 2007 and 2015 with about a 30% fatality rate; the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak remains the largest on record (28,600 cases, >11,300 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: アフリカで稀なエボラ株が大流行、100人以上が死亡、アメリカ人も感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つすべて満たす。Bundibugy oeblovirus（ブンディブギョウイボウイルス）は新興感染症で、致命率が高く、既にPHEIC宣言されており、複数国での急速な拡大と国際的な患者移送が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはBundibugy oeblovirusのアウトブレイクについて述べており、DRCとウガンダでの発生が主題である。しかし対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。見出しに「Influenza」とタグ付けされているが、実際の疾患はBundibugy oeblovirus（エボラウイルスの一種）で、既にWHOがPHEIC宣言している。105人以上の死亡、約400人の感染、複数国への拡大、アメリカ市民の感染と国際的な医療移送が確認されている極めて危機的な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Estados Unidos restringió el ingreso de viajeros de algunos países por el brote de ébola en África central
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States restricted the entry of travelers from several countries due to the Ebola outbreak in Central Africa
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa prompts U.S. entry restrictions for travelers who passed through the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the last 21 days; a 30-day Title 42 ban with military and diplomatic staff exemptions. WHO declares international health emergency. A U.S. worker exposed in the DRC tested positive and will be treated in Germany; six others evacuated for medical observation. CDC expands contact tracing, testing, and hospital readiness; ~25 staff are in the DRC field office, with plans to deploy a senior technical coordinator. Immediate U.S. risk is low, though measures may adapt. The outbreak began in late April, centered on Mongwalu and Rwampara near Uganda/South Sudan. Congolese authorities report ~350 suspected cases and 91 deaths; WHO counts 88. Uganda reports two Kampala cases (one death); South Sudan one case in Western Equatoria; no vaccine or specific treatment for this strain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の中央アフリカでの流行により、米国が複数国からの渡航者の入国を制限
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な流行で、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。複数国での確認、死亡例、国際的渡航制限措置が実施されており、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは発生地域がDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンと記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ・南スーダンは対象国外のため除外。米国の渡航制限措置は国際的な関心を示す証拠だが、発生地域は中央アフリカ。WHO緊急宣言、複数死亡例、複数国での確認が重大性を示す。

article.articleHeadline: WHO cảnh báo dấu hiệu bùng phát nguy hiểm của Ebola và vi rút Hanta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Warns of Dangerous Signs of Ebola and Hantavirus Outbreaks
article.articleSummary: On May 18, during the WHO annual assembly in Geneva, Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned of a new Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the International Health Regulations Emergency declared last weekend, and reported a rare hantavirus case on the cruise ship MV Hondius. Health authorities in the DRC and Uganda are attempting to contain Ebola outbreaks, underscoring growing infectious-disease risks amid climate crisis and armed conflict. Experts warn that global readiness to respond to outbreaks is waning. This week WHO plans an emergency scientific consultation to synthesize current knowledge on the Ebola virus and identify priorities for vaccine, diagnostics, and therapeutics development.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラウイルスおよびハンタウイルスアウトブレイクの危険な兆候について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスの新規アウトブレイク（DRC）、国際保健規則上の緊急事態宣言、複数国での感染拡大リスク、国際的な関心の高さから、フルRRA対象
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはWHO総会（ジュネーブ開催）の時点での報道。エボラウイルスの新規アウトブレイクはDRCで報告、国際保健規則上の緊急事態宣言済み。ハンタウイルス症例はクルーズ船での報告（地理的なシグナル源ではなく事象の位置）。DRCおよびウガンダでの封じ込め努力が記載されているが、対象国リストにはウガンダが含まれていないため verified_locations にはDRCのみを含める。ジュネーブ（スイス）での会議開催は背景情報であり、アウトブレイク発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 我驻安哥拉大使馆提醒：重视霍乱、埃博拉疫情，发现症状尽早诊治
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Chinese Embassy in Angola reminds you to pay attention to cholera and Ebola outbreaks and to seek prompt diagnosis and treatment if symptoms appear.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Icolo and Bengo Province, Angola, resurges with deaths amid increased rainfall. In eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola has reached 336 cases and 87 deaths as of May 16, with cross-border spread; on May 17, the World Health Organization declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The Chinese Embassy in Angola reiterates vigilance on cholera and urges prompt diagnosis and treatment if symptoms appear, alongside ongoing hygiene and food safety measures. It also advises people to avoid travelling to high-risk Ebola areas, to avoid contact with wildlife, and to avoid meat from unknown sources, while acquiring knowledge about Ebola to reduce risk.

triage.headline_ja: 中国駐アンゴラ大使館が注意喚起：コレラとエボラ出血熱の流行に警戒を、症状が出た場合は早期診断治療を
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱がWHOの国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）と宣言され、336症例・87死亡を記録。アンゴラではコレラが流行。IHR基準を複数満たし、国際的影響が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではアンゴラのコレラとコンゴ民主共和国のエボラが主題だが、対象国リストではDRCのみに該当。アンゴラはサハラ以南アフリカで発生しているが対象国に含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。WHOがPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）している点で国際的関心が極めて高い。エボラウイルス病は致死率が高く、既に87死亡が報告されており重症度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: TP.HCM khẩn trương ngăn chặn nguy cơ dịch Ebola xâm nhập
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City Urgently Prevents the Risk of an Ebola Outbreak Entering
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City on May 19 tightened border surveillance to prevent Ebola (Bundibugyo strain) from entering Vietnam, following WHO’s May 17 declaration that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda is a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The city’s health authority will bolster screening at airports, seaports, and land crossings, assess travel histories, and coordinate with aviation, maritime, and international health quarantine units to rapidly identify suspected cases and arrange isolation and safe transport. Early detection of suspected cases is deemed essential. WHO recommends a 21-day monitoring period for close contacts and temporary restrictions on international travel during this period; discharge of confirmed cases requires two consecutive negative tests at least 48 hours apart. Guidance varies by risk: outbreak countries should activate disaster response and border controls; neighboring states should heighten border readiness; countries without shared borders need not close borders or restrict travel.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市がエボラ出血熱流行のベトナム流入リスクを緊急に防止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みのエボラ出血熱流行に対応した対象国での防疫強化であり、フルRRAへ進む必要がある。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）済みのエボラ出血熱流行。発生地域にはホーチミン市（ベトナム）とDRC・ウガンダが含まれているが、サマリーの主題はベトナムがDRC・ウガンダでの流行からの流入防止対策であるため、実際の発生地はDRCとウガンダ。ベトナムは防疫強化中の国として記録。Bundibugyo株のエボラ出血熱という高リスク病原体。

article.articleHeadline: US bans entry to foreigners travelling from Africa after American contracts Ebola
article.articleSummary: As of 19 May 2026, Bundibugyo virus, an Ebola-related pathogen, is driving an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. The World Health Organization formally declared the outbreak an international emergency on Sunday. Four healthcare workers have died; authorities warn the outbreak may have been spreading undetected for more than three weeks, with evidence suggesting a much larger outbreak than currently detected. Africa CDC director-general Dr. Jean Kaseya said patient zero has not been identified, leaving the true magnitude unknown. The virus is highly contagious, heightening fears amid heavy cross-border movement and migration in the region. The article notes a policy response: the United States has banned entry for foreigners traveling from Africa. No vaccine exists for Bundibugyo virus.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ患者発生後にアフリカからの入国者を禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際的緊急事態、渡航制限措置実施）。複数国での流行拡大、致死例、WHOによる国際緊急事態宣言、政策対応が発生。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo virus（エボラ関連病原体）の流行。DRCが主要発生地域。ウガンダへの拡大言及があるが、対象国リストにはウガンダが含まれていないため除外。WHOによる国際緊急事態宣言（PHEIC）、米国の渡航制限措置、複数死亡者、ワクチン不在、患者ゼロ未特定による不確実性が重大な懸念。フルリスク評価（RRA）への進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Confirman caso de ébola en estadounidense proveniente de África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola case confirmed in a U.S. citizen from Africa.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola case has been confirmed in a U.S. citizen in Trenton, New Jersey, linked to work in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reported the positive result and activated international isolation protocols immediately. The patient began experiencing symptoms over the past weekend, with laboratory confirmation on Sunday night, according to Satish Pillai, head of the agency’s Ebola response incidents. The development prompted preventive measures and alerts within specialist teams monitoring affected zones in Africa, reflecting ongoing surveillance for the disease. As of May 19, 2026, authorities continue to manage the case with rapid isolation and monitoring to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカから渡来した米国市民のエボラ出血熱感染が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、かつエボラ出血熱という高危険病原体による事例のため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、患者は民主共和国コンゴでの業務に関連する感染を示唆。米国内での事例報告であるが、感染源がDRCであるため verified_locations に DRC のみを記載。エボラ出血熱は IHR(2005) Annex2 リスト掲載疾患であり、国際通知義務あり。

article.articleHeadline: 世衛警告無疫苗，此次埃博拉疫情會否全球流行？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Warns There Is No Vaccine: Will This Ebola Outbreak Become a Global Pandemic?
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports a Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in Ituri Province near the Uganda border, with potential weeks of community transmission before detection. By May 17, 2026, 10 laboratory-confirmed cases and 336 suspected cases were recorded, with 88 deaths; BBC later cited over 80 deaths and more than 300 suspected infections. WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 17, emphasizing slow local response, scarce medical resources, and cross-border risk to Uganda, Rwanda, and South Sudan; Uganda has reported imported cases. The Bundibugyo strain is rare, and there is no licensed vaccine or specific antibody therapy for it; most vaccines/therapies target the Zaire strain. Management relies on isolation and supportive care (fluids, electrolytes, blood pressure, oxygen, infection control). Diagnostic capacity lagging due to assays focused on Zaire strain, delaying recognition. The outbreak’s trajectory depends on surveillance, containment, and international support across neighboring countries."

triage.headline_ja: WHOが警告：ワクチンなし、今回のエボラ感染症は世界流行となるか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当、かつWPRO基準5項目全て該当。Bundibugyo株のエボラ出血熱で、DRCで336疑似症例・88死亡、ウガンダで輸入症例確認、WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。ワクチン・特異的治療なく、越境感染リスク高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにDRC（対象国）での発生が明記されている。ウガンダ・ルワンダ・南スーダンでの越境リスク・輸入症例言及があるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。Bundibugyo株は稀で、ワクチン・特異的治療なし。医療資源不足、検査能力遅延が指摘される。WHOのPHEIC宣言により、国際的危機管理対象となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Американский миссионер заразился вирусом Эбола в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American missionary contracted the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, U.S. missionary Peter Stafford has tested positive for Ebola virus, specifically Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with symptoms consistent with the disease. The case follows WHO’s earlier declaration of a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for Congo and neighboring Uganda due to cross-border spread. In Kampala, Uganda, two laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases were reported among people who had travelled from Congo, with one death. WHO recommends rapid isolation of infected individuals, thorough contact tracing, and movement restrictions for contacts up to 21 days, while advising against complete border closures or broad trade limitations to avoid illicit crossings. The report underscores ongoing international transmission risk linked to Congo’s outbreak and the need for vigilant surveillance and containment measures in the region as of May 19, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ人宣教師がコンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）の確定症例があり、DRCとウガンダで国際的な拡大が既に報告されており、WHO緊急事態宣言が発令されている。
triage.notes: DRCとウガンダに関して報告があるが、対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。2026年5月19日の記事で、WHO PHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）が既に宣言されており、確定死亡例と複数国での症例が報告されているため、高度な優先度でのシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: कङ्गोमा इबोला प्रकोप: मृत्यु हुनेको सङ्ख्या १ सय जना पुग्यो
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo: death toll reaches 100.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed at least 100 people with over 390 suspected cases. The strain is Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there are no approved treatments or vaccines. Uganda reports two infections and one death related to the outbreak. An American physician affiliated with a missionary group has tested positive and will be treated in Germany, according to the US CDC. CBS News notes at least six American citizens have had exposure, though exact numbers awaiting public disclosure. The World Health Organization has declared an international emergency for this Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak. The United States has issued a Level 4 travel advisory for Congo, with enhanced contact tracing, expanded testing, hospital readiness, and entry restrictions for travelers who visited Uganda, DRC, or South Sudan within the past 21 days; evacuees may be housed at a German U.S. military camp.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行：死者数が100人に達した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（100人以上の死者、390件以上の疑似症例）、Bundibugyo型という比較的稀な株、複数国への国際的な拡大（ウガンダ、米国、ドイツでの症例）、WHOによる国際保健上の緊急事態宣言、米国によるレベル4渡航勧告発出により、極めて高いリスク評価。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドには米国、スーダン、ドイツ、ウガンダも含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は民主共和国コンゴでの発生地であり、他国（米国、ドイツ）は感染者の治療受入地または対応国として言及されているのみ。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみのため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダも対象国リストには含まれていないため除外。2次感染国ではなく、発生地の明確な特定が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, Usa effettueranno test a viaggiatori da paesi colpiti. Trump, per ora confinata in Africa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: U.S. will test travelers from affected countries. Trump, for now confined to Africa.
article.articleSummary: U.S. strengthens Ebola measures, implementing airport health screenings for travelers from affected areas and temporarily suspending visa issuance, per the CDC. With the WHO declaring the Congo Ebola outbreak a global health emergency, the CDC says immediate risk to Americans is low but may adjust public health measures as information evolves. Entry restrictions also apply to foreign nationals who have traveled in Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, or South Sudan within the past 21 days. A U.S. physician is among the cases confirmed in Congo’s outbreak caused by a rare Ebola virus variant with no vaccines or approved therapies; Dr. Jean-Jacques Muyembe, director of INRB, notes the patient is in Bunia, Ituri Province. CBS News reports at least six Americans exposed; one U.S. citizen tested positive in the DRC. President Trump says the outbreak is currently confined to Africa despite a rising situation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：米国が影響を受けた国からの旅行者に検査を実施。トランプ大統領は当面アフリカに限定されていると述べる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが世界保健上の緊急事態を宣言したコンゴのエボラアウトブレイクである。国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限、および複数国への影響が確認されている。
triage.notes: 米国内での確認事例（医師および市民1名の陽性確認）が報告されているが、記事サマリーの主題はコンゴでのアウトブレイクである。ウガンダとスーダンは渡航制限の対象として言及されているが、アウトブレイク発生地として明確に記述されていないため verified_locations に含めない。WHOが世界保健上の緊急事態を宣言した点は極めて重要。ワクチンおよび承認された治療法が存在しない稀なエボラウイルス変異体による。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola treatment centres open in Congo as WHO sends team
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri and North Kivu) prompts three new Ebola treatment centres in Ituri. The World Health Organization has dispatched a team of experts and declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. As of Monday, at least 118 deaths and 300 suspected cases have been reported in Ituri and North Kivu, with one death and one suspected case in neighboring Uganda. The Bundibugjo (Bundibugyo) strain has spread undetected for weeks; early tests focused on the Zaire strain, yielding false negatives and delaying response. Confirmed regional cases include Bunia, Mongbwalu, Butembo, Nyakunde, and Goma. An American doctor, Dr Peter Stafford, treating patients in Bunia, is among the infected; seven Americans are being transported to Germany for monitoring. There are no approved vaccines or medicines for Bundibugyo Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ治療センターがコンゴで開設、WHOがチームを派遣
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。ブンディブギョエボラウイルスの国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態で、死亡者118名、疑い患者300名、WHOがPHEIC宣言。ウガンダへの国境越え事例もあり、国際的拡大リスク高い。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョエボラウイルス株による大規模流行。WHOはPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言済み。ウガンダへの越境事例あり。米国人医師を含む複数国籍の患者がドイツに搬送予定。ワクチン・治療薬なし。北キブ州・イトゥリ州での複数地点での確認症例あり。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果（金）埃博拉疫情擴散　116例疑似病例死亡 - 香港文匯網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; 116 suspected cases have died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is expanding from Ituri Province to North Kivu Province. The government reports 116 suspected deaths and 435 suspected cases under observation and treatment, with laboratory testing and epidemiological investigations ongoing to confirm links to Ebola. As of May 15, nationwide 80 deaths, including four laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases. On May 17, the World Health Organization declared the Congo-Uganda Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Neighboring Rwanda, Zambia, and Tanzania have intensified border health surveillance, entry screening, and preparedness. Ebola presents with fever, bleeding, and multiorgan failure, and carries a high fatality rate of 50–90%; transmission occurs via contact with blood, bodily fluids, secretions, excreta, or infected animals. Uganda reported an imported fatal case, highlighting cross-border transmission risks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疫情が拡散　116例の疑似病例が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが国際保健上の懸念事項を宣言し、複数国での確認と国境を越えた感染が報告されている。
triage.notes: WHOが2026年5月17日にコンゴ・ウガンダエボラ疫情をPHEIC（国際保健上の懸念事項）と宣言。ウガンダでの輸入症例確認により、対象国リストに含まれるDRCおよびZambiaで実際のイベント発生が確認される。ルワンダ、タンザニア、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。死亡率50-90%で致命率が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: 백신·치료제 없다...'분디부조 에볼라' 초기식별 실패해 위기 | 연합뉴스
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There are no vaccines or treatments... Bundibugyo ebolavirus: early identification failure leads to crisis
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) is fueling an outbreak in Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. BDBV, one of four Ebola species causing human disease, has no approved vaccines or treatments. Transmission occurs via contact with blood, body fluids, or contaminated objects, endangering healthcare workers and funeral attendees. Early symptoms resemble influenza, with fever, fatigue, headache, and sore throat, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, bleeding, and multi-organ failure. Fatality rate 30–40%, lower than Zaire EBOV (~90%), but slower replication delays diagnosis. Incubation is typically 8–10 days, up to three weeks. Diagnostic tests exist but are not widely used; initial cases were misidentified as EBOV, delaying response. The first suspicion appeared April 24; a nurse in Bunia, Ituri Province, died after three days; DRC declared the 17th outbreak on May 15. Cross-border spread, towns, cultural practices, and rebel-controlled cities like Goma hinder control; aid cuts worsen challenges. Origin has spread 700 km.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチン・治療薬なし…『ブンディブギョ・エボラ』初期特定失敗が危機招く
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、スクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラウイルス（BDBV）の多国間アウトブレイク、高い致死率、国境越え拡大、医療体制の脆弱性が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのアウトブレイクが述べられているが、対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるため verified_locations はDRCのみとした。ウガンダは対象国に含まれていない。Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV)は致死率30-40%、ワクチン・治療薬なし、初期診断の遅れ、国境越え拡大（700km）が報告されている。医療従事者と葬儀参列者への高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Centre closely monitoring Ebola situation in Central Africa; Public health measures being strengthened: Sources
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease caused by Bundibugyo strain is spreading in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province) and Uganda, with the WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. India’s Union Ministry of Health reports no confirmed cases and minimal risk, but is strengthening surveillance and preparedness at entry points. Preparedness measures include revised SOPs for screening, surveillance, quarantine, and case management; enhanced laboratory readiness with NIV Pune designated for testing and additional labs onboarding; coordinated monitoring of international travel from affected regions; and readiness of isolation and quarantine facilities at major airports and ports. Public reassurance is stressed; no panic. Dr. NK Arora highlights nearly 100 Ebola deaths in eastern Congo’s Ituri and underscores vigilant One Health surveillance to monitor animal-to-human transmission and support rapid response.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカのエボラ状況を厳密に監視；公衆衛生対策を強化：情報筋
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo株によるエボラウイルス病がDRC（Ituri州）とウガンダで拡大し、WHO PHEIC宣言され、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。インドは検査体制強化と国境での監視を実施中で、国際的な対応が必要な状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから：DRC（Ituri州）およびウガンダでBundibugyo株エボラが確認され、WHOがPHEIC宣言。インドは確定患者なし・最小リスクだが、検査体制（NIV Pune）、空港・港での隔離施設、入国地点での監視体制を強化中。対象国リストからはインドとDRCのみverified_locationsに含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola, hantavirus y una histórica crisis: Lo que se juega el mundo en la Asamblea de la OMS 2026 - El Imparcial de Oaxaca
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, hantavirus and a historic crisis: What’s at stake for the world at the 2026 World Health Assembly - El Imparcial de Oaxaca
article.articleSummary: The World Health Organization opened its 79th World Health Assembly in Geneva, Switzerland, on May 18, 2026, amid geopolitical strain and funding pressures. New health alerts dominate the backdrop: an Ebola outbreak detected in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, triggering renewed emergency protocols, and a hantavirus alert tied to a cruise drawing attention despite not being on the main agenda. Beyond infectious threats, uncertainty looms over whether the United States and Argentina will exit the WHO, potentially reshaping global health leadership. UN Secretary-General António Guterres delivered a video appeal highlighting the consequences of shrinking international resources and drastic cuts to health aid. The assembly aims to define strategies to contain active outbreaks while securing sufficient financing to protect developing countries from future pandemics.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、ハンタウイルスと歴史的危機：2026年WHO世界保健総会で世界が直面する問題
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで新規に検出されており、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響（死亡リスク高）、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクに該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行リスク・管理可能性で複数該当。国際保健当局の注視対象。
triage.notes: 記事はWHO世界保健総会の政治的背景を扱っているが、実際の感染症イベント（エボラ爆発）はDRC発生と明記されている。ハンタウイルスに関してはクルーズ船関連で言及されているが、具体的な発生地域・影響が不明確なため検証対象外。エボラのDRC発生が主な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Alarma en EEUU: Negarán ingreso a viajeros de estos tres países tras confirmarse primer estadounidense contagiado con ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US on alert: Entry will be denied to travelers from these three countries after the first American infected with Ebola is confirmed.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the United States announced a 30-day entry suspension for non-U.S. passport holders traveling from or through Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and South Sudan within the previous 21 days, under Title 42; exemptions apply to U.S. military, diplomatic staff, and families. The move follows the World Health Organization declaring the Ebola outbreak in the DRC a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, and aims to curb importation risk while risk assessments are conducted. A U.S. citizen working in the DRC has contracted Ebola, developing symptoms over the weekend and testing positive Sunday night. The patient will be evacuated to Germany for specialized treatment, with six other individuals evacuated for strict monitoring. In the DRC, 11 confirmed Ebola cases, 336 suspected, and 88 deaths, with the outbreak centered in Mongwalu and Rwampara health zones near Uganda and South Sudan, where population movement is high.

triage.headline_ja: 米国が警戒態勢：初の米国人エボラ感染確認後、3か国からの旅行者の入国を拒否へ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みで、米国市民の感染確認と渡航制限実施という国際的対応が既に開始されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはRwanda、Uganda、Sudan、Germany、USAも含まれているが、サマリーの主題は『DRCでの発症が米国市民に及び、米国が渡航制限を実施した』という状況であり、実感染症イベントの発生地はDRCのみ。WHOのPHEIC宣言が既にされており、重大性と国際的関心が非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO declares Ebola outbreak an emergency as CDC restricts travel, infected US doctor confirms - ExBulletin
article.articleSummary: WHO designates the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda as a public health emergency of international concern. It involves Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD), a strain with a 25–50% fatality rate and no vaccine or specific treatment. So far, at least 100 deaths and over 390 suspected cases have been reported, with true counts likely higher. The first known patient died on April 24; the outbreak was declared May 15 after initial laboratory tests misidentified the strain, potentially enabling spread during funeral rites. WHO notes unusual community deaths with BVD symptoms in Ituri and at least four healthcare worker deaths, signaling nosocomial transmission risks and gaps in infection control. In the United States, CDC imposed a Title 42 order barring most non-U.S. entrants with recent exposure to DRC, South Sudan, or Uganda for 30 days, and DRC travel remains level four. A U.S. doctor, Peter Stafford, treated in Bunia, tested positive and was evacuated to Germany; seven more Americans were evacuated. Travelers are advised to avoid contact with the sick and report symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、CDCが渡航制限を課す中、エボラ感染症を緊急事態と宣言、感染した米国医師が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo virus disease）の国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言であり、高い致死率（25-50%）、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限が既に実施されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUSA、Germany、Sudan、Ugandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は DRC（Ituri州Bunia市）でのエボラアウトブレークであり、対象国リストに DRC のみが含まれる。米国の医師がドイツで治療を受けたのは二次的な情報。WHO による PHEIC 宣言と CDC による Title 42 渡航制限命令が既に発令されている。

article.articleHeadline: الولايات المتحدة تشدد القيود على السفر لمنع دخول فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States tightens travel restrictions to prevent the entry of the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: On May 18, 2026, the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention announced tightened travel restrictions to curb entry of Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus amid an East-Central Africa outbreak. Non-US passport holders who have been in Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, or South Sudan within the previous 21 days face entry limits. The CDC will bolster general health screening, traveler monitoring, airline and international partner coordination, and border-point controls; enhance port health activities, contact tracing, laboratory testing capacity, and national hospital preparedness; and deploy staff to support containment in affected areas. As of Monday, 11 confirmed and 336 suspected cases, including 88 deaths, have been reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo; 2 confirmed cases, including 1 death, in Uganda. Symptoms include fever, headache, vomiting, weakness, abdominal pain, epistaxis, and hematemesis. There is no vaccine; treatment is supportive. U.S. risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラウイルスの侵入防止のため渡航制限を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）による東中央アフリカの流行に関連する多国間事象であり、IHR基準4項目すべてが該当する（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の地域での発生、国際的拡大リスク、複数国による渡航制限実施）。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは複数国（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）が言及されているが、確認情報は主にDRCおよびウガンダから報告されている。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当する（ウガンダ、南スーダン、米国は対象国リストに含まれない）。エボラ流行は公衆衛生上の重大な脅威であり、米国の渡航制限は国際的な懸念の高さを示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: 视频丨非洲暴发埃博拉疫情 刚果（金）已有91例疑似死亡病例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video | Ebola outbreak erupts in Africa; the Democratic Republic of the Congo already has 91 suspected deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) with Uganda also affected. On May 17, 2026, WHO declared this event a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) but not a pandemic under the IHR. The DRC reports about 350 suspected cases and 91 suspected deaths, predominantly among people aged 20–39. Early symptoms mimic influenza and malaria, leading to misdiagnosis; the infection source remains unconfirmed. DRC Health Minister Kamba says hospitals are stretched, with 59 patients under care and three new treatment centers being established. This is the third Bundibugyo outbreak, previously seen in Uganda’s Bundibugyo region (2007–2008) and northern DRC’s Isiro; Africa CDC notes higher fatality and no vaccine or specific therapy yet. Surveillance and response are being intensified, including vaccine/drug development and protection for frontline workers. At least six Americans have been exposed; CDC is coordinating safe evacuations, while Germany updated travel advisories for DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: ビデオ | アフリカでエボラ疫病が発生；コンゴ民主共和国はすでに91例の疑い死亡例を有する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WHO PHEIC宣言済みの高優先度事象。フルRRA進行を推奨。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダの影響も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCはバンディブギオエボラウイルスの集団発生で約350例の疑い患者、91例の死亡を報告。WHO PHEIC宣言済み（パンデミックではない）。ワクチンや特異的治療法がまだない状況下での国際的な対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Prvý nakazený Američan a stopka pre tri štáty. USA čelia hrozbe eboly, na ktorú niet vakcíny | Info.sk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The first infected American and a ban on three states. The USA faces the Ebola threat, for which there is no vaccine
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the United States imposes extraordinary security and travel restrictions to curb Ebola spread after the World Health Organization declared a public health emergency due to an outbreak in Central Africa. The Ebola strain involved has no approved vaccine. A single U.S. citizen, who worked in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, developed symptoms over the weekend and tested positive on Sunday night; he is being evacuated to Germany for specialized treatment, and six additional individuals from the region are being evacuated for health monitoring. A ban applies to non-U.S. passport holders who have visited Uganda, the DRC, or South Sudan in the prior 21 days. The CDC says immediate risk to Americans is low. The State Department has allocated $13 million in humanitarian aid to the outbreak epicenter. Critics note the measures coincide with Washington’s withdrawal from WHO and cuts to USAID.

triage.headline_ja: 最初の感染したアメリカ人と3つの州への禁止。USA はワクチンのないエボラの脅威に直面している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病の多国間アウトブレイク、WHOによる公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、渡航制限措置が実施されており、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではエボラの発生地がCentral Africaおよび民主共和国コンゴであると述べられている。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ（203312）。南スーダン（Sudan）はサマリーで言及されているが対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。米国およびドイツへの患者移送は対象国外でのインシデント。WHOの公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、ワクチン未開発、複数国での渡航制限、多数の避難措置が確認され、全IHR基準および全WPROスクリーニング基準に該当する高リスクシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Estados Unidos restringe entradas desde El Congo, Uganda y Sudán del Sur por el brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States restricts entry from the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan due to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: United States restricts entry from Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and South Sudan due to an Ebola outbreak. Starting May 18, 2026 for 30 days under Title 42, the ban targets travelers without U.S. passports who have traveled from or through these countries within the prior 21 days; exemptions apply to U.S. military personnel, diplomatic staff and their families. The measure aims to reduce Ebola importation and enable risk assessment. U.S. health authorities are coordinating with airlines and border agencies, bolstering port health, contact tracing, laboratory testing capacity, and hospital preparedness nationwide. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the outbreak has caused 116 deaths to date, with transmission beginning in late April. The virus is currently concentrated in Mongwalu and Rwampara health zones, areas with substantial population movement near Uganda and South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ流行に対しコンゴ、ウガンダ、南スーダンからの入国を制限
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。エボラウイルス病の複数国での同時流行で、米国が入国制限を発令する国際的に重大な感染症事象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでエボラ流行の中心がDRCで確認（116死亡、4月下旬から発生）。ウガンダ、南スーダン、ルワンダは隣国で関連地域だが、記事の主題は『DRCでの流行に対する米国の入国制限』であり、実際の流行発生地はDRCのみが明確。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみに該当。

article.articleHeadline: US imposes travel restrictions against Ebola, first infected American identified - ExBulletin
article.articleSummary: US imposes a 21-day travel ban on foreign travelers who have recently visited the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan, in a 30-day CDC order to curb the Ebola outbreak. The measure applies regardless of nationality, with exemptions for U.S. citizens, military, or DHS-approved exceptions. The move follows confirmation that American physician Peter Stafford, working at Bunia hospital in northeastern DRC since 2023, has contracted the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola. Stafford has been transferred to Germany for treatment; his family and a second CDC-exposed physician at Nyankunde hospital are under observation there, all asymptomatic. The CDC and BARDA are pursuing treatments, including post-exposure prophylaxis and monoclonal antibodies studied in primates for Bundibugyo. Cases have appeared in DRC and Uganda, with South Sudan at risk. The 21-day incubation window means potential exposure in transit centers; critics say bans often fail to stop outbreaks and can hinder response.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ熱に対する渡航制限を実施、初の米国人感染者を確認 - ExBulletin
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大、渡航制限の実施、医療従事者の感染など重大な公衆衛生上の懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは主にDRC（Bunia市の病院）でのエボラ発生とウガンダでの症例、南スーダンのリスクが記載されている。発生地域リストにはウガンダ、スーダン、独国、米国が含まれているが、サマリーの主題はDRCでの発生であり、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスの確認、米国人医療従事者の感染、21日間の渡航禁止令の発令など、複数の深刻な要素がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch: Ebola-infizierter US-Bürger soll in Deutschland behandelt werden
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: Ebola-infected U.S. citizen to be treated in Germany.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola-infected U.S. citizen will be treated in Germany, according to the CDC. The patient, who worked in the Democratic Republic of Congo, tested positive over the weekend. He will be transferred to Germany for treatment with six high-risk contacts, to shorten travel time. Nationalities of the contacts and the exact German facility were not disclosed. US media say the patient is a physician; a Christian missionary organization said a U.S. medic contracted while treating patients in Congo. Ebola is highly contagious and often fatal, spreading via contact with body fluids or contaminated objects. The WHO has declared an international health emergency for outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda, linked to a rare variant with no vaccine, with regional spread considered high. The outbreak began in the third week of April and was reported in early May by Africa CDC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染者：コンゴで感染した米国市民がドイツで治療を受ける予定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルスの国際的拡大、死亡率の高さ、ワクチン未開発の稀少変異体、複数国への拡大、WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言によりシグナル認定。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴでのエボラ感染事例と国際的な患者移送を報じている。ウガンダでも流行が報告されているがサマリーの主要な感染発生地はDRCであり、患者転送先（米国、ドイツ）は感染症の発生地ではなく治療地。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言、ワクチン未開発の稀少変異体、高い地域拡大リスクが記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: Aumento dos casos de gripe ampliam público-alvo das campanhas de vacinação contra o vírus influenza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increase in flu cases expands the target audience for influenza vaccination campaigns.
article.articleSummary: Rising influenza activity in Brazil, coupled with poor vaccination uptake, has led health authorities to broaden the target audience for influenza vaccination campaigns nationwide. In the city of São Paulo, the vaccination plan explicitly targets 90% coverage among priority groups, yet only about 33% have been vaccinated so far. To address the shortfall, officials have liberalized the influenza vaccine to all residents older than six months, expanding access beyond the traditional priority cohorts. The measure signals a nationwide effort to increase population immunity during the current flu season. No mortality or laboratory-confirmation data are provided in the report, and there is no mention of imported cases; the emphasis is on improving vaccination coverage to reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ患者の増加がワクチン接種キャンペーンの対象者拡大につながる
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザは季節性疾患であり、ブラジルでの症例増加は予期された現象。死亡や重症化の報告がなく、ワクチン接種キャンペーンの拡大は公衆衛生対応として管理可能。国際的拡大リスクやIHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準への該当が認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の活動増加。死亡例、重症例、または検査確認数の提示がなく、当該記事は公衆衛生当局によるワクチン接種キャンペーンの対応策に焦点を当てている。WPROスクリーニングで prolonged_exposure と epidemic_prone の2基準に該当するが、社会的・政治的懸念が限定的で、かつシグナルとしての識別基準（「1つ以上該当かつ社会的関心あり」）を満たしていない。

article.articleHeadline: Россиян предупредили о вспышке опасного заболевания
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russians warned about an outbreak of a dangerous disease.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are described as cyclical, according to Academician Gennady Onishchenko. The article notes the last major outbreak occurred in 2014 and warns Russians to exercise caution, as Ebola spreads easily between people but can be prevented through hygiene, avoiding contact with the sick, and avoiding travel to countries with rising Ebola activity. Russia plans to deploy specialists to Uganda to assist in outbreak response, and Rospotrebnadzor will send a team to Kampala for an epidemiological investigation at Uganda’s request. The piece underscores personal protective measures and international cooperation to monitor and contain Ebola outbreaks. Keywords: Ebola, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, Uganda Ebola outbreak, Russia, epidemiological investigation.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア国民に危険な疾病の流行について警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の流行がDRC・ウガンダで報告され、国際的な対応（ロシアの専門家派遣）が既に開始されている。IHR基準で3項目（深刻な影響、予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目に合致する。フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行が主題であるが、発生地域に含まれるウガンダ（GeoNames ID: 226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙した。ロシアからの国際支援派遣が既に決定されており、社会政治的関心が高い。2014年のDRCでの大規模流行以降の「周期的」な流行パターンが指摘されている点も注目。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Tightens Surveillance, WHO Declares Emergency As Ebola Kills 88 In Congo
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, Nigeria reports no confirmed Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) case but is strengthening surveillance, laboratory readiness, infection prevention, and public awareness nationwide after 88 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and an imported Ugandan case. In the DRC, about 246 suspected EVD cases have been reported, originating in eastern Ituri province and involving the Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists. An imported case has been reported in Uganda, and cases linked to the outbreak have reached Kinshasa, signaling high regional risk. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern, while stopping short of a pandemic and advising against border closures or trade restrictions. Early symptoms include fever, muscle pain, fatigue, headache, sore throat, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, a rash, and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア監視体制強化、WHOが緊急事態宣言 コンゴでエボラで88人死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の広がり、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHO公式な国際保健上の緊急事態宣言、複数国での発生確認、Bundibugyo株による治療法未確立の状況。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaとNigeriaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは輸入症例1件のみ、ナイジェリアは確認症例がなく監視強化段階と記載されており、主要な発生地はDRC（Ituri州およびKinshasa）。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。DRC内での広がりと域内拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Indonesia heightens Ebola surveillance at border checkpoints after WHO's global emergency alert
article.articleSummary: Indonesia raised Ebola surveillance at international entry points after the World Health Organization declared the Africa outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. Jakarta’s Sulianti Saroso Hospital and national authorities are closely monitoring travellers; suspected cases are referred to designated hospitals and reported through the national emergency response system. The government is boosting early detection and risk communication via an Ebola information portal to counter misinformation. The Bundibugyo-strain outbreak is currently limited to the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with more than 90 deaths. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission occurs through close contact with bodily fluids; spillover can involve infected animals such as bats, chimpanzees, and gorillas. Early symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle pain, headaches, progressing to vomiting and diarrhoea. Travellers returning from affected countries should seek medical care if symptoms appear within 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア、WHO の世界的緊急警報後、国境検問所でエボラ出血熱の監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが国際的懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言したエボラ出血熱の確定的なアウトブレイク（DRC・ウガンダで90人以上の死亡）で、インドネシアが積極的な国境監視体制を構築。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明確に述べられているように、Bundibugyo株エボラ出血熱の実際の発生地はDRC及びウガンダであり、インドネシアはWHO宣言への対応として国境監視を強化している段階。Uganda（226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。Jakarta特定の監視措置は継続中だが、症例発生報告はない。WHOによるPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）が確認されており、国際的関心・政府関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: EUA suspendem vistos e ampliam triagem para conter Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States suspends visas and expands screening to contain Ebola.
article.articleSummary: CDC announces entry restrictions and airport screening to contain Ebola in the United States, prompted by WHO's international health emergency amid a Congo outbreak. Non-US passport holders who have been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan in the last 21 days are barred from entry; Uganda visa suspensions are confirmed by the Kampala embassy. Travelers from affected regions arriving at US airports will undergo medical exams; initial measures run 30 days. A US citizen on assignment in Congo tested positive on May 17; symptoms developed over the weekend. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with a 25–50 percent mortality rate and no vaccine or specific treatment. Congo's Ministry of Health reports 91 deaths and about 350 suspected cases as of Sunday, mostly aged 20–39 and over 60 percent female. Officials say immediate US risk is low and have mobilized 13 million dollars in aid. The context includes political strains such as the US exit from WHO in 2026 and criticisms of bilateral approaches.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ対策としてビザ停止と検査拡大を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全てに該当。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）による国際的な公衆衛生上の重大事象であり、米国が国家レベルの入国制限措置を講じており、複数国での発生が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで確認される発生地域はコンゴ民主共和国であり、ウガンダ（Kampala）およびスーダンは言及されているが、これらは旅行者の発生地ではなく米国の入国制限対象地域として記述されている。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当。米国での事例は対象国リストに含まれないため検出対象外。エボラウイルス病、高い死亡率（25-50%）、複数国への波及懸念があり、IHR基準全項目に該当する重大シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: 백신·치료제 없다...'분디부조 에볼라' 초기식별 못해 위기
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There is no vaccine or treatment... Bundibugyo Ebola not identified early, crisis.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus (BDBV) infections are spreading across the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. There is no approved vaccine or treatment; case fatality is about 30–40%, lower than Zaire ebolavirus (~90%) but still deadly. Transmission occurs via contact with infected blood, body fluids, or contaminated objects, placing healthcare workers and funeral attendees at high risk. Symptoms begin with flu-like signs—fever, fatigue, headache, sore throat—progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, hemorrhage and multiorgan failure.
