The first suspected case appeared April 24; a nurse in Bunia, Ituri Province, died, and the outbreak was officially declared May 15 as the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak, three weeks after the onset. The virus has spread roughly 700 km and crossed into Uganda. Incubation averages 8–10 days, sometimes as short as 2 days or as long as 3 weeks. No widely used BDBV diagnostic test existed initially, delaying confirmation due to prior focus on EBOV. Response is hampered by rebel control of Goma (≈850,000) and reduced international health funding.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチン・治療薬がない…『ブンディブギョ・エボラ』初期段階で見逃され危機的状況
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当し、スクリーニング基準でも全5項目該当。ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスの国際的拡大（DRC→ウガンダ）、高い致命率（30-40%）、診断遅延、国際支援不足など複合的な重大リスク要因が存在する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの拡大言及があるが、サマリーの主焦点はDRCであり、実際の症例報告はDRC内（Ituri州Bunia、Nord-Kivu州Goma）から。検査能力の欠如、反政府勢力によるGoma支配、国際的な保健資金削減など複数の管理上の障害が存在。初期診断遅延（4月24日初例、5月15日発表）は制御困難性を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak in DRC and Uganda: Global Emergency and Rising Death Toll - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17, 2026, for an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, caused by Bundibugyo virus, a member of the orthoebolavirus group. As of May 16, 2026, DR Congo reported 8 laboratory-confirmed cases, 246 suspected cases, and 80 suspected deaths, with transmission across at least three Ituri Province zones: Bunia, Rwampara, and Mongbwalu. BBC later cited at least 100 deaths. The outbreak has reached international travelers, including an American infected in DRC, prompting the United States to restrict entry from the affected region. The PHEIC decision was made under the International Health Regulations (2005) after assessing health risk, potential international spread, and impact on international traffic. Containment focuses on Ituri with cross-border coordination between DRC and Uganda to prevent further regional transmission.

triage.headline_ja: DRCとウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイク：世界的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態と死亡数の増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラの国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言、複数国への拡大、米国を含む国際的な渡航制限がなされており、フルリスク評価が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはウガンダへの言及がありますが（見出しと初出段落に記載）、詳細内容では主にDRC（イトゥリ州）に焦点が当たっており、ウガンダは「国際的旅行者」「越境調整」の文脈でのみ言及されています。対象国リストにはウガンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとしました。WHOがPHEIC宣言を行い、複数基準で懸念事項が確認され、社会政治的関心も高い事案です。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola volta a assustar o mundo após avanço mortal no Congo, ausência de vacinas e alerta internacional sobre risco de nova crise sanitária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Returns to Scare the World After a Deadly Advance in the Congo, Lack of Vaccines, and International Warning Over the Risk of a New Health Crisis.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces a deadly Ebola outbreak from the rare Bundibugyo variant, with 80 deaths confirmed and about 250 suspected cases; Uganda has a confirmed case and a related death. The Bundibugyo variant has no approved vaccines or officially licensed treatments, and laboratories struggle to rapidly detect this strain, delaying containment. Symptoms typically appear 2–21 days after infection, starting with fever, headache, and fatigue, then vomiting, diarrhea, organ failure, and possible internal/external bleeding. Treatment is supportive care—hydration, fluid management, nutrition, pain relief—with early care significantly improving survival. Ongoing civil conflict in the DRC has displaced roughly 250,000 people, and mobile populations in mining regions raise cross-border transmission risk to Uganda, Rwanda, and South Sudan, raising international concern. The first case emerged April 24, with confirmation taking about three weeks, highlighting continued transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの致命的な拡大後、エボラウイルスが世界を再び脅かす。ワクチン不足と新たな保健危機のリスクに関する国際警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、稀なBundibugyo変異株で異常、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。緊急シグナルとしてフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴでのエボラ発生を主題とし、ウガンダ・ルワンダ・南スーダンへの越境リスクを言及。ただし対象国リストではDRCのみが含まれるため、DRCのみを verified_locations に記載。稀なBundibugyo変異株で承認ワクチンなし、検査遅延による制御困難、民族紛争による避難民移動が重大リスク。2026年5月時点で既に80人死亡、250人の疑い患者がいる急速な状況。

article.articleHeadline: 백신도 치료제도 없다...에볼라 확산에 WHO 비상사태 선언 - 시사저널
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There is neither a vaccine nor a treatment... WHO declares a public health emergency due to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda has killed over 100 people. DRC reports 393 suspected cases with 105 deaths; Uganda confirms two DRC nationals infected in Kampala, with one death. The Bundibugyo variant has no vaccine or targeted treatment, leaving containment and supportive care as primary tools. Detection relies on RT-PCR. By May 15, Africa CDC tallied 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths in DRC; WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. Rwanda closed its land border with DRC; the Uganda-based US Embassy suspended visa services. Korea’s KDCA raised a watch level and designated DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan as priority quarantine areas. From May 19, travelers from these areas must report via Q-CODE and undergo airport screening; avoid wildlife contact, funerals, and wear PPE. Returnees should monitor 21 days and seek care for fever or abdominal pain.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチンも治療薬もない...エボラ拡大でWHOが公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な健康被害100人以上死亡、予想外の集団発生、複数国への国際的拡大、国際的な行動制限の開始）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言し、複数国が対応を強化している高度な懸念シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事ではDRCとウガンダでの集団発生が述べられているが、ウガンダ（対象国外）について具体的な患者情報があり、韓国がDRC・ウガンダ・南スーダンを優先隔離地域に指定している。しかし対象国リスト内では DRC のみが verified_locations に含まれる。Rwanda も記事に言及されているが発生地ではなく対応国であるため除外。WHO による PHEIC 宣言（5月17日）と各国の対応強化が重要な背景。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Best of BS Opinion: FTA strains, virus alerts, and market reform debate
article.articleSummary: UK restricts tariff-free steel imports and imposes a 50% duty beyond quota; India should resist delaying FTAs despite zero-tariff aims under India-UK CEFTA, as protectionist pressures from UK/EU steel interests may hinder India's trade goals. Hantavirus and Ebola have revived health preparedness concerns; the lesson is preparedness over panic: stronger surveillance, faster testing, local capacity, global cooperation, vaccine access, and clear public communication to prevent outbreaks from widening. Ananth Narayan argues India’s securities-market regulation must be future-ready as markets grow more complex; the draft Securities Market Code should modernize regulation without stifling innovation, emphasizing consultation, transparent decision-making, board expertise, and accountability. Rajeshwari Sengupta stresses price signals during crises are crucial; suppressing prices weakens information systems amid energy stress and high oil prices. Neha Kirpal reviews The Good Reporter: A Memoir of Journalism in the 21st Century, highlighting Khabar Lahariya and Dalit women reporters building local journalism.

triage.headline_ja: Best of BS Opinion: FTA strains, virus alerts, and market reform debate（FTA問題、ウイルス警告、および市場改革討論に関するBS Opinion特集）
triage.triage_reason: 記事はハンタウイルスおよびエボラウイルスへの健康準備態勢の懸念を言及しているが、具体的な現在の発生事例ではなく、一般的な準備と協力の必要性についての意見記事である。情報が不足しており、実際のシグナルかどうか判断保留が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーを精査すると、ハンタウイルスおよびエボラは具体的な発生事例ではなく、健康準備態勢についての一般的な議論・意見記事の文脈で言及されている。UK記載は貿易関連の討論文脈であり感染症イベントではない。実際の疾患発生報告ではないため、詳細情報が不足している。続報により具体的な発生事例が明らかになるまで経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: What to know about the new Ebola outbreak that quietly raged for weeks
article.articleSummary: A rare Ebola Bundibugyo strain has prompted the World Health Organization to declare a public health emergency of international concern. Most cases and over 100 suspected deaths, with nearly 400 suspected infections, have been reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Delays in the emergency declaration are questioned, with suggestions the Bundibugyo strain circulated for weeks as officials tested for a different Ebola type. In response to the outbreak, the Trump administration invoked an emergency public health rule to seal American borders to travelers recently in Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan. An American missionary doctor has tested positive for Ebola and has been sent to Germany for treatment, alongside six others who may have been exposed, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention on Monday.

triage.headline_ja: 数週間静かに蔓延した新しいエボラ出血熱の発生について知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラ・ブンディブギオ株によるWHO国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、DRCでの100人以上の疑い死亡、400人近い疑い感染者、国際的広がり、複数国への渡航制限実施により、フルRRAに進むべき重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRCでのエボラ発生。USA、Sudan、Germanyは二次的な影響（輸入症例、治療地、渡航制限国）として言及されているが、実際の発生地はDRCのみ。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。エボラ・ブンディブギオ株は稀で、WHO緊急宣言が既に発出されており、公開されている重大シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Defensa lleva adelante medidas sanitarias para evitar contagios de Ébola en el Congo y en aeropuertos uruguayos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Defense carries out sanitary measures to prevent Ebola infections in the Congo and at Uruguayan airports.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, Uruguay implements preventive measures against Ebola virus disease linked to the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Defense Minister Sandra Lazo stated that 11 personnel—including observers, soldiers, and State Majors staff—are in zones near the outbreak, located more than 80 kilometers away, while over 600 personnel are stationed in Goma. A confirmed Ebola case has been reported in Goma, prompting prophylaxis and infection-control measures. Separately, sanitary measures are being applied at Uruguayan airports to prevent the possible importation of infections via travelers. The statements emphasize surveillance, targeted prophylaxis in the Congo, and precautionary steps for international arrivals in Uruguay, aiming to prevent transmission without indicating current infection among the Uruguayan contingent.

triage.headline_ja: 防衛省がコンゴのエボラ感染を防ぐための衛生対策を実施、ウルグアイの空港でも対策実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外の事象、国際的拡大リスク）。DRCでのエボラ確定患者発生と、複数国への拡大リスク対応が報道されており、シグナルとして処理必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主要な感染症イベントはDRC（北キブ州ゴマ）でのエボラ確定患者発生。ウルグアイは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRC内での複数拠点での監視・対策実施が記載されており、地域的な拡大兆候あり。

article.articleHeadline: Bé trai đồng nhiễm vi khuẩn, virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Boy with bacterial and viral co-infection.
article.articleSummary: In Hanoi, Vietnam, a 17‑month‑old boy presented with two weeks of cough and high fever. Laboratory testing detected Haemophilus influenzae and Mycoplasma pneumoniae, along with influenza virus, indicating a bacterial–viral co-infection. He had poor appetite, tachycardia (142 bpm), and lung crackles; two weeks earlier he was diagnosed with otitis media, bronchopneumonia, and acute nasopharyngitis and treated with multiple oral antibiotics without improvement. An IV antibiotic regimen caused a grade II anaphylactic reaction, promptly recognized and switched to a safer antibiotic. The patient received respiratory support and nutritional care, and fever resolved with improved appetite and stable respiration before discharge. This case underscores the complexity of co-infections in young children and cautions against unsupervised antibiotic use or changes without medical guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 細菌とウイルスの同時感染を持つ少年
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、異常な流行パターン、国際的拡大リスク、または管理上の困難さを示す証拠がない。臨床教育的価値はあるが、シグナルレベルの懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 本イベントはハノイでの単一小児症例（17ヶ月齢）の臨床報告である。複数病原体（ヘモフィルス・インフルエンザ、マイコプラズマ・ニューモニエ、インフルエンザウイルス）の同時感染は臨床的に興味深いが、流行の兆候、急速な拡大、または公衆衛生上の懸念をもたらす証拠がない。患者は適切な治療後に回復し、退院している。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus Dikabarkan Sudah Masuk Indonesia, Warga Cirebon Diminta Waspada, Ditularkan lewat Udara
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus Reported to Have Entered Indonesia, Cirebon Residents Urged to Be Vigilant, Transmitted Through the Air.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus has entered Indonesia, with authorities urging vigilance in Cirebon Regency as of May 19, 2026. The virus, carried by rodents, transmits mainly via air contaminated with urine, feces, or saliva, unlike leptospirosis. There are no confirmed hantavirus cases in Cirebon yet, but the local Health Service (Dinkes) is escalating preventive measures following directives from West Java provincial health authorities. A Disease Prevention and Control for Communicable Diseases (P2PM) team is drafting a circular for all hospitals, and heads of Puskesmas are tasked with broad community education through social media and internal channels. Several Puskesmas are also producing educational videos. The Health Service stresses preparedness since hantavirus is rare but now detected in Indonesia, requiring awareness among residents.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスがインドネシアに侵入したと報告、シレボン住民に警戒を呼びかけ、空気感染する
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルスのインドネシア初の侵入報告であり、異常かつ予想外の事象。公衆衛生当局による警戒体制の構築と広域的な対応準備が開始されており、スクリーニング基準で複数の項目に該当する。
triage.notes: ハンタウイルスはインドネシアでは新規の脅威であり、地方当局が複数レベルで対応を開始している。現時点では確認症例がないが、プレパレッドネスと早期警戒システムの構築が進行中。ジャワ州西部（Jawa Barat）のシレボン地区が主な関心地域。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情扩散 已报告116例疑似病例死亡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreads in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; 116 suspected cases have died.
article.articleSummary: As of May 18, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s eastern Ituri Province outbreak of Ebola is expanding, with 116 suspected deaths and 435 suspected cases under observation and treatment; laboratory tests and epidemiological investigations are ongoing to confirm whether the deaths are linked to Ebola. Ituri and nearby North Kivu Province have reported cases, with health authorities continuing analyses to verify links. Earlier, by May 15 the Ministry reported 80 deaths nationwide, including 4 laboratory-confirmed Ebola deaths. On May 17, the World Health Organization declared the DRC and Uganda outbreaks a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. A laboratory-confirmed imported case in Uganda has died. Rwanda, Zambia, and Tanzania have stepped up border health surveillance, entry screening, and outbreak-preparedness. Ebola virus disease causes fever, bleeding, and multi-organ failure, with mortality reported as 50–90%.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疫情が拡大、116例の疑似死亡症例が報告されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として、深刻な影響、異常性、複数国への国際拡大リスク、および国際的な対応を要する状況。
triage.notes: WHOは2026年5月17日にコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ感染症を国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）と宣言。ウガンダではラボ確認済みの輸入症例が報告され死亡。ルワンダ、ザンビア、タンザニアは国境警戒を強化。記事に記載されたIturi州はDRC内の感染地域。対象国リストに含まれるDRCとザンビアのみを verified_locations に含めた。

article.articleHeadline: LDS employees speak on Ebola outbreak after spending 2 years in impacted region
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in remote areas of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with the CDC confirming investigations. As of the latest reports, 11 confirmed Ebola cases and 336 suspected cases, including 88 deaths, are in the DRC, plus 1 confirmed death in Uganda. On May 17, an American who was caring for patients in the DRC tested positive for Ebola. The United States has implemented travel restrictions to and from the DRC and Uganda. Two LDS Church missionary leaders, Paula and Brooke Jones, who spent 23 months in Kolwezi, DRC, and have since returned to Canada, discuss the outbreak; they report no Ebola activity during their time there and expect local plus international efforts to contain it. The Church says no Americans are currently in the impacted areas. CDC and other organizations are working to prevent further spread and aid those exposed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行について語るLDS職員 - 影響を受けた地域で2年を過ごした後
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準の全4項目に該当する極めて重大な公衆衛生上の脅威である。既に複数国での確認症例、死亡者、国際的な移動制限が実施されており、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、実際のエボラ出血熱の流行発生地はDRCとウガンダである。米国とカナダは患者や帰還者の所在地であり、出血熱の発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため含めない。CDC関与、国際的な旅行制限実施、複数国への潜在的な波及リスク、米国人患者の出現など複合的なリスク要因を含む。

article.articleHeadline: 美国加强机场筛查预防伊波拉病毒 禁止三国非公民入境
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United States tightens airport screening to prevent the Ebola virus, bans non-citizens from three countries from entering.
article.articleSummary: On May 18, 2026, the U.S. CDC tightened Ebola safeguards: non-citizens who have traveled in the past 21 days to the Democratic Republic of Congo (Kinshasa), South Sudan, or Uganda are barred from entering the United States for 30 days, with strengthened travel screening, entry restrictions, and other public health measures; visa services abroad are suspended. A U.S. citizen who contracted Ebola after exposure in the Congo tested positive and is to be treated in Germany; six others are to be evacuated for health screening. The U.S. embassy in Kampala has halted all visa services. In eastern DRC’s Ituri province, the Ebola outbreak continues to spread, with 116 reported deaths among suspected cases and about 350 suspected cases; roughly 435 suspected cases are under observation or treatment as laboratories and epidemiology investigations proceed. WHO has deemed this outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; there is no vaccine or specific therapy. The article notes a prior U.S. withdrawal from WHO.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラウイルス防止のため空港検査を強化、3カ国の非国民の入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスク、複数国への渡航制限措置の実施、WHO PHEIC認定、死亡・患者多数など深刻な公衆衛生影響が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから確認される実際の発生地は DRC Ituri州。ウガンダとスーダンは記事内で言及されているが、発生地としてではなく米国の渡航制限対象国として記載されているため、verified_locations には含めない。WHO PHEIC認定済み、死亡116名、患者350人超、米国内での確認患者あり（ドイツで治療中）という極めて深刻な状況を反映している。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织：埃博拉疫情已构成"国际关注的突发公共卫生事件"-经济参考网 _ 新华社《经济参考报》官方网站
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola outbreak has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.
article.articleSummary: On May 17, 2026, the World Health Organization declared the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The article notes ongoing Ebola activity in eastern DRC, including Ituri Province near Bunia (as shown in a hospital scene), and in Uganda. The piece provides no specific case or death counts, nor detailed epidemiological data. Published May 19, 2026, the report emphasizes the PHEIC status as a signal of international concern and the need for heightened global coordination, without offering laboratory confirmation details or transmission sources. The photo credit references Ituri Province, Bunia, in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：エボラ出血熱の流行は「国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態」に認定されている
triage.triage_reason: WHO により PHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として公式認定されたエボラ出血熱。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、DRC及びウガンダでの発生は検証済み。国際的な拡大リスクと対応の必要性が極めて高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Uganda）はWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCのみを記載。WHO PHEIC公式認定により、シグナルとしての信頼性は極めて高い。具体的な症例数や死亡数はサマリーに記載されていないが、PHEIC認定自体が重大な公衆衛生イベントを示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Αμερικανός γιατρός που εργάζονταν στο Κονγκό βρέθηκε θετικός στον Έμπολα | in.gr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American doctor who worked in Congo tested positive for Ebola | in.gr
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, an American physician, Dr. Peter Stafford, with the Serge medical missionary group in Bunia, Democratic Republic of Congo, tested positive for Ebola virus, Bundibugyo ebolavirus, after exposure at Nyankunde Hospital. He was evacuated to Germany for treatment per the CDC. His wife and another physician remain asymptomatic; all three have followed quarantine protocols. The CDC plans to move six more Americans for monitoring or care. The Congo and Uganda Ebola outbreak has logged over 250 suspected cases and around 80 suspected deaths; the WHO declared a health emergency on Sunday. Bundibugyo is the third known Ebola strain, with no vaccine or approved treatment. Transmission is through close contact with bodily fluids; early symptoms include fever, fatigue, sore throat, evolving to vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, organ dysfunction, and bleeding. The urban setting and armed conflict raise spread concerns, and several cases exported for monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスに感染したアメリカ人医師がコンゴで発見される | in.gr
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ種）の確定患者が発生し、国際的な患者移送、複数国への危機波及、250症例以上の疑い患者、80人以上の死亡が報告されており、WHO緊急事態宣言も発出されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ブンディブギョエボラウイルス）は第3の既知エボラ株で、ワクチンや承認済み治療法がない。都市設定と武装紛争により拡大懸念が高い。複数の症例が国際的に監視対象となっており、米国医師の国際移送はリスク管理の対象。記事のsummaryに基づき、Congo(DRC)が主要な発生地で、Uganda、USA、Germanyは二次的影響地のため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: TPHCM tăng cường giám sát cửa khẩu ngăn chặn nguy cơ dịch Ebola xâm nhập
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City strengthens border surveillance to prevent Ebola virus disease from entering
article.articleSummary: On 19 May 2026, Ho Chi Minh City Department of Health ordered strengthened and tightened border surveillance at entry points to proactively detect and block Ebola virus disease from entering the city. Following WHO's 17 May declaration of an Ebola outbreak due to Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda as a public health emergency of international concern, HCMC's Health Department tasked the Ho Chi Minh City Center for Disease Control and Prevention (HCDC) with integrated port-of-entry measures. These include monitoring for abnormal fever or illness among arrivals; gathering epidemiological and travel histories; coordinating with aviation, maritime, and international health quarantine authorities; and maintaining ready isolation, handling, and safe transport protocols for suspected cases. Healthcare facilities will receive training on infection control and use of PPE. Authorities will continually update guidance from WHO and the Ministry of Health and assess risk to guide appropriate response.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市がエボラウイルス病の流入を防ぐため国境監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: WHOが2026年5月17日にコンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダでのエボラ・ブンディブギョウイルス勃発を国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態として宣言し、複数国での確認に基づく国際的拡大リスクが存在するため、IHR基準を複数満たす。また、ベトナムを含む複数地域でのシグナルレベルの警戒体制強化が行われており、スクリーニング基準複数該当とともに社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはWHOの国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言（2026年5月17日）を受けて、ホーチミン市が国境監視を強化した動向を報告している。DRC・ウガンダでの確認流行、およびベトナムでの予防的対応措置の実施を明記。ウガンダはAPI発生地域に含まれているが対象国リストに無いため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: DVG ta monitor desaroyonan internacional relaciona cu Ebola | 24ora - Prome Den Noticia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DVG is monitoring international developments related to Ebola | 24ora - First in News
article.articleSummary: As of 19 May 2026, the Directie Volksgezondheid (DVG) is actively monitoring Ebola developments tied to outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, following the World Health Organization's designation of a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Ebola (Bundibugyo virus) is a severe viral hemorrhagic fever, zoonotic, transmitted to humans through direct contact with blood or bodily fluids of an infected person or animal. Aruba reports no Ebola cases and no direct local threat, though DVG continues risk assessments and maintains regional/international partner communications. The public is urged to rely only on official channels—the Directie Volksgezondheid and WHO—to avoid misinformation. If the international situation changes or new Aruba-relevant information emerges, DVG will inform the community.

triage.headline_ja: DVGはエボラに関連する国際的な動向を監視している | 24ora - First in News
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WHO PHEIC指定済みのエボラアウトブレイク（DRC・ウガンダ）に対する監視活動であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、実際のエボラアウトブレイク発生地はDRC（対象国リストに含まれるGeoNames ID 203312）のみを verified_locations に含める。ウガンダ（対象国リストに未含）とアルバ（対象国リストに未含）は除外。WHO PHEIC指定済みのため公衆衛生上の重要性は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Human avian flu: 8 suspected samples in Maharashtra to be sent to NIV
article.articleSummary: Eight samples from poultry workers in Nandurbar district, Maharashtra, involved with bird farms or culling, will be sent to the National Institute of Virology (NIV) Pune for testing of human avian influenza. District Health Officer Ravindra Sonawane said the eight samples—nasal swabs—from workers who had contact with poultry will be sent to NIV on Tuesday. The workers have not shown any symptoms of human avian flu. They are being given Tamiflu tablets as a precautionary measure, and no samples from government employees have been collected. The move reflects ongoing surveillance in the bird flu-hit district to detect potential human infections, with results pending after laboratory confirmation at NIV Pune.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ人感染疑い: マハラシュトラ州で8つの疑いサンプルがNIVに送付される
triage.triage_reason: マハラシュトラ州で鳥インフルエンザの人感染疑い事例が報告され、予防的な医療対応が実施されている。国内外への拡大リスク、異常性、重症度が潜在的に存在し、スクリーニング基準複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではマハラシュトラ州ナンドゥルバル地区の家禽労働者8名から採取された鼻腔スワブが人鳥インフルエンザの検査対象となっており、症状未発症だが予防的タミフル投与が実施されている。NIV Puneでの確定診断結果待機中。鳥インフルエンザは人獣共通感染症で国際的影響が大きいため、引き続き注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 致命「漢他病毒、伊波拉」雙重爆發　WHO示警：全球新危機　 | ETtoday國際新聞 | ETtoday新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly dual outbreaks of hantavirus and Ebola: WHO warns of a new global crisis.
article.articleSummary: At the World Health Assembly in Geneva, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned of a dangerous, fractured era as two deadly outbreaks unfold: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, declared an international public health emergency, and a hantavirus outbreak aboard the Dutch-flagged cruise Hondius, including a human-to-human Andes strain now reaching North America. Canada confirmed a 70-something Yukon traveler tested positive and hospitalized in Victoria; the ship outbreak totals 10 cases with 3 deaths. In the United States, the CDC reports no symptomatic cases among travelers monitored at a Nebraska quarantine center and Emory University Hospital, though about 36 people remain under home monitoring. The Andes hantavirus is the only known hantavirus with sustained human transmission. Separately, US and Argentina have exited WHO funding, cutting about 21% of the budget and creating a near $1 billion gap; Spain’s Sanchez urged solidarity.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的なハンタウイルスとエボラの二重流行　WHO警告：世界的新危機
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の多発地流行、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラは国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み、ハンタウイルスはヒト-ヒト感染で北米に拡大。
triage.notes: DRC内でのエボラ流行は確実に報道されているため verified_locations に含める。ハンタウイルスはクルーズ船（オランダ籍）での多国籍アウトブレイクだが、記事は主にエボラ流行と船上流行の国際的広がりを主題としている。対象国リストに該当する国での陸上での実際の流行確認はDRCのエボラのみ。カナダのYukon確認例は cruise ship based outbreak の拡大例であり、北米での確定的な陸上での流行報告ではなく、監視対象の帰国者・滞在者である。したがって検証済み位置はDRCのみとする。

article.articleHeadline: India still short on expertise, tools to manage fungal health burden
article.articleSummary: India bears a mounting fungal-disease burden with more than 5 crore people affected, including mucormycosis (black fungus) which is about 80 times more prevalent in India than in developed nations. Fungal infections (mycoses) attack eyes, skin, lungs, vagina, brain, and can cause blood infections; tropical heat and humidity amplify risk. Clinicians often start with antibacterial drugs, delaying antifungal treatment and allowing fungi to invade deeper tissues. An estimated 3–4 fungal eye infections occur daily at LVPEI Hyderabad; nationwide, there is insufficient expertise and few institutes dedicated to fungal outbreaks. Diagnosis relies on microbiology culture to confirm fungal growth, plus examination of fungal spore morphology; some fungi do not form spores and cultures can take weeks. Experts urge simultaneous fungal testing with bacterial testing to enable earlier identification and better outcomes. The issue gained attention during the COVID-19 era due to mucormycosis.

triage.headline_ja: インド、真菌性疾患の管理に必要な専門知識とツールが不足
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は真菌感染症（特にムコーマイコーシス）の負担についての疫学的・公衆衛生的考察であり、新たな感染症アウトブレイクの検出ではない。COVID-19の言及は背景情報に過ぎず、現在のCOVID-19イベントではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知の真菌感染症（主にムコーマイコーシス）の公衆衛生上の負担と診断能力の不足に関する実態報告であり、新興感染症イベント（アウトブレイク）の検出ではない。COVID-19との関連は歴史的背景のみで、現在の流行情報ではない。シグナル検知対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Gigitan Hewan Penular Rabies di Sukabumi Melonjak Signifikan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies-Transmitting Animal Bite Cases in Sukabumi Surge Significantly
article.articleSummary: Rabies-transmitting animal bite cases in Sukabumi City, West Java, Indonesia surged in the first quarter of 2026, with at least 104 bites reported from January to March. While no laboratory-confirmed rabies cases have been found, the high bite volume has prompted heightened vigilance, and all at-risk victims are being treated at RSUD Al-Mulk, designated as a Rabies Center. Denna Yuliavina of the City Health Office notes a rising trend over the past five years, though previous periods reported bites without confirmed rabies. To strengthen response, Sukabumi Dinkes is developing the Rabies Management Integration System (SINAR) to improve medical governance for bite victims and support Indonesia’s national rabies-free target by 2030. SINAR is planned to launch in the first week of June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: スカブミ市における狂犬病感染動物咬傷事例が大幅に増加
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・西ジャワ州スカブミ市で2026年第1四半期に104件の狂犬病感染動物咬傷が報告され異常性が認められるが、現時点で実験室確認症例がなく、公衆衛生への深刻な影響は確認されていない。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死的疾患であるが、現時点で確認症例がないため重症度は評価不可。スカブミ市の狂犬病咬傷事例数の過去5年間にわたる上昇傾向と、インドネシア政府の2030年狂犬病排除目標に向けた対応システム構築から、政府の関心と管理体制への取り組みが示唆される。咬傷事例の多くが未確認であること、および2026年6月の新システム導入予定から、続報が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) | Ebola - Operation Update 6 month (MDRCD047)
article.articleSummary: 16th Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Kasai Province, Bulape and Dikolo) declared Sept 4, 2025, reporting 64 cases (53 confirmed, 11 probable) and 45 deaths across six health areas; vaccination reached 47,577 people. The outbreak was declared over on Dec 1, 2025 after a 42-day period since the last discharge (Oct 19, 2025), with a 90-day post-epidemic surveillance plan in Kasai and surrounding areas. The DRC Red Cross supported community engagement and preparedness through transition planning. By May 15, 2026, a 17th EVD outbreak began in Ituri Province (Mongwalu, Bunia, Rwampara) with about 246 suspected cases and over 80 deaths; 13 lab-confirmed cases linked to Bundibugyo strain. No licensed Bundibugyo vaccine; cross-border movement heightens risk. Uganda reports one imported fatal Bundibugyo case in Kampala (May 11, 2026) linked to the DRC outbreak; border districts activated preparedness and regional partners coordinate surveillance and response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）| エボラ - 6ヶ月オペレーション更新（MDRCD047）
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の新規発生（第17波、2026年5月15日）が報告され、国境を越えた拡大リスク（ウガンダへの輸入例）、高い致死率、ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ株の流行が確認されている。IHR基準4つすべてに該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、DRCでの第16波（2025年9月〜12月、カサイ州）の後、第17波が2026年5月15日にイトゥーリ州で発生。ウガンダでは5月11日に輸入感染例（死亡）がカンパラで確認された。ブンディブギョ株に対する認可ワクチンがなく、国境を越えた拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Health workers race to contain Congo's fast-spreading Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-19, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province is battling a fast-spreading Ebola outbreak centered around Bunia. An American missionary is among those tested positive. The World Health Organization has declared Ebola a public health emergency of international concern because of cross-border spread risk after two cases were confirmed in Kampala, Uganda. Across nine health zones in Ituri, 393 suspected Ebola cases have been reported, with 105 suspected deaths; eight cases have been laboratory-confirmed. Health workers are racing to the frontlines amid late detection and rapid spread, with the disease described as often fatal. The outbreak has drawn international concern and underscores cross-border surveillance needs, though the report provides no infection source details or further import/export specifics beyond Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの急速に広がるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク封じ込めに保健労働者が奮闘
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は極度に深刻で異常であり、ウガンダへの国際的な越境感染確認により国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限リスクが明確。WHOが国際的懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、フルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはウガンダ（226074）も含まれているが、記事サマリーでは越境感染は「ウガンダで2例確認」と述べられており、主要なアウトブレイク地域はDRC（イトゥリ州）である。WHO国際的懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済み。致死率が高い病原体であり、緊急度は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: American doctor with Ebola works for Jenkintown nonprofit
article.articleSummary: American doctor Dr. Peter Stafford, who contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo during an outbreak, works with the Jenkintown-based Serge nonprofit as a medical missionary; his asymptomatic wife Rebekah Stafford and Dr. Patrick LaRochelle are in quarantine. The CDC, with the State Department, is relocating Stafford and six others to Germany for treatment and monitoring. Serge, founded in the 1980s in Jenkintown by pastor Jack Miller, operates missions in over 25 countries. The current outbreak concerns Bundibugyo virus, a species of Ebola, with at least 80 deaths and about 250 suspected cases in eastern DRC as of May 16. WHO and U.S. agencies say American risk remains low; entry restrictions apply for certain travelers who recently visited Uganda, DRC, or South Sudan in the prior 21 days. No approved therapies or preventive prophylactic measures exist for Bundibugyo virus.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱に感染したアメリカ人医師がペンシルバニア州の非営利団体で勤務
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラ出血熱の一種）の東DRCでのアウトブレイクに関連し、患者が米国から欧州への移送対象となっており、国際的な公衆衛生への重大な懸念が存在する。
triage.notes: 記事の主要なイベント（Bundibugyo ebolavirus アウトブレイク）はDRCで発生している。患者の移送先（米国、ドイツ）や団体の本部所在地（米国）は二次的な情報であり、実際のアウトブレイクの発生地はDRCのみに限定される。WHOと米国保健当局は米国内のリスクは低いと述べているが、国際的な懸念材料として指定渡航制限措置が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: À la une de ce mardi : Hantavirus, prix des carburants, attentat islamophobe, championnat de natation, spectacle KiLLT et météo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This Tuesday's front page: Hantavirus, fuel prices, Islamophobic attack, swimming championship, KiLLT show and weather.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus presence in the Indian Ocean is reported, though there is no circulation among Réunion’s rodents. Public Health France notes the virus has been identified in rats in Mayotte and Madagascar, including a variant linked to Thailand (Thailand virus), but Réunion shows no evidence of local rodent infection to date. Health authorities state that, at this stage, the transmission chain on French soil is under control, with ongoing vigilance. Leptospirosis is rising on Réunion, adding to concerns about zoonotic disease risk on the island. The article does not mention human cases or laboratory-confirmed infections for hantavirus beyond rodent findings, and provides no details on imports or exports. Overall, the focus remains on surveillance, regional risks, and precautionary measures to prevent spillover.

triage.headline_ja: 今週火曜日のニュース：ハンタウイルス、燃料価格、イスラム嫌悪攻撃、水泳選手権、KiLLTショーと天気予報
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルスとレプトスピラ症が複数地域で報告され、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性・流行可能性）に該当する可能性があるが、人での確定症例報告が不明確で、現時点では情報不足。続報の監視が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはマダガスカル、フランス、レユニオン、イギリス領インド洋領土が含まれるが、記事サマリーの詳細読解では、人での確定症例がハンタウイルスについて明記されておらず、ネズミでの検出に限定されている。対象国リストではタイのみが該当。レプトスピラ症はレユニオンで増加中と記述されているが、レユニオンは対象国外。人での感染確認状況が明確でないため、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニングの重症度と管理可能性は「不明」と評価。IHR 2つ以上該当かつWPRO 3つ該当するが、情報不足により「WATCH」判定。

article.articleHeadline: 한타에 에볼라까지...국제기구 "팬데믹 대비 미흡해 더 투자해야" | 연합뉴스
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From Hantavirus to Ebola... International organizations say "pandemic preparedness is inadequate; more investment is needed" | Yonhap News
article.articleSummary: Global health watchdog GPMB warns that pandemic preparedness remains inadequate as risk of pandemics rises due to climate crisis and conflicts. In a report released May 18, 2026, organized by the World Bank and WHO, authorities highlight that while pandemic frequency increases, impact grows, and global security is not meaningfully safe. The report cites a recent Atlantic cruise ship hantavirus outbreak and Ebola deaths exceeding 100 in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, underscoring high-alert conditions. Despite rapid development of new technologies like mRNA vaccines, equitable access to vaccines, diagnostics, and therapeutics is eroding; for example, mpox vaccines took nearly two years to reach Africa, longer than COVID-19 vaccine rollout (17 months). Political polarization and public distrust of science worsen responses. GPMB calls for a pandemic treaty guaranteeing equitable access and greater funding for prevention and response, urging leaders to turn commitments into measurable progress before the next crisis.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスからエボラまで...国際機構「パンデミック対策が不十分。より多くの投資が必要」
triage.triage_reason: 複数の高リスク疾患（Ebola、Mpox、Hantavirus、COVID-19）が同時にフラッグされ、IHR基準3項目以上該当。DRC・ウガンダでのエボラ死亡100超、グローバルなパンデミック対応の弱体化が国際機構により警告されており、国際的な公衆衛生への深刻な影響と対応の管理可能性の問題が明確。
triage.notes: 記事はGPMBレポート発表に関する複数疾患の同時警告。実際の発生地はDRCとウガンダだが、対象国リストはDRCのみ。大西洋でのハンタウイルス集団発生は地理的にはサマリー外。Mpoxワクチンアフリカ到達遅延、COVID-19対応の教訓などグローバルな疫学・対応の弱点が強調されており、国際的に高い関心と懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고·우간다 에볼라 확산...美, 방문 이력 외국인 입국 제한 - 신아일보
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda... U.S. restricts entry of foreign nationals with travel history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks continue in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with about 100 deaths. The virus is Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Bundibugyo strain); there is no approved vaccine or treatment, and transmission occurs via contact with infected body fluids or contaminated materials, causing hemorrhagic fever. An American missionary infected in DRC has been treated in Germany. In response, the CDC barred entry of foreign nationals who visited DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan within 21 days, but U.S. citizens remain exempt; airport screening was intensified, and the Ugandan visa office was suspended. The WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. UN and aid groups cite challenges from ongoing conflict, famine, and humanitarian crises. Domestic spread is considered unlikely, given isolation and enhanced border screening.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴ・ウガンダでエボラ拡散...米、渡航歴のある外国人の入国を制限
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みの確認事例。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC・ウガンダでのエボラ拡大が主題。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみ該当。米国・ドイツ・スーダン・ウガンダは対象国外だが、DRCでの実際の発生は確認。WHO PHEIC宣言（5月17日）により国際的な関心は極めて高い。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株、約100人の死亡、ワクチン・治療法なし、接触感染という重大度から判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-infected US citizen to be treated in Germany
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-19, a US citizen infected with the Ebola virus is to be treated in Germany after testing positive late Sunday. The individual had worked in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and is being moved to Germany—with six high-risk contacts—due to shorter flight times and Germany’s experience; nationalities of contacts not disclosed, treatment location in Germany undisclosed. US media cite the patient as a doctor; a US medical worker allegedly contracted the virus while treating patients at a hospital in the DRC. The World Health Organization has declared an international health emergency for the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda. The outbreak involves a rare Ebola variant with no available vaccine, and the regional risk of spread is considered high. Africa CDC notes the outbreak likely began in the third week of April, with reports emerging in early May.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染のアメリカ市民がドイツで治療を受ける予定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）に該当し、WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言済みのエボラウイルス病アウトブレイク関連。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで発生しているエボラウイルス病アウトブレイクに関連した事例を報道。米国市民患者はDRCで感染し、ドイツへ移送予定。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが実際の発生地。ウガンダも記事本文に言及されているが、対象国リスト外のため含めない。WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言済み、ワクチン非対応の稀なエボラ変異株という重篤性が記載されており、高優先度シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: CDC Mỹ cập nhật Ebola, ông Trump lên tiếng, TGĐ WHO nhận định về thời kỳ nguy hiểm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. CDC updates on Ebola; Trump weighs in; WHO Director-General comments on the dangerous period.
article.articleSummary: U.S. citizen infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo; symptoms appeared late weekend and tested positive on May 17, with the patient being transported to Germany for treatment. About 25 Americans work at the U.S. field office in DRC. The CDC says the immediate risk to the U.S. public remains low but will adjust public health measures as needed, including enhanced airport screening and 21‑day entry restrictions for foreigners who have recently visited Uganda, the DRC, or South Sudan. The U.S. Embassy in Kampala has paused visa services. President Trump expressed concern, noting the outbreak appears confined to Africa. WHO has declared the Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Separately, Canada reports a Hantavirus case linked to the MV Hondius cruise ship off the Canary Islands, with 10 cases and 3 deaths reported to WHO as of May 18; Tedros warned of crises in a dangerous, polarized world during the Geneva WHO assembly.

triage.headline_ja: 米CDC、エボラについて更新；トランプ大統領が発言；WHO事務局長が危険期について見解を示す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、エボラの国際的公衆衛生緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言、複数国での症例確認、国際的な移動制限と入国規制が実施されており、高度なリスク
triage.notes: 記事は主にDRCでのエボラ症例（米国市民）と、カナリア諸島沖での船舶関連ハンタウイルス症例を扱っている。DRCはWHO-PHEIC宣言があり対象国リスト内。ハンタウイルス症例はカナリア諸島（スペイン）で発生しているが、対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。複数の高リスク基準に該当し、フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cara Aman Bersihkan Kotoran Tikus agar Tak Tertular Hantavirus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How to Safely Clean Rat Droppings to Prevent Hantavirus Infection
article.articleSummary: Indonesia reports renewed concern over hantavirus, a rodent-borne virus detected in the country since the 1980s. Transmission occurs when humans inhale air or dust contaminated with rat urine, feces, or saliva, or through direct skin contact with contaminated waste or contaminated food. To prevent aerosolization during cleanup, areas with rat droppings should be first moistened with disinfectant, then cleaned safely; sweeping or vacuuming dry waste is discouraged. According to Kemenkes RI guidelines and IPB University expert Prof. Upik Kesumawati, hantavirus infection typically begins with flu-like symptoms (fever, muscle pain, malaise, headache, nausea) and, after days 4–10, can progress to Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS) with coughing, severe shortness of breath, and markedly low blood oxygen. Two clinical syndromes with high fatality are described. A particular concern is the Andes virus strain, notable for rare human-to-human transmission. Prevention hinges on rodent control and strict environmental sanitation.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス感染を防ぐためにネズミの糞を安全に清掃する方法
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染は既知の病原体であり、インドネシアでは1980年代から検出されている。記事は予防情報が主体であり、新規の流行やアウトブレイク状況の報告ではなく、情報不足のため経過観察の判定とする。
triage.notes: 記事は啓発・予防情報が中心であり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。ハンタウイルスは1980年代からインドネシアで既知の病原体。IHR基準は『unusual_unexpected』を満たさず、且つWPRO基準でも『epidemic_prone』『manageability』が不明である。続報によるアウトブレイク兆候の有無を監視する必要があるため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: CDC Confirms U.S. Ebola Case Linked to Congo Outbreak as Travel Restrictions Tighten - EconoTimes
article.articleSummary: Laboratory-confirmed Ebola case in the United States linked to a Congo outbreak of a rare strain. As of May 19, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports over 100 suspected deaths and nearly 400 suspected cases in the eastern region, with Nyankunde Hospital cited as the exposure site. The infected American healthcare worker developed symptoms over the weekend and is being transferred to Germany for specialized treatment; six additional exposed individuals are relocated for monitoring. The CDC is deploying Atlanta-based experts to bolster local response, and BARDA is developing a monoclonal antibody therapy for this strain. U.S. authorities impose 30-day travel restrictions on recent travelers from the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan, with exemptions for U.S. citizens, permanent residents, military personnel, and several exempt groups, and enhanced screening, monitoring, contact tracing, and hospital preparedness expanding nationwide. Experts warn that staffing cuts and weaker global cooperation could hinder containment.

triage.headline_ja: CDCが米国内エボラ出血熱症例がコンゴアウトブレイクに関連していることを確認、渡航制限が強化される
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大、米国での確認症例、渡航制限実施など重大な懸念要因が複数存在。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、DRCの東部地域でのエボラアウトブレイク（100人以上の疑い死亡、約400疑い症例）が主体であり、米国での症例はDRCアウトブレイクとの関連性が示されている。Bluedot APIで米国、ドイツ、ウガンダ、スーダンも発生地域として列挙されているが、サマリー上では主要な流行地は東部DRCであり、米国・ドイツの症例は関連症例または転院対応。verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダ・スーダンについては記事サマリーで具体的な症例報告がなく（渡航制限対象国としてのみ記載）、対象国リストに含まれるも、実際の病原体発生地としては確認されないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ熱に米国人1人が感染 CDCが入国制限
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One American infected with Ebola; CDC imposes entry restrictions.
article.articleSummary: One American has contracted Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo through local work-related exposure; symptoms appeared over the weekend and a late Sunday test confirmed infection on May 17. The patient is being prepared for treatment in Germany. The World Health Organization declared Ebola outbreaks in the DRC a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. The CDC notes that, at present, the risk to the U.S. general public remains low, but authorities will adjust measures as the situation evolves. Enhanced airport screening and visa restrictions now bar entry for travelers who visited Uganda, the DRC, or South Sudan within the past 21 days and do not hold U.S. passports. About 25 U.S. staff work at the U.S. mission in the DRC; additional senior technical coordinators are being sent. Six more people are being prepared for transport for monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱に米国人1人が感染 CDCが入国制限
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。WHO が Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) を宣言した Ebola アウトブレイクであり、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威が確認されている。
triage.notes: WHO が Ebola outbreak を PHEIC に指定。米国人感染者は DRC での職務関連の露出が原因。CDC が空港スクリーニング強化および査証制限を導入。対象国リストには Uganda、Sudan、Germany が含まれるが、評価対象国は DRC のみ。

article.articleHeadline: LDS missionaries speak on Ebola outbreak after spending 2 years in impacted region
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak confirmed in remote areas of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with the CDC investigating. As of May 17, 11 confirmed Ebola cases and 336 suspected cases have been reported in the DRC, with 88 deaths; Uganda has 1 confirmed death. An American who cared for patients in the DRC has tested positive for Ebola, prompting U.S. travel restrictions to and from the DRC and Uganda. The CDC and others are working to prevent further spread and assist those exposed. Two LDS missionaries who spent 23 months in Kolwezi, DRC, recently returned to Canada and expressed cautious optimism, noting no Ebola outbreaks during their stay and reliance on local and international medical support. The Church confirms there are no Americans currently in the impacted areas.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症危機対応でのLDS宣教師の証言：エボラ出血熱の流行地域での2年間の活動を振り返る
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当。確認症例と多数の死亡、複数国での検出、国際的な渡航・貿易制限措置が実施されており、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはDRC、米国、ウガンダ、カナダが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題イベントはDRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行である。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。米国とカナダは感染者の渡航先・帰国地であり、主要発生地ではない。2026年5月配信で近未来のシナリオと考えられるが、記事内容に基づきシグナルトリアージを実施した。

article.articleHeadline: (وسائط متعددة) الولايات المتحدة تشدد القيود على السفر لمنع دخول فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: (Multimedia) The United States tightens travel restrictions to prevent the entry of the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) is fueling an East‑Central Africa outbreak with ongoing transmission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. As of May 19, 2026, there are 11 laboratory‑confirmed cases and 336 suspected cases, including 88 deaths in the DRC, and 2 confirmed cases in Uganda with 1 death. Patients exhibit classic Ebola symptoms: fever, headache, vomiting, severe weakness, abdominal pain, nosebleeds, and hematemesis. There is no licensed Bundibugyo vaccine; treatment remains primarily supportive. In the United States, the CDC has tightened travel restrictions to reduce entry risk, restricting non‑U.S. passport holders who have been in Uganda, DRC, or South Sudan within 21 days. Measures include enhanced entry screening, port‑of‑entry health checks, airline coordination, expedited contact tracing, laboratory testing capacity, hospital preparedness, and deployment of response staff. Overall, the immediate risk to the U.S. population remains low.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカがエボラウイルスの流入を防ぐため渡航制限を厳しくする
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）の東中央アフリカアウトブレイク。IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外/異常、国際拡大リスク）。複数国での確認例と米国による公式な渡航制限措置により、国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、DRC、ウガンダ、スーダン、米国が言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダとスーダンは確認例が記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。エボラウイルス病は極めて重大な感染症であり、複数国での確認と米国による公式な渡航制限により、国際的な影響が顕著。

article.articleHeadline: இந்தோனீசிய எல்லைகளில் இபோலா நோய்த்தொற்று கண்காணிப்பு தீவிரம், உல‌க‌ம் செய்திகள் - தமிழ் முரசு World News in Tamil, Tamil Murasu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Intensified polio outbreak surveillance at Indonesian borders, World News - Tamil Murasu
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, intensified polio surveillance is underway at Indonesia's borders after the WHO declared polio a global health emergency. The Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 88 deaths and 336 infections from polio, triggering emergency status last Sunday. Indonesia is tightening entry screening, focusing on travelers from polio-affected countries. Health ministry official Aji Muhvarman Andara stated that international travelers are closely monitored, suspected cases are sent to designated hospitals, and events recorded under the national emergency management framework. Hospitals are urged to boost beds and coordinate with public health agencies to improve early detection. The Congo outbreak is described as rapidly spreading; for the circulating poliovirus strain there is no vaccine or specific treatment, with fatality risk up to 50%. Symptoms may include fever, bleeding, and vomiting.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの国境でのポリオ感染症監視の強化、ジカウイルス感染症 - タミル・ムラス
triage.triage_reason: ポリオの国際的拡大リスク（WHO緊急事態宣言）、重大な公衆衛生上の影響（DRCでの88死亡336感染）、複数国での感染確認により、IHR基準3つ以上該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: WHO緊急事態宣言済みのポリオアウトブレイク。DRCで致死率50%の流行が急速に拡大中。インドネシアは国境での監視を強化し、国際的拡大の懸念が高い。両国ともWPRO対象国リストに含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: 印尼罗马尼亚分别通报汉坦病毒确诊病例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indonesia and Romania separately report confirmed hantavirus cases.
article.articleSummary: On 19 May 2026, Indonesia and Romania reported confirmed hantavirus cases. In Jakarta, Indonesia, the city health office disclosed 3 laboratory-confirmed hantavirus infections and 6 suspected cases under monitoring, with authorities raising the alert level and issuing guidance to medical facilities. Screening at Soekarno–Hatta International Airport has been intensified using health declarations, temperature checks, and inbound traveler observation to reduce import risk. In Arad, western Romania, the National Institute of Public Health confirmed one hantavirus infection; the patient is stable and under treatment. The Romanian case is not linked to the recent outbreak on the Hondius, a Dutch cruise ship, and the patient had no international travel in the past three years. Hantaviruses are rodent-borne and encompass over 20 species, causing hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome or hantavirus pulmonary syndrome.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアとルーマニアがそれぞれハンタウイルス確認症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで3例の確定例と6例の疑い例が報告され、当局が警戒レベルを上げており、異常性と重症度の懸念がある。国際線での検疫強化と複数国での同時報告により、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではインドネシア（ジャカルタ）とルーマニア（アラド）の両国でハンタウイルス確定例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはインドネシア（ID: 1643084）のみ。ルーマニアは対象国に含まれないため除外。インドネシアでは実験室確認例3例、疑い例6例が報告され、当局が警戒レベルを引き上げており、国際空港での検疫も強化されている。ハンタウイルスはげっ歯類媒介性で、人間と動物の両方に影響を及ぼす可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Indonesia heightens Ebola surveillance at border checkpoints after WHO's global emergency alert
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa prompts Indonesia to heighten border surveillance. On May 17, WHO declared the Ebola outbreak a public health emergency of international concern; Indonesia's health ministry says it has intensified monitoring at international entry points and will refer suspected cases to designated hospitals, reporting through the national emergency response system. Public education and risk communication are being expanded via the Ebola information portal. The outbreak is limited to the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with over 90 deaths reported. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for the Bundibugyo strain. Transmission is spillover from infected animals (chimpanzees, gorillas, bats) and human-to-human via close contact with bodily fluids. Early symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle pain, headaches, progressing to vomiting and diarrhea. Public advised to avoid contact with infected individuals or animals; travelers from affected areas should seek medical attention if symptoms appear within 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: WHO のグローバル緊急警告後、インドネシアが国境検問所でのエボラ監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHO が PHEIC 宣言した確認済みエボラアウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、主要なエボラアウトブレイクは DRC とウガンダで発生しており、インドネシアは国境監視強化の対応措置を講じている国として記載。ウガンダ（226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため excluded。WHO PHEIC 宣言（2026-05-17）により国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性が確認されている。タイムスタンプは2026年であり未来日付だが、シミュレーション記事と見なして評価を実施。

article.articleHeadline: Virus Ebola Bundibugyo Mengganas, Begini Sejarah dan Cara Penularannya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Goes on the Rampage, Here’s Its History and How It Is Transmitted
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus (BDBV), a member of Orthoebolavirus, drives Bundibugyo Ebola disease and has triggered a cross-border outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri) and Uganda (Kampala). By May 16, 2026, about 246 suspected cases and 80 deaths had been reported; WHO declared a PHEIC on May 17. The 2007 Uganda outbreak had 149 cases and 37 deaths; the 2012 DRC Orientale outbreak had 52–57 cases and 25–29 deaths. The 2026 cluster began around April–May 2026 in Ituri, with spread to Kampala. Symptoms start with fever, severe headache, myalgia, malaise, then nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and possible renal/hepatic dysfunction; hemorrhage in 40–50% and CNS involvement may occur. Transmission is zoonotic from fruit bats and primates; human-to-human spread via blood and body fluids. An American clinician with aid groups tested positive; cross-border exposure raises regional risk.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョエボラウイルスが猛威、その歴史と感染方法
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。WHOがPHEIC宣言した国際的に重要なエボラアウトブレイク（DRC・ウガンダ国境地帯）。高い死亡率、国際的拡大リスク、複数国への影響確認。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRC（Ituri地域）とウガンダ（Kampala）での国境地帯アウトブレイク確認。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみ列挙。WHOがPHEIC宣言（5月17日）、246疑い例、80死亡、人-人感染・医療従事者感染確認。高いリスク評価。

article.articleHeadline: [속보] "100명 넘게 줄사망" 백신·치료제도 없다... 민주콩고 에볼라 확산·WHO 비상사태 선포
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Breaking] "'Death toll surpasses 100' — no vaccines or treatments... Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; WHO declares a Public Health Emergency of International Concern."
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda have surpassed 100 deaths, with 393 suspected cases in the DRC and two confirmed cases in Uganda (one death). Bundibugyo ebolavirus has no approved vaccine or treatment (unlike Zaire). WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) but says it is not a global pandemic. Cross-border measures have tightened: Rwanda closed the land border with the DRC; Burundi and Tanzania increased screening. The United States restricts entry for noncitizens who traveled to DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan within 21 days and paused most visa processing for those regions; U.S. citizens are exempt. An American missionary in the DRC tested positive and was evacuated to Germany. Transmission is via contact with bodily fluids; incubation 2–21 days; early fever, progressing to rash, bleeding, shock, and organ failure; Bundibuglio CFR about 30–50%.

triage.headline_ja: [速報] "100人以上の死亡" ワクチン・治療薬もない... コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ拡大・WHO緊急事態宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHO PHEIC宣言済みのエボラウイルス感染症で、死亡者100名超、複数国での確定症例、国際的な移動制限導入、ワクチン・治療薬なしという極めて深刻な状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCが主要な発生地で、ウガンダで確定症例2件（死亡1名）が確認されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。ルワンダ、ブルンジ、タンザニアは境界対策強化国だが、記事上では実際の発症地としての記載はない。米国の入国制限はDRC等への渡航歴ベースで、米国内での発症報告ではなく、宣教師の陽性確認・ドイツへの搬送の報告のみ。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで極めて高優先度。

article.articleHeadline: La nouvelle épidémie d'Ebola signalée, avec déjà plus de 60 morts (Point santé)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The new Ebola outbreak reported, with over 60 deaths already (Health News).
article.articleSummary: New Ebola outbreak in DR Congo’s Ituri with 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths in Mongwalu and Rwampara. Testing detected Ebola in 9 of 20 samples; sequencing is ongoing to identify the strain. Africa CDC warns of rapid regional spread due to mining-driven mobility and cross-border proximity to Uganda and South Sudan amid security challenges; a May 15 emergency meeting included DRC, Uganda, South Sudan and partners (WHO, UNICEF, Gavi, MSF). In Lomé, 22 West/Central African states adopted the Lomé Declaration on child nutrition, committing to governance and funding for integrated services. In Nigeria’s Niger Delta, methane leaks in Bille contaminate rivers and about 70% of drinking wells; some sites reach 10,000x thresholds; 100 million naira allocated for water, health and emergency response. WHO’s 2026 World Health Statistics warns slower progress; HIV down 40% since 2010, malaria up 8.5% since 2015, and 18% of countries report mortality data within a year.

triage.headline_ja: 新しいエボラ出血熱の流行が報告され、既に60人以上の死亡が確認（保健ニュース）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。既知の致死性感染症の新規流行で、複数国への拡大警告と国際的対応機構の動員。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国(DRC)のイトゥリ地域での新規エボラ出血熱流行（246疑い患者、65死亡）を主要な懸念事項として記述。ウガンダ・南スーダンへの拡大リスクと国際的な対応会議が記載されている。その他の記載地域（ロメ（トーゴ）、ナイジェリア）は栄養・環境汚染など異なるテーマであり、エボラ流行イベントの直接的な発生地ではない。スーダン・ニジェール・ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・トーゴ・ルワンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが、サマリー上ではDRCのみが主要なエボラ流行として記述されているため、検証済み位置はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Poor storage may undermine RO water safety: Study finds E coli bacteria in samples
article.articleSummary: In Chennai, India, a study of 216 households using home reverse osmosis (RO) filtration found E. coli in 81 of 262 post-filtration drinking-water samples, about one in three. The IIT Madras-led team, published in the Journal of Exposure Science and Environmental Epidemiology, indicates contamination occurs after filtration during storage and handling, when treated water contacts unclean storage containers or untreated tap water. Storage in steel or plastic vessels, often uncovered or inadequately cleaned, can reintroduce bacteria; even rinsing a container with untreated water before refilling can compromise safety. RO improved other water-quality metrics, with hardness decreasing from 0.69 to 0.08 parts per million, and reductions in dissolved solids and turbidity. Education level correlated with contamination: E. coli persisted in 36% of post-RO samples for households with postgraduate education versus 83% for those with lower education, underscoring hygiene and maintenance practices. Implications extend to urban Indian households relying on RO filtration.

triage.headline_ja: 給水貯蔵システムの不十分な衛生管理がRO浄水装置の安全性を損なう可能性：研究でサンプルから大腸菌を検出
triage.triage_reason: 本事例は環境水質調査に基づく技術的知見であり、感染症の流行・集団発生ではない。IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術研究（IIT Madras発表）による家庭用RO浄水装置の水質検査報告。患者の症状報告や疫学的リンク、臨床的影響が記載されておらず、感染症イベント（outbreak）ではなく、水質管理上の技術的課題についての実験的知見である。従って感染症危機管理の対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola alert: Health Ministry ramps up airport screening, surveillance and lab preparedness
article.articleSummary: Eight lab-confirmed Ebola cases, 246 suspected cases, and 80 suspected deaths in Ituri Province, DR Congo; two lab-confirmed cases in Kampala, Uganda (one death), both with travel history to DR Congo and no link to each other. WHO notes eight of eleven initial samples positive, suggesting a potentially large outbreak. India reports no Ebola cases and low current risk, but ramps up airport screening, surveillance, and lab preparedness, designating NIV Pune for testing with added labs to be onboarded. Isolation/quarantine facilities at major airports/ports being identified; passenger travel history monitoring and information sharing with immigration/airport authorities intensified. Preparedness measures include reviewed SOPs for screening, surveillance, quarantine, and management, with interagency coordination for monitoring international travel. Ebola is zoonotic (Orthoebolavirus), transmitted via direct contact with infected fluids, contaminated surfaces, or handling dead bodies; symptoms mimic flu, with fever and muscle/joint pains, and bleeding in severe cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報：保健省が空港スクリーニング、監視、ラボ対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（多数の確定患者・死亡）、異常性、国際拡大リスク（ウガンダ及びインド等への波及）の3基準以上に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性で該当し、インドを含む対象国における政府レベルの対応強化が報告されている。
triage.notes: DRC・ウガンダでの既知の複数の確定患者・死亡が報告されており、インドが空港スクリーニング強化・ラボ準備等の対応を実施中。ニパ・インフルエンザも疾患リストに含まれているが、記事サマリーはエボラに焦点。DRCはコンゴ民主共和国、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため検証対象外だが、インドが積極的対応を取っているため対象国として列挙。

article.articleHeadline: Cel puţin 100 de morţi în urma focarului de Ebola din Republica Democratică Congo, afirmă un oficial
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At least 100 deaths following the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, an official says.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has caused at least 100 deaths among more than 390 suspected cases. Jean Kaseya, director of the African CDC, warns that in the absence of approved medicines or vaccines, public health measures — including safe burial practices — are essential. Uganda reports two confirmed cases and one death linked to the outbreak. The World Health Organization has declared the current Bundibugyo strain of Ebola an international emergency. An American physician in the DRC is among those with confirmed infection and will be transported to Germany for treatment, per a missionary group and the CDC. CBS News cites sources indicating at least six Americans have been exposed during the outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラアウトブレークにより少なくとも100人が死亡、公式筋が発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、重症度の高いエボラウイルス病の多国にまたがる流行。国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念である。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの確認症例2例と死亡1例が報告されているが、サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国のアウトブレークに焦点を当てており、ウガンダは二次的な拡大地域として言及されている。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ドイツへの搬送報告は医療対応であり、ドイツでのアウトブレークではない。WHOが国際的緊急事態宣言を発出しており、複数の米国市民の曝露が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: 'Numbers increasing': border changes flagged for Ebola
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with potential spillover to West Africa; as of 19 May 2026, enhanced border screening for travelers from West Africa is being considered. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak an international emergency on Sunday. At least 100 people have died in the Congo, with more than 390 suspected cases reported by the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention. The virus spreads via contact with infected bodily fluids, and incubation can be up to 21 days, complicating surveillance. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for this Bundibugyo strain, and most cases are in a Congo region affected by ongoing conflict. Australian Health Minister Mark Butler said border measures could be increased if the outbreak spreads; Oxfam warns many deaths may go unreported as people die at home. Early symptoms mimic a cold, progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: 「数が増加中」：エボラに関して国境措置の変更が指摘される
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準で4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが国際緊急事態を宣言し、死亡者100名以上・疑い例390例以上の大規模アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCを中心とした発生が主題であり、西アフリカへの流入の可能性が言及されている。オーストラリアは渡航者スクリーニング強化を検討中だが、主たる発生地はDRCのみ。アンゴラはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは具体的な発生報告なし。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。Bundibugyo株の致死率が高く、ワクチン・治療法なし。紛争地域での感染拡大リスクも評価される。

article.articleHeadline: CDC ยกระดับคุมเข้มเดินทางเข้าสหรัฐฯ สกัดอีโบลาระบาดจากแอฟริกา
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CDC Tightens Travel Controls Into the United States to Curb Ebola Outbreak Originating in Africa
article.articleSummary: As of May 18, 2026, the U.S. CDC tightened travel controls to curb an Ebola outbreak linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus in East and Central Africa. Measures include enhanced health screening and a 21-day entry restriction for foreign passport holders who recently resided in Uganda, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), or South Sudan. The agency will coordinate with Homeland Security, airlines, and border authorities to screen high-risk travelers, while boosting border health protection, contact tracing, laboratory capacity, and hospital readiness; CDC staff will support control efforts in affected areas. Current totals: 11 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 336 suspected cases, with 88 deaths in the DRC; Uganda reports 2 confirmed cases and 1 death. Symptoms include fever, headache, vomiting, severe fatigue, abdominal pain, nasal bleeding, and hematemesis. Africa CDC warns regional spread remains possible; no vaccine exists for Bundibugyo ebolavirus.

triage.headline_ja: CDC、アフリカからのエボラ流行を食い止めるため米国への渡航管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生影響を示し、国際的な拡大リスク（米国の入国管理強化）と渡航制限が既に実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで確認される実際の感染症イベント発生地はDRC（88確認例・336疑い例）およびウガンダ（2確認例・1死亡）だが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダは対象国に含まれていないため excluded。米国の渡航管理強化は対応措置であり、米国内での発生報告はサマリーに記載されていない。Bundibugyo ebolavirus はワクチン未開発で、地域的広がりの可能性と高い死亡率が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh do vi rút Ebola, biết đúng thì không sợ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus disease: Know the facts and you need not fear.
article.articleSummary: Outbreaks of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda were declared by the World Health Organization as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Vietnam’s Ministry of Health issued warnings. Ebola attacks immune cells, disrupts blood vessels and organs, and can cause internal bleeding, with a fatality rate up to 50%. Transmission requires direct contact with infected blood, vomit, sweat, urine, saliva, or other body fluids, or through contaminated objects; it can also spread via handling of the deceased and through contact with wildlife. Incubation ranges from several days to three weeks. Disease progression occurs in three stages: onset with high fever and headache; middle stage with vomiting and diarrhea and dehydration; severe stage with bruising, nasal or gum bleeding, or blood in vomit or stool. Prevention emphasizes cooked food, avoiding wildlife meat, hand hygiene, not sharing personal items, and limiting contact with suspected cases. The US has approved antibody-based therapy. Ho Chi Minh City increased border surveillance to prevent importation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病：事実を知れば恐れる必要はない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。DRCおよびウガンダでのアウトブレイク報告、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、ベトナムでの警告発令があり、複数の対象国が関与。
triage.notes: Ho Chi Minh Cityはベトナム内の都市であるため、Vietnam(1562822)に統合。ウガンダはGeoNames IDが対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCおよびベトナムの両国でエボラ関連の対応（警告発令、境界監視強化）が実施されており、対象地域として確認。

article.articleHeadline: 8 human samples from Maharashtra's Nandurbar to be sent to NIV for avian flu tests
article.articleSummary: Eight poultry workers in Nandurbar district, northwestern Maharashtra, are being tested for avian influenza after exposure to birds or involvement in culling. Samples, including nasal swabs, will be sent to the National Institute of Virology (NIV) Pune for human avian flu testing on Tuesday, as a precaution since the district has been hit by bird flu. None of the workers have shown symptoms of human avian flu so far; they are receiving Tamiflu as a precautionary measure. No government employee is among those tested. The Maharashtra health department notes proactive monitoring and laboratory confirmation to rule out human-to-human transmission. If tests confirm avian influenza in humans, responses would be triggered, but currently this is an exposure-based screening with no symptomatic cases reported.

triage.headline_ja: マハーラシュトラ州ナンドゥーバルの8名の人間サンプルがNIVで鳥インフルエンザ検査のため送付される
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザへの職業的曝露に基づく人間サンプルの検査であり、ニパウイルスも同時に疾患として報告されている。異常/予想外（IHR基準）およびスクリーニング基準の複数項目（重症度リスク、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）に該当し、公衆衛生的に重要なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは症状なき曝露ベースのスクリーニングと記述されているが、複数の鳥インフルエンザおよびニパウイルスの同時報告、職業的曝露、複数州での地理的拡がり、予防的治療(タミフル)の実施、国立ウイルス研究所への検査送付など、全体として高い警戒水準を示す。今後の検査結果は緊急のモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Noi centre deschise pentru tratarea Ebola în Congo, după aproape 120 de decese provocate de o tulpină rară
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New centers opened to treat Ebola in Congo, after nearly 120 deaths caused by a rare strain
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri and North Kivu provinces, with a linked case in Uganda, prompted the WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. As of May 19, 2026, authorities report at least 118 deaths and about 300 suspected cases in Ituri and North Kivu, plus one death and one suspected case in Uganda. The Bundibugyo strain is extremely rare; no vaccines or approved treatments exist. Initial diagnostics misidentified early Bunia samples; Ebola confirmation followed on May 14 and Bundibugyo typing on May 15. The first outbreak-associated death occurred April 24 in Bunia; repatriation of a body to Mongbwalu is believed to have aided spread. Cases have been confirmed in Bunia, Goma, Mongbwalu, Butembo and Nyakunde. Transmission via bodily fluids; common symptoms include fever, muscle pains, diarrhea, vomiting, and sometimes hemorrhage. The crisis unfolds in a conflict-affected, hard-to-reach region; Rwanda closed its border; Uganda increases cross-border surveillance; MSF warns of rapid progression.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ治療センター新設、珍しい株による約120人の死亡後
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラBundibugyo株の大規模集団感染で、WHO公衆衛生上の国際的に懸念される事象（PHEIC）宣言、複数国への波及、ワクチン・治療法なし、高い死亡率。
triage.notes: エボラBundibugyo株は極めて稀で、承認されたワクチンや治療法が存在しない。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。ウガンダへの波及も報告されているが、記事サマリー上の主体はコンゴ。紛争地域での流行で疾患対応が困難。MSFによる迅速な進行警告。

article.articleHeadline: Trump responds as deadly ebola strain spreads beyond the Democratic Republic of Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo strain outbreak linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo has spread to Uganda’s capital Kampala, with WHO declaring a public health emergency of international concern. The outbreak has caused at least 100 deaths and hundreds of suspected cases; Uganda reports more than 336 suspected cases in Kampala. One American worker, Dr Peter Stafford, contracted the virus after exposure in DRC; his wife and another treating physician are monitored, their four children are under observation, and six more people have been evacuated. U.S. CDC deployment includes about 25 personnel with a senior technical coordinator to the region; transport to Germany for Dr Stafford is being organized. U.S. measures include air-travel screening and entry restrictions for non-U.S. passport holders with recent travel to Uganda, DRC, or South Sudan in 21 days; the Embassy in Kampala suspended visa services, and $13 million in aid was mobilized. Bundibugyo has no approved vaccines or treatments; symptoms progress from flu-like to vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, rashes, and bleeding. Australia notes no local transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ大統領がコメント：致命的なエボラウイルス株がコンゴ民主共和国を超えて拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、複数国への拡大、渡航制限実施）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。対象国DRCおよびウガンダでの確認事例あり。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Kampala）と南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsに含めない。ただし記事の主題はDRCからの拡大流行であり、DRCは対象国に含まれる。WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言済み。オーストラリアとドイツ、米国での事例言及があるが、これらは対象国ではなく、事例発生地ではなく患者移送先・スクリーニング先である。

article.articleHeadline: Ситуация достаточно серьезная: Онищенко рассказал, как уберечься от Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The situation is quite serious: Onishchenko explained how to protect yourself from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Persistent Ebola outbreaks are cyclical. The 2014 outbreak killed about 11,000 people with a 41% case fatality rate; a new flare has emerged 12 years later. Recently, in Ituri province, northeast Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola fatalities exceed 80. The World Health Organization has declared Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda a public health emergency of international concern, underscoring serious international concern but not a pandemic. Ebola transmits easily between humans, but protection is possible through hygiene, avoiding contact with ill animals and people, and refraining from travel to countries with rising transmission. Public adherence remains a challenge, with reports that many residents and visitors disregard precautions such as masks and disinfection. Vigilance and adherence to control measures are essential.

triage.headline_ja: 状況はかなり深刻だ：オニシチェンコはエボラから身を守る方法を説明した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言した確認済みエボラ outbreak。DRCとウガンダの両国で発生。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに明示的に「Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda」と述べられているが、対象国リストでウガンダ（GeoNames ID不明）は含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、ヒト-ヒト感染が容易で、公衆衛生措置の遵守が課題とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Govt names districts at high Ebola risk
article.articleSummary: Two laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases have been identified in Uganda by 15–16 May 2026, both linked to the DRC outbreak; the index case, a 59-year-old Congolese man, was treated at Kibuli Muslim Hospital in Kampala (admitted May 11) and died May 14 in ICU with bleeding; the body was returned to DRC. Uganda has flagged 36 districts as very high risk, including Kampala, Wakiso, and numerous western-border districts (Lamwo, Kiryandongo, Hoima, Kasese, Kanungu, Isingiro) plus refugee-hosting areas; a number of health workers are in quarantine. In DR Congo, as of 15 May there were 13 confirmed and 67 probable cases under investigation. The outbreak is attributed to Bundibugyo virus; Ituri Province reported by 16 May eight lab-confirmed cases, 246 suspected cases, and 80 suspected deaths across Bunia, Rwampara and Mongbwalu health zones. WHO calls it a PHEIC. Cross-border movement and flights from Bunia to Entebbe are noted; Uganda monitors imported/exported cases and potential cases from DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: 政府が高リスク地域としてのエボラ感染症リスク地域を指定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。複数国での確認例、WHO PHEIC宣言、国境越え移動に伴う流行拡大リスク。
triage.notes: 記事は主にウガンダでのエボラ確認例と対策に関するものだが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCがリスト上の対象国であり、記事でDRC発症例との関連性が明記されている。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、複数国への拡大リスク極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Jadi Darurat Global, Kemenkes Imbau Hindari Makanan Jenis Ini
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Becomes a Global Emergency, Health Ministry Urges Avoiding This Type of Food
article.articleSummary: WHO has declared Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The alert drives heightened vigilance in Indonesia, where authorities urge cooking meat thoroughly and avoiding bushmeat to reduce transmission risk. As of May 19, 2026, WHO reports over 300 suspected Ebola cases and 88 deaths; the agency notes the situation is not a pandemic and international borders are not closed. Indonesia's response includes strengthened entry screening with thermal scanners, visual observations, and expanded surveillance via 198 PIE-designated referral hospitals and 21 sentinel hospitals across 20 provinces; laboratory capacity and cross-sector coordination with WHO are expanding. Public health measures stress hand hygiene, masking when ill or in crowded places, cough etiquette, and avoiding direct contact with potentially contaminated sources. Bundibugyo ebolavirus—originating in Bundibugyo District, Uganda (2007–2008)—is the current strain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがグローバル緊急事態に、保健省は食品の種類を避けるよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、WHOがPHEIC宣言した国際的に重要な感染症イベント。DRCおよびウガンダでの発生に対し、複数対象国（DRC、インドネシア）での公式な対応と警戒強化が明記されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda（226074）も含まれているが、対象国リスト外のため verified_locations に含めていない。記事サマリーは明確にDRCおよびウガンダでのWHO PHEIC宣言を述べており、インドネシアは対応国として記載されている。Bundibugyo ebolavirus の現在の流行が主題。

article.articleHeadline: Im Kongo infiziert: Ebola-infizierter US-Bürger wird in Deutschland behandelt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Congo, Ebola-infected American citizen is being treated in Germany.
article.articleSummary: Rare Ebola virus variant drives an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with about 350 infections and more than 90 deaths, predominantly in the eastern region. The World Health Organization has declared an international health emergency with Uganda; no vaccine or targeted therapy exists for this variant. An American doctor who contracted the virus while working in the DRC will be treated in Germany, per US CDC, and six high-risk contacts will be flown to Germany for monitoring and care. Nationalities of the contacts are not disclosed; the exact hospital in Germany is unspecified. Experts say Europe-wide spread is unlikely, noting that severe diseases with high mortality are more traceable in countries with strong health systems, but the outbreak remains a high regional risk requiring containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで感染：エボラウイルスに感染したアメリカ人がドイツで治療を受ける
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当する。エボラウイルスの稀な変種によるDRCでの大規模アウトブレイク（約350感染、90死以上）、WHOによる国際保健緊急事態宣言、複数国への患者移動、ワクチン・治療法がない状況であり、重大な国際的リスク事象である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラアウトブレイクの主要な発生地はDRCであることが明確。米国医師およびウガンダとの国際保健緊急事態が記載されているが、ウガンダでの実際の感染事象は記事に明示されていないため verified_locations から除外。ドイツでの治療は患者移送の結果であり発生地ではない。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。本事象は複数IHR基準とWPRO基準すべてに該当し、WHO緊急事態宣言を伴う重大シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: 特朗普：關注伊波拉疫情　指目前疫情僅局限於非洲 - 香港文匯網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trump: Focusing on the Ebola outbreak, says the current outbreak is confined to Africa
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, U.S. President Donald Trump said the Ebola outbreak is confined to Africa and remains the focus. The U.S. CDC earlier announced that an American physician working in the region has contracted Ebola and will be transported to Germany for treatment. The World Health Organization designated Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda as Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). In the DRC, the eastern Ituri province outbreak is spreading; authorities report 116 suspected deaths and 435 suspected cases under observation and treatment. Nationally, the DR Congo health ministry says about 80 deaths so far, with 4 confirmed Ebola infections. Neighboring countries—Rwanda, Zambia, Tanzania—have stepped up border health surveillance, entry screening, and outbreak preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ：エボラ疫情に注視、現在の疫情はアフリカに限定されていると指摘
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的な健康上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言、複数国での確認、医療従事者の感染、国際的な対応動員が認識され、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ発生がWHOにより国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）として指定されている。Ituri州での地域的な蔓延、死亡者116名（疑い例）、確認感染4名。米国の医療従事者の感染およびドイツでの治療計画も報告されている。ルワンダ、ザンビア、タンザニアが国境での監視強化。対象国リストに基づきDRCとザンビアのみ検証位置として列挙。

article.articleHeadline: 'Numbers increasing': border changes flagged for Ebola
