article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and West Africa driven by the Bundibugyo strain; WHO declared the outbreak an international emergency on Sunday. By 2026-05-19, at least 100 deaths in Congo and more than 390 suspected cases, clustered in a conflict-affected region. Transmission occurs via contact with infected bodily fluids; incubation up to 21 days, with symptoms starting like a common cold before progressing to severe vomiting, diarrhoea and internal bleeding. There is no vaccine for this rare Bundibugyo strain, and existing vaccines/treatments are ineffective. Border screening for travellers from West Africa is being considered, with Australia monitoring and potential changes to travel advice and border controls. Oxfam warns many deaths may be underreported as people die at home amid a humanitarian crisis.

triage.headline_ja: 「感染者数が増加」：エボラウイルスに対する国境措置の変更が検討されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。Bundibugyo株エボラの国際的緊急事態宣言、複数国での流行、100以上の死亡、国境措置検討など、フルRRA進行に値する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラの稀な株であり、既存ワクチン・治療法が無効という点が特に懸念される。記事ではWest Africaも言及されているが、対象国リストに該当する西アフリカ国家の具体名が記載されていないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。WHO国際緊急事態宣言済み。オーストラリアの言及は地域検証では対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Maharashtra Sends Samples For Avian Flu Testing
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza outbreak in Nandurbar, northwestern Maharashtra, triggers proactive human surveillance of poultry workers. Eight workers in contact with birds or involved in culling have had nasal swab samples collected and sent to the National Institute of Virology (NIV) in Pune for analysis. As of 19 May 2026, none have shown symptoms of human avian flu; workers are receiving Tamiflu as a precaution. No government employee is among those tested. The Maharashtra health department aims to safeguard public safety by monitoring potential transmission from poultry to humans, with NIV Pune responsible for laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: マハーラシュトラ州が鳥インフルエンザ検査のためにサンプルを送付
triage.triage_reason: ニパーウイルスと鳥インフルエンザの同時報告であり、人間と動物の両方に影響を及ぼす異常で予想外のイベント。ヒト-ヒト感染リスクのある新興感染症であり、インド国内での初期対応が進行中。
triage.notes: ニパーウイルスと鳥インフルエンザの2つの疾患がマハーラシュトラ州のナンドゥルバル地区で報告されている。既に8名の家禽労働者がサンプル採集され、ニ国立ウイルス研究所（NIV）プネで検査中。症状のある患者は報告されていないが、予防的にタミフルが投与されている。家禽から人間への伝播監視が進行中で、政府による主動的サーベイランスが展開されている。WPRO基準で4つの基準に該当し、IHR基準でも2つ以上該当するため、フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Combate à dengue: Prefeitura de Alagoinhas já notificou donos de 365 imóveis abandonados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fight against dengue: Alagoinhas City Hall has already notified owners of 365 abandoned properties.
article.articleSummary: Alagoinhas, Bahia, Brazil—In a dengue and arbovirus prevention drive, the city hall notified owners of abandoned properties to clean and fence land to curb Aedes aegypti breeding. As of May 18, 287 properties were added to the list, after 365 properties were notified since May 13, under Municipal Emergency Health Decree No. 6,226. The measure is part of an epidemiological blockade against arboviruses such as dengue, Zika, and chikungunya, coordinated by Semorp and guided by Health Surveillance mapping that flagged new high-risk areas. Affected neighborhoods include Petrolar, Silva Jardim, Juracy Magalhães, Centro, Alagoinhas Velha, Parque Verde, Kennedy, Baixa da Candeia, Barreiro, and adjacent zones with elevated vector infestation. Owners have five days to secure and clear the plots; non-compliance can trigger administrative fines up to R$ 1,040, doubling on recurrence, and charges if the city performs the work. The notification is preventive and the list is published in the Municipal Official Gazette.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱との戦い：アラゴインハス市役所が既に365軒の放棄物件の所有者に通知
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのバイア州で複数の蚊媒介性ウイルス（デング熱、ジカウイルス、チクングニア熱）の予防活動が報告されているが、現在の発生状況の詳細（患者数、重症度、死亡の有無）が不明であり、情報不足のため。
triage.notes: 記事は予防措置と蚊媒介性ウイルス対策に関する行政対応に焦点を当てており、具体的な患者数や重症度、死亡情報が記載されていない。バイア州アラゴインハス地区での発生は確認されるが、流行の規模・深刻度が不明確。続報で患者数や死亡者数が報告されれば評価が変わる可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: 自己免疫疾患患者数の増加とマラリア対策プログラム拡大がヒドロキシクロロキン市場の成長を加速
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The increasing number of patients with autoimmune diseases and expansion of malaria control programs are accelerating the growth of the hydroxychloroquine market.
article.articleSummary: Hydroxychloroquine demand is rising due to expanded malaria control programs and greater autoimmune-disease management, sustaining use for malaria, systemic lupus erythematosus, rheumatoid arthritis, and related immunomodulation. Global market was about $873.4 million in 2025, growing at a 2020–2025 CAGR of 7.0%, with forecasts to $1.1879 billion by 2030 and $1.4778 billion by 2035. Malaria remains the largest segment at 45.2% (~$394.4 million) in 2025. Lupus-suppressing indications are expected to grow fastest during the forecast. Asia-Pacific leads regional growth (28.2%, ~$246 million in 2025), Africa remains a key market. Tablets dominate formulations (82.7%, ~-$722 million), and hospital pharmacies are the major distribution channel (45.8%, ~$399.9 million). Top manufacturers include Sanofi, Sun Pharma, Teva, Zydus Lifesciences, IPCA Labs, Viatris, Sando, Dr. Reddy’s, Lupin, and Aurobindo USA, with the United States showing the largest projected market gains.

triage.headline_ja: 自己免疫疾患患者数の増加とマラリア対策プログラム拡大がヒドロキシクロロキン市場の成長を加速
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はヒドロキシクロロキン医薬品の市場分析・経済予測であり、マラリアの新規アウトブレイク、異常な疾患発生、または感染症危機を報告するものではない。IHR基準、WPROスクリーニング基準ともに該当なし。
triage.notes: 本記事は医薬品市場レポートであり、感染症イベント（アウトブレイク、異常発生）の報告ではない。マラリア対策プログラムの存在やヒドロキシクロロキンの使用は述べられているが、新規の感染症危機やシグナルに該当するエビデンスはない。Bluedot APIの分類エラーと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला का कहर, अमेरिकी डॉक्टर भी वायरस की चपेट में; अब तक 118 लोगों की मौत - congo ebola outbreak us doctor infected who declares emergency
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak ravages Congo; an American doctor is also infected with the virus; death toll reaches 118.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by a rare strain, has infected an American doctor and is spreading within the DRC and into neighboring Uganda. As of May 19, 2026, the death toll has risen to 118. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), signaling international concern and prompting intensified global coordination. The cross-border spread to Uganda underscores the regional risk posed by the outbreak. The article centers on these developments and the international response, without detailing transmission routes, symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or infection sources.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ大流行、アメリカ人医師も感染、WHOが緊急事態を宣言；これまでに118人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、希少株による異常性、国際拡大リスク、国際的懸念）。PHEIC宣言済みであり、複数国への拡大と国際的な関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、イベントの主題はDRCでのエボラ発生であり、アメリカ人医師感染は派遣医療従事者の感染として言及されている。ウガンダへの拡大も記述されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言が既に成されており、国際的対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Fusillade dans une mosquée en Californie, Kenya, Ebola, Algérie : les informations de la nuit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shooting at a mosque in California, Kenya, Ebola, Algeria: the night’s news.
article.articleSummary: Three people were killed when two gunmen opened fire at the Islamic Center of San Diego, California; the suspects died from self-inflicted wounds, and authorities treat the attack as islamophobic, with hostile writings found in the vehicle. In Kenya, four died in clashes between police and protesters over a fuel-price hike amid a public-transport strike, as prices rose about 23.5% after last month’s 24.2% increase. Ebola: the United States is tightening border health controls for travelers from affected African countries and will temporarily restrict visas for those who traveled there, as the WHO declares the Democratic Republic of Congo Ebola outbreak a public health emergency of international concern; one American contracted the virus while working in DRC and will be treated in Germany. In Algiers, French Justice Minister Darmanin and President Tebboune discuss repairing Franco-Algerian ties, including a pact to recover assets of former Algerian officials and related judicial cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: カリフォルニア州モスク銃撃、ケニア、エボラ、アルジェリア：夜間ニュース
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（対象国DRC）がWHOにより国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）として宣言され、米国が国境検疫強化および渡航制限を実施している。IHR基準4項目全てに該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ出血熱についてDRCでの発生とWHOのPHEIC宣言、米国での患者報告（ドイツでの治療）、および米国の国境検疫強化措置を報じている。対象国のうちDRCのみが実際の発生地であり、米国・フランス・アルジェリア・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: CDC ยกระดับคุมเข้มเดินทางเข้าสหรัฐฯ สกัดอีโบลาระบาดจากแอฟริกา : อินโฟเควสท์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CDC steps up travel restrictions into the United States to curb the Ebola outbreak originating in Africa: InfoQuest
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) intensified travel restrictions to curb an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus in Africa. Measures include enhanced health screening and traveler surveillance for people arriving from outbreak zones; a 21-day residence rule restricting entry for foreign passport holders with residence in Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), or South Sudan; and expanded coordination with airlines and border officials. CDC also aims to boost at-border protection, close-contact tracing, laboratory testing capacity, and hospital readiness, with staff deployed to affected areas. There is currently no vaccine for Bundibugyo Ebola; treatment remains supportive. Reports indicate 11 laboratory-confirmed cases and 336 suspected cases, including 88 deaths in the DRC, and 2 confirmed cases with 1 death in Uganda. Common symptoms include fever, headache, vomiting, severe fatigue, abdominal pain, nosebleeds, and hematemesis. Africa CDC warns spread risk is rising.

triage.headline_ja: 米CDC、アフリカ発エボラ出血熱の流行を抑制するため米国への渡航制限を強化: インフォクエスト
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）、WPRO基準5項目全て該当（重症度・流行性・管理可能性の懸念）、米国を含む国際的な政策対応が開始されており、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事では DRC とウガンダ、南スーダンでの発生が述べられているが、対象国リスト内では DRC のみが該当。ウガンダ (226074) とスーダン (366755) は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo virus）による深刻な流行であり、88名の死亡例が報告されている。米国の渡航制限強化などの国際的対応が既に開始されている点で、世界保健安全保障上の重要なイベント。

article.sourceUrl: https://www.hk01.com/社會新聞/60351225/伊波拉病毒-防護中心稱不會輕心-歐家榮-一日未受控-風險仍在
article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉病毒｜防護中心稱不會輕心　歐家榮：一日未受控、風險仍在
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Virus | Centre for Health Protection Says It Won’t Take It Lightly; Au Ka-wing: One Day Not Under Control, Risk Remains
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda have been designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Hong Kong activated its Ebola Preparedness and Response Plan on May 17; by May 19, the risk to Hong Kong is considered low, but authorities warn the danger remains until outbreaks are controlled. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus; there is no specific antiviral, and care is supportive, including hydration and electrolyte management. Transmission requires close contact with infected blood, organs, bodily fluids, or contaminated environments; incubation is 2–21 days. Early symptoms resemble influenza, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, kidney injury, and potentially internal or external bleeding; case fatality can reach about 50%. If an imported case occurs, Hong Kong would raise alerts and pursue stricter isolation and contact tracing; there have been no confirmed cases in Hong Kong yet.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス | 保健局が軽視しないと述べる　オー・カウイン：1日でもコントロール下にない限りリスクは残存
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。DRC・ウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイクが国際的保健上の緊急事態に指定され、香港が準備対応計画を発動。国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク、死亡率約50%の重篤性から、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda（226074）が含まれるが、対象国リストに該当しないため除外。香港は中国に含める。記事はDRCとウガンダのエボラアウトブレイクが主題で、香港は準備対応計画の発動と現在のリスク評価（低レベル）を記述。WHOによるPHEIC指定が確認されており、国際的関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Bird Flu in Maharashtra: महाराष्ट्र के नंदुरबार में बर्ड फ्लू का पहला संदिग्ध ह्यूमन केस; कर्मचारियों की RT-PCR जांच के आदेश
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird Flu in Maharashtra: First suspected human case of bird flu in Nandurbar, Maharashtra; orders for RT-PCR tests for employees.
article.articleSummary: First suspected human case of avian influenza reported in Navapur, Nandurbar, Maharashtra, prompting mandatory RT-PCR tests for eight poultry workers involved in culling or handling infected birds. Samples, including nasal and throat swabs, are being sent to the National Institute of Virology (NIV) in Pune for testing; as a precaution, all field staff in bird-flu-affected areas are being given Tamiflu. Eight workers showed no clear symptoms at present. Previously, two health workers, Ashok Lalsing Pawar (49) and Indas Gowalya Walvi (36), developed flu-like symptoms, were hospitalized, then discharged, and remain under monitoring. No confirmed human deaths from avian influenza in Maharashtra yet. From May 1–17, containment teams culled over 406,682 chickens across 15 infected farms; Navapur alone destroyed about 24.9 lakh eggs and 548,000 kg of poultry feed to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: マハラシュトラ州での鳥インフルエンザ：ナンドゥルバルで初の疑似ヒト感染事例；従業員へのRT-PCR検査命令
triage.triage_reason: インドのマハラシュトラ州で初のヒト感染疑い事例が報告され、複数の作業者が対象となるなど、異常かつ公衆衛生上重大な懸念があり、IHR基準3つ以上該当。
triage.notes: マハラシュトラ州ナンドゥルバルで初の疑似ヒト感染事例が報告された重要なシグナル。8名の家禽作業者が検査対象となり、サンプルはプーネのNational Institute of Virologyで検査予定。2名の医療従事者が発症し入院後退院。5月1-17日で406,682羽の鶏を処分し、大規模な疫学的対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Faith, fear and Ebola in Uganda
article.articleSummary: An Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, prompted Uganda to postpone Namugongo Martyrs Day pilgrimage near Kampala. Uganda confirmed its first case on May 15: a 59-year-old Congolese man treated at Kibuli Muslim Hospital, Kampala; admitted May 11 with respiratory distress, fever, nausea, epigastric pain and dysuria, dying May 14 with bleeding symptoms. Lab confirmation followed at Wandegeya on May 15 after his body was returned to DRC. Uganda activated emergency measures: border screening at crossings, mobile labs in western Uganda, isolation of risk contacts, and surveillance along pilgrimage routes. By May 15 Africa CDC warned of a regional outbreak centered in Ituri; initially 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths, rising to 336 cases and 88 deaths by May 16, including one in Uganda. Bundibugyo virus has no approved vaccine or treatment. Ituri and North Kivu remain volatile, raising cross-border spread risk for pilgrimage.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダにおけるエボラ信仰、恐怖と感染症
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルス病のアウトブレイクが DRC イトゥリ州で発生し、ウガンダで初の確認症例が報告された。国際的拡大リスクが高く、渡航制限措置が既に実施されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域として DRC とウガンダが列挙されているが、記事サマリーの主題はイトゥリ州（DRC）でのアウトブレイクであり、ウガンダは国境を越えた二次的な影響地である。対象国リストに DRC が含まれるため verified_locations に DRC のみ記載。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Bundibugyo型は重篤度が高く、承認されたワクチンや治療法がないことが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: China Pushes for Parrot Fever Vaccine as Human Cases Surge
article.articleSummary: China’s Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs has added the parrot fever vaccine to a directory of critically needed and locally undersupplied veterinary drugs, aiming to spur domestic development as human infections jump. The Center for Veterinary Drug Evaluation says the directory is intended to drive innovation and resolve supply bottlenecks for essential pet medications, guiding drug developers with a roadmap. After targeted research and extensive consultations with clinical experts, the list emphasizes vaccine development to address public health needs connected to animal-origin disease. The article provides no laboratory-confirmed case counts or outbreak specifics. This policy move highlights how veterinary drug strategy may influence human health by supporting production of vaccines to curb rising parrot fever infections in China.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、鳥インフルエンザワクチン推進 人間の感染者数増加に対応
triage.triage_reason: オウム病（鳥インフルエンザ）の人間感染が中国で増加しており異常・予想外である。しかし具体的な確定症例数や詳細な流行状況が記事に明記されておらず、IHR基準やWPRO基準の評価に必要な情報が不足している。今後の具体的データ報告を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は中国での人間感染の増加と政策対応を述べているが、具体的な確定症例数、死亡者数、流行地理的範囲などの詳細なアウトブレイク情報が欠落している。オウム病は動物由来感染症で人-人感染リスクは限定的だが、抗生物質治療への耐性株出現の可能性や中国での流行規模拡大に関する続報を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: TP.HCM ngăn chặn nguy cơ xâm nhập của dịch bệnh Ebola từ cửa khẩu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City blocks the risk of Ebola virus disease entering from border checkpoints.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) due to Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda is a WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern as of May 17, 2026. No travel or trade restrictions are currently recommended. Ho Chi Minh City authorities (Sở Y tế) have intensified border surveillance to prevent importation, with the Ho Chi Minh City Center for Disease Control (HCDC) monitoring for abnormal health signs, reviewing travel history, and coordinating with aviation, maritime, and international health quarantine units to rapidly identify suspects. Preparedness includes isolation and safe transport protocols, ongoing staff training in infection prevention and control, and PPE use. Close contacts require 21-day health surveillance; confirmed cases may be discharged or travel only after two consecutive negative tests at least 48 hours apart. WHO outlines three country-group responses: infected nations should activate emergency centers and strict isolation; neighboring border countries need cross-border readiness; non-bordering, non-restrictive approaches should focus on risk communication and evacuation readiness.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市、国境検問所からのエボラウイルス病の侵入リスクを遮断
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。WPRO基準でも複数該当。WHO PHEICに指定されている既存の国際的エボラ流行への対応事例であり、検出・監視体制の強化は重要シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナム（ホーチミン市）のエボラ侵入防止体制を主題としており、DRCおよびウガンダの既存流行への言及を含む。ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。WHO PHEIC指定（2026年5月17日）された国際的エボラ流行の監視強化事例として識別。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah Hantavirus, Begini Cara Tepat Membersihkan Kotoran Tikus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent Hantavirus: Here's the Correct Way to Clean Up Mouse Droppings
article.articleSummary: To prevent hantavirus, dampen mouse droppings with disinfectant before cleaning. Do not sweep or vacuum dry nests and droppings, as virus particles can become airborne when disturbed. Instead, wet the area with disinfectant first. After exposure to areas that may harbor mice, wash hands with soap and running water. If fever with kidney problems occurs after being in environments suspected of containing rodent droppings, seek medical care promptly. Guidance from Prof. Upik Kesumawati, head of the Entomology for Health Laboratory at IPB University’s School of Veterinary Medicine and Biomedical Sciences, is cited. The article emphasizes inhalation of dust contaminated with urine, feces, or saliva from infected mice as the primary infection route. No outbreak or case counts are mentioned.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスを防ぐために：ネズミの糞を正しく掃除する方法
triage.triage_reason: 記事はハンタウイルス感染症の予防法に関する啓発・教育記事であり、発生地域での実際の患者数、死亡例、または流行の報告がない。IHR基準およびWPROスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は予防啓発コンテンツであり、インドネシアでのハンタウイルス患者発生の報告、流行状況、重症度に関する具体的情報は含まれていない。シグナルトリアージの対象にはならない。

article.articleHeadline: Glanders scare: Horse riding regulated after confirmed case in city
article.articleSummary: Glanders case in Chennai prompts Tamil Nadu Animal Husbandry Department to regulate horse riding across beaches and major tourist spots, including Chennai, Udhagamandalam (Ooty), and Kodaikanal. A horse in Chennai died after testing positive for glanders, a highly contagious bacterial disease affecting equines. In response, authorities ordered horse owners and operators to adhere strictly to veterinary safety protocols and to avoid using unhealthy animals for commercial rides. Officials advised that horses displaying fever, coughing, nasal discharge, skin lesions, or respiratory distress should not participate in public riding activities. The measure aims to curb potential spread of glanders within equine venues and tourist sites. No further details on laboratory confirmation timing are provided beyond the confirmed Chennai case, but the linkage to regulation underscores heightened vigilance for animal health at popular destinations in Tamil Nadu.

triage.headline_ja: グランダース懸念：チェンナイで確認症例後、乗馬規制が実施
triage.triage_reason: グランダースは動物由来疾患で、公開情報によればチェンナイで馬が確認感染しており、地域的な動物健康管理上の懸念がある。しかし人間への感染リスク、重症度、国際拡大の可能性については記事に明示されておらず、IHR基準の複数該当が確認できないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: グランダースは馬などの動物に主に感染する細菌疾患。記事ではチェンナイ、ウーティ、コダイカナルの観光地で規制が実施されている。人間への感染リスクや重篤性に関する具体的情報が記事に記載されていない。動物衛生上の懸念として社会的・政治的関心は確認されるが、IHR通知基準の満たし方が不十分なため、続報待ちの段階と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in Congo and Uganda declared a health emergency, at least 100 dead: The timeline explained
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo (Ituri province: Bunia, Mongbwalu) and Uganda (Kampala) driven by Bundibugyo strain, triggering a WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026. By May 17–18 Congo reported 246 suspected cases, eight confirmed, and at least 80 deaths in key health zones; Uganda reported additional cases with two confirmed in Kampala in mid-May, one death. By May 18–19 total deaths exceeded 100, with suspected cases over 300 in the region and Goma’s urban surge raising cross-border concerns. Transmission via contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, weakness, bleeding, organ failure. Rare Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment, complicating containment amidst conflict, displacement, and cross-border movement. WHO warns non-pandemic but international concern; calls for enhanced screening, hospital capacity, and vigilance for imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴとウガンダのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが保健上の緊急事態と宣言、少なくとも100人以上が死亡：タイムラインの説明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の複数国での同時発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEICが発令されており、Bundibugyo株による致死的アウトブレイク、複数国での急速な症例増加、有効なワクチン・治療なしという極めてハイリスク状況。
triage.notes: WHO PHEICが2026年5月17日に発令されている。Bundibugyo株はまれな株で、承認されたワクチンや治療法がなく、紛争地域での発生、国境を越えた人口移動、都市部への拡大（ゴマ）が懸念される。複数国での同時発生と急速な症例増加（3日間で300例以上の疑い例、100例以上の死亡）は国際的な保健上の脅威である。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: tudo que se sabe sobre a emergência de saúde internacional que já causou 80 mortes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: everything we know about the public health emergency of international concern that has already claimed 80 lives.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-19, the World Health Organization declared an International Public Health Emergency over an Ebola outbreak in Africa caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with no vaccines or specific treatments available. The outbreak is ongoing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with 246 cases and 80 deaths reported to date. The declaration aims to mobilize international support to prevent further spread, accelerate humanitarian assistance, and strengthen epidemiological surveillance. It highlights cross-border risk and guides coordinated control measures, funding, and technical assistance. In the absence of approved vaccines or targeted therapies for this strain, containment relies on outbreak response, border health measures, case finding, contact tracing, and rapid diagnostics to limit fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：すでに80人の死亡を引き起こしている国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態についてわかっていることすべて
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo strain）の爆発的流行で、WHO国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言、246例80死亡、DRCとウガンダでの進行中の発生。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、フルRRA進捗の明確な対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダはGeoNames ID 226074で対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsから除外。DRCのみ対象国リストに該当。Bundibugyo株のエボラ発生、ワクチンと特異的治療なし、WHO PHEIC宣言、国境を越えたリスク、強化された監視体制が必要。フルRRA実施は必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: 100 deaths reported in DRC, six Americans exposed
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has at least 100 deaths and over 390 suspected cases, with the World Health Organization declaring an international emergency. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo, for which there are no approved drugs or vaccines. Uganda reports two confirmed cases and one death. About six Americans have been exposed; one symptomatic and three with high-risk exposure, with unclear infection status. The CDC is assisting the safe withdrawal of a small number of Americans and considering transport to a quarantine site; U.S. risk is deemed relatively low, with entry-prevention measures planned. Nigeria’s Academy of Medical Sciences warns of cross-border transmission risk to Nigeria, urging intensified surveillance. As of May 16, 2026, DRC records eight laboratory-confirmed cases, 246 suspected cases, and 80 suspected deaths; Uganda has two confirmed cases and one death. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood, secretions, organs, contaminated materials, infected animals, and bodies during burial rites. Recommendations call for enhanced border screening, risk-based movement controls, and improved diagnostics to enable early detection.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱: DRCで100人の死亡報告、6人のアメリカ人が露出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO緊急事態宣言、複数国での確認例、治療薬/ワクチン不在のBundibugyo株、国境を超えた伝播リスク。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはUSA、Uganda、Nigeriaも含まれているが、サマリーの主題はDRCでのエボラ発生。Ugandaは2例の確定症例と1死亡例が記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Nigeriaは警告のみで実際の患者報告ではないため除外。DRCのみ verified_locations に含める。WHO緊急事態宣言、治療薬/ワクチン不在のBundibugyo株、複数国への広がり、アメリカ人の露出などが全て高リスク要因として機能している。

article.articleHeadline: 119명 사망... '변종 에볼라' 팬데믹 공포
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 119 Dead... 'Variant Ebola' Pandemic Fear
article.articleSummary: The Bundibugyo variant of Ebola is resurging in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with outbreaks centered in Ituri Province—specifically Bunia, Lewampara, and Mongbaluda—and reports from North Kivu’s Goma (held by rebels M23). As of May 18 local time, DR Congo has over 300 suspected Ebola cases and 118 deaths; Uganda has one death. The Bundibugyo strain has a fatality rate around 30–50%, lower than the Zaire ebolavirus, but there is no available vaccine. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) the day before. In response, African nations tightened borders and quarantines; the United States restricted entry for travelers who visited DRC. South Korea’s Foreign Ministry issued safety notices and travel advisories for Ituri and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: 119人死亡... 『変異エボラ』パンデミック懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の変異株（ブンディブギョ株）がDRCで急速に拡大し、118-119人の死亡が報告されている。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。国際的拡大リスク高（ウガンダで既に死亡例、複数国が渡航制限実施）。フルRRAに進む必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダでの1例死亡とDRC内での複数地域（イトゥリ州、北キブ州）での流行を明記。ただし、対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみ該当。発生地域リストに米国・韓国・ウガンダが含まれているが、サマリーではこれらは対策実施国/関心国として記述されており、実際の疾患発生地ではない。ウガンダでの1例死亡の記述あるが、対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言（前日）は公式確認済みのシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 바이러스, 美 상륙...확진자 발생에 공포 확산
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus lands in the United States ... fear spreads as confirmed cases are reported
article.articleSummary: One American missionary in the Democratic Republic of Congo is confirmed to have Ebola and was transported to Germany for intensive care; six additional individuals with possible exposure are being moved for evaluation. U.S. authorities imposed 30-day entry restrictions on noncitizens who have recently traveled to Ebola-affected areas—Democratic Republic of Congo, South Sudan, and Uganda—within the prior three weeks, and halted visa issuance to Uganda and the DRC. President Donald Trump commented on the situation, noting growing concern over Ebola. The confirmed strain is Bundibugyo, with a case fatality rate of about 30-50%; there are currently no vaccines or specific therapies available. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, authorities report 393 suspected Ebola cases and 105 deaths to date. As of May 19, 2026, the outbreak’s effects extend beyond Africa as U.S. cases are monitored.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス、米国上陸...確診者発生に恐怖拡散
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の国際的拡大、確定患者の複数国への移送、米国での症例報告、および30日間の入国制限と査証発行停止による国際的影響が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、確定患者は米国人宣教師であるが、感染地はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）。米国は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは対象国（ID: 203312）であり、393件の疑い患者と105件の死亡が報告されている。Bundibugyo株の致命率30-50%、ワクチンおよび特異的治療法がない点で重症度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 歐家榮稱政府高度重視非洲爆發伊波拉病毒　本港風險至今屬低水平 - RTHK
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ou Ka-wing says the government attaches great importance to the Ebola outbreak in Africa; Hong Kong's risk remains at a low level to date - RTHK.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-19, Hong Kong activates the Ebola preparedness and response plan as Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda report Ebola outbreaks. The Centre for Health Protection states Hong Kong’s current risk is low, driven mainly by imported risk with some local pockets; no cross-continental spread and distant from affected countries. Escalation depends on outbreak progression and epidemiological risk; a worsening situation, spread to more countries, or the first imported case could raise HK to the serious level, while local transmission or unidentified local sources would trigger the highest emergency level with stricter community controls to stop transmission. Ebola virus is transmitted via close contact and is of moderate contagiousness. Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Bundibugyo virus) lacks specific drugs or vaccines. Travelers should avoid outbreak areas unless necessary, maintain hygiene, and avoid wildlife; travel advisories are posted by the Security Bureau.

triage.headline_ja: 欧家榮稱政府高度重視非洲爆發伊波拉病毒　本港風險至今屬低水平
triage.triage_reason: アフリカでのエボラアウトブレイク（DRC・ウガンダ）は IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響および国際的拡大リスクに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が該当。対象地域での複数国同時発生であり、フルRRA実施の必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは香港（中国）でのエボラ準備・対応計画の啓動を報じるが、実際のアウトブレイク発生地はDRCとウガンダ。ウガンダは対象国リストに非含有のため verified_locations には DRC のみ登録。香港記事であってもイベント発生地は DRC が中心。Bundibugyo ebolavirus が言及されており、多地域での同時発生が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: 독감같은 초기증상 '치사율 50%'... 전세계 국경 비상
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flu-like early symptoms with a 50% fatality rate... Global border emergency.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak resurges in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Bunia, Ituri Province, with spread to the Mongbalu area and spillover to North Kivu and South Kivu. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain is involved. Death toll stands at 119 (DRC 118, Uganda 1) with more than 300 suspected cases. First confirmed on May 24 at a Bunia health center; Mongbalu likely earlier. Early symptoms mimic flu and malaria, delaying detection; initial patients reportedly sought religious facilities rather than hospitals. WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 15. Ongoing war, famine, and weak health systems hinder surveillance, contact tracing, and care. Border measures include Rwanda closing land borders; Burundi and Tanzania increasing screening; South Africa enhancing entry screening. The US CDC restricts entry for travelers who visited DRC/Uganda/South Sudan within 21 days; Uganda and DRC visa processing suspended. An American physician in DRC tested positive and was treated in Germany; the US plans repatriation.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザのような初期症状で『致死率50%』...世界各地の国境が緊急事態
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の大規模流行で、IHR基準4項目全て該当。119名の死亡、300名以上の疑い患者、複数国への拡大、WHO緊急事態宣言、国境措置実施など全てのシグナルが確認される。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドに米国、ドイツ等が含まれるが、記事サマリーでは米国医師がドイツで治療を受けたのは医療搬送に伴うものであり、実流行地はDRC（イトゥリ州ブニア中心）とウガンダのみ。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが実流行地として該当。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、複数国による国境対策実施中。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고·우간다 에볼라 확산...사망자 100명 넘어
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda... death toll exceeds 100.
article.articleSummary: Two-country Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda has surpassed 100 deaths. As of May 18, the DRC’s Ministry of Health reports 393 suspected Ebola cases and 105 deaths, though limited testing means not all suspects are lab-confirmed. Outbreaks are centered in Ituri Province’s Bunia, with Lewampala and Mongwalu affected, and cases reported in North Kivu’s Goma under M23 rebel control. In Uganda, two nationals infected with Bundibugyo Ebola have been confirmed, with one death in Kampala. Bundibugyo Ebola lacks approved vaccines or therapies and presents with flu- or malaria-like early symptoms, hindering early detection. WHO declared an International Public Health Emergency. Rwanda closed its land border with DRC; Burundi and Tanzania heightened surveillance and border screening; Germany updated travel guidance; the U.S. Embassy in Uganda suspended all visa services.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴ・ウガンダ エボラ拡散...死亡者100名を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルスの国際的な多国間流行で100名超の死亡者、複数国での確認、WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言、複数国による渡航制限措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の国際的流行として重大なシグナル。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言済み。DRCではIturi州Buniaを中心に393例の疑い患者・105死亡；ウガンダではBundibugyo型確定2例・1死亡。複数国が国境措置や渡航制限を実施。Bundibugyo型は承認済みワクチン/治療法がなく早期検出が困難との記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: Avian flu: Eight human samples from Maharashtra's Nandurbar to be sent to NIV
article.articleSummary: Eight poultry workers in Maharashtra’s Nandurbar district, exposed to poultry or involved in culling during an avian influenza outbreak, will have nasal swab samples sent to the National Institute of Virology (NIV) Pune for avian influenza testing. All eight have so far shown no symptoms of human avian flu. As a precaution, workers are being given Tamiflu, and district health officer Ravindra Sonawane noted samples were collected due to exposure to birds; results are pending. No government employee is among those tested. Nandurbar in northwestern Maharashtra remains affected by the avian flu outbreak, with authorities monitoring for potential human cases through laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ：マハラシュトラ州ナンドゥルバルの8人の人間サンプルがNIVに送付される
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザの人間への感染リスク（H5N1相当）に関する監視事例であり、IHR基準で異常・予想外の事象かつ国際的拡大リスクを有する。WPROスクリーニング基準で異常性・流行性・管理可能性が該当し、シグナル認識として妥当。
triage.notes: 鳥インフルエンザ outbreak におけるヒト感染リスク監視。8名の家禽労働者が曝露され、現在症状なしだが検査中。Tamiflu投与による予防的対応が実施されている。ナンドゥルバル地区で継続的な家禽ウイルス流行が確認されており、ヒト-ヒト感染発生の可能性がある場合、急速な国際的拡大リスクが高い。継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: What is Ebola? Symptoms, Congo outbreak, US travel measures and Trump's remarks
article.articleSummary: Ebola is caused by orthoebolaviruses, a group of viruses first identified in 1976 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and occurring in sub-Saharan Africa. The article notes a Congo outbreak and U.S. travel measures referenced in the title. People exposed to orthoebolaviruses typically develop symptoms 2 to 21 days after exposure, most commonly around 8–10 days. Early, 'dry' signs include fever, fatigue, body aches, and pain; as illness progresses, 'wet' symptoms can include diarrhea, vomiting, and unexplained bleeding. The piece provides general symptom timelines and background but offers no specific case or death counts, no laboratory confirmation details, and no information on infection sources or imported/exported cases within the text. It focuses on background and clinical evolution rather than operational outbreak metrics.

triage.headline_ja: エボラとは何か？症状、コンゴの流行、米国の渡航措置、トランプの発言
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（致死性の高い感染症）の発生がDRC で報告されており、米国の渡航措置が言及されているが、記事サマリーに具体的な患者数、死亡数、確認症例、感染源の詳細がなく、現在の流行の規模や深刻度が不明。情報不足のため WATCH として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は教育的背景情報とサマリー形式であり、具体的な流行データ（患者数、死亡数、確認日、感染源）を含まない。DRC でのエボラ流行の存在は示唆されているが、現在の疫学的状況の詳細が欠落しているため、より詳細な情報の収集が必要。米国の渡航措置言及は国際的な関心を示すが、本記事単独では十分な詳細を提供していない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola fears: Nigerian scientists want emergency border surveillance
article.articleSummary: Cross-border Ebola risk to Nigeria as outbreaks continue in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. As of 2026-05-19, Nigerian scientists warn that Ebola could slip into Nigeria unless urgent preventive measures are activated. The Academy of Medical Sciences, Nigeria urged tightening border surveillance and rapid screening at airports, seaports and land borders, with dedicated screening lanes, digital travel surveillance, temperature checks, exposure-history assessments and emergency isolation units at entry points. They cited regional mobility, trade and travel as elevating cross-border transmission risk. Urgent activation of the National Ebola Incident Management System involving the Federal Ministry of Health, NCDC, port health services and state governments, plus reactivation of infectious-disease emergency structures, isolation centres, referral systems and rapid-response teams nationwide were advocated. Health facilities should establish Ebola-ready treatment zones with strict infection prevention, adequate PPE, training and emergency protocols for frontline staff, given Ebola’s severe, often fatal nature and potential for disruption.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の脅威：ナイジェリアの科学者が国境における緊急監視体制を要求
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の国際的拡大リスク（DRC・ウガンダでの継続的発生とナイジェリアへの越境リスク）が明確に指摘されており、IHR基準（異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）に複数該当、かつWPRO基準（重症度・流行性・管理可能性）でも複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUganda（226074）とNigeria（2328926）も含まれているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRC（203312）のみ。記事サマリーでは「DRCとウガンダでのエボラ発生継続とナイジェリアへの越境リスク」が述べられているが、対象国リストではナイジェリアは含まれていない（アフリカ対象国はGhana, DRC, Zambiaのみ）。エボラの高い致死率と国境を越えた拡大リスク、複数国家レベルでの対応要求が明記されており、シグナル優先度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kabupaten Bekasi Tingkatkan Kewaspadaan Hantavirus, Dinkes Terbitkan Surat Edaran ke Fasilitas Kesehatan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bekasi Regency Steps Up Hantavirus Vigilance, Health Office Issues Circular to Health Facilities.
article.articleSummary: On May 19, 2026, Bekasi Regency’s Health Office issued circular 400.7.7.1/5943/Dinkes/2026 to all hospitals, puskesmas, and clinics, elevating hantavirus vigilance after cases were reported in DKI Jakarta. No Bekasi facilities have reported hantavirus cases yet, but authorities stressed enhanced surveillance and early detection for symptoms resembling leptospirosis, dengue, typhoid, or acute respiratory infections. Laboratory testing is being strengthened to confirm Orthohantavirus infections, whose main reservoirs are rodents and shrews. Supria Dinata, Secretary of the Bekasi Health Office, noted the guidance in Cikarang on May 18. Public guidance urges individuals with fever, headache, body pains, cough, shortness of breath, or jaundice to seek medical care promptly, reflecting proactive preventive measures amid potential cross‑jurisdictional transmission with Jakarta."

triage.headline_ja: ベカシ県、ハンタウイルスへの警戒強化、保健局が医療機関に通知書を発行
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（ジャカルタ都市圏）でハンタウイルス感染症が確認され、複数の医療機関に警戒通知が発令されている。デング、レプトスピラ症、チフスとの症状の類似性があり、複合的なリスク管理が必要である点で異常かつ重要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はベカシ県とジャカルタ都市圏（DKI Jakarta）での発生を扱っており、両地域ともインドネシア領内。ハンタウイルスはげっ歯類が主要な保有宿主であり、野外接触リスクがある。複数の類似症状を呈する感染症（デング、レプトスピラ症、チフス）との鑑別が課題となっている点で、診断と管理体制の強化が急務。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Qué debemos saber sobre el brote de ébola?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What should we know about the Ebola outbreak?
article.articleSummary: Rwanda's Ministry of Health has strengthened border controls and surveillance with the Democratic Republic of the Congo as part of the ongoing Ebola response in the region. Kenya announced similar measures at all entry points, including airports and land and sea crossings. Ebola is caused by a group of related viruses known as ebolaviruses. The outbreak in the region traces back to the virus first identified in 1976 in what are now South Sudan and the Democratic Republic of Congo, near the Ebola River. Frugivorous bats are believed to be carriers of the viruses, potentially maintaining transmission to humans. The report emphasizes heightened cross-border vigilance to prevent importation and further spread, though no case counts are provided in the article. Authorities emphasize border screening and surveillance as part of broader outbreak containment efforts as of May 19, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行について私たちが知るべきことは何か？
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の地域的流行であり、IHR基準4項目中3項目（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）が該当。複数国での国境管理強化が報告されており、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRCでのエボラ流行が主題であり、ルワンダ・ケニアはDRCからの輸入防止のための国境管理強化の対応国として言及されている。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが確認対象に該当。症例数が記事に記載されていないため重症度は「不明」と評価。コウモリが自然宿主と指摘されており、長期的な曝露リスクがある。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला वायरस क्या है? अफ्रीका में बढ़ते प्रकोप के बीच जानिए इसके लक्षण, फैलने के तरीके और भारत में स्थिति - CNBC Awaaz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is the Ebola virus? Amid the rising outbreak in Africa, learn its symptoms, modes of transmission, and the situation in India - CNBC Awaaz.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus outbreak intensifies in Africa, with more than 80 deaths reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern as the Bundibugyo virus strain, part of the Orthoebolavirus group, drives the surge. Africa CDC reports rising cases and fatalities; confirmed cases are accompanied by hundreds of suspected infections. The disease spreads through infected blood, saliva, sweat, and other bodily fluids, as well as via contaminated clothing, bedding, needles, and medical equipment; unsafe handling of corpses raises transmission risk. Early symptoms resemble viral fever and can progress to central nervous system effects such as confusion, irritability, and abnormal behavior. India currently has no Ebola cases; one imported case occurred in 2014. Emphasis remains on surveillance, early detection, infection control, and avoiding contact with infected fluids.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスとは何か？アフリカで拡大する発生の中で、その症状、感染経路、およびインドの状況を知る - CNBC Awaaz
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威。WHO が国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言し、DRC とウガンダで 80 人以上の死亡と数百の疑い患者が報告されている。IHR 基準 3 つ以上該当し、シグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではアフリカでのエボラ発生が主に DRC とウガンダで報告されている。ウガンダは対象国リストにないため verified_locations から除外。インドについては「現在エボラ患者はなし、2014年に1件の輸入症例」と記載されており、情報提供対象国として含める。WHO が PHEIC 宣言済みのため国際的関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Confirman caso de ébola en estadounidense proveniente de África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola case confirmed in U.S. citizen from Africa.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola case has been confirmed in a United States citizen. The patient contracted the virus while working in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, triggering immediate international isolation protocols. Symptoms emerged over the past weekend, with laboratory tests confirming the diagnosis on Sunday night, according to Satish Pillai, who leads Ebola incident response at the federal health agency. Health authorities are coordinating logistics to transport the patient to Germany for specialized therapy. The transfer aims to ensure access to advanced medical infrastructure while maintaining strict epidemiological control during the transatlantic journey. The case underscores ongoing Ebola vigilance linked to work in Central Africa and the U.S. health system's response, including rapid isolation, cross-border coordination, and access to specialized treatment.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ国籍者のエボラ出血熱感染が確認 アフリカから帰国
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は重篤な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを伴う。米国での確認例は明らかに異常・予想外であり、直ちにフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは患者はDRC（対象国）で感染し、米国で診断確認、ドイツへの転送予定。対象国リストに米国・ドイツは含まれないため verified_locations はDRCのみ。エボラ出血熱の国際的な患者移送と国境を越えた医療対応は極めて高いリスク。直ちにフル評価の対象。

article.articleHeadline: Vietnam ramps up Ebola prevention measures at Ho Chi Minh City gateways
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City intensified health monitoring at airports, seaports and international entry points, issuing an urgent directive on May 19, 2026, after the WHO declared the Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. The city Department of Health ordered enhanced border surveillance, including screening inbound travelers for unusual symptoms, reviewing travel histories, and coordinating with aviation, maritime and quarantine authorities, with preparations for isolation, treatment and safe transport of suspected cases. The Ho Chi Minh City Center for Disease Control (HCDC) will implement comprehensive border surveillance, while hospitals receive training in infection control, PPE use, and handling suspected Ebola cases. WHO guidance distinguishes recommendations by country group; border-sharing nations should raise preparedness and respond within 24 hours, while non-border countries should avoid mass entry screening and emphasize prevention information and evacuation planning.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムがホーチミン市の出入口でエボラ防止対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的に異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。また、WHO PHEIC宣言された実在の流行に対する国境対策の強化という明確なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はベトナム（ホーチミン市）の対応強化であるが、発動のトリガーはDRC/ウガンダでのBundibugyo株エボラ流行のWHO PHEIC宣言。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。本件は既知の重大流行への国際的対応段階であり、シグナルとして拾うべき。

article.articleHeadline: У Конго вже щонайменше 100 померлих від Еболи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Congo, at least 100 people have died from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports at least 100 Ebola deaths and over 390 infections. In Uganda, two confirmed cases and one death have been reported. Africa CDC director Jean Kasaya warns that, without approved medicines or vaccines, strict safety measures—especially during funerals—are essential to curb transmission. Dr. Heidi Overton says one patient is an American with Bundibugyo virus; he and six high-risk contacts will be evacuated to Germany. The WHO recommends border screening for Congo and Uganda to prevent cross-border spread; Rwanda will strengthen border controls, and Nigeria is monitoring the situation. The WHO had declared the Congo-Uganda Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern the day before. (As of 2026-05-19)

triage.headline_ja: コンゴではすでにエボラで少なくとも100人が死亡している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラウイルス病は高い死亡率で深刻な公衆衛生への影響があり、DRC・ウガンダでの多数死亡・感染、米国患者のドイツへの搬送予定により国際的拡大リスク、国境スクリーニングと渡航制限勧告がある。WHO PKEICも前日に宣言済み。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例報告、ドイツへの患者搬送予定、ルワンダ・ナイジェリアでの対応準備も記載されているが、主要な発生地はDRCであり、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。WHO PKEICが前日に宣言済みで、緊急対応段階に入っている。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго уже как минимум 100 погибших от Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Congo, at least 100 have died from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports an Ebola outbreak with at least 100 deaths and more than 390 cases, according to Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya. Uganda confirms two Ebola cases and one death. Authorities stress safety measures, especially during burial rites, due to lack of approved treatments or vaccines. An American patient has tested positive for Bundibugyo virus, an Ebola strain, and, along with six high-risk contacts, will be evacuated to Germany. The World Health Organization has urged border screening in Congo and Uganda and urged neighboring countries to heighten readiness. Rwanda says it will tighten border controls, and Nigeria reports close monitoring. Previously, the WHO declared the Congo–Uganda Ebola outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. Separately, WHO anticipates rising hantavirus infections linked to the Andes virus following the Hondius cruise ship outbreak, with up to 40% case fatality.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴではエボラで少なくとも100人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、予想外の急速な拡大、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。複数国での確認、死亡例の急速な増加、WHOによるPHEIC宣言済みのため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは複数国（ウガンダ、ルワンダ、ナイジェリア、ドイツ）に言及しているが、主要な発生地は DRC（コンゴ）であり、他国は接触者追跡・国境警戒等の対応段階。対象国リストでの検証に基づき DRC のみを verified_locations に含める。Hantavirus Infection（ハンタウイルス感染症）はHondius船での発生と記載されているが、発生地を特定できないため除外。PHEICは既に宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: US issues travel ban amid massive Ebola outbreak that has killed 100: Here's all about it
article.articleSummary: 30-day US entry ban on travelers who have been in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan in the past 21 days was issued by the CDC, with exemptions for US citizens and permanent residents, amid a Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak that has killed at least 100. The ban aims to minimize spillover and buys time to assess threat, while the US steps up health screening and contact tracing for recent entrants. An American physician with the Serge aid group, Peter Stafford, working at Bunia hospital in northeastern DRC, tested positive for Ebola; his wife and two other doctors exposed are also affected. Stafford and his family, plus four children, are being relocated to Germany for treatment; other Serge doctors at Nyankude Hospital have been transferred there for observation and are asymptomatic. WHO declared a health emergency; Bundibugyo mortality is 25–50% and there is no vaccine or specific therapy.

triage.headline_ja: 100人以上が死亡した大規模エボラ出血熱の発生を背景に米国が渡航禁止令を発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な出来事、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による100人以上の死亡、WHO健康緊急事態宣言、米国の渡航禁止令発令により、国際的な関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: Bunia はDRC北東部の都市で、DRC内での発生地。記事サマリーでは Sudan (South Sudan) が言及されているが、対象国リストに South Sudan が含まれていないため除外。Uganda も記事に言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。米国、ドイツはいずれも発症事例の移送・治療地であり、発生地ではない。WHO緊急宣言、Bundibugyo ebolavirus（致死率25～50%）、米国による30日間の渡航禁止令発令が確認される高リスク事象。

article.articleHeadline: What to know about the Bundibugyo virus, a species of Ebola causing an outbreak in Congo - CNBC TV18
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus, a rare Ebola species behind an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Congo River basin), has killed nearly 120 people. The virus, first identified in 2007 by the CDC's Special Pathogens Branch, is believed to be less deadly than Zaire Ebola, with a preliminary mortality around 30% or higher, though precision is limited by experience. Transmission occurs through close contact with bodily fluids of sick or deceased individuals; healthcare workers and family carers face the highest risk. No specific treatments or vaccines exist for Bundibugyo, and clinical trials are not ready. Public health responses focus on rapid case finding, isolation, contact tracing, and ensuring PPE for health workers, plus supportive care (IV or oral fluids). Past Bundibugyo outbreaks show early detection and rapid response reduce mortality; safe burial practices and public education remain key as Congo has had 17 Ebola outbreaks and can be stopped.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで発生しているエボラウイルスの一種であるブンディブギョウイルスについて知っておくべきことー CNBC TV18
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルスの新種（ブンディブギョウ株）によるDRC発生の未確認エボラアウトブレイク。死亡者120名近く、国際的拡大リスク、医療体制への深刻な影響。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（ブンディブギョウ株）の新規アウトブレイク。DRCは過去17件のエボラアウトブレイク経験あり。ワクチン・治療法なし。ヒト-ヒト感染リスク高（接触感染）。医療従事者と家族介護者がハイリスク。早期検出と迅速対応が死亡率低減に有効（過去データより）。国際社会の支援・関心が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Bundibugyo Mewabah, Apa yang Membuat Varian Ini Sangat Mengkhawatirkan?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bundibugyo Ebola Outbreak: What Makes This Variant So Concerning?
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization has declared a global health emergency as the Bundibugyo Ebola variant drives renewed outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province) and neighboring Uganda. In Ituri, 80 Ebola-related deaths have been recorded among about 250 suspected cases. Laboratory confirmation has linked eight cases directly to the Bundibugyo virus, with cross-border transmission confirmed into Uganda. The principal challenge is the Bundibugyo strain, a rare Ebola variant for which there is no vaccine or disease-specific treatment, complicating containment and isolation efforts. Ebola, a viral hemorrhagic fever in the genus Orthoebolavirus, was first identified in 1976 near the Ebola River in what are now South Sudan and the DRC. Transmission occurs predominantly through direct contact with bodily fluids from the infected or the deceased, and via contaminated objects; Ebola typically progresses in two phases. The outbreak spans multiple countries, with ongoing surveillance and border containment required.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱ブンディブギョ型が流行、この変異株がこれほど懸念される理由は？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。WHOが国際的な保健上の緊急事態を宣言し、ワクチン非対応の稀有な変異株による複数国での集団発生、高い致死率（80人死亡/約250人疑い例）、国境を超えた伝播確認、および国際的な対応の必要性が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRC（イツリ州）での確定症例と死亡例が具体的に記載されている。ウガンダとスーダンへの言及は越境伝播の文脈だが、サマリー上で確定的な発生地域として記載されておらず、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。2026年5月の現在日付から将来の日付イベントである点に留意。WHOの国際的な保健上の緊急事態宣言により、シグナル性は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: 世衛將埃博拉疫情列國際緊急事件 港府啟動戒備級別嚴防輸入
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Declares Ebola Outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; Hong Kong Government Activates High-Alert Level to Strictly Prevent Importation.
article.articleSummary: WHO on May 17 declared the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Hong Kong activated the Ebola preparedness and response plan’s alert level to prevent importation, intensifying health screening for African arrivals at the airport. As of May 16, Ituri Province, DRC, reported 8 laboratory-confirmed cases, 246 suspected cases, and 80 suspected deaths across three health zones, including four healthcare workers among the deceased; a Kinshasa-confirmed case was linked to a return from Ituri. Uganda reported two confirmed cases, one death, both travelers from DRC, with no clear epidemiologic link between them; the deceased was a 59-year-old Congolese patient in Kampala. Bundibugyo EBOV has no approved vaccine or specific therapy; control relies on supportive care. Transmission occurs via contact with infected bodily fluids; no airborne spread. Reservoirs include fruit bats; incubation 2-21 days.

triage.headline_ja: WHO がエボラ出血熱の発生を国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態として指定、香港政府が厳格な輸入防止対策のため高度警戒レベルを発動
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ中4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、かつWHOによる国際緊急宣言が既になされている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) の発生。DRCでの確認症例は8例、疑い例246例、死亡80例超。ウガンダでも2例の確認症例あり。WHOは既に2026年5月17日に国際緊急事態（PHEIC）として宣言済み。ワクチンや特異的治療法がなく、接触感染による人-人感染。複数国への拡大リスク、国際的な対応が進行中。香港など域外地域でも防止措置が発動。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in der DR Kongo: Was jetzt fÃ¼r Diagnostik und EindÃ¤mmung zÃ¤hlt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo: What matters now for diagnostics and containment.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo intensifies as transmission likely has been undetected for weeks, with at least 10 confirmed cases and over 330 suspected infections. On May 17, the WHO declared the situation a public health emergency of international concern. The Bundibugyo strain is implicated, with a typical fatality range of 25–50% and transmission via contact with blood or body fluids. Healthcare workers are dying, indicating transmission within care and supply chains. There are currently no licensed vaccines or targeted treatments for Bundibugyo, heightening the importance of rapid diagnostics and isolation. Containment hinges on expanding diagnostics, creating more testing sites, and standardizing sample logistics to detect mild cases and trace contacts. The outbreak is occurring in conflict-affected areas, complicating access and cross-border surveillance. Three system levels—test capacity, quality assurance, and data/communications flows—must be addressed to shorten the time from suspicion to confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴのエボラ：診断と封じ込めに必要なこと
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべて該当。WHO が国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言した重大なエボラ出血熱の流行。
triage.notes: 2026年5月17日にWHOが国際保健上の緊急事態(PHEIC)を宣言。Bundibugyo株で致命率25-50%。少なくとも10確認例、330以上の疑い例。医療従事者の死亡が報告されており、医療環囲での感染が示唆される。紛争地域での発生により、アクセスと越境監視が複雑化。ワクチンと標的治療薬が利用不可。

article.articleHeadline: الولايات المتحدة تفرض إجراءات مشددة على حدودها بعد تفشي إيبولا في دول أفريقية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States imposes stringent border measures after Ebola outbreak in African countries.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-19, the United States tightened border measures after an Ebola outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with spillovers to Uganda and South Sudan, following the WHO's declaration of an international health emergency. The US CDC assesses direct risk to Americans as low but says preventive measures could be adjusted as new data emerge. WHO Ebola incident manager Satish Pillay reported a US citizen infected in the DRC developed symptoms over the weekend and tested positive on Sunday; efforts are underway to move the patient to Germany for treatment, and six others will be evacuated for health monitoring. The CDC will restrict entry of non-US passport holders who traveled to Uganda, the DRC, or South Sudan in the prior 21 days, alongside enhanced airport screening. The US embassy in Kampala suspended all visa services temporarily. No vaccine or specific therapy exists for the current strain; about 350 suspected cases, predominantly aged 20–39, with more than 60% women.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、アフリカ諸国のエボラ流行後、国境での厳格措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は高い公衆衛生影響、複数国への国際的拡大（DRC・ウガンダ・南スーダン）、渡航制限措置、WHOの国際保健上の緊急事態宣言など、シグナル要件を明確に満たしている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラ流行の中心地はDRC（民主共和国コンゴ）で、ウガンダと南スーダンへの二次的な拡大が報告されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。米国やドイツでの対応はエボラ対策の一環だが、当該対象国でない。約350の疑い患者、60%以上が女性、20～39歳が中心。米国籍市民1名がDRCで感染し陽性確認。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。ワクチン・特異的治療なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: en Ouganda, l'état d'alerte et une vigilance renforcée après la confirmation de deux cas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: in Uganda, alert status and heightened vigilance after the confirmation of two cases.
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola cases have been confirmed in Uganda, including one death, linked to the ongoing outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. Contacts of the deceased Congolese national have been isolated; Uganda tightened border controls, testing all travelers entering or returning from the DRC. Authorities postponed the June 3 Day of the Martyrs pilgrimage to reduce risk, citing the need to avoid large gatherings. The Entebbe Viral Research Centre is fully equipped and experienced in managing such outbreaks. Officials urge vigilance, hand hygiene, and avoidance of handshakes, embraces, and other close contact. Uganda notes cross-border containment has helped keep the 2025 outbreak free of deaths; the country maintains border surveillance to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ウガンダでアラート状態と強化された警戒態勢が確認された2件の事例の後に実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な集団感染拡大の初期兆候。DRCの流行からウガンダへの越境感染が確認され、IHR基準（異常・予想外、国際的な感染拡大リスク）を複数満たす。公式な警戒態勢の強化と国境管理の厳格化が報告されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドにはウガンダ（Republic of Uganda, ID 226074）も含まれているが、記事サマリーの内容を精査すると、実際の集団感染の主要発生源はDRCの東部であり、ウガンダはDRCの流行からの越境感染を受けた二次的な影響国である。対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsではDRCのみを記載する。ただし、ウガンダが対象国に含まれる場合は両国を記載すべき状況である。エボラは高い重症度（既に1名死亡）、ヒト-ヒト感染の高い可能性、対策を必要とする点でWPRO基準をすべて満たす。

article.articleHeadline:
Ebola death toll in DR Congo rises to 118
                            Health officials believe the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo began several weeks ago, with the death toll now rising to 118. The outbreak has been declared a Public Health Emerg...
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri and North Kivu) has caused 118 deaths among roughly 300 suspected cases as of 19 May 2026. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The Bundibugyo strain is involved; Africa CDC reports more than 390 suspected cases overall. Across the border in Uganda, authorities report one death and one suspected case linked to the outbreak, with numbers expected to rise as surveillance expands; US CDC confirms cases and fatalities in Uganda connected to the outbreak. Congo plans to open three Ebola treatment centers in eastern Ituri to bolster containment while WHO dispatches a team of experts. The situation underscores the need for coordinated international response to halt cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死亡者数が118人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模発生で、WHO公式宣言の公衆衛生緊急事態、国際的拡大（ウガンダへの越境感染）、渡航・貿易制限のリスク高。スクリーニング基準も全項目該当し、国際支援が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーでウガンダは越境感染の報告にとどまり、主要な発生地はDRC（Ituri・North Kivu州）。対象国リストにウガンダは含まれていないためverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。複数治療センター設置予定で対応体制構築中。

article.articleHeadline: Американски лекар е дал положителна проба за вируса ебола в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American doctor has tested positive for the Ebola virus in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: An American physician working in the Democratic Republic of Congo has tested positive for the Ebola virus. The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) confirmed infection after the doctor developed symptoms over the weekend and yielded a positive test late Sunday. He is being prepared for transfer to Germany for treatment, according to Satish Pillai, CDC official overseeing the Ebola response. The incident underscores ongoing Ebola risks associated with field work in the DRC and raises questions about international patient transport for specialized care. No details were provided on the exact location within the DRC or the recipient hospital in Germany. The CDC continues to monitor the case and coordinate public health measures to prevent secondary transmission.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ人医師がコンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス検査で陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。ヒト-ヒト感染可能な病原体（エボラ）の確認例であり、国際的な患者搬送を伴うため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ確認例が主題。米国医師がDRCで感染し、ドイツへの搬送が予定されている。Bluedot APIが米国とドイツを発生地域として挙げているが、サマリー上でこれらは患者搬送の目的地（米国CDC確認、ドイツ治療受け入れ）であり、実際の感染発生地はDRCのみ。対象国リストにDRCのみ該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: restriction d'entrée aux États-Unis pour certains voyageurs d'Afrique centrale après un cas américain
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: U.S. entry restrictions for certain travelers from Central Africa after a U.S. case
article.articleSummary: Ebola case in the United States prompts CDC to tighten border controls in May 2026. The United States will bar entry for foreign nationals who traveled in the last 21 days to Ebola-affected regions: the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan. The measures follow an Ebola infection of an American physician with the Christian humanitarian organization Serge, working at Nyankunde Hospital near Bunia, DRC. The patient tested positive two days ago and is to be transferred to Germany; his wife and another American are in quarantine. Six other people, nationality unspecified, are to be repatriated and may be Americans. Germany previously quarantined U.S. personnel during Ebola outbreaks (2014), with care at Landstuhl Regional Medical Center. In addition, visa restrictions for the affected countries will be temporary; the Kampala embassy is already enforcing them. The WHO declared the DRC outbreak a PHEIC, but the immediate U.S. risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：米国人症例後、米国が中央アフリカからの特定の旅行者の入国を制限
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）、WPRO基準3つ以上該当（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）、社会的・政治的関心も高い（WHO PHEIC宣言、米国の国境管理措置）。フルRRAに進む。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは米国とドイツも記載されているが、主要な感染症イベント（エボラ発生地）はDRC（Nyankunde Hospital近くのBunia）。Uganda、South Sudan（Sudan）は「影響を受けた地域」として米国の入国制限の対象となっているが、記事サマリー上で現在の感染症発生事例は米国の医師がDRCで感染した1例のみが述べられている。ウガンダとスーダンは対象国に含まれていないため、verified_locationsに追加しない。WHO PHEIC宣言とDRC発生の情報から、このシグナルはハイプライオリティで対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: le séquençage du virus confirme le retour de la souche rare Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: viral sequencing confirms the return of the rare Bundibugyo strain.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus has returned to eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with transmission centered in Ituri (Bunia and the Mongwalu mining area) and new foci in North Kivu (Butembo) and Ituri (Nyankunde). Kinshasa's National Institute for Biomedical Research (INRB) confirmed the Bundibugyo strain by sequencing; authorities say the 2026 outbreak is not linked to the 2007 or 2012 epidemics and involves animal-to-human spillover, with bats suspected as the reservoir though the source has not been identified. There are 435 suspected cases and 116 probable deaths reported by the Health Ministry. A US doctor with the humanitarian group Serge in Nyankunde was infected; his wife and another American are in quarantine. No vaccine or approved treatment exists for Bundibugyo; officials are planning vaccine-testing protocols to assess potential cross-protection, while stressing prevention and avoiding high-risk contacts and funeral rites.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ウイルス配列解析により稀なブンディブギョ株の復帰を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてにも該当。ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスの出現は稀であり、ワクチンと承認済み治療法がない点で特に重大。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスは稀な株であり、本格的なRRA実施が必須。複数の地理的フォーカス（イトゥリ地域、北キブ州）、米国人医療スタッフの感染、動物由来感染の確認がある。ワクチン開発中であるが承認済み治療法がない点が懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Claves del brote de ébola que preocupa a la OMS: más de un centenar de muertes en África, una cepa rara y sin vacuna
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Key aspects of the Ebola outbreak that concern the WHO: more than a hundred deaths in Africa, a rare strain, and no vaccine.
article.articleSummary: WHO declares Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) amid 116 suspected deaths and eight lab-confirmed cases in the DRC as of May 18. Ituri province reports cases across Bunia, Rwampara, and Mongbwalu; Uganda has two confirmed cases in Kampala from travelers from the DRC, with another case from Ituri to Kinshasa testing negative. A U.S. citizen infected in the DRC will be evacuated to Germany for treatment; CDC says symptoms began over the weekend and testing was positive on Sunday. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus; no approved vaccines or treatments exist for this strain, though vaccines for other Ebola viruses exist and vaccines for Sudan and Bundibugyo are in development. Transmission requires contact with blood or bodily fluids; natural reservoirs include frugivorous bats (Pteropodidae); incubation 2–21 days, with a roughly 50% fatality rate. The OMS emphasizes strengthened surveillance, labs, infection prevention, and isolation units, noting security and mobility challenges. This is the seventeenth Congo Ebola outbreak since 1976; the last ended last December.

triage.headline_ja: WHOを懸念させるエボラ出血熱の集団発生：アフリカで100人以上の死亡、珍しい株、ワクチンなし
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WHOがPHEIC宣言している確定的なシグナル。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo virus（ブンディブギョウイルス）による確認エボラ出血熱。116人の死亡疑い例、8例の確定例（DRC、2026年5月18日時点）。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。ウガンダはDRCからの流入例であるため主要発生地はDRCと判断。米国民は既に国外脱出のため直接的な発生地と見なさない。対象国リスト外の国（ウガンダ、ルワンダ、ドイツ、米国）は除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Amerikaanse arts met ebola voor behandeling naar Duitsland overgebracht
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American doctor with Ebola transferred to Germany for treatment.
article.articleSummary: An American doctor infected with Ebola is being treated in Germany after testing positive Sunday night, CDC reports; he worked in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). He is transported to Germany due to shorter flight times and Germany's experience in Ebola care, accompanied by six high-risk contacts; nationalities and exact treatment location not disclosed. The World Health Organization has declared an international health emergency over the Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda, involving a rare variant with no available vaccine; regional spread risk is high. As of May 16, ten laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases, mostly in Ituri Province, DRC, with 246 suspected cases and 80 deaths potentially linked; additional infections confirmed in Kampala, Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染したアメリカ人医師、治療のためドイツに搬送
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染の国際的事例であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが明白。WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言済み。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明確に DRC におけるエボラ確定例（10例）と疑い例（246例）、死亡例（80例）が報告されている。Kampala, Uganda は発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダでの追加感染確認の言及のみであり、主要な発生地はDRC。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めず。WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言、ワクチンなし、地域拡大リスク高と明記。

article.articleHeadline: В Африке новая вспышка Эболы: что важно знать
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola outbreak in Africa: What you need to know.
article.articleSummary: WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over an Ebola outbreak spanning the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province) and Uganda. In DRC, 91 deaths and over 350 cases have been reported, with 49 patients still receiving care in Bunia and Mongwalu, the outbreak’s main centers. Uganda reports cases in Kampala among two travelers from DRC, including one death. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, one of three known Ebola viruses; past outbreaks occurred in 2007 and 2012, with mortality around 30% then. There is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment; care is supportive. Transmission is via close contact with blood or bodily fluids; incubation 2–21 days; WHO cites roughly 50% overall fatality. Civil conflict in DRC drives displacement (>250,000), complicating control. Russia will provide epidemiological support and diagnostic tests; border surveillance is heightened. No significant immediate risk to Russia.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ出血熱の新たな流行：知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大の実現、複数国での確認、国際支援必要）。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全てに該当。WHO PHEICが宣言されている高リスクシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（Ituri Province）とウガンダでの発生が確認されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが含まれるため verified_locations に DRC のみを列挙。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、複数国での確認、約50%の致死率、治療法なし、内戦による住民移動（25万人以上）が制御を複雑化させている。ロシアの疫学支援提供と境界監視強化が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 사망자 100명 넘어...美 '증오범죄' 총기난사
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll surpasses 100... U.S. hate crime mass shooting
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, Ebola deaths in Africa exceed 100 with over 300 suspected cases across the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment; containment relies on infection prevention and supportive care. The World Health Organization has declared an international public health emergency. Nearby countries are tightening borders and increasing quarantine measures, while the United States has restricted entry for travelers who recently visited Africa. Separately, hantavirus outbreaks are linked to the cruise MV Hondius, which docked in the Netherlands for disinfection after three onboard deaths since February 2. In Colorado, one hantavirus death has been reported, with authorities investigating exposure sources and noting no link to the cruise.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染症による死者が100人を超える...米国では『ヘイトクライム』銃乱射事件
triage.triage_reason: Ebola（エボラウイルス）の大規模感染事件であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHO国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済み、複数国での拡大確認、死亡者100名超。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラ死者100名超、疑い症例300名以上、Bundibugyo株による大規模流行。WHOが国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言済み。複数国での渡航制限実施。Uganda経由での言及もあるが、記事サマリーではDRCが主要発生地域。Hantavirus（ハンタウイルス）についてはオランダのクルーズ船由来で、コロラド州での死亡報告はあるが、対象国外（米国）のため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: अफ्रीका में अमेरिकी नागर‍िक में इबोला संक्रमण के बाद ट्रंप प्रशासन ने लगाए नए यात्रा प्रतिबंध | US tightens curbs after American citizen tests positive for Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After an American citizen contracted Ebola in Africa, the Trump administration imposed new travel bans | US tightens curbs after American citizen tests positive for Ebola
article.articleSummary: An American citizen in Africa tested positive for the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, triggering new travel bans and emergency steps by the Trump administration. There are no current cases in the United States. The interagency response includes the State Department, the CDC, and the Department of War. The infected individual and six other high-risk contacts will be evacuated to a specialized virus treatment center in Germany. Effective immediately, non-U.S. nationals who have recently traveled to Uganda, the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Republic of Congo, or South Sudan are barred from entering the United States for 21 days. U.S. travelers in the outbreak region have been warned. Ebola Bundibugyo can cause fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding and spreads through direct contact with infected bodily fluids. The exact location of the patient within the outbreak area has not been disclosed.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでアメリカ市民がエボラに感染、トランプ政権が新たな渡航禁止措置を実施 | エボラ感染確認後、米国が規制を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WPRO基準でも4つ該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。高い社会的・政治的関心があり、国際的対応が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、患者がアフリカで感染し、DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン、コンゴ共和国が言及されている。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが確認される。患者の正確な位置は未開示だが、outbreak regionはアフリカの上記地域を指している。米国での症例はなく、海外での感染報告が主軸。ドイツへの患者搬送予定により国際的拡大リスクは存在。

article.articleHeadline: سلاسة نادرة من فيروس "إيبولا" تودي بحياة 120 شخصاً في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A rare Ebola virus strain kills 120 people in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo faces a Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in Ituri, with about 120 deaths reported as of May 19, 2026. WHO has declared Ebola a Health Emergency. Three new Ebola treatment centers will open as WHO deploys experts. Fatalities began in Bunia on April 24, with spread to Goma, Butembo, Mongbalu, and Nyakandi; Bundibugyo confirmation came on May 14–15 after initial tests targeted Zaire. An American physician treating patients in Bunia is among the confirmed cases; seven Americans are being evacuated to Germany for observation. The U.S. CDC says risk to Americans remains low; travel advisories are in place; a 30-day entry ban applies to foreigners who visited DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the prior three weeks. The outbreak worsens a regional humanitarian crisis with over 273,000 internally displaced; no vaccines or approved antivirals exist. Rwanda and Uganda tightened border controls; no confirmed cross-border transmission yet.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで「エボラ」ウイルスの稀な株が120人の命を奪う
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱の確認された集団発生で深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、複数国での渡航制限措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: 2026年5月19日時点で120人の死亡が報告されているBundibugyo型エボラ出血熱の集団発生。DRC東部Ituri州およびNord-Kivu州で発生。米国医師1人を含む確認症例があり、7人のアメリカ人がドイツへ避難中。WHOは保健緊急事態を宣言。複数国で渡航制限措置が発動されている。

article.articleHeadline: 美加强旅行限制等措施防埃博拉病例输入
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. steps up travel restrictions and other measures to prevent the importation of Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the US CDC tightened measures to prevent Bundibugyo ebolavirus importation. Travel screening and monitoring will apply to travelers from Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan who visited in 21 days; non-US passport holders are barred entry. Coordinated with DHS, measures include stronger contact tracing, lab capacity, and hospital readiness, valid 30 days. A US healthcare worker who treated a Bundibugyo ebolavirus patient in the DRC tested positive on May 17; the patient and high-risk contacts are being moved to Germany; US risk remains low. Symptoms include fever, headache, vomiting, severe weakness, abdominal pain, epistaxis, and hematemesis; case fatality 25–50%; no vaccine; treatment is supportive. WHO declared the DRC and Uganda Ebola outbreaks a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. In Ituri Province, eastern DRC, 116 suspected deaths and 435 suspected cases; Uganda reports two lab-confirmed cases (one death), no linkage reported.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ病例の輸入防止に向けて渡航制限等の措置を強化
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo ebolavirus のDRC・ウガンダでの集団発生、WHO による国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、米国での医療従事者の確認患者、複数国での流行の拡大リスクが認められ、IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）が該当する。
triage.notes: DRC（Ituri州）での116疑い死亡・435疑い例、ウガンダでの2確定例が記事の主題。スーダンはサマリーに言及されていないため除外。米国・ドイツ・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。WHO による PHEIC 宣言により、シグナル判定は強く支持される。

article.articleHeadline: US to screen for Ebola at airports, one American in DR Congo infected
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompts renewed U.S. CDC measures: airport screening for travelers from outbreak areas and visa restrictions for non-U.S. passport holders who have traveled to Uganda, DRC, or South Sudan within 21 days. One American in the DRC infected via work exposure tested positive late Sunday and will be transported to Germany for treatment; six more people are being evacuated for health monitoring. About 25 U.S. personnel work in the DRC field office, with an additional senior technical coordinator to be deployed. The United States assesses the immediate risk to the general public as low while monitoring the evolving situation and adjusting measures as needed. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for this Ebola strain. Current figures: about 350 suspected cases and 91 deaths suspected; most patients are aged 20–39, with over 60% women.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ出血熱の空港スクリーニングを実施、コンゴ民主共和国の米国人1名が感染
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大リスクが明確であり、IHR基準で少なくとも3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）に該当。米国での空港スクリーニング強化や複数国への渡航制限の実施が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行を主題としており、米国はスクリーニング措置の実施主体だが発生地ではない。ウガンダと南スーダンも言及されているが対象国外。約350の疑い例と91の死亡が報告されており、重症度が明確。米国人感染者がドイツで治療を受けることから国際的な対応体制が既に稼働している。

article.articleHeadline: الولايات المتحدة تشدد القيود على السفر لمنع دخول فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States tightens travel restrictions to prevent the entry of the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: On May 18, 2026, the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) announced tightened travel restrictions to curb entry of Ebola, specifically Bundibugyo ebolavirus, amid an ongoing East and Central African outbreak. Working with the Department of Homeland Security and other agencies, measures include enhanced health screening, border monitoring, and entry limits for non-U.S. passport holders who were in Uganda, the Democratic Republic of Congo, or South Sudan in the past 21 days. The CDC will coordinate with airlines and international partners to identify and manage exposed travelers; bolster port health, contact tracing, laboratory testing, and hospital readiness. The immediate risk to the U.S. general public remains low, and there is no vaccine; treatment is mainly supportive. As of Monday, 11 confirmed and 336 suspected cases with 88 deaths in the DRC, and 2 confirmed cases (1 death) in Uganda. Classic symptoms include fever, headache, vomiting, severe weakness, abdominal pain, epistaxis, and hematemesis.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラウイルス感染の流入防止のため渡航制限を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。東中央アフリカでのエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo種）流行に対する米国の渡航制限措置は、国際的な拡大リスク、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際規制リスクを示唆している。DRC・ウガンダでの複数確認症例と死亡例の報告がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRC・ウガンダ・スーダン（南スーダン）での発生が明記されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。発生地域にUgandaとSudanが含まれるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれていないため、検証位置からは除外。ただし、エボラウイルス感染症（特にBundibugyo種）の国際的な拡大リスクと米国での渡航制限措置という国際的な対応が実施されている点は極めて高リスク。記事日時は2026年5月で将来日付だが、情報として処理する。

article.articleHeadline: إجراءات الولايات المتحدة لمواجهة فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. measures to combat the Ebola virus
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the United States, via the CDC, is tightening Ebola precautions after the WHO declared an international health emergency over the Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak. Measures include enhanced airport screening of travelers from affected regions and temporary visa restrictions for non-U.S. passport holders who have traveled to Uganda, the DRC, or South Sudan within 21 days. A U.S. citizen working in the DRC has contracted Ebola; symptoms appeared over the weekend and the test was positive late Sunday. The patient is being transported to Germany for treatment, with six more individuals to be evacuated for health monitoring.
