About 25 U.S. Embassy staff operate in the DRC, and the CDC will dispatch an additional technical coordinator. The direct risk to the U.S. is deemed low; there is no vaccine or specific treatment for the current strain. Approximately 350 suspected cases, mostly ages 20–39, with over 60% female. The U.S. had withdrawn from WHO earlier this year.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスに対抗するための米国の措置
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言に基づく多国間対応。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによるとアウトブレイク主体はコンゴ民主共和国(DRC)であり、米国はこれに対する応答措置を講じている。Uganda、South Sudan(Sudan)は記事中で言及されているが、サマリーの主要な感染症イベント発生地はDRCである。対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言し、複数国で対応が開始されており、シグナルとしての重要度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）伊波拉疫情扩散 116例疑似病例死亡|光华网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; 116 suspected cases have died
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread in Ituri Province and nearby North Kivu, with 116 suspected deaths and 435 suspected cases under observation or treatment. National tests and epidemiological investigations are ongoing to confirm whether these deaths are linked to Ebola. Nationwide, 80 deaths have been reported, with 4 laboratory-confirmed Ebola infections as of May 15. In Uganda, an imported, laboratory-confirmed Ebola death was reported on May 15. On May 17, the World Health Organization designated the Congo–Uganda outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Neighboring countries—Rwanda, Zambia, and Tanzania—have stepped up border health surveillance, entry screening, and outbreak preparedness to prevent cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の疫情が拡散、116例の疑似病例死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱は重篤な公衆衛生影響を持ち、国際的拡大のリスクが高く、WHOがPHEIC宣言。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（Ituri Province、North Kivu）とUgandaでの確定症例が主に述べられている。Ugandaは対象国リストに未含まれるため除外。RwandaとTanzaniaは国境強化対策実施国として言及されているが、記事の主題はDRCの疫情拡散であり、これらの国での発生は報告されていないため除外。Zambiaは国境サーベイランス強化国として言及され、対象国リストに含まれるため included。WHOはPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）を発出しており、国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Dinas PKH Riau Temukan 775 Kasus PMK pada Sapi Ternak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Riau PKH Office Finds 775 Foot-and-Mouth Disease Cases in Cattle
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (PMK) in cattle detected across Riau Province, Indonesia, from January to March 2026, with 775 total cases reported in multiple districts. Indragiri Hulu registered the highest burden with 368 cases, followed by Siak with 118 cases; remaining cases occurred in other districts. By March 2026, 243 cases had recovered. The Riau Department of Animal Husbandry and Animal Health (PKH) has implemented preventive measures, including vaccination in exposed herds and screening of other cattle. Ahead of Eid al-Adha, officials urge calm and caution when purchasing cattle for sacrifice, recommending buyers obtain a health certificate from the department. The report emphasizes vaccination and herd checks as core control measures, with no fatalities or laboratory confirmation details provided, and notes ongoing containment efforts in the affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: リアウ州PKH局、家畜牛における775件の口蹄疫（PMK）症例を発見
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける口蹄疫の大規模発生（775症例）は予想外かつ異常であり、WPROスクリーニング基準複数に該当。動物感染症ながら経済的影響と公衆衛生関心が高い。
triage.notes: 口蹄疫は動物感染症だが、インドネシアのリアウ州での大規模発生（775症例、2026年1月～3月）は経済的影響が大きく、特にイード・アル＝アドハ期間における牛取引への影響から社会的・政治的関心が高い。ワクチン接種と群検診が実施中。人への感染報告はないが、貿易制限リスク有り。

article.articleHeadline: Ezért nem kell félned az új Ebola-járványtól - de miért van akkor nemzetközi vészhelyzet?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: That's why you don't need to fear the new Ebola outbreak - but why is there then an international emergency?
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province) and in Uganda (Kampala) prompted the WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though not a pandemic. By mid‑May, at least 80 suspected deaths, eight laboratory-confirmed infections, and over 240 suspected cases were reported, with several infections confirmed in Kampala; all linked to Congo travel. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or targeted therapy. Ebola causes severe hemorrhagic fever and spreads via direct contact with infected bodily fluids or contaminated objects, not by casual airborne transmission. Estimated case fatality for Bundibugyo is 25–40%, higher than COVID‑19’s roughly 1% at its peak. Emphasis on early detection, contact tracing, and strengthening health systems in Congo and Uganda; border closures are not advised. Europe’s risk is low, though imported cases remain possible.

triage.headline_ja: 新しいエボラアウトブレイクを恐れる必要がない理由 - しかしなぜ国際的な緊急事態があるのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WHO公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事象（PHEIC）宣言済みの重大な感染症イベント。複数国での確認症例と死亡者の報告があり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak confirmed in eastern DRC (Ituri Province) with cross-border spread to Uganda (Kampala). WHO declared PHEIC on 2026-05-19. As of mid-May: 80 suspected deaths, 8 laboratory-confirmed cases, 240+ suspected cases. Case fatality rate 25-40%, significantly higher than COVID-19. No approved vaccine or targeted therapy available. Spread via direct contact with bodily fluids. Uganda is geographically identified in the article but DRC is the primary affected location per article content; however, Uganda data location not in target country list so only DRC verified. Continued monitoring for international spread recommended.

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Hantavirus, Hati-hati saat Membersihkan Lingkungan yang Dihuni Tikus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus Warning: Be Careful When Cleaning Environments Inhabited by Rats
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus, a rodent-borne zoonosis, is transmitted to humans via three routes: inhalation of aerosols from rat feces, saliva, and urine; direct contact with virus-contaminated rat secretions; and rat bites. In Jakarta Barat, Kecamatan Kembangan, the Meruya Selatan II area was cited for heightened risk when cleaning environments inhabited by rats. At Puskesmas Pembantu Meruya Selatan II, Ani urged precautions on May 18, 2026: ensure good ventilation, spray droppings with disinfectant before cleaning, and use household bleach as a disinfectant. After cleanup, maintain hygiene by washing hands with soap and running water. The briefing emphasizes preventing hantavirus exposure through proper cleaning and hygiene practices, with the article dated May 19, 2026, reporting the guidance given by local health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス警告：ネズミが生息する環境を清掃する際の注意
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（ジャカルタ地域）でのハンタウイルス感染リスク警告であるが、実際の患者発生報告がなく、予防啓発が主体である。スクリーニング基準の該当が限定的で情報不足が大きい。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の患者発生報告ではなく、ジャカルタ地域のネズミ生息環境での感染リスク啓発である。ハンタウイルスはげっ歯類媒介性感染症で、ヒト-ヒト感染はまれであり国際的拡大リスクは低い。地域保健機関による予防ガイダンスが5月18-19日に提供されている。継続的な情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Weekly Health Update | From Ebola to Hantavirus, African Countries Strengthen Health Preparedness
article.articleSummary: New Ebola virus disease outbreak declared in DRC’s Ituri region (Mongwalu and Rwampara): 246 suspected cases, 65 deaths; 13 of 20 samples positive; preliminary analyses indicate a non-Zaire ebolavirus strain, with sequencing ongoing. Africa CDC warns of rapid regional spread risk due to mining-related mobility and cross-border movement with Uganda and South Sudan; emergency regional meeting held May 15 with DRC, Uganda, South Sudan and partners including WHO, UNICEF, Gavi, MSF. Kenya faces renewed hantavirus–pandemic preparedness debate. In Nigeria’s Niger Delta, the Bille community endures a methane-leak crisis with methane in rivers, marshes and about 70% of drinking wells; December 2025 tests up to 10,000x above normal; April 7 regulator order; 100 million naira allocated for water and emergency measures. WHO warns global health progress is slowing in WHS 2026, with malaria up and 1.6 billion people pushed into poverty by healthcare costs; 18% of countries report mortality data within one year. Togo pilots SIIG-AMU digital universal health insurance (Lomé May 4–7; GIZ/World Bank), and Lomé hosts a 22-country Lomé Declaration on Nutrition (May 11–13) addressing governance, funding and data; stunting 25%, anemia in 65 million women, CAR malnutrition 40%.

triage.headline_ja: 週間保健情報 | エボラからハンタウイルスまで、アフリカ諸国が保健対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCのイトゥリ地域における新規エボラウイルス病の流行宣言（疑い例246件、死亡65件、陽性率65%）は、IHR基準2つ以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、ウガンダ・南スーダンとの越境リスク、採鉱関連の人口流動による地域拡大の懸念から、フルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRCのイトゥリ地域（Mongwalu and Rwampara）における新規エボラ流行が主要トピック。ナイジェリアのハンタウイルス、ナイジェリア・トーゴのマラリア関連情報も含まれるが、これらは対象国外（ナイジェリア、トーゴ）であるため verified_locations に含めない。DRCのみが対象国リスト内で、かつサマリーの中心的な発生地である。

article.articleHeadline: ＮＥＷＳＦＬＡＳＨ：アフリカ、エボラ熱死者100人超
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: NEWSFLASH: Africa, Ebola death toll surpasses 100.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri Province have killed more than 100 people, AU-CDC Director Kasaya told BBC on May 18. He reported that the death toll has surpassed 100 and that the total number of infections, including suspected cases, was not specified in the excerpt. He appealed to the international community for assistance, noting there are no vaccines or medicines available to treat or prevent the outbreak at this time. The report emphasizes an ongoing Ebola outbreak in Ituri with limited medical countermeasures. The BBC report is the cited source; no further details on confirmed case counts, dates of onset, or imported/exported cases are provided in the excerpt. The published date is May 19, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: NEWSFLASH：アフリカ、エボラ熱死者100人超
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の大規模アウトブレイク（死者100人超）はシグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（EVD）は高い致死率と国際的な伝播リスクで知られる第1種感染症。死亡者100人超、ワクチン・治療薬の利用不可、国際支援要請など複数の危機要因が合致。フルRRA実施が急務。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ alarm verdi: Ebola salgını küresel halk sağlığı acil durumu ilan edildi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO issues alarm: Ebola outbreak declared a global public health emergency.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the World Health Organization has declared the Ebola outbreak a global Public Health Emergency. The outbreak's epicenter is the Ituri region of the Democratic Republic of Congo, near the Uganda border. Africa CDC data report 395 suspected cases and 106 outbreak-related deaths across DRC and Uganda, with two laboratory-confirmed cases in Kampala, Uganda, one of which died. Ebola spreads via contact with infected body fluids, causing fever, fatigue, muscle and throat pain, progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, and bleeding. The current Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has an estimated fatality rate of 25–40%. There is no approved specific treatment or vaccine for Bundibugyo Ebola. In response, CDC activated Title 42, increasing entry screening for travelers from Uganda, DRC, and South Sudan; potential restrictions for non-U.S. citizens who were in those states in the last three weeks. Ongoing challenges include protracted conflict and weak health systems.

triage.headline_ja: WHO警報：エボラ流行がグローバル公衆衛生緊急事態宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準の4つすべてに該当。エボラの国際的な多国間拡大（DRC・ウガンダ確認）、WHOによるグローバル公衆衛生緊急事態宣言、高い致死率（25-40%）、渡航制限措置の発動により、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはウガンダとスーダンも言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCが確認された主要な発生地域であり、Ituri地域がエピセンター。WHOのグローバル緊急事態宣言とCDCの Title 42 発動により、国際的な影響は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'Europe sera-t-elle au rendez-vous de cette crise sanitaire et humanitaire ? Par le Pr Flahault
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Will Europe be up to the challenge of this health and humanitarian crisis? By Prof. Flahault.
article.articleSummary: Across the Uganda–Democratic Republic of Congo border, an Ebola outbreak attributed to the Bundibugyo strain was identified, with 249 suspected cases and 80 deaths reported as of 16 April. The World Health Organization warns of severe under-reporting in this dense, poor, hard-to-reach region. Bundibugyo, identified in Uganda in 2007, has caused only two prior outbreaks and differs by about 40% from the Zaïre strain, which has the only widely used vaccine that is less effective against Bundibugyo. Ebola presents after a 1–2 week incubation with fever, digestive and respiratory symptoms, followed by a rash and hemorrhagic complications; without advanced care, deaths occur within about ten days. Transmission requires direct contact with symptomatic patients’ blood or fluids, and is amplified by unsafe funeral practices. Early isolation and health-worker protection are essential; the outbreak highlights Ebola as a health and humanitarian crisis in Africa, including lessons from 2014 West Africa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：この保健・人道危機にヨーロッパは対応できるのか？フラオー教授による
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の確認された国境越え流行で、深刻な公衆衛生影響（249疑い例、80死亡）、予防接種の効果が低い株、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性があり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで「ウガンダ・コンゴ民主共和国国境」にまたがる流行と記述されているが、対象国リストにはコンゴ民主共和国(203312)のみ該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Bundibugyo株はZaïre株より予防接種効果が低く（40%異なる）、地域の貧困・衛生状況・アクセス困難が相まって管理リスク高。2014年西アフリカ流行との比較も言及され、国際的関心が明確。

article.articleHeadline: TPHCM chủ động ngăn chặn nguy cơ dịch bệnh Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City Takes Proactive Measures to Prevent the Risk of an Ebola Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk prompts Ho Chi Minh City health authorities to tighten surveillance after the World Health Organization designates a Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda as an international public health emergency. While WHO does not recommend travel or trade restrictions, Ho Chi Minh City’s Department of Health orders heightened vigilance and border screening at gateways to detect importation early. The city’s Center for Disease Control and Prevention will screen entrants for abnormal health signs, review epidemiological histories, and coordinate with airlines, shipping, and international health quarantine services to identify suspected cases and ensure safe isolation and transport. For international exposure, close contacts are monitored for 21 days with travel restrictions; confirmed cases require two consecutive negative tests at least 48 hours apart before discharge or movement. Ongoing staff training and adherence to WHO and MOH guidelines remain priorities.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市がエボラ出血熱の流行リスク防止に積極的に取り組む
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言したBundibugyo株エボラ出血熱の流行がDRCとウガンダで発生しており、ベトナムが能動的な検知・検疫体制を構築している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでのBundibugyo株エボラ出血熱流行をWHOが国際保健上の緊急事態と指定したことを述べており、ベトナム（ホーチミン市）はこれに対応する検疫・検知体制を強化している。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていない。Ho Chi Minh CityはVietnamに含まれるため、Vietnamのみを対象国として記載。

article.articleHeadline: Dharma Pongrekun Minta MK Hapus Larangan Halangi-halangi Penanggulangan Wabah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dharma Pongrekun Requests the Constitutional Court to Remove the Prohibition on Obstructing Outbreak Response.
article.articleSummary: Dharma Pongrekun, a former Deputy Head of Indonesia’s National Cyber and Crypto Agency (BSSN), filed a constitutional challenge with the Constitutional Court (MK) to strike down provisions in the Health Law (UU Kesehatan) prohibiting obstructing outbreak response. The petition, registered as No. 172/PUU-XXIV/2026, targets: Article 353(2)(g) of Law No. 17/2023 on Health mandating compliance with outbreak and epidemic control activities by central and local governments; Article 395(1) requiring anyone aware of illness or suspected illness with outbreak potential to report to village/kelurahan authorities or nearest health facility; Article 400 prohibiting hindering outbreak response; and Article 446 of the Health Law. The move seeks removal or relaxation of penalties for obstructing outbreak management in Indonesia. The case appeared on MK’s official site on May 19, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ダルマ・ポングレクン氏が憲法裁判所に健康法の感染症対応阻害禁止規定の削除を要請
triage.triage_reason: 本件は感染症の発生そのものではなく、インドネシアの健康法に関する法的・政治的紛争であり、公衆衛生への直接的な影響、異常な疾患発生、国際的な拡大リスク、または重症度の高い患者発生を示す医学的シグナルは認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はCryptosporidiosisというカテゴリで分類されているが、実質は感染症対応に関するインドネシア国内の法的・政治的争点であり、実際の感染症の発生報告ではない。感染症イベント監視の対象ではないため見送る。

article.articleHeadline: Disnakkeswan Lampung Awasi Ketat Hewan Kurban Agar Bebas Penyakit Menular
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lampung's Disnakkeswan Tightens Monitoring of Sacrificial Animals to Ensure They Are Free of Contagious Diseases
article.articleSummary: Lampung Province's Department of Animal Husbandry and Animal Health (Disnakkeswan) tightens monitoring of potential sacrificial animals to ensure freedom from contagious diseases ahead of Eid al-Adha 2026. Inspections cover breeding centers, markets, holding pens, and sale stalls, targeting foot-and-mouth disease (FMD), lumpy skin disease (LSD), and zoonoses such as brucellosis and anthrax. Led by Disnakkeswan head Lili Mawarti, the program implements phased checks: at farm centers and supplier barns from day-14 before Eid; at sale stalls from day-7 to day-3; and at mosques and slaughterhouses from day-3 to the event. Monitoring continues from the day of sacrifice to day+3 for processing and distribution. Livestock movement is tightened with selective issuance of health documents, including the Health Certificate for Animals (SKKH) and Veterinary Certificates. The public is urged to buy from official stalls checked by animal health workers to ensure quality and safety.

triage.headline_ja: ランプン州の動物衛生部門が家畜の犠牲祭供用動物の厳格監視を実施し伝染病の予防を徹底
triage.triage_reason: 複数の人獣共通感染症（炭疽病、ブルセラ症）と動物疾病（口蹄疫、ルンピースキン病）の同時監視が対象の記事であり、WPROスクリーニング基準の「流行しやすさ」に該当する可能性がある。しかし記事は予防的な監視活動の報道であり、実際の患者発生・動物疾病発生の明確な報告ではなく、情報が限定的であるため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主体はランプン州（インドネシア内）における犠牲祭（イード・アル＝アドハー）前の家畜の予防的監視活動である。複数の人獣共通感染症と動物疾病が監視対象として挙げられており、人間への曝露リスク（動物市場での購入・処理）と流行可能性が存在する。ただし現時点での患者発生や確診患者数の報告はなく、予防的警戒段階の情報のため、フルRRAは不要だが続報が必要な段階と判断。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS alerta por brote de ébola en el Congo y crece preocupación mundial - HSB NOTICIAS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of an Ebola outbreak in the Congo and global concern grows - HSB News
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization declares an international alert over an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with dozens of deaths and multiple suspected and confirmed cases, concentrated in the northeast. The outbreak involves a less common Ebola variant, complicating containment and treatment, and may have circulated for weeks before detection, enabling silent transmission in communities and healthcare settings. Transmission occurs through direct contact with blood, body fluids, secretions, infected tissues, or contaminated surfaces. Symptoms include high fever, vomiting, diarrhea, muscle pain, hemorrhaging, and organ failure. Global risk is currently deemed moderate, but imported cases abroad remain possible if transmission continues. International teams are isolating patients, tracing contacts, and conducting community monitoring while bolstering surveillance and rapid-response capacities in the affected region.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴでのエボラ出血熱の流行を警告し、世界的懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の確認症例・死者を含む国際的に重大な感染症イベント。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の確認症例および死亡者が存在。稀なエボラウイルス変異株の関与により遏制困難化。数週間の無症状伝播の可能性あり。国際的な支援チームによる対応実施中。グローバルリスク評価は現在「中程度」だが、継続的な感染リスクがある場合、国外での輸入症例の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Darurat Global! Angka Kematian Bisa Capai 90 Persen, Belum Ada Obat-Vaksinnya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Global Emergency! The mortality rate could reach 90 percent; there are no drugs or vaccines yet.
article.articleSummary: Ebola declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) by the WHO on May 17, 2026. Three reasons cited: (1) extraordinary outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 8 confirmed Ebola cases and 246 suspected infections as of May 16, and 80 suspected deaths; a cluster shows Bundibugyo virus disease–like symptoms, including four suspected deaths among health workers; (2) cross-border spread to Uganda, which has two confirmed cases and one death; (3) transmission pattern requiring global coordination for surveillance, prevention, and response. Of 13 suspected cases tested, 8 were confirmed. Officials warn the outbreak may be larger than officially reported. The situation underscores the need for intensified international collaboration to control cross-border transmission and scale up response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱、グローバル緊急事態！死亡率は90%に達する可能性、まだ医薬品やワクチンがない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHO PHEICが宣言され、DRCで多数の確定例と疑い例、ウガンダへの越境感染が確認されており、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確に存在する。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの発生を明記していますが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ（ウガンダは1668845、対象外）。WHO PHEICの正式宣言が2026年5月17日であり、これは極めて深刻な国際的シグナル。ヘルスケアワーカー4名を含む死亡例、Bundibugyo virusの関与可能性、および「報告されている以上の大規模アウトブレイクの可能性」という情報は、今後の拡大リスクが高いことを示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: North Sumatra running out of measles vaccines amid increasing cases
article.articleSummary: Measles suspects in North Sumatra surged to 748 cases by April 30, with 51 lab-confirmed positives, as MR vaccine stocks ran dry in the province. Medan city and the regencies of Deli Serdang and Simalungun report the highest concentrations, all designated as 'extraordinary occurrence' (KLB) areas; the province has not declared a provincial-level KLB. MR vaccine stockouts occurred earlier this year for about two months, compounding low complete immunisation — 7.6% in Medan, 22.77% in Simalungun, and 31.48% in Deli Serdang as of April. Some residents refuse vaccination amid hoaxes about vaccines. Budget constraints hinder outreach, while mobility increases contagion risk. Health authorities plan outbreak response immunisation and PENARI catch-up within a week. Experts cite uneven vaccination coverage, rapid spread, and potential delays in detection/response as drivers; herd immunity remains not yet achieved.

triage.headline_ja: 北スマトラ州で麻疹患者増加の中、ワクチン在庫が枯渇
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2項目以上該当（異常/予想外の急増、国際的拡大リスク）。スクリーニング基準複数該当（異常/予想外、重症度、流行しやすさ）、ワクチン在庫枯渇と低いカバー率により管理可能性に懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事は北スマトラ州（インドネシア）における麻疹の急増をルーティー。4月末時点で748例の疑い患者、51例確認。ワクチン在庫枯渇、低いMRワクチン接種率（メダン市7.6%など）、ワクチン忌避、予算制約などが管理を困難にしている。複数地域で『異常発生』（KLB）に指定されている。東南アジアの主要都市を含む地域での流行であり、地域的な懸念は大きい。

article.articleHeadline: สธ. ยันไทยปลอดเชื้อ "อีโบลา" ยกระดับคัดกรองเข้ม 21 วัน
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Public Health confirms Thailand is Ebola-free; steps up stringent screening for 21 days.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) is not detected in Thailand as of 19 May 2026. Thailand remains Ebola-free, with intensified 21-day surveillance of travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, and other risk areas. No cases have been found. EVD, caused by Ebola virus in the Orthoebolavirus group, spreads by direct contact with blood, secretions, organs, contaminated surfaces, and through certain wildlife; it is not airborne. Incubation is 2–21 days; early symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache, and muscle pain, potentially followed by diarrhea, vomiting, rash, kidney and liver dysfunction, and severe bleeding. Preparedness covers isolation rooms, PPE, laboratory capacity, and rapid case investigation, with international cooperation. Public guidance emphasizes hand hygiene, avoiding contact with secretions, cooking meat thoroughly, and avoiding contact with wild animals. Returnees from DRC or Uganda who develop fever within 21 days should seek care and report travel; hotline 1422.

triage.headline_ja: タイ保健省がタイのエボラ感染を否定、21日間の厳格なスクリーニング強化を発表
triage.triage_reason: タイでのエボラ確認患者はなく、予防的監視体制が構築されている。DRC・ウガンダでの発生が背景にあるため国際的関心があるが、対象地域でのアクティブな感染イベント報告ではなく情報が限定的である。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はタイにおけるエボラ対応・監視体制の強化であり、実際の患者発生や確定診断ケースの報告ではない。DRC・ウガンダからの旅行者監視が背景にあるが、タイ国内での感染イベント確認なしのため、対象国リストではThailandのみに限定。継続的な監視情報として追跡推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Новые центры для лечения редкой формы лихорадки Эбола откроются в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New centers for the treatment of a rare form of Ebola fever will open in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Three new Ebola fever treatment centers will open in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak has caused about 120 deaths. The World Health Organization is dispatching a panel of experts to assist after the flare-up. Congolese officials also report that a U.S.-based physician is among recently confirmed cases, and there are no approved vaccines or medicines for this Ebola strain. On May 17, WHO declared the DRC-Uganda Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. In related news, a hantavirus outbreak aboard the Atlantic cruise ship MV Hondius infected six passengers, with three deaths and one patient in intensive care. Russian virologist Anatoly Altshtein says a domestic Ebola outbreak in Russia is unlikely.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ熱の新しい治療センターが開設される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO により公衆衛生上の国際的に懸念される事態（PHEIC）が宣言されている。
triage.notes: DRC-ウガンダエボラ出血熱の集団発生は既にWHOにより2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言されており、約120人の死亡が報告されている。記事ではハンタウイルス感染症（大西洋のクルーズ船MV Hondiusでの集団発生）も言及されているが、この事例は対象国の領域外であるため、verified_locationsには含めない。ロシアの国内エボラ出血熱発生の可能性については低いと評価されている。

article.articleHeadline: Hong Kong (Trung Quốc) kích hoạt ứng phó khẩn cấp trước dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong (China) activates emergency response ahead of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong (China) activated an emergency response ahead of Ebola after WHO declared an international alert on May 17 for Africa. As of May 19, there are no confirmed Ebola cases in Hong Kong, and the immediate health impact is low, but authorities will enforce preventive controls. The Centre for Health Protection will monitor developments, align with WHO guidance, and implement risk-based surveillance. Airport passenger screening for travelers from Africa will be intensified; suspected cases will be referred to public hospitals for isolation and treatment until laboratory confirmation is negative. Public awareness and health education on Ebola will be expanded at entry points, with notices to travelers and information shared with the Airport Authority, airlines, and local doctors and hospitals. Dr. Tang Ky An, co-chair of the Infectious Diseases Advisory Committee of the HK Medical Association, notes the outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, a rare strain; there is no vaccine or specific treatment, and early symptoms include fever and muscle pain with potential rapid deterioration and about 50% mortality. Ebola spreads mainly via direct contact with blood and body fluids, not via droplets or airborne transmission. Vietnam’s Ministry of Health is monitoring and tightening border health controls. WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern.

triage.headline_ja: 香港（中国）がエボラ出血熱の流行に先立ち緊急対応を発動
triage.triage_reason: アフリカでのエボラ流行に対する香港と中国による予防的対応であり、IHR基準では国際的拡大リスク（基準3）が該当する可能性があるが、香港・中国での確認患者はゼロであり現在の実際の発生は限定的。スクリーニング基準では「流行しやすさ」の懸念はあるが重症度や発生実績がないため判定が定まらない。WHO国際的懸念の宣言と複数国の警戒態勢から社会的関心が存在するため、WATCH段階として続報を注視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはアフリカでのエボラ流行に対する香港・中国・ベトナムの予防的対応に焦点。香港・マカオはChina(1814991)に含める指示に従い、香港の対応はChina内に統合。現在の実確認患者は香港・中国・ベトナムにゼロであり、WHO宣言（2026-05-17）に基づく後発的な警戒であるため、シグナル判定はWATCHとし、アフリカ地域での実際の患者発生状況に関する続報を注視すべき段階。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو: وفاة 105 وإصابة 393 بسلالة بونديبوجيو من الإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: 105 deaths and 393 infections from the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo Ebola in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, with 105 deaths and 393 suspected infections; 8 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1 confirmed in Goma. The current outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no licensed vaccines or approved treatments. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever and bleeding. A government mission led by Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba has set up new treatment centers to handle rising case numbers. The American CDC reports an American patient with Ebola has been transported to Germany, while supporting Congo’s infection-control efforts. The World Health Organization notes this situation is of international concern due to potential spread beyond Congo, following two confirmed cases in Kampala, Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラウイルス病ブンディブギオ株で105人が死亡、393人が感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の致命的アウトブレイク（死亡105例、疑い例393例）、希少なブンディブギオ株、ワクチン・治療法なし、複数国への拡大（ウガンダで確認例あり）、国際的懸念をWHOが明記。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Kampala）での確認例2件が記事に記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。ドイツへの患者搬送も記載されているが、発生地はDRC。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。エボラウイルス病は最重要感染症であり、ブンディブギオ株はまれで、利用可能なワクチン・治療法がないため、緊急フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: US tightens curbs after American citizen tests positive for Ebola
article.articleSummary: An American who is symptomatic has tested positive for Bundibugyo virus, a strain of Ebola, and will be evacuated with six high-risk contacts to Germany for treatment at a specialized viral haemorrhagic fever facility. The White House announced immediate entry restrictions for non-US citizens who have recently travelled to affected parts of Africa—Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Republic of the Congo and South Sudan—along with travel warnings for Americans in the region. Officials emphasized there are currently no Ebola cases in the United States. Bundibugyo virus causes fever, vomiting, diarrhea and, in severe cases, internal bleeding, and spreads via direct contact with infected bodily fluids. The case remains connected to the active outbreak zone in Africa; the precise location of the infected American was not disclosed. Containment efforts are ongoing, per the CDC briefing.

triage.headline_ja: 米国民がエボラウイルスで陽性判定後、米国が規制を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の米国での症例、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラウイルスの国際越境症例であり、ただちにフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、感染者は米国市民だが感染源はアフリカ（ウガンダ、コンゴ民主共和国、コンゴ共和国、南スーダン）の発生地域と明記。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（203312）のみ。米国での症例は「現在米国内でエボラケースはない」と述べられており、米国での定着を示すものではなく、アフリカからの輸入症例。ウガンダ（対象国だが該当ID確認不可）は記事で言及されているが対象国リストに無いため除外。南スーダンはRepublic of the Sudanと別の国のため、スーダンも除外。最高レベルの緊急度で対応要。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تعلن وفاة 105 أشخاص وإصابة 393 بسلالة "بونديبوجيو" لفيروس الإيبولا - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo reports 105 deaths and 393 infections from the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus - Youm7
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports an Ebola outbreak in the eastern province of Ituri attributed to the Bundibugyo strain, a rare lineage with no approved vaccines or treatments. In Ituri, 9 health zones have 105 suspected deaths and 393 suspected infections; laboratory testing has confirmed 8 cases, with an additional confirmed case in Bunia (the provincial capital) and 1 confirmed case in Goma, North Kivu. The outbreak raises cross-border concerns after cases surfaced in Uganda, including Kampala, prompting international alarm and response. WHO has deemed Ebola a public health emergency of international concern due to the risk of international spread. A Congolese government delegation arrived in Bunia with tents and equipment to bolster treatment centers amid hospital strain. The US CDC is coordinating to fly the American patient to Germany for treatment, along with six exposed individuals; US risk remains low. WHO is supplying PPE and medical aid to Congo after Kinshasa stockouts to strengthen containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラウイルスのブンディブギョ株による105人の死亡と393人の感染を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当：深刻な公衆衛生影響（105死亡、393感染）、極めて異常（ブンディブギョ株は稀種）、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダで既に確認）、渡航制限のリスク。WPROスクリーニング基準全て該当。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株はエボラウイルスの稀なリネージであり、承認されたワクチンや治療法がない。ウガンダへの越境感染が既に報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）と認定済み。米国とドイツも関与している。

article.articleHeadline: Explainer: Why DR Congo's latest Ebola outbreak is raising regional alarm
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyro Ebola outbreak in the DRC's Ituri province has spread to eastern areas, with confirmed imported cases in Uganda, prompting the WHO to declare an international public health emergency. As of May 19, 2026, about 435 suspected cases and 116 suspected deaths have been reported. The Bundibugyo virus is rarer than Ebola Zaire; there are no approved therapeutics or vaccines specific to Bundibugyo, though vaccine candidates are under early research. The outbreak began in April; the presumed index case was a nurse in Ituri's Rwampara health zone, but the true index remains unidentified. Early labs tested for Zaire, delaying confirmation until broader Kinshasa testing detected Bundibugyo. Response relies on isolation, contact tracing, and community engagement; three new treatment sites are being built. Neighboring Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania have stepped up surveillance. Isiro saw a prior 2012 outbreak of the same strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の最新エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが地域的警戒を高めている理由
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の新規感染者数、地域内での国際的拡大、WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言）。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全て該当。コンゴ民主共和国及びウガンダで確認されるブンディブギョエボラの地域的拡大。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョエボラ株によるアウトブレイク。435疑似症例、116死亡報告。ウガンダへの輸入症例確認。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言。ワクチン・治療薬の欠乏。記事でウガンダでの確認症例明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations には含めない。ルワンダ、ブルンジ、タンザニアでの監視強化についても記述されているがこれらも対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: കോംഗോയിൽ എബോള ഭീതി: അമേരിക്കൻ ഡോക്ടർക്കും രോഗബാധ സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു | Ebola virus outbreak: American doctor infected while treating patients at Congo hospital | Madhyamam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola fear in Congo: An American doctor infected.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, Ebola fears rise in the Democratic Republic of Congo after Bundibugyo strain infection is confirmed in an American doctor in Bunia, Ituri Province, with transmission linked to Uganda. The World Health Organization has declared an international health emergency. Over 300 suspected cases have been reported in Ituri and North Kivu; 118 deaths officially recorded, with Uganda reporting 2 deaths. The infected doctor’s case was confirmed by Dr. Jean-Jacques Muyembe of the National Institute for Biomedical Research. Initial tests misidentified the strain, delaying recognition. Three treatment centers have opened; more than 60% of cases are women, and most patients are aged 20–39. The United States has increased traveler screening, suspended visa services temporarily, and restricted entry for recent travelers from Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan; CDC is monitoring six other Americans. There is no approved vaccine or targeted treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola; major symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ恐怖：アメリカ人医師も感染確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WPRO基準も5項目すべて該当。WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言済み。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola strain（ブンディブギョ株）による2026年の大規模流行。DRCのIturi州Buniaで確認され、ウガンダへの越境リスク存在。300以上の疑い例、118人の死亡確認。米国が渡航制限・査証一時停止実施、CDCが6人のアメリカ人を監視中。WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言済み。ワクチンなし。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: ইবোলার প্রাদুর্ভাবে কঙ্গোতে অন্তত ১০০ জনের মৃত্যু | বাংলাদেশ প্রতিদিন
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At least 100 people dead in Ebola outbreak in Congo | Bangladesh Pratidin
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo's eastern Ituri Province has caused at least 100 deaths, with more than 390 suspected cases reported. The World Health Organization has declared the Bundibugyo strain a public health emergency of international concern, warning the outbreak may be larger than detected and could spread locally and regionally. The U.S. CDC confirms two Ebola cases in Uganda, with one death. With no approved drug or vaccine, authorities urge adherence to public health measures, including safe burial practices. Context: the 2014-2016 West Africa Ebola epidemic killed about 11,325 people across Guinea, Sierra Leone, and other countries including the United States, the United Kingdom, and Italy.

triage.headline_ja: イボーラの流行でコンゴで少なくとも100人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生で100人以上の死亡、390件以上の疑い例、WHOによるPHEIC宣言があり、IHR基準を複数満たす。DRCはモニタリング対象国。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは主にDRCのIturi州でのエボラ発生を述べており、ウガンダでの2例（1例は死亡）も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。歴史的文脈として西アフリカのエボラ流行（2014-2016年、ギニア、シエラレオネ等）が記載されているが、現在のイベントの主題はDRCの発生。PHEIC宣言により国際的な懸念は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: दुर्लभ प्रकार के इबोला के इलाज के लिए कांगो और केंद्र खोलेगा, अब तक 120 लोगों की मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo and the Center Will Open to Treat a Rare Form of Ebola; So Far 120 People Have Died.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, spanning Ituri and North Kivu, has caused around 120 deaths and more than 300 suspected cases. Three Ebola treatment centers will be opened in Bunia, Ituri, as WHO deploys a team and declares a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. By Monday, infections have been detected in Bunia and in Mongbwalu, Butembo, and Nyakunde, with transmission linked to mining areas around Mongbwalu; the first death occurred on 24 April. An American doctor is among the confirmed cases in Bunia. There is no approved vaccine or antiviral for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Seven Americans, including the infected patient, are being monitored in Germany. The outbreak’s progression has raised concerns about delayed response and rising fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴが稀有型エボラ治療センターを開設へ、現在までに120人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準5つ全て該当。WHO緊急事態宣言済み。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（BDBV）の大規模発生。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。米国医師を含む複数国籍の患者が確認。ドイツでも患者監視中。治療法未承認。鉱業地域での伝播リンク確認。人道支援が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Bali increases surveillance for hantavirus
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-19, Bali tightens hantavirus surveillance with all entry gates—seaports and airports—closely monitored. No suspected cases have been detected in Bali to date, per Bali Health Agency head I Nyoman Gede Anom, though vigilance is heightened following suspected cases elsewhere in Indonesia. Measures include strengthened coordination with health facilities, real-time intra-Indonesia monitoring, and tightened screening of Indonesians returning from abroad, including cruise ship workers. Public education on hygiene and rodent control is being promoted; emphasis on preventing exposure during cleaning of abandoned premises, and use of masks and gloves when handling potential rat environments. Early symptoms resemble flu (fever, dizziness, muscle pain) and can progress to severe respiratory problems. A Jakarta-linked alert notes a 60-year-old British national, close contact of a positive Hondius case, tested negative by PCR for two hantavirus strains, with no Bali cases confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: バリがハンタウイルスの監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでハンタウイルスの疑い例が報告されており、バリでの監視強化が実施されている。ただし、バリでの確定例はなく、現時点では情報が限定的なため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではバリでの確定例は報告されておらず、インドネシア国内の他地域（ジャカルタ関連）での疑い例が監視の引き金となっている。国際的拡大のリスクは現在低い。ハンタウイルスはヒト-ヒト感染のリスクが限定的であることに留意。

article.articleHeadline: Korban Ebola Terus Bertambah di Kongo, 118 Orang Meninggal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola victims continue to rise in Kongo, 118 people have died.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in Kongo, Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 118 deaths reported as of May 19, 2026. To curb losses, Kongo plans to open three Ebola treatment centers in Ituri; the World Health Organization will dispatch a team of experts. A United States physician working in the area has tested positive for Ebola. The first recorded fatality in this period occurred on 24 April 2026 in Bunia, the provincial capital, after which the body was moved to Mongbwalu, a mining town with a large population. On 5 May, WHO noted 50 deaths in Mongbwalu, including four health workers. Laboratory results announced on 14 May identified Ebola virus as Bundibugyo. Experts warn the situation is alarming and evolving rapidly, noting delayed detection due to symptom overlap with other tropical diseases; no infection source is stated, and no mention of imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ感染者が増加し続け、118人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当、および米国医師の感染報告による国際的関心の高まり。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス種はBundibugyo（ブンディブギョ型）と同定されている。医療従事者4名を含む118人の死亡が報告されている。米国医師の感染報告は国際的な関心を高める重要な要素。症状検出の遅延（熱帯病との症状重複）が状況を複雑化させている。感染源、輸入/輸出症例の記載はなし。

article.articleHeadline: At least 118 dead in Ebola outbreak in DR Congo, official says
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, has at least 118 deaths and more than 390 suspected cases, with new infections in Nyakunde (Ituri), Butembo (North Kivu), and Goma. Two confirmed cases and one death in Uganda, per CDC. The WHO has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC) and warns it could be a much larger outbreak with local and regional spread. An American doctor among the confirmed cases will be treated in Germany; other medical missionary group members are exposed or under quarantine, with reports of up to six Americans affected. The CDC is imposing travel measures: entry screening, possible restrictions for travelers who have been in Uganda, DR Congo, or South Sudan in the last 21 days; enhanced testing, contact tracing, and hospital readiness. Rwanda tightens border screening; Nigeria monitors; US issues Level Four travel advisory.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行で少なくとも118人が死亡、当局者が発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる大規模流行で、WHOがPHEIC宣言、複数国への波及、国際的な渡航制限実施。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる大規模流行。少なくとも118人の死亡、390人以上の疑似症例。ウガンダでも確認例あり。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。CDC、ルワンダ、ナイジェリア、米国が対応・警告を発出。ウガンダはWPRO対象国ではないが、DRCはプログラム対象国として verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: L'OMS déclare l'urgence sanitaire pour Ebola, tandis que les coupes de Trump en santé minent les efforts mondiaux de surveillance des pathogènes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO declares Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, while Trump's health cuts undermine global pathogen surveillance efforts.
article.articleSummary: On May 16, 2026, the WHO declared the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC)—the third Ebola PHEIC and the first for Bundibugyo, with no licensed vaccine or treatment. Director-General Tedros announced the declaration without the Emergency Committee, to be convened retroactively. By May 16, eight laboratory-confirmed cases, 246 suspected cases, and 80 suspected deaths were reported, including at least four health workers; Ituri reported 336 suspected/confirmed cases and 87 deaths. Transmission to Kinshasa and Kampala raises cross-border concerns. The index case remains unknown; the outbreak likely began in late April in Mongbwalu and spread to Rwampara and Bunia before Uganda. Initial field tests were negative; samples were confirmed in Kinshasa on May 14–15. WHO advised against travel bans, urged airport screening, and cited substantial uncertainties. The article notes Trump's cuts to global surveillance, including January 2025’s end of STOP Spillover.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラをPHEICとして宣言、トランプ政権の保健予算削減が世界的な病原体監視の取り組みを損なう
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo Ebola がWHOにより PHEIC として宣言された重大事案。IHR基準において公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的な拡大リスク（DRC-Uganda国境越境、Kinshasa・Kampala への伝播）が複数該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行可能性・管理可能性に関する懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、Bundibugyo Ebola の主要な発生地はDRC（Ituri州Mongbwalu→Bunia、及びKinshasa）であり、ウガンダへの越境伝播が報告されている。ただしウガンダ（対象国リストに含まれない）は二次的な確認事案であるため verified_locations には含めない。DRC は対象国リストに含まれるため記載。PHEIC 宣言、複数死亡例、医療従事者への感染、ワクチン・治療法の不在、国際的な監視機能低下への懸念が評価に反映されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola virus: Thailand tracks travellers from high-risk areas, puts hospitals on alert
article.articleSummary: Thailand is stepping up Ebola virus surveillance for travellers from high‑risk areas, especially the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with 21‑day monitoring and hospital screening for suspected cases. Ebola, caused by an Orthoebolavirus, spreads via direct contact with blood, bodily fluids or organs, contaminated surfaces, and through handling infected wild animals; it is not airborne. Incubation is 2–21 days; early symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache and sore throat, followed by diarrhoea, vomiting, rash, kidney/liver problems and possible bleeding. Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or targeted treatment; control relies on surveillance, contact tracing, isolation, laboratory testing and rapid supportive care. In the DRC’s Ituri province, about 246 suspected cases, 80 deaths and 8 lab‑confirmed; Uganda reports two Kampala cases linked to travel from DRC. WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern, urging international coordination; Thailand emphasizes hygiene and travel-history reporting for returnees with fever within 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス：タイが高リスク地域からの渡航者を追跡、病院にアラート
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つ全て満たす。DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ発生が国際的に拡大し、WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言。タイが早期警戒体制を整備している状況は、シグナルとしてフルRRAの対象となる。
triage.notes: DRCのイトゥリ州で約246疑似症例、80死亡、8件の確定例。ウガンダではカンパラで2例の確定例がDRCからの渡航歴と関連。タイは高リスク地域からの渡航者に対し21日間の監視体制を実施。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言し、国際的な調整を促促している。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、検証済み地域には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: US to screen for Ebola at airports, one American in DR Congo infected
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-19, the United States tightens Ebola precautions after the WHO declared the DRC outbreak an international health emergency. CDC measures include airport screenings for travelers from outbreak areas and temporary visa suspensions. One American in the DRC contracted Ebola through work exposure; symptoms appeared over the weekend and were confirmed late Sunday, with plans to move the patient to Germany for treatment. Six additional people are being evacuated for health monitoring. The U.S. Ebola response includes about 25 staff in the DRC field office and a senior technical coordinator being sent. The CDC says the immediate risk to the U.S. public remains low. Non-U.S. passport holders who traveled to Uganda, DRC, or South Sudan in the past 21 days face entry restrictions; the U.S. Embassy in Kampala has paused visa services.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、空港でエボラ熱スクリーニングを実施。コンゴ民主共和国でアメリカ人1名感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大（DRC→USA確認例）、WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言、複数国への影響、渡航制限措置が講じられている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン、USA、ドイツが言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（203312）のみ。ウガンダ、南スーダンは対象国に含まれず。WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言済み、複数国への渡航制限、米国での症例確認により国際的拡大リスク高。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: UN: Hostile environment in Eastern DRC threatens Ebola response | New Straits Times
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC persists under a hostile environment across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Ituri has reported more than 482 suspected cases since April, including 8 confirmed infections and about 116 deaths among suspected cases; a confirmed case was recorded in Goma, North Kivu, heightening urban spread concerns. The World Health Organization has declared the DRC–Uganda outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. The Bundibugyo strain is involved and there is no vaccine. More than five tonnes of medical supplies were airlifted to Ituri by the World Food Programme. Surveillance and contact tracing are impeded by insecurity and displacement, with nearly 10 million people facing hunger in the three provinces. The UN urges intensified international support and notes the humanitarian response plan is only 34% funded.

triage.headline_ja: 国連：東部DRCの敵対的環境がエボラ対応を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全5項目該当。エボラ出血熱は国際緊急事態であり、確定症例、死亡、ウガンダへの拡大、都市部への波及の可能性があり、世界保健機構が国際保健上の懸念事項として宣言している。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリー上ではウガンダでの確定例報告がなく、DRC-Uganda outbreak（国際的懸念）として言及されている。verified_locationsはDRCのみに限定した。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）、確定症例あり、死亡多数、ワクチン無し、都市部（Goma）での確定例、国際保健機構による国際保健上の懸念事項宣言、人道的対応計画の資金不足（34%）など、複数の深刻なリスク要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Американец е дал положителна проба за ебола в Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American has tested positive for Ebola in Congo.
article.articleSummary: An American doctor infected with Ebola while working in the Democratic Republic of Congo tested positive late Sunday and is being transferred to Germany for treatment. The case comes amid ongoing Ebola outbreaks in DRC and neighboring Uganda. At the 79th World Health Assembly opening in Geneva, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus outlined the organization’s challenges as the Ebola public health emergency of international concern remains in effect for DRC and Uganda. The Assembly is considering the adoption of the Pathogen Access and Benefit-Sharing (PABS) annex to the WHO pandemic treaty to ensure rapid sharing of pathogens and fair benefits, including vaccines, diagnostics and therapies. However, due to lack of consensus among member states, the PABS annex and subsequent national ratifications have not been finalized. The report emphasizes the need for swift pathogen exchange and equitable access to medical countermeasures.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ人がコンゴでエボラウイルスの陽性反応を示した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の確認患者が複数国（DRC・ウガンダ）で報告され、治療目的での国際移送が発生。WHO公式会議で国際懸念事項に指定されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にGenève(Switzerland)とGermanyが含まれているが、サマリーの主題はDRCでの感染と治療目的の国際移送。DRCのみが対象国リストに該当するため verified_locations に含める。WHOの正式な国際懸念事項（PHEIC）指定状態にあり、複数国での同時流行が進行中。患者の国際移送は国境を越える医学的対応の必要性を示す。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaría de Salud emite aviso de viaje por ébola en Congo y Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health issues travel advisory due to Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: May 19, 2026: The Ministry of Health issued a preventive travel advisory for travelers to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda amid active Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreaks. The risk to travelers remains low, but general preventive measures are advised. Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease is a severe viral illness transmitted by direct contact with blood, secretions, or objects contaminated with bodily fluids from infected persons. Individual risk depends on recent travel to or residence in zones with active transmission, exposure to sick individuals, or contact with contaminated materials. There is no specific treatment or vaccine for this Ebola variant; timely identification and isolation of symptomatic persons significantly reduce transmission. International mobility and air travel raise the potential for importing cases from regions with active transmission; the incubation period ranges from 2 to 21 days. The virus is not transmitted through the air.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生省がコンゴとウガンダのエボラに関する渡航勧告を発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生への影響（複数国での活発なエボラ発生）、国際的な拡大リスク（国際航空輸送による症例の輸入可能性）、渡航・貿易制限のリスク（渡航勧告の発令）の3基準が該当。これらはWPROスクリーニング基準の重症度（重症ウイルス疾患）、長期曝露（活発な伝播地域）、流行しやすさ（人-人感染、対策不十分の可能性）、管理可能性（政府による対応が必要）とも合致し、PICKUP判定。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease の活発な発生が報告され、複数国での確認が記事で述べられているが、対象国のうち確実に発生が記載されているのはDRC（203312）のみ。ウガンダ（1814991に対応する対象国なし）は発生地域に含まれるが対象国リスト外のため除外。記事では治療法やワクチンがないこと、隔離による伝播阻止の重要性が強調されており、リスク評価の継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Unicef amplía respuesta al brote de ébola y alerta de riesgo para niños
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNICEF expands response to Ebola outbreak and warns of risk to children
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province) and Uganda; UNICEF expands emergency response after WHO declares an international health emergency. UNICEF has mobilized nearly 50 tons of medical supplies—PPE, disinfectants, soap, and drinking-water supplies—to Bunia, DRC, and plans a rapid-response team and community information campaigns. UNICEF activated its Level 3 internal emergency to accelerate funding, personnel, and operational resources. The DRC government reports 116 suspected Ebola deaths as the outbreak affects two new eastern areas; WHO and Africa CDC-UA have not updated their death tolls beyond 88, which includes a case imported in Uganda. Cross-border transmission risk is heightened by insecurity, access barriers, and high population mobility. Children are especially vulnerable due to disease, service disruptions, loss of caregivers, stigma, and protection risks. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC since 1976; WHO has declared a public health emergency. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: ユニセフがエボラ流行への対応を拡大し、子どもへのリスクに警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHOが国際的保健上の緊急事態を宣言し、複数国に波及。フルRRAに進む。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでの輸入事例が言及されているが、サマリーの主題はDRC（Ituri州）でのエボラ流行とUNICEFの対応拡大である。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。DRCは対象国リスト（ID: 203312）に含まれている。WHOが国際的保健上の緊急事態を宣言しており、重大度は最高クラス。

article.articleHeadline: Human avian flu in Maharashtra's Nandurbar: Eight samples to be sent to NIV for tests
article.articleSummary: Eight poultry workers in Nandurbar district, northwestern Maharashtra, have samples collected for human avian influenza testing after exposure to poultry birds or involvement in culling. The nasal-swab samples will be sent to the National Institute of Virology (NIV) in Pune for testing to determine any human infection. The workers have not shown symptoms of human avian flu but are receiving Tamiflu tablets as a precaution. No government employee is among those tested. No confirmed human cases yet; eight samples to NIV Pune on Tuesday as authorities monitor the bird flu situation in the district.

triage.headline_ja: マハラシュトラ州ナンドゥルバルの人間鳥インフルエンザ：8つのサンプルがNIVテストのために送付される
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザの人間感染の可能性を示す異常なシグナルであり、複数の労働者からサンプル採取されている。NipahとAvian Influenzaの両方が報告されており、重要なシグナルとして早期のRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに複数の懸念要素あり：(1)Niphah と Avian Influenza の両疾患が報告されている点、(2)8名の家禽労働者が病原体に曝露した可能性、(3)症状なしながらも予防的にTamiflu投与されている点。確定症例はまだないが、初期段階のシグナルとして重要。NIVへのサンプル送付により、検査結果の経過観察が必須。

article.articleHeadline: สธ. ยันไทยปลอดเชื้อ "อีโบลา" ยกระดับคัดกรองเข้ม 21 วัน ผู้เดินทางจากคองโก-ยูกันดา : อินโฟเควสท์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Public Health reaffirms that Thailand is Ebola-free, intensifies 21-day screening for travelers from Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Thailand remains Ebola-free as of 19 May 2026, but authorities intensify 21-day surveillance for travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. Ebola virus disease, caused by viruses in the Orthoebolavirus group, spreads through direct contact with blood, secretions, or organs of an infected person, contaminated surfaces, or contact with wild animals; it is not airborne. Early symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache, and muscle pain, followed by diarrhea, vomiting, rash, and kidney/liver dysfunction, with a 2–21 day incubation and a high fatality rate. The Department of Disease Control maintains continuous monitoring, screening at all healthcare levels, rapid outbreak investigation, isolation capacity, PPE, laboratory readiness, and international collaboration. Public guidance: wash hands regularly, avoid contact with secretions or the deceased, eat thoroughly cooked foods, and avoid wildlife. Travelers returning within 21 days with fever should seek care and report travel; contact 1422.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、タイはエボラ出血熱から安全と確認、コンゴ・ウガンダからの旅行者に対する21日間の集中スクリーニング強化
triage.triage_reason: タイでのエボラ患者報告はなく、感染症の深刻な拡大リスクは現在低いが、隣接地域での流行に対する監視体制強化は重要なシグナル。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではタイは現在エボラフリーと明記されており、DRCおよびウガンダからのスクリーニング強化は予防的対応。DRCとウガンダでの実際の発生状況の詳細は記事に含まれていないため、対象国リストに該当する地域はタイのみ。スクリーニング基準でepidemic_prone（エボラは極度に感染しやすく高い致死率）とmanageability（タイ当局が積極的な監視・対応を実施）の2項目に該当。

article.articleHeadline: अफ्रीका में अमेरिकी नागर‍िक में इबोला संक्रमण के बाद ट्रंप प्रशासन ने लगाए नए यात्रा प्रतिबंध - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trump administration imposes new travel restrictions after Ebola infection in an American citizen in Africa.
article.articleSummary: On May 19, 2026, after a U.S. citizen in Africa tested positive for Bundibugyo Ebola virus, the Trump administration announced new travel restrictions, with no U.S. cases reported. The infected individual’s exact location within the outbreak area was not disclosed. An interagency response involving the State Department, CDC, and DoD was activated. The patient and six high-risk contacts will be evacuated to Germany for treatment at a specialized virus center. Immediate entry bans were imposed on non-U.S. nationals who had recently traveled to Uganda, Democratic Republic of Congo, Congo, or South Sudan within the past 21 days. Officials issued travel advisories for Americans in the region to prevent further spread. Bundibugyo Ebola virus can cause fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding, and transmits via direct contact with infected body fluids.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでアメリカ市民がエボラに感染した後、トランプ政権が新たな渡航制限を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラウイルスの確定症例に対する政府レベルの対応と国際的な措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダ、DRC、コンゴ、南スーダンが言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（203312）のみ。発生地域としてアフリカ大陸が広く指定されているが、サマリーの具体的な記載に基づきDRCを verified_locations として採用。米国市民の感染報告とドイツへの治療搬送は既に国際的な対応が開始されていることを示す。

article.articleHeadline: Amerikanac koji je zaražen ebolom u Kongu evakuisan na liječenje
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American infected with Ebola in Congo evacuated for treatment.
article.articleSummary: An American, Peter Stafford, infected with Ebola virus Bundibugyo strain, was evacuated to Germany for treatment after developing symptoms over the weekend, following exposure while treating patients at Nyankunde Hospital in Bunia, Democratic Republic of Congo. The outbreak in the DRC has produced at least 118 deaths and more than 390 suspected cases. Stafford, a medical missionary with the Serge group, and his wife Rebekah and their four children are on-site for monitoring and specialized care. The Staffords moved to Africa in 2019 and previously worked in Togo; they met at Ohio State University. The U.S. CDC is coordinating evacuation of at least six additional Americans who were exposed to the virus. There are no approved vaccines or therapies for Bundibugyo Ebola, highlighting ongoing risk during this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラウイルスに感染したアメリカ人が治療のため救出される
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）によるDRCでの継続的な流行イベント。118死亡、390疑い例以上の深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な患者移送と複数国への拡大リスク、未承認治療法という状況から、IHR基準3つ以上該当しシグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは明確にDRCでのエボラ流行を主題としており、患者のアメリカへの移送やドイツでの治療、ドイツ言及、オハイオ州言及は背景情報に過ぎない。発生地域にUSA、ドイツが含まれているが、実際の流行発生地はDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株は希少で、治療法なし、医療従事者への曝露という高リスク特性を持つ。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : plus de 100 décès enregistrés sur plus de 400 cas en trois
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: more than 100 deaths recorded in over 400 cases in three
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri and North Kivu provinces reports 118 deaths among 435 suspected cases over a three-day period as of May 18, 2026. Two health zones, Katwa and Goma, are now affected, with authorities still analyzing cases to determine if they are linked to Ebola virus disease. Government spokesperson Patrick Muyaya urged calm and strict adherence to public health measures: wearing masks, regular handwashing with water and soap or ash, and avoiding high-risk contacts. He stated that teams are mobilized to contain the spread in the affected areas. Populations were advised to minimize physical contact and avoid consuming incompletely cooked smoked meat. The statement emphasizes that Ebola is a viral disease requiring sanitary precautions and refutes rumors of mysticism.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：3日間で400件以上の患者中100人以上の死亡が記録される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な感染拡大と高い致命率（27.1%）により、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は最も危険な感染症の一つであり、3日間で435疑い患者中118人の死亡という急速な進展は極めて懸念される。Katwa、Goma地区での感染確認、政府による公衆衛生対策の実施通知も確認。DRC（GeoNames ID: 203312）はWHOアフリカ地域事務局（AFRO）管轄であるが、CEPR対象国であるため即座にフルRRA進行を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Focarul de Ebola din Congo creşte bilanţul deceselor asociate cu acest virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo increases the death toll associated with this virus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has 118 deaths, with nearly 400 suspected cases reported across an expanded region. The United States has tightened airport health screenings after an American was infected in Congo, plans to transfer the patient to Germany for treatment, and temporarily suspended visas for travelers from affected areas. The CDC is coordinating repatriation of a small number of Americans and says the immediate risk to the general population is low, though public health measures remain adaptable. The World Health Organization has declared the Congo Ebola outbreak a global health emergency. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus cites difficult, dangerous times and deadlock among member states on a rapid information-sharing mechanism for pathogens, hindering vaccine, diagnostic and therapeutic sharing. Reuters cites a 2024 global study indicating the Congo Ebola strain kills about 30-40% of the infected, versus ~90% for the Zaire strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行により関連死亡者が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生に深刻な影響を与え、死亡率が高く、国際的な拡大と渡航制限のリスクが明確である。WHOも国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言しており、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは米国とドイツを言及しているが、イベント発生地は明確にコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）である。米国とドイツは二次的な対応国であり、対象国リスト外のため verified_locations には含めない。DRCは対象国リストに含まれる（ID: 203312）。WHO緊急事態宣言、高い致死率（30-40%）、400近い疑い症例、国際的な渡航制限措置がすべて確認される。シグナル強度は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: TP HCM siết kiểm soát người nhập cảnh phòng Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City tightens entry controls to prevent Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City tightens entry controls to prevent Ebola after WHO declares a global health emergency for the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. On May 19, the city's CDC tightened border screening, examining health signs, travel history, and epidemiological risk, and coordinating with aviation, maritime, and international health quarantine authorities to detect suspected cases early. Preparations include isolation facilities and safe transport for suspected cases, with early detection as a key surveillance objective. The outbreak involves Bundibugyo Ebola virus, a rare strain with no licensed vaccine or specific treatment; early supportive care improves survival. WHO recommends 21-day monitoring for close contacts and two negative tests (48 hours apart) before discharge. Vietnam's Ministry of Health urged calm, advising travelers from affected areas to self-monitor for 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市がエボラ熱予防のための入域管理を厳格化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO による国際保健上の緊急事態宣言に基づく対応であり、複数国での同時爆発に対する越境的な防疫措置を実施している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはホーチミン市の防疫対応を主題としているが、原発地はDRC およびウガンダ。対象国リストにウガンダが含まれないため、verified_locations には DRC とベトナムのみを記載。Bundibugyo Ebola virus はまれなストレインで、ワクチン未承認、特異的治療なしという高リスク特性を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Creștere alarmantă de decese în Congo. Peste 390 de cazuri suspecte de Ebola și cel puțin 100 de morți - Știrile ProTV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarming rise in deaths in Congo. Over 390 suspected Ebola cases and at least 100 deaths - ProTV News
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo faces a Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak with over 390 suspected cases and at least 100 deaths. Uganda reports two laboratory-confirmed cases and one death. The World Health Organization has declared the current outbreak an international emergency. Public health measures, including safe burials, are emphasized as medicines or vaccines remain unavailable. A U.S. physician working in the DRC is among the confirmed cases and will be transported to Germany for treatment, according to missionary groups and CDC sources. CBS News cites reports that at least six Americans have been exposed to Ebola during the epidemic in the DRC. The article highlights ongoing cross-border concerns and the need for rapid laboratory confirmation and infection control, with authorities monitoring imported-exported risk and urging adherence to health guidance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで死亡者急増。390件以上のエボラ疑い例と少なくとも100人の死亡 - ProTV News
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。WHO が国際的緊急事態を宣言しており、複数国への波及と国際的関心が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC でのエボラ流行を主題としており、390件以上の疑い例と100人以上の死亡を報告。ウガンダでの確認例（2件＋1死亡）は提及されるが、記事の主要な対象地域はDRC。US医師がDRCで感染し、ドイツでの治療予定と記載されているが、ドイツ・米国は対象国でないため verified_locations に含めない。WHO が国際的緊急事態を宣言している点が極めて重要。

article.articleHeadline: ΗΠΑ: Νέοι ταξιδιωτικοί περιορισμοί λόγω του ξεσπάσματος Έμπολα στην Αφρική | LiFO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: USA: New travel restrictions due to the Ebola outbreak in Africa | LiFO
article.articleSummary: New US travel restrictions target travelers who recently visited the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Uganda, or South Sudan amid an Ebola outbreak in the region. The CDC will restrict entry for non-U.S. passport holders who have visited these countries within the last three weeks; enhanced health screenings will be implemented for travelers from outbreak areas. The measures take effect immediately and will last 30 days. US citizens, green-card holders, and US military personnel are exempt. The WHO reports at least 80 deaths from the latest Ebola outbreak in the region. International humanitarian sources told CBS News that at least six Americans have been exposed in Congo (DRC); it is unclear if they are infected or there. The CDC will coordinate with airlines, international organizations, and border authorities to identify potentially exposed individuals. Immediate risk to the U.S. population remains low, but measures may be adjusted as data emerge.

triage.headline_ja: 米国：アフリカのエボラ流行に対する新たな渡航制限 | LiFO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施）、かつWPRO基準でも複数該当。対象国DRCでの実際のエボラ確認事例と米国による渡航制限措置により、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ流行が報道されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。米国による渡航制限の実施は国際的な対応を示唆し、WHOの報告では少なくとも80名の死亡が確認されている。米国内での露出者6名の報告もあり、国際的な拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Hơn 100 người chết vì Ebola, Mỹ hạn chế nhập cảnh khách từ 3 nước châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 100 people have died from Ebola, and the United States restricts entry of travelers from three African countries.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda has killed over 100 people, amid 395 suspected cases and 106 deaths reported in Congo and Uganda. The WHO declared a global health emergency after Uganda detected two imported cases and the outbreak, centered in Ituri following a mid‑April funeral, prompted public health actions. The Bundibugyo strain transmits by direct contact with infected bodily fluids; there is no vaccine or specific treatment, with a case fatality of 25–40%. In response, the United States activated Title 42 to restrict entry for travelers who have resided in Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan during the past three weeks, effective for at least 30 days—the second use of Title 42 since Covid-19. At least six U.S. citizens have been exposed; Dr. Peter Stafford, a missionary physician, contracted Ebola in Congo and is being evacuated with family and a colleague to Landstuhl Regional Medical Center, Germany, for isolation and care. The evacuation hub supports regional emergency response and echoes West Africa’s 2014–2015 outset.

triage.headline_ja: エボラで100人以上死亡、米国がアフリカ3カ国からの入境を制限
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）、WHO緊急事態宣言、複数国での確認、米国による大規模渡航制限措置実施。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in DRC with 106 deaths confirmed, international cases (Uganda, US citizens exposed), WHO Global Health Emergency declared, US Title 42 restrictions implemented. Uganda mentioned in summary but not in target country list (only DRC is verified). Sudan and Angola listed in Bluedot but not substantiated in article summary as outbreak locations.

article.articleHeadline: Trump: "Il virus Ebola ha registrato un'impennata in Africa"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trump: "The Ebola virus has registered a surge in Africa."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province, northeast near Uganda and South Sudan) has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) by the World Health Organization. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no vaccines or specific treatments, and it has a high fatality profile. The first case was confirmed in Goma. The latest Africa CDC tally reports 88 deaths among 336 suspected cases; a 59-year-old Congolese man also died in neighboring Uganda, indicating cross-border spread. An American citizen has tested positive for Ebola in the DRC, marking an imported case. The Ituri focus lies in a gold-rich area with significant population movement and security challenges due to armed groups. WHO Director-General Tedros said the outbreak is an international concern but not a pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ：「エボラウイルスはアフリカで急増している」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の高い致死性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。PHEIC宣言済み、国境を越えた確認症例、米国市民の感染確認あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは明確にDRC（イトゥリ州、ゴマ）でのエボラアウトブレークを主題としている。ウガンダとスーダンは国境を越えた拡大の文脈で言及されるが、確認症例は主にDRCに限定。PHEIC宣言済み、Bundibugyo株による高致死性、ワクチン・治療法なし、国際的な感染（米国市民）、セキュリティリスクを含む多くの悪化要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Američki liječnik zaražen ebolom u Kongu. Evakuiran je u Njemačku
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American doctor infected with Ebola in Congo. He was evacuated to Germany.
article.articleSummary: An American physician with the Serge medical mission group in the Democratic Republic of Congo contracted Ebola and was evacuated to Germany for treatment, CDC-confirmed. The patient, Dr. Peter Stafford, developed symptoms after exposure while treating patients at Nyankunde hospital in Bunia, Ituri province, where he has worked since 2023. His wife, Dr. Rebekah Stafford, and two other clinicians from the group were exposed but asymptomatic and under quarantine; their four children are under monitored care. The Congo outbreak has recorded at least 118 deaths and more than 390 suspected infections; WHO has declared Ituri’s outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, and the strain is Bundibugyo, for which no approved therapies or vaccines exist. CDC is evacuating at least six more exposed Americans. A new travel ban under 42 CFR bars entry to non-Americans who recently visited outbreak zones including DR Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人医師がコンゴでエボラ出血熱に感染。ドイツに搬送される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当し、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。複数国への拡大リスク、死亡者118名、疑い患者390名以上、国際的な渡航制限実施の実績がある。
triage.notes: DRC(コンゴ民主共和国)のイトゥリ州Buniaでのエボラ出血熱(Bundibugyo株)の流行。WHOがPHEICを宣言済み。米国人医師が国際搬送されドイツで治療。CDC確認の新規感染例。複数の医療従事者が曝露。発生地域に他国(ウガンダ、南スーダン、ドイツ)が列挙されているが、サマリーから実際の発生地はDRCのIturi州が中心であり、ドイツは治療受け入れ地、ウガンダ・南スーダンは旅行禁止対象地として言及されているのみ。本対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: África oriental vigila las fronteras por el ébola y pide precaución a la población: "¿Por qué solo nosotros sufrimos epidemias?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East Africa monitors its borders against Ebola and urges the public to exercise caution: "Why do only we suffer epidemics?"
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, a new Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) raises regional alarm. Ituri province reports the main transmission focus with eight confirmed cases, 246 suspected cases, and about 80 deaths possibly linked to the disease. A further case in Goma involves a woman in her 30s from Bunia; her husband died from Ebola. Two Congolese patients who arrived in Uganda seeking advanced treatment are among Uganda's two confirmed cases; South Sudan reports one. The World Health Organization has declared a public health emergency of international concern. The East African Community urges intensified cross-border surveillance. Africa CDC is coordinating with DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan to accelerate surveillance, preparedness, and response. On the ground, authorities deploy handwashing stations at major checkpoints, secure Goma–Rwanda border entry points, reactivate an isolation center, and expand treatment centers in three affected zones.

triage.headline_ja: 東アフリカがエボラウイルス対策で国境を監視し、国民に注意を呼びかけ：「なぜ私たちだけが流行病に苦しむのか？」
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの多国間にまたがる確認事例（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）、WHOによる国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）宣言、クロスボーダー感染リスク、および地域的な準備・対応体制の確立があり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの発生地域にはウガンダ、南スーダン、ルワンダ、モザンビークが記載されていますが、サマリー本文を精読すると、主な発生地はDRCのIturi州およびGomaで、ウガンダとSouth Sudanは患者が治療を求めて到着した地点として記載されており、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため除外しました。DRCは対象国であり、確認事例と疑わしい事例、死亡者数が報告されており、WHOによるPHEIC宣言とクロスボーダー監視強化の呼びかけがあります。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: le séquençage du virus confirme le retour de la souche rare Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: viral sequencing confirms the return of the rare Bundibugyo strain.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease due to the Bundibugyo strain has been confirmed in the 2026 outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo by genomic sequencing. The strain is not linked to the 2007 or 2012 outbreaks, and the virus appears to have crossed from animals to humans, with bats suspected as the reservoir. The Ministry of Health reports 435 suspected cases and 116 probable deaths as the epidemic progresses in North Kivu and Ituri provinces. Two new foci were announced: Butembo in North Kivu and Nyankunde in Ituri (Nyankunde is about 45 km southwest of Bunia). In Nyankunde, a U.S. physician from the Serge Christian humanitarian organization treating patients has been infected; his wife and another American are asymptomatic and quarantined. There is no licensed vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola; authorities stress prevention—limiting contacts, avoiding gatherings, and respecting burial rites. Researchers plan to test candidate vaccines for cross-protection using existing tools.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ウイルス塩基配列解析により稀なブンディブギョ株の再来が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。稀なブンディブギョ株の確認、複数州での流行、米国人医療従事者の感染、ワクチン・治療法なし、という重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株は2007年・2012年の流行とは無関連の新規系統。動物由来感染（コウモリが疑われる）。435疑似症例、116推定死亡。有効なワクチン・治療法がない。米国人医療者の感染は国際的関心を高める。国際的支援と協調が急務。

article.articleHeadline: TPHCM tăng cường giám sát trước nguy cơ dịch Ebola xâm nhập
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City strengthens surveillance ahead of the risk of Ebola entering
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, tightens border surveillance as Ebola risk from Africa rises. On 19 May 2026, the city’s Health Department and HCDC coordinate with aviation, maritime, and quarantine units to detect suspected cases at entry points, assess epidemiological links, and ensure rapid isolation and safe transport. WHO has not advised travel or trade restrictions; authorities stress vigilance to prevent importation. Close contacts of any suspected case should be monitored for 21 days, with movement restricted. Discharged patients require two consecutive negative tests at least 48 hours apart. Ebola signs include fever, fatigue, headache, myalgia, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and possible bleeding; incubation is 2–21 days. As of 17 May 2026, WHO declared Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda a PHEIC. The article also notes six Americans exposed to Ebola in DRC, with three high-risk exposures and one symptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市、エボラ侵入のリスクに備え監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みのエボラアウトブレイク（DRC・ウガンダ）に対し、ベトナムが国境監視強化を実施する社会的・政治的に重要なイベント。
triage.notes: 記事はアフリカ（DRC・ウガンダ）でのエボラPHEIC宣言を背景に、ベトナムが国境監視強化する内容。発生地域にはHo Chi Minh City（ベトナム）やアフリカ大陸、米国も含まれるが、記事の主題は①DRC・ウガンダでの既知アウトブレイク、②ベトナムのサーベイランス強化。米国は6人の露出事例言及のみで主題ではないため対象国リストに含まれても除外。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため、DRCのみ verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Повеќе од 100 мртви во епидемијата на ебола во Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 100 dead in the Ebola epidemic in Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 19 May 2026, the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has killed at least 100 people and infected more than 390. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. CBS News sources say at least six Americans have been exposed to Ebola; one is symptomatic, and three had contact with high-risk individuals; it remains unknown whether any are infected. The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) is assisting in the safe evacuation of a small number of directly affected Americans, though exact numbers are not disclosed. STAT reports the U.S. government is arranging transport of a small group to a safe quarantine location, with a U.S. military base in Germany cited as a possible destination, though not officially confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行で100人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症は高い致死率と国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを持つ公衆衛生上の重大事象であり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事は主にコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行を報じており、米国とドイツへの言及は米国市民の避難輸送に関する情報であり、これら国での実際の発生地ではない。そのため verified_locations はコンゴ民主共和国のみ。WHO による国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言があり、高優先度のシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主での死者100人以上に　当局が対策呼びかけ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus disease: More than 100 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; authorities urge measures.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province) has at least 100 deaths and over 390 suspected cases. Africa CDC Director Gene Kasaya told BBC there are no approved therapeutics or vaccines for the Bundibugyo strain driving this outbreak, making public health measures crucial, including safe burial practices. Uganda reports 2 cases and 1 death. WHO on May 17 declared the Bundibugyo outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though not a pandemic; risk of wider spread remains high locally and regionally. Vaccines exist for the Zaire strain but not Bundibugyo. Rwanda plans strengthened border quarantine; Nigeria is monitoring. The United States is coordinating evacuations and enhanced surveillance for affected or exposed Americans, with a Level 4 travel advisory for DRC. Transmission is via contact with infected body fluids; incubation 2–21 days; early symptoms include fever and headache, progressing to vomiting, diarrhea and organ failure; origin linked to fruit bats.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主での死者100人以上に　当局が対策呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHO PHEIC宣言済みの重大な感染症イベント。複数国への拡大リスク、重度の死亡率、国際的な対応が既に展開されている。
triage.notes: WHO により2026年5月17日にPHEIC(Public Health Emergency of International Concern)宣言済み。Bundibugyo エボラウイルス株による2026年の大規模発生で、100人以上の死亡、390人以上の疑い例が報告されている。ウガンダで2例1死亡の二次感染あり、ルワンダはナイジェリアとの対応を実施中。米国はレベル4渡航勧告を発出し、米国民の早期撤退と監視強化を調整している。治療薬・ワクチン不在により対策が限定的。Bluedot APIが示す他国（USA, Rwanda, Uganda, Nigeria）は国境対策や監視活動の関連国として列挙されたもので、実際の発生地はDRC（Ituri州）に限定。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго уже почти 120 погибших от вируса Эбола, среди больных - американский врач
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, nearly 120 have died from the Ebola virus, among the patients is an American doctor.
