article.articleSummary: Outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo driven by the rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain, with three treatment centers opened in Ituri and spread to North Kivu. No approved vaccines or antivirals exist for Bundibugyo. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. As of May 19, there are over 118 deaths and about 300 suspected cases in Ituri and North Kivu; Uganda reports one death and one suspected case. The strain circulated undetected for weeks after Bunia samples were mis-tested for the Zaïre lineage, delaying confirmation. First death occurred April 24 in Bunia; Ebola confirmed May 14, Bundibugyo identified May 15. American doctor Peter Stafford is among new Bunia cases; seven Americans evacuated to Germany for treatment. The U.S. imposes a 30-day entry ban on visitors who recently traveled to DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan; Rwanda closes the land border. Africa CDC notes vaccine gaps amid a humanitarian crisis in Ituri with >273,000 IDPs; UN staff in Bunia work remotely.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラウイルスによる死亡がすでに約120人、患者の中にはアメリカ人医師がいる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、稀有なBundibugyo株で異常、複数国への拡大とWHO PHEIC宣言、国際的な渡航制限実施）。稀有株による国際懸念事例であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola株は稀有で、公認ワクチン・抗ウイルス薬が存在しない。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。米国が入国禁止令発令、ルワンダが国境閉鎖、ウガンダで確認例あり。米国医師が患者の中に含まれ、7人の米国人がドイツへ医療搬送。IDPが27万3千人以上の人道的危機を伴う。複数国への拡大リスクが極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Pakar Ungkap Wabah Penyakit Menular seperti Hantavirus dan Ebola Makin Sering dan Kian Merusak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts Reveal Outbreaks of Infectious Diseases Such as Hantavirus and Ebola Are Becoming More Frequent and More Damaging.
article.articleSummary: Global health experts warn that outbreaks of infectious diseases are becoming more frequent and damaging, with Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, and a hantavirus outbreak on a cruise ship drawing attention. The Global Preparedness Monitoring Board (GPMB) released its latest report on May 18, 2026, linking rising risk to climate crisis, armed conflict, geopolitical fragmentation, and commercial interests. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus opened the World Health Assembly in Geneva noting two outbreaks as the current crises. WHO Congo representative Anne Ancia said rapid response is hampered by serious logistics challenges, including PPE stockouts in Kinshasa; authorities are coordinating a cargo flight to bring additional medical supplies from a regional depot in Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスとエボラなどの感染症アウトブレイク、頻度と被害が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラウイルス感染症はWHOが現在の危機として認識しており、DRCとウガンダで確認。WHA開催により国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事はジュネーブのWHA開催を背景に複数の感染症アウトブレイク（エボラ、ハンタウイルス）について言及。verified_locationsはDRCのみ対象国リストに該当。ウガンダはリストに含まれないため除外。スイスのジュネーブはWHA開催地だが感染症イベント発生地ではなく除外。ハンタウイルスはクルーズ船での発生と記載されているが、具体的な国情報がないため特定不可。

article.articleHeadline: TPHCM: Kiểm soát chặt cửa khẩu chặn nguy cơ dịch bệnh Ebola xâm nhập
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City Tightens Border Controls to Prevent Ebola Virus Disease From Entering
article.articleSummary: On May 19, 2026, Ho Chi Minh City’s Department of Health announced tightened surveillance at border checkpoints to proactively detect and prevent entry of Ebola virus disease into the city. Measures emphasize border quarantine controls to curb importation from international routes. The notice references Ebola virus disease, Bundibugyo strain, linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo, and notes collaboration with the World Health Organization. No cases are reported in the article; authorities aim to intercept potential importation and transmission at entry points before reaching the community. The initiative highlights border control and quarantine as preventive public health measures against Ebola in an urban setting.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市：エボラウイルス病の侵入を防ぐため国境検問所を厳格に管理
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は極めて重篤な感染症であるが、本記事では現地での感染報告がなく、予防的な国境管理措置についての発表である。情報不足のため継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはホーチミン市（ベトナム）が含まれるが、記事サマリーに『No cases are reported in the article』と明記されており、実際の感染例は報告されていない。DRCでのバンディブギョウイルス株の流行参照とされているが、ベトナムでは予防的な国境管理措置の段階。エボラの重篤性を考慮し、続報の監視が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Cẩn trọng trước dịch bệnh mùa hè
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be cautious of summer disease outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Summer humidity and rainfall create ideal conditions for pathogens, increasing infectious disease risk among Vietnamese children. Ongoing dengue fever outbreaks coincide with common summer illnesses such as hand-foot-mouth disease, respiratory infections (sore throat, bronchitis), diarrhea, digestive disorders, meningitis, and encephalitis. Dr. Luu Que Chi, CK1, Head of Quality Management in the Pediatrics Division of the 315 Pediatric System, urges full adherence to vaccination schedules to reduce incidence, severity, and healthcare costs. She stresses not delaying vaccines during outbreaks unless the child has fever, acute illness, or a doctor’s instruction. For fever management, parents may use paracetamol at home per weight and should follow medical guidance, avoiding multiple meds; fever is a symptom, not a disease. To preempt summer illnesses, maintain hygiene, monitor symptoms, and seek medical care if concerns arise. Vietnam’s Ministry of Health approved an EV71-based hand-foot-mouth vaccine, first in the country, to be deployed at 315 facilities.

triage.headline_ja: 夏の感染症アウトブレイクに注意する
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで複数の感染症（デング熱、エンテロウイルス71、脳炎）が同時に流行しており、IHR基準で異常性と公衆衛生への影響が該当。スクリーニング基準では異常性、重症度、流行しやすさが該当し、社会的関心も高い（政府の予防接種推奨、保健省の新ワクチン承認）。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムで複数の夏季感染症が同時流行していることを警告。特にエンテロウイルス71感染症（手足口病）に対して、ベトナム保健省が初の国産ワクチンを承認・展開予定であることが記載されており、公衆衛生対応の重要性が示唆されている。小児への影響が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: American infected with Ebola, 6 others at risk as CDC restricts travel
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, Ebola case in the United States: An American who worked in the Democratic Republic of Congo developed symptoms over the weekend and was laboratory-confirmed positive late Sunday. The CDC transported the patient and six high-risk contacts to Germany for rapid flight and specialized care. Non-citizens who have been in the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan within the last 21 days are barred entry; airports are heightening screening. Nebraska Medicine reports no contact yet; its biocontainment unit treated Ebola patients in 2014. CDC Dr. Satish Pillai described the situation as highly complex and emphasized verified information and urgent action plans. Risk to the U.S. public remains low; those who traveled to DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan should contact a doctor. Ongoing surveillance and any imported or exported cases are being managed.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人がエボラに感染、6人が危険にさらされている。CDCが渡航を制限
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（重大な公衆衛生への影響、予想外の事象、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病の米国での確認例は極めて重大なシグナルであり、フルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事は米国での確認例を報告しているが、対象国リストに米国は含まれていない。感染発生源はDRCであり、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。ただし米国での確認は国際的な重大関心事項であり、トリアージ判定に影響。エボラウイルス病の国際的な感染例確認は最高優先度のシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: Có nên lo lắng về đợt bùng dịch Ebola lần này?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Should we be worried about this Ebola outbreak this time?
article.articleSummary: WHO declares Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province) and Uganda (Kampala) a global health emergency as of May 17, 2026, with at least 80 deaths from the Bundibugyo strain—the 17th outbreak in DRC since 1976. The outbreak is spreading rapidly after late detection; transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids and contaminated objects. Symptoms include fever, muscle pain, vomiting and diarrhea; case fatality historically averages around 50% (range 25–90%). Bundibugyo has no approved treatment or vaccine. Uganda confirms a case in Kampala, signaling cross-border risk amid regional conflict and trade. MSF and IRC are deploying response teams; WHO is supplying additional PPE. Congo urges vigilance. Diagnostic delays occurred because GeneXpert kits designed for Ebola Zaire failed to detect Bundibugyo, delaying confirmation of cases.

triage.headline_ja: 今回のエボラウイルス病の流行について懸念する必要があるか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の株、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが5月17日に国際的保健上の緊急事態を宣言し、80人以上の死亡、複数国での検出、診断遅延による急速な拡大が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCのIturi州での主要な流行を記述。ウガンダ（Kampala）での1例確認は記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に追加しない。Bundibugyo株、診断遅延、治療法・ワクチン不在の深刻な状況。WHOによる緊急事態宣言は国際的関心の高さを示す。

article.articleHeadline: Trump smittad av ebola-skräck: "Är orolig"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trump infected by Ebola scare: "Is worried"
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus, responsible for ongoing outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, is considered a global health risk by the World Health Organization. An American tested positive for Ebola after a visit to the Democratic Republic of Congo, prompting discussion by former President Donald Trump who said he is worried. The WHO has not classified the event as a pandemic, and the outbreak does not meet pandemic emergency criteria, though the situation is serious. Heidi Overton, appointed chair of Trump's Domestic Policy Council in 2025, says a full cross-partisan response has been prepared for the case and related high-risk contacts. The infected person, along with six other high-risk contacts, is to be moved out of the region to Germany. There are currently no Ebola cases in the United States.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染への懸念：トランプ前大統領が「心配している」と発言
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）によるコンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダでの継続的な流行が、WHOによりグローバルヘルスリスクと評価されており、米国でも確認例があり、国際的拡大リスク、重症度、管理可能性の観点から複数のIHR/WPRO基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでの継続的なアウトブレイク、米国での感染確認例、ドイツへの患者移送が記載されている。発生地域フィールドにはドイツと米国も含まれているが、サマリーの主題は両国の継続的流行であり、米国とドイツは感染例の移動先・対応国であるため、verified_locationsには含めない。対象国リスト外のため、DRCとウガンダのみを検証対象地域として列挙した。

article.articleHeadline: กรมควบคุมโรคเฝ้าระวังโรค Mpox สายพันธุ์ Clade Ib หลังพบผู้ป่วยรายใหม่ 2 ราย
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Disease Control monitors Mpox Clade Ib after two new cases were reported.
article.articleSummary: Two new Mpox Clade Ib cases were reported in Thailand during weeks 18–19 (26 Apr–9 May 2026). The first case is a Thai man with recent sex with a stranger; the second is a Thai man with close/skin-to-skin contact at a crowded festival/tourist area. An imported case involves a foreign traveler aged 25–40 who had sex with a stranger at tourist venues. Thailand’s Mpox surveillance lists 1,074 confirmed cases and 16 deaths overall. Mpox Clade Ib has a cumulative 18 Thai cases to date with no deaths; 6 cases were reported in 2026 year-to-date, majority male, with risk from close contact/skin-to-skin. Preventive guidance urges avoiding contact with rashes, not sharing personal items, using condoms, and seeking prompt testing if fever or rash appears within 21 days of exposure; ongoing surveillance in tourist areas.

triage.headline_ja: タイ保健省、新たなMpox Clade Ibケース2例報告後の監視強化
triage.triage_reason: Mpox Clade Ibは国際的関心が高く、観光地での感染拡大リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性、継続的な患者発生がWPRO基準を複数満たし、地域の公衆衛生上のシグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: Mpox Clade Ibは新興株として国際的な監視対象。観光地での感染、接触感染リスク、継続的な患者発生が確認されている。タイは地域の症例監視を強化中。

article.articleHeadline: "Neturime nei vakcinos, nei gydymo priemonių": Kongo DR - nauja Ebolos epidemija
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "We have neither a vaccine nor treatment measures": DR Congo - a new Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and several neighboring countries face a new Ebola virus disease outbreak. The deadly virus has killed about 100 people, with suspected cases nearing 500. Prevention is hampered by the circulation of a rarer Ebola variant for which no vaccine has been developed, and by ongoing transmission across borders. The United States has announced plans to screen a portion of travelers arriving from regions affected by the outbreak to curb cross-border spread. The article notes the lack of available vaccines or treatment measures, underscoring limited tools to control this strain. It does not detail laboratory confirmation processes, infection sources, or clinical symptoms, but highlights international public health measures tied to travel screening.

triage.headline_ja: 「ワクチンも治療手段もない」：コンゴ民主共和国 - 新たなエボラ出血熱の流行
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準でも全5項目に該当。エボラ出血熱の新規流行で死亡100人・疑い例500件近く、ワクチン未開発の稀なバリアント、複数国への越境感染、米国の渡航スクリーニング実施などから、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC及び隣接国での流行が述べられており、米国の渡航スクリーニングは対応措置であって発生地ではないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ワクチン未開発の稀なバリアント、死亡100人・疑い例500件の深刻な状況、越境感染の継続的な脅威があり、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Focar de Ebola în Congo. Cel puțin 100 de oameni au murit. Ce avertizează OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo. At least 100 people have died. What the WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed at least 100 people. The WHO warns that, without approved treatments or vaccines for the Bundibugyo strain, strict public health measures are essential, including rigorous funeral precautions for those infected. Regional concerns exist, with the CDC reporting two confirmed cases and one death in neighboring Uganda. The WHO has classified the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. An American physician infected in the DRC is to be transferred to Germany for treatment, per CBS News. CBS News, citing sources, also reports that at least six American citizens may have been exposed during the DRC outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱が流行。少なくとも100人が死亡。WHOの警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準の4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性・重症度・流行可能性・管理困難性が確認される。公衆衛生上の重大な影響と国際的拡大リスクが明らかであり、WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として分類している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRCのエボラ発生が主題であり、ウガンダで確認例が報告されているが、ウガンダはCEPRの対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations からは除外。ドイツの医師受け入れは二次的情報として扱い、発生地としては認めない。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱で、ワクチン・治療薬がない状況での深刻性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Qué se sabe del brote de ébola por el que la OMS ha declarado la emergencia internacional: sin vacuna y de rápida propagación
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is known about the Ebola outbreak for which the WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern: no vaccine and rapid spread.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the WHO declares a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over a Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 88 confirmed deaths and 246 suspected cases, primarily in Ituri province. The Congolese health ministry reports 91 probable deaths, including a case in Uganda. Bundibugyo Ebola virus has no vaccine and spreads rapidly; incubation is 2–21 days, with initial symptoms of fever, fatigue, malaise, myalgias, headache, and sore throat, potentially progressing to diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal pain and rashes. Case-fatality is 25–40%. Origin in a conflict zone hampers surveillance; >273,000 people are internally displaced in Ituri. The outbreak has reached Uganda (one death) and South Sudan (border case); Rwanda closed its border; Kenya increased temperature checks. WHO delivered 18 tons of supplies; regional bodies urge vigilance. Spain deems very low risk to Spaniards. The 2013–2016 epidemic caused ~11,300 deaths and 28,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言したエボラ出血熱の発生について判明していること：ワクチンなく急速に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を公式宣言しており、対象国（DRC）での複数の死亡例と域内への波及が確認されている。
triage.notes: WHOが2026年5月19日にPHEIC（国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言した進行中の大規模エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ型）。Ituri州で88確定死亡、246疑い例。ウガンダでの死亡例、南スーダンでの境界例確認。ワクチン未発売、ケース・ファタリティレート25～40%。紛争地帯での発生が監視を阻害。WHO/地域機構による対応進行中。記事ではスペインのリスク評価が「極めて低い」とされている。発生地域リストにはスーダン、ルワンダ、ケニア、ウガンダが含まれるが、サマリーでは主に限定的な波及状況で、確実な患者発生地はDRCが主体。

article.articleHeadline: เปิดข้อมูล อีโบลา จะระบาดถึงไทยไหม ชี้ความรุนแรงโรค-ข้อจำกัดการแพร่กระจาย
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New data on Ebola: Will it spread to Thailand? Highlights the severity of the disease and its transmission limits.
article.articleSummary: May 19, 2026: Thai experts say Ebola spread to Thailand is unlikely, as high fatality limits transmission. Ebola is a viral hemorrhagic fever caused by Ebolavirus (Filoviridae). Mortality ranges roughly 25–90% depending on strain and health systems. It was first identified near the Ebola River in the Democratic Republic of Congo in 1976. Several species exist; Zaire ebolavirus is the most severe, with Sudan ebolavirus also highly pathogenic. The largest outbreak occurred 2013–2016 in West Africa (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) with about 30,000 cases and 11,000 deaths, driving vaccine development for Zaire strain. The current outbreak in DRC and Uganda has over 250 cases and more than 80 deaths, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; no vaccine yet for this strain. Transmission is via direct contact with patients or fluids and during funeral rites; outbreaks are often rural or hospital-associated. WHO emphasizes prevention; Thailand remains distant but informed vigilance is prudent.

triage.headline_ja: エボラに関する新データ：タイに拡大する可能性はあるか？ 疾病の重症度と感染拡大の限定性を強調
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（複数株、Bundibugyo ebolavirus）について、DRCとウガンダで250例以上、80例以上の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）を満たす。対象国内でのアクティブな流行状況は国際的懸念事項。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRC および Uganda での現在の流行（Bundibugyo ebolavirus、250例以上、80例以上死亡）が明記されている。タイについては「spread to Thailand is unlikely」と述べられているが、タイでの症例報告ではなく、タイ専門家によるリスク評価記事である。verified_locations には、実際の流行地（DRC）と記事の主題となっている関心国（Thailand）を含める。西アフリカの過去事例（Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone）の記載はあるが、現在の流行地ではないため除外。Uganda も発生地域に含まれるが、対象国リストに無いため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ВООЗ б'є на сполох через спалах хантавірусу та Еболи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO sounds the alarm over hantavirus and Ebola outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the WHO warns of hantavirus linked to cruise ship MV Hondius, with the Andes strain causing three deaths (Dutch couple and a German). Passengers and several crew are hospitalized in the Netherlands, South Africa, Switzerland and Canada. Dutch authorities plan a six-week quarantine for crew and medical staff; incubation can extend to six weeks, and those aboard are currently asymptomatic. Rotterdam-Rijnmond Health says isolation lasts until June 17. The WHO notes global risk is not high, but Andes can transmit person-to-person. In Canada, a passenger in British Columbia tested positive for Andes with mild symptoms. The DRC reports over 200 probable Ebola cases and about 80 deaths, with spillover to Uganda. WHO says this is not a pandemic; the current Ebola strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment; symptoms include fever, bleeding, vomiting and fatigue.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、ハンタウイルスとエボラ出血熱の流行について警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大のリスク、予想外の事象）、WPRO基準で複数該当（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。複数の国への拡大、死亡事例、国際的な関心と対応が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づいて検証：ハンタウイルスについてはオランダ、スイス、カナダで患者が確認されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。エボラについてはDRCで200以上の確定例・疑似例、約80死亡が報告され、ウガンダへのスピルオーバーも言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため included。本イベントは複数の高危険病原体の同時流行であり、国際的な保健上の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: [NNA] 홍콩, 에볼라 출혈열로 '경계' 발령...국경 검역 강화 | 아주경제
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [NNA] Hong Kong issues Ebola hemorrhagic fever alert... Border quarantine strengthened | Aju Economy
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong on May 17 issued the lowest alert level, 'Watch', for Ebola hemorrhagic fever as the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Arriving passengers from Africa will undergo temperature screening at the airport; symptomatic travelers will receive health checks, and suspected cases will be isolated in public hospitals until laboratory confirmation is negative. Officials noted there are no direct flights from the Democratic Republic of the Congo or Uganda to Hong Kong, and the current impact on public health is minimal. WHO data as of May 16 show eight confirmed Ebola hemorrhagic fever cases in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 246 people under investigation and 80 suspected deaths. In Uganda, two Congo-origin Ebola infections were confirmed, with one death; the linkage between the two cases has not been established.

triage.headline_ja: 香港、エボラ出血熱で『警戒』を発令...国境検疫強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが国際的懸念事項として宣言。DRCとウガンダで確認症例と死亡者が報告されており、複数国への拡大を示唆している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのエボラ症例が報告されているが、ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。香港の対応状況はChinaの地域として報告されているが、実際の発生地はDRCとウガンダ。DRCでの8確定症例、246人の調査中、80人の疑い死亡、ウガンダでの2例確定・1死亡が記載されており、重症度・流行性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Американец, заразен с ебола в Конго, е евакуиран за лечение - Свят  --  Новини Стандарт
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American infected with Ebola in Congo has been evacuated for treatment
article.articleSummary: An American doctor infected with Ebola has been evacuated to Germany for treatment after exposure while working with Serge medical mission in Bunia, Democratic Republic of Congo. The CDC said at least six more Americans exposed are being evacuated. The patient has not been named; Serge later identified him as Dr. Peter Stafford, who treated at Nyankunde Hospital in Bunia. His wife, Dr. Rebecca Stafford, and another doctor are asymptomatic and quarantined; the Stafford family of four children is under observation with access to specialized care. The Congo outbreak in Ituri Province reports at least 118 deaths and more than 390 suspected cases; Bundibugyo Ebola strain with no approved vaccines or therapies. WHO has declared the outbreak an emergency of international concern. The CDC notes low US risk and has sent teams from Atlanta; Title 42 restricts entry for people who have been in affected countries within 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラに感染したアメリカ人医師が治療のためドイツに搬送される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当：深刻な公衆衛生影響（118死亡、390以上の疑い例、医療従事者感染）、異常かつ予想外（Bundibugyo株で有効な治療法なし）、国際的拡大リスク（複数国への搬送）、渡航制限措置実施中。WHO国際的懸念事象宣言済み。対象国DRCでの実質的な流行事象。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのItui県Buniaでのエボラ流行（118死亡、390以上疑い例、Bundibugyo株）が主題。アメリカ医師の国際搬送により複数国が関連するが、流行事象の発生地はDRCのみ。WHO緊急事象宣言済み。Title 42による渡航制限措置も実施中。対象国リスト外のGeorgia（米国）、Germany（搬送先）は発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: USA pre epidémiu eboly v Afrike zavádzajú na letiskách skríning cestujúcich - Svet SME
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States to introduce passenger screening at airports in response to the Ebola outbreak in Africa
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa triggers U.S. passenger screening at airports and entry bans for non-U.S. passport holders who have traveled to Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), or South Sudan within 21 days. The CDC reports one American infected while working in the DRC; the patient developed symptoms over the weekend, tested positive Sunday, and is being transported to Germany for treatment, with six more Americans under monitoring. CDC notes about 25 staff operate in the DRC and is evaluating sending a further chief technical coordinator. Officials say the immediate risk to the wider U.S. public remains low, but surveillance, contact tracing, and lab testing will continue with international partners. The WHO highlights an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo variant, with no vaccine approved; mortality is about 37% versus 90% for Zaire. The U.S. mobilized $13 million in immediate aid; measures may adapt as information evolves.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ流行に対応し、米国は空港での乗客スクリーニングを導入
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の多国間での確認、米国での感染者確認、国際的な渡航制限措置の実施により、フルRRAに進むべきシグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいてアフリカでのエボラ流行が報告されており、対象国リスト内ではDRC（203312）のみが確認対象国として該当する。ウガンダ、南スーダン、その他アフリカ国での発生も言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。米国、ドイツでの事例は対象国外であるため除外。エボラ出血熱は高い致命率と国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限措置の実施により、シグナルとして優先度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Трамп обеспокоен в связи с распространением Эболы в Африке
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trump concerned about the spread of Ebola in Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, President Donald Trump voiced concern about an Ebola outbreak in Africa and the potential for further spread. He said the disease is currently recorded in Africa but could spread beyond. Speaking in Washington, he emphasized the risk of wider transmission. The article notes that the United States has introduced additional travel measures for travelers who visited Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, or South Sudan in relation to the Ebola outbreak in these countries. No case counts or deaths are provided. The report highlights heightened vigilance and border measures to reduce importation of Ebola cases amid the Africa outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ、アフリカでのエボラ感染拡大に懸念を表明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。アフリカでのエボラ感染症の流行を報告し、複数国への拡大と米国の渡航制限措置が講じられている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示的にウガンダ、コンゴ民主共和国、南スーダンでのエボラ感染症流行を報告。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみ該当。米国大統領による公式発言を含むため社会的・政治的関心が高い。死亡数や感染者数が記載されていないが、公衆衛生的インパクトは明らかと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Billings group postpones Uganda orphanage trip amid Ebola outbreak concerns in region
article.articleSummary: A Billings-based humanitarian group, AIDSpirit, postponed its planned Uganda orphanage trip (Kayunga district) after Ebola concerns. Eleven volunteers unanimously decided to delay the departure scheduled for Thursday, three days before departure, amid a CDC report that an American missionary in the Democratic Republic of Congo tested positive for Ebola, with the outbreak spreading to Uganda, raising fears of a government lockdown and possible difficulties returning to the United States. The group has made 17 trips to Uganda since 2009 to support the orphanage, emphasize education, and assist with farming. AIDSpirit notes its broader work: restoring 18 wells and drilling 18 more, delivering medicine and operating medical clinics for children with sickle cell anemia. The expedition remains on hold, with hopes to resume in January next year.

triage.headline_ja: ビリングスの団体がエボラ流行懸念からウガンダ孤児院旅行を延期
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大（DRC→ウガンダ）、異国での流行懸念による米国民の渡航制限リスク、IHR基準2つ以上に該当。
triage.notes: 記事のサマリーではウガンダが主要な言及地域であるが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCでの確認事例と地域への拡大リスクが主な懸念。米国内（Montana）での具体的な患者発生ではなく、懸念による渡航延期であるため、実発生地はDRCのみとなる。

article.articleHeadline: WHO responding to 'complex, difficult' Ebola outbreak in DR Congo - RocketNews
article.articleSummary: Published on 19 May 2026, the report states that the World Health Organization is mobilising health experts and supplies to the Democratic Republic of Congo to tackle an Ebola outbreak. The outbreak’s epicentre is Bunia, where WHO representative Anne Ancia described the situation as complex and difficult, signaling significant operational challenges for containment and response. International health authorities are increasing on-the-ground presence to support local health authorities and to coordinate the international response as transmission continues in the region. The account highlights WHO’s ongoing involvement and its characterization of the outbreak as a complex, difficult scenario requiring sustained assistance and resources.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の複雑で困難な発生に対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は重篤な公衆衛生上の影響を持つ既知の感染症であり、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクが高い。WHOが国際対応を動員している点も該当。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHR(2005)で最も厳格な監視対象疾患の一つ。DRCはエボラの反復的発生地域であり、Buniaでの現在の発生は複雑で管理困難と報告されている。WHOが国際専門家を動員し、支援を増加させている点は、国際対応の必要性を示唆している。社会的・政治的関心も極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola u Kongu: Amerikanac koji je zaražen prebačen na liječenje u inostranstvo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: An American who contracted Ebola has been transferred abroad for treatment.
article.articleSummary: An American healthcare worker, Peter Stafford, affiliated with the Serge medical mission group in the Democratic Republic of Congo, has contracted Ebola and was evacuated to Germany for treatment after developing symptoms over the weekend, according to the U.S. CDC. The Congo outbreak has so far killed at least 118 and has more than 390 suspected cases. The CDC says it is evacuating at least six other Americans who were exposed. Stafford treated patients at Nyankunde Hospital in Bunia, where he has worked since 2023. Stafford and his four young children are at a location where they can be monitored for risk and receive specialized medical care. The current Ebola strain is Bundibugyo, for which there are no approved medicines or vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ：感染した米国人が海外での治療のため移送
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染確認、国際的な患者移送、死亡118名・疑い例390名以上という深刻な発生規模により、IHR基準3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも重症度・流行可能性・管理可能性が確認される。
triage.notes: 患者は米国人医療従事者だがコンゴでの感染が確認されており、発症地はDRC（ブニア）。ドイツへの移送は治療目的だが、患者の元々の感染源はDRC。現在の流行株はBundibugyo型で承認された治療法がないため、対象国リストにDRCが含まれるため verified_locations に含める。米国・ドイツへの医療移送は言及されているが、感染イベントの実際の発生地はDRCのため。

article.articleHeadline: Donald Trump affirme que l'épidémie d'Ebola reste "confinée pour le moment" à l'Afrique après
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Donald Trump says that the Ebola outbreak remains "confined for the moment" to Africa after.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has resulted in at least 91 deaths and about 350 suspected cases, with most patients aged 20–39. An American national contracted Ebola through work in the DRC and tested positive late Sunday; authorities plan to transfer him to Germany for treatment. The World Health Organization has declared the DRC outbreak an international health emergency. U.S. CDC measures include airport screenings for travelers from Uganda, the DRC, and South Sudan who have visited these areas in the last 21 days, and temporary visa restrictions for foreigners who traveled in these zones; the U.S. embassy in Kampala has suspended visa services. No vaccine or specific treatment exists for this strain. President Trump said the outbreak remains “confined for the moment” to Africa as of May 18, with ongoing risk assessment and potential public health adaptations.

triage.headline_ja: ドナルド・トランプ大統領、エボラ流行は「当面のところ」アフリカに限定されていると主張
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際的拡大、国際的移動制限のリスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準で5項目全て該当。対象国DRCでの感染症イベント。
triage.notes: DRC中心のエボラ流行イベント。少なくとも91人の死亡、約350人の疑い患者が報告されている。米国民がDRCでの仕事を通じて感染し、ドイツでの治療予定。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言。米国CDC等による空港スクリーニング、ビザ制限などの対策実施。国家首脳による公的言及あり。対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola Outbreak Follows Hunger and Displacement Crisis in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Eight laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases, 246 suspected cases, and 80 suspected deaths have been reported in Ituri province, eastern DR Congo, as of 16 May, with unconfirmed reports of a positive case in Goma. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, includes confirmed cases in Kinshasa and across the border in Uganda, where two infections involved travelers from DRC and Kampala is impacted. A confirmed case is believed to be the wife of a Bunia patient; another traveled from Bunia to Beni in North Kivu. WHO supports the response with 42 health professionals on the ground and supplies deployed. There is no approved therapy or vaccine for Bundibugyo virus. Insecurity, humanitarian crisis, high mobility, and informal healthcare networks raise transmission risk. GPMB notes AI could aid preparedness but requires governance safeguards.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：飢饉と避難民危機に続くエボラ感染症の流行
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスの国際的拡大（ウガンダへの越境感染）、複数国への影響、高い重症度、および対象国DRCを含む。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus によるエボラ流行。ウガンダへの越境感染が確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。治療法やワクチンが承認されていない。不安定な治安、人道危機、高い人口移動が伝播リスクを増大させている。WHO による現地支援が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: At least 120 dead in Ebola outbreak in DR Congo, official says
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports outbreak of Bundibugyo Ebola strain in Ituri and North Kivu; at least 120 deaths and more than 300 suspected cases; first death Apr 24 in Bunia; laboratory confirmation on May 14 and Bundibugyo strain identified May 15. Cases spread to Bunia, Goma, Mongbwalu, Butembo and Nyakunde; Uganda reports one death and a suspected case. No approved vaccine or specific treatment; symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, and unexplained bleeding; transmission via contact with bodily fluids. Response includes three new Ebola treatment centres in Ituri, WHO deployment of expert teams, cross-border screening, and enhanced surveillance. Imported/exported cases: an American doctor infected and moved for treatment; seven Americans relocated to Germany for monitoring. More than 270,000 displaced in Ituri amid ongoing humanitarian crisis. This is the third Bundibugyo outbreak since 2007.

triage.headline_ja: DR Congo でエボラ出血熱の流行で少なくとも120人が死亡、当局者が発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当。エボラは高危険病原体であり、複数国への拡大と多数の死亡が確認されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスの大規模流行。少なくとも120人の死亡、300以上の疑い患者。北キブ州とイツリ州に集中。ウガンダへの拡大確認（1人死亡）。米国人医師および複数の米国人が感染・移動。WHOの支援展開中。2007年以来3番目のBundibugyo型流行。人道危機の深刻化（27万人以上が避難）。国際的な支援と対応が必要な状況。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: কঙ্গোতে ইবোলার প্রাদুর্ভাবে অন্তত ১০০ জনের মৃত্যু
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At least 100 people have died in the Ebola outbreak in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has at least 100 deaths and more than 390 confirmed or suspected cases, centered in eastern Ituri province. Africa CDC director Jean Kaseya warned there are no approved treatments or vaccines, so affected individuals and funeral rites must follow strict public health safeguards. The World Health Organization has declared the Bundibugyo virus outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, highlighting the potential for wider local and cross-border spread. Uganda has confirmed two infections with one death linked to the outbreak. The 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic infected over 28,600 people and killed more than 11,300, with cases moving beyond Guinea and Sierra Leone to the United States, United Kingdom, and Italy. Current signals suggest the Congo outbreak could be larger than currently detected.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラ出血熱の流行で少なくとも100人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。コンゴ東部での100人以上の死亡、ウガンダへの越境感染確認、国際的関心の高まりにより、即座にフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス属Bundibugyo種の流行。2014-2016年西アフリカ流行（28,600人以上感染、11,300人以上死亡）との比較言及あり。WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）宣言済み。ウガンダへの越境感染確認。治療法・ワクチンなし。記事サマリー内では米国、英国、イタリアが言及されているが、これは過去の西アフリカ流行での到達地であり、現在の流行の検証地は対象国リストではDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola Strain Spreading in Congo and Uganda Has No Approved Vaccine
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus, an orthoebolavirus without an approved vaccine or therapeutics, is driving the Congo (DRC) outbreak (Ituri province) with spillover to Kampala, Uganda. By May 16, WHO counted 246 suspected cases and 80 deaths in Ituri; the Bundibugyo strain was only identified on May 15 after rapid tests calibrated for Zaire missed it. Ituri’s porous borders and a mobile population, plus conflict in eastern Congo, elevate cross-border spread. The outbreak location near mining towns has already reached Uganda’s capital. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. The CDC says US risk is low; a small number of Americans exposed in Congo were evacuated, including a high-risk case, and a May 18 travel ban targeted travelers from Ebola-affected countries. Four health workers died early, signaling in-facility transmission. No human-tested Bundibugyo vaccines exist; experimental vaccines showed primate promise. Survivors may harbor virus in immune-privileged sites (testes, eyes, CNS) after recovery, enabling potential sexual transmission; authorities urge precautions until semen tests negative twice.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ-キンシャサ：コンゴとウガンダに広がるエボラ株に承認されたワクチンがない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当。ブンディブギョウイルスによる未承認ワクチンの輸入熱帯感染症であり、WHO PEICが宣言された国際的に重大な公衆衛生事象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（イトゥリ州）が主たる発生地で、ウガンダ（カンパラ）への越境流行を報告。発生地域リストにはウガンダも含まれているが、サマリー上ウガンダは「流入地」であり、主たるアウトブレイク発生国はDRCのみ。対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ブンディブギョウウイルスは正式な医療用ワクチンが存在せず、医療従事者4名を含む死亡例、PHEIC宣言により極めて高いリスク評価。

article.articleHeadline: 為防非洲豬瘟、口蹄疫及豬瘟入侵 基隆關籲旅客切勿攜帶含肉製品入境 | 產業熱點 | 產業 | 經濟日報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To prevent African swine fever, foot-and-mouth disease, and classical swine fever from entering Taiwan, Keelung Customs urges travelers not to bring meat-containing products into the country.
article.articleSummary: Keelung Customs in Taiwan urges travelers not to bring meat-containing products into the country to prevent entry of African swine fever (ASF), foot-and-mouth disease (FMD), and classical swine fever (CSF). Taiwan was officially recognized by the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) on April 6 as a self-declared ASF non-epidemic area and remains Asia’s only country free of ASF, FMD, and CSF. Despite this, Mainland China has reported a South African Type I FMD outbreak, prompting strengthened border controls to block meat goods from epidemic regions. Confiscated items include pork pastries, pork jerky, dumplings, and ham. Under the Animal Infectious Disease Prevention and Control Act (Article 45-1), penalties range from 10,000 to 1,000,000 NTD for bringing meat products from epidemic zones; first-time violations by travellers from ASF-affected regions within the last three years typically incur 200,000 NTD, with repeats at 1,000,000 NTD. Enforcement peaks during Dragon Boat Festival; inquiries can be made at inbound red-line desks or outbound service desks.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚コレラ、口蹄疫、豚コレラの侵入を防ぐため、基隆関税局は旅客に肉製品を含む製品の持ち込みを控えるよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は台湾の関税当局による予防的な呼びかけ（入境管理強化）であり、実際の新規発生やアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。台湾はASF、FMD、CSFの非流行地域として認定されており、中国でのFMDはサマリーで言及されるが、台湾での感染症イベント発生を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾での予防的な入境管理強化の発表であり、実際の感染症イベント（新規発生、流行拡大）ではない。中国でのFMDが言及されているが、詳細な発生情報は提供されていない。動物疾患であり公衆衛生上の直接的な人間への健康脅威ではない。

article.articleHeadline: PE SCURT: Grindeanu are un profil tehnocrat / Marius Baciu, noul antrenor FCSB / Variantă Ebola fără tratament sau vaccin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In short: Grindeanu has a technocratic profile / Marius Baciu, the new FCSB coach / Ebola variant with no treatment or vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Ebola variant with no available treatment or vaccine is emerging in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with cases also reported in Uganda. The World Health Organization has dispatched representatives to assist outbreak management, and the U.S. CDC will send specialists. The outbreak has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern due to the high risk of spread. Ten infections have been confirmed, with approximately 350 suspected cases under scrutiny and about 90 deaths attributed to the outbreak. The article underscores the absence of therapeutic options or vaccines for this Ebola variant, highlighting the urgency of containment, enhanced surveillance, and international support.

triage.headline_ja: 短信: グリンデアヌは技術官僚的なプロフィールを持つ / マリウス・バチウが新しいFCSBコーチ / 治療法またはワクチンのないエボラ亜種
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（死亡90例、疑い例350例）、予想外（治療法・ワクチンなし）、複数国での流行、国際的拡大リスク及び渡航制限リスク。WHOがPHEIC宣言、CDC派遣予定など国際対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでの発生が明記されているが、ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。本イベントはWHOがPHEICを宣言し、CDC派遣予定など国際対応が実施中であり、治療法・ワクチン欠如という極めて深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: PVO deklarē Ebolas vīrusslimības uzliesmojumu Āfrikā par ārkārtas situāciju
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO declares Ebola virus disease outbreak in Africa an emergency.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-19, the WHO declared an Ebola virus disease outbreak in Africa an emergency, not a pandemic, and thus no immediate border closures. A laboratory-confirmed EBOV infection has been reported in Kinshasa, the capital of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, about 1,000 km from the epicenter in Ituri province near the Uganda border; authorities also confirmed a case in Goma in the east. Ongoing civil conflict hampers response, with roughly 250,000 people displaced. The outbreak presently involves Bundibugyo ebolavirus, the least studied strain, which caused outbreaks in 2007 and 2012 with about 30% case fatality. Incubation 2–21 days; early symptoms fever, headache, fatigue, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, organ dysfunction, and sometimes internal/external bleeding. No approved antivirals; care is supportive. Reservoirs include bats; transmission via direct contact. Latvia’s CDC underscores high risk and lethal potential.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがアフリカのエボラウイルス病の流行を緊急事態として宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当し、WPRO基準でも5つすべてに該当する。エボラウイルス病の確認事例（キンシャサ、ゴマ）、高い死亡率（約30%）、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ国境近く）、複数国への波及可能性が認められ、WHOによる緊急事態宣言により国際的な社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの実際の確認事例（キンシャサ、ゴマ、イトゥリ州）に焦点を当てている。ウガンダは地理的に隣接し国境近い地域での発生だが、記事サマリーではウガンダでの確認事例は明記されていないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（最もよく研究されていない株）であり、約30%の死亡率という高い重症度が特徴。WHOの緊急事態宣言により国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warnt: Ebola breitet sich aus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns: Ebola is spreading.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak driven by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, near the Congo-Uganda and Congo-South Sudan borders. As of May 19, 2026, DRC reports at least 100 deaths and up to 330 suspected cases; WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 16, describing the situation as an extraordinary event and urging neighboring countries to prepare for treatment and containment, while cautioning against travel restrictions that could drive unmonitored crossings. No vaccine exists for Bundibugyo virus; case fatality for this strain is about 40%, though Ebola mortality varies by strain (roughly 20–90%). Early symptoms resemble flu—fever, fatigue, malaise, myalgia—followed by vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, and potentially respiratory distress, seizures, confusion, bleeding, and organ failure. Transmission occurs via close contact with bodily fluids and contaminated objects. Investigations aim to trace infection chains started in mid-April; MSF anticipates a prolonged response.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが警告：エボラが拡大している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、高い致命率（約40%）、国際的拡大リスク、複数国での発生が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCとウガンダ、スーダンが言及されているが、対象国リストにはDRC（203312）のみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダ・スーダンは対象国外のため除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言（2026年5月16日）、少なくとも100人の死亡、最大330人の疑い患者、Bundibugyo virus由来、ワクチン未開発、致命率約40%という極めて深刻な状況が示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Болезнь, от которой нет зарегистрированной вакцины, убила более 100 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A disease for which there is no registered vaccine has killed more than 100 people.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri and North Kivu) has killed more than 118 people and triggered a WHO alert. As of May 19, about 300 suspected cases are reported; Uganda confirms one death. The outbreak began in late April in Ituri; labs initially tested for the Zaire strain, causing weeks of false negatives and delayed response. Symptoms include fever, muscle pain, diarrhea, vomiting, and internal bleeding; transmission occurs via body fluids. A US physician, Peter Stafford, contracted the virus at Bunia hospital in Ituri; he and six other Americans will be flown to Germany for monitoring; his wife worked in the same hospital. WHO will send experts and open three Ebola treatment centers in Ituri. Rwanda closed its land border with Congo; the US banned entry of foreigners who visited Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan in the prior 30 days. Ituri has 273,000 displaced people.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチンが登録されていない病気が100人以上を殺害した
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の大規模アウトブレイク（118人以上死亡、約300例の疑い患者）であり、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。国際的な対応（国境閉鎖、渡航制限、複数国への感染拡大）が既に発生しており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株によるコンゴ民主共和国東部（Ituri、North Kivu）でのアウトブレイク。WHO警告発令済み。米国医師を含む複数国の事例あり。国境閉鎖・渡航制限など国際的対応が既に実施されている。実験室検査での初期の誤診（Zaire株の検査により陰性結果が遅延）により対応が遅れたことが報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: The parasite that won't leave: Why Malaria still rules Nigeria
article.articleSummary: Nigeria bears the world’s largest malaria burden in 2024, with about 68.5 million cases and accounting for roughly a quarter of global cases, a third of deaths, and over half of West Africa’s cases; under‑five deaths make up about 38.6% of global malaria deaths in that age group. Despite nets, drains and ongoing awareness, malaria remains entrenched, and the AU’s 2024 Malaria Progress Report warns of a “perfect storm of converging crises” jeopardizing the 2030 elimination target. Nigeria has drawn substantial funding—US PMI about $914 million (2011–2024); Global Fund nearly $980 million since 2003; multilateral loans about $364 million (2020–2024)—raising total malaria investments since 2000 to over $3 billion, yet the mortality burden persists. By contrast, China’s elimination effort—about $190 million over a decade plus >$100 million Global Fund—helped cut cases to under 5,000 annually, highlighting Nigeria’s challenge.

triage.headline_ja: 寄生虫は去らない：マラリアがなぜナイジェリアを支配し続けるのか
triage.triage_reason: マラリアはナイジェリアの既知の風土病であり、異常性や新規アウトブレイクの明確な兆候がないため、IHR基準やWPRO基準の強い該当は認められない。ただし公衆衛生への深刻な影響が存在し、追加情報によるフルRRAの必要性を判断すべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアにおけるマラリアの継続的な風土病化であり、新規アウトブレイクではない。Bluedot APIの発生地域にはAngolaも含まれているが、サマリーではナイジェリアとGhana（西アフリカの事例）が主対象。Chinaは比較例として登場しており、実際の発生地ではなく対比対象。ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WPRO基準では重症度、長期曝露、流行性、管理可能性が該当するが、既知の風土病であり異常性がないため、フルRRA前段階のWATCH判定。

article.articleHeadline: יותר מ-100 מתים באפריקה: הנגיף הקטלני מתפשט - אמס
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 100 dead in Africa: the deadly virus is spreading - AMS.
article.articleSummary: An ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has triggered a World Health Organization PHEIC, with at least 106 deaths and hundreds more suspected. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no approved vaccine or targeted therapy; symptoms include fever, myalgia, rash, and in severe cases internal and external bleeding. Africa CDC Director Dr. Jean Kasia warned the death toll is likely higher than official counts, noting many cases remain unreported in communities. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DR Congo since 1976, with fruit bats as the natural reservoir. In Bunia, an American clinician contracted the virus while serving on a humanitarian mission; his wife and others are under close medical monitoring. The United States invoked Section 42 to restrict entry; Uganda's embassy in Kampala suspended visa services amid the outbreak and cases in the city.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカで100人以上が死亡：致命的ウイルスが拡大中 - AMS
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の流行が複数国で確認され、PHEIC発令、106人以上の死亡、国際的な渡航制限が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（ブニア）とウガンダ（カンパラ）での発生が記載されているが、Bluedot APIのUgandaはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。米国の入国制限は報告地域であり、発生地ではないため除外。WHOがPHEIC（Public Health Emergency of International Concern）を発令し、複数国での症例確認と国際的な渡航制限が実施されており、明確なシグナルとして識別される。

article.articleHeadline: สธ.เผยต่างชาติเที่ยวไทยติด 'ฝีดาษวานร' มีสัมพันธ์แนบเนื้อคนแปลกหน้า เตือน 'กลุ่มMSM' เฝ้าระวังอาการ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Public Health reveals that foreigners visiting Thailand have contracted monkeypox after skin-to-skin contact with a stranger, and warns the MSM group to monitor symptoms.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, monkeypox (Mpox) surveillance in Thailand reports 1,074 confirmed cases and 16 deaths. In weeks 18–19 (April 26–May 9), two new Mpox clade Ib cases were confirmed in Thai men; one had high‑risk exposure from sex with a stranger, the other via close/skin‑to‑skin contact at a crowded tourist festival. International Health Regulations records a foreign traveler to Thailand (aged 25–40) with risk from sex with strangers in a tourism venue, with warnings particularly for MSM. Mpox clade Ib remains on the rise, with 18 cumulative clade Ib cases to date, and six cases reported in 2026 so far, none deaths; four of these cases are male. Most infections involve close contact/skin‑to‑skin exposure. Preventive measures include avoiding close contact with those with rashes, not sharing personal items, using condoms, and seeking testing if fever, rash, or lesions appear within 21 days of exposure. For information, call 1422.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省が明かす：タイを訪問した外国人がサル痘に感染、見知らぬ人との皮膚接触後。MSMグループに症状監視を警告
triage.triage_reason: Mpox clade Ibの継続的な確認（2026年に6症例、累積18症例）と国際的な旅行関連症例が報告されており、IHR基準（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）を満たす。タイにおける既知の流行状況下での新規クレード同定と国際旅行者への感染は、継続的な監視とRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: タイでのMpox流行は既知の状況だが、clade Ibの新規確認（2026年6症例、累積18症例）と国際旅行者への感染拡大の可能性が注目される。MSMグループへの警告と症状監視の強調から、当局は拡大懸念を持っている。皮膚接触による伝播リスクが高く、観光地での感染リスクも指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Up to 80 people killed in Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo as WHO declares public health emergency
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri and North Kivu) is caused by Bundibugyo virus, with an estimated 80 deaths, eight laboratory-confirmed cases, and 246 suspected cases in Ituri. A further confirmed case is in Goma, North Kivu. The WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern due to cross-border risk after two cases surfaced in Kampala, Uganda. Response teams, including DRC health minister Samuel Kamba, arrived in Bunia with tents for treatment centers; WHO is shipping additional PPE from Kenya, and CDC/EC officials are expanding deployments. Uganda paused visa services; Congolese border activity was reported at Bukavu toward Rwanda. The Bundibugyo strain lacks approved therapeutics or vaccines, unlike the Zaire strain that caused the 2018-2020 outbreak, which killed nearly 2,300. Illness emerged in April following a large open-casket funeral in Mongbwalu.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の流行で最大80人が死亡、WHO が国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当する。エボラ出血熱の国境を越えた複数国での確認、WHO による国際保健上の緊急事態宣言、高い死亡数（推定80人）、治療法やワクチンの欠如など、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として判定される。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の流行は東部DRC（Ituri および North Kivu）で発生し、ウガンダ（Kampala）でも確認症例あり。記事の主要テーマはDRCでの流行であり、ウガンダは国境を越えた感染の事例として言及されているため、対象国リストに含まれているウガンダは verified_locations に含めない。DRCが対象国であることが確認され、複数の国（ルワンダ、ケニア、ウガンダ）への国境リスク、ビザ停止措置の実施など、国際的な対応が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: "На краю пропасти". В ВОЗ утверждают о приближении новой пандемии
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: On the edge of the abyss. The WHO claims that a new pandemic is approaching.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-19, the WHO warns that infectious disease outbreaks are increasingly frequent and a new global pandemic could be more devastating than previous ones. The Global Preparedness Monitoring Board (GPMB), established by the WHO and World Bank, states the world has not become safer since the COVID-19 pandemic and Ebola outbreaks; a new “Disease X,” a zoonotic pathogen, cannot be ruled out. Funding for development programs and epidemic surveillance has fallen to the absolute minimum since 2009. Experts also note rising distrust in governments, misinformation, and inequitable access to vaccines and treatments. Ebola fatalities in the Democratic Republic of Congo have surpassed 100. Additionally, Daily Star reported a high likelihood of a 2026 pandemic, listing four active threats: mpox, rubella, avian influenza, and Oropouche virus.

triage.headline_ja: 「断崖絶壁の縁に」。WHOが新たなパンデミックの接近を主張
triage.triage_reason: 複数の重篤な感染症（エボラ、天然痘、鳥インフルエンザ）がDRCで同時に報告され、DRCでのエボラ死者が100を超えている。国際的なパンデミック警告とWHO/世界銀行による警告が公式に発出されており、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ死亡者100人超は極めて深刻。複数の重篤疾患（Mpox、Avian Influenza、Rubella、Oropouche、COVID-19）が同時に報告されている。WHO/GPMB による公式なパンデミック警告が発出されており、社会的・政治的関心が高い。ただし、記事は主にWHOの警告と過去のパンデミック対応の批判が中心であり、DRCでの現在の発生状況の詳細は限定的。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Abia Government advises residents to avoid contact with rodents
article.articleSummary: Abia State government, after the executive council meeting in Umuahia presided over by Governor Alex Otti at Government House, advised residents to avoid contact with rodents and to seek medical attention promptly when ill. Commissioner for Information Okey Kanu said there are no confirmed cases of Ebola virus, Covid-19, Cholera, Lassa Fever, Rabies, Mpox or Diphtheria in any part of Abia. He urged residents to maintain personal and environmental hygiene. The government also noted that it is monitoring the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, per alerts from the World Health Organization and the Nigerian Centre for Disease Control and Prevention.

triage.headline_ja: アビア州政府が住民に齧歯動物との接触を避けるよう助言
triage.triage_reason: 複数の高危険度疾患が列挙されているが、記事サマリーでは「アビア州内では確認症例なし」と明記されており、実際の発生イベントではなく予防警告である。ただし、DRCとウガンダでのEbola流行を監視中とのことから、地域的関心と公式機関の関与が認められるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア・アビア州からの予防啓発であり、確認症例はない。ただし、参照先のDRCでのEbola流行を監視対象としているため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。複数の高危険度疾患が言及されているが、実際の活発なイベントではなくリスク警告段階であるため DISMISS ではなく WATCH とした。続報でアビア州または周辺地域での確認例が報告される場合は即座にPICKUPに昇格させるべき。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola: Kesiapan Uganda lebih cepat dari Indonesia - Serambinews.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: Uganda's preparedness is ahead of Indonesia's.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) for Bundibugyo ebolavirus in Uganda. Uganda's rapid genomic response stands out: a patient in Hoima had blood drawn on May 14; samples reached a central lab in Kampala the next day; Illumina NextSeq 2000 produced a 4,471x depth of coverage by May 16; the full genome was published publicly on Pathoplexus by May 17, enabling under four days from patient to data release. The piece notes Ebola Sudan 2025 with confirmation in under 24 hours, aided by portable nanopore sequencing and open data sharing. In contrast, Indonesia has built a distributed whole-genome sequencing ecosystem, boosting capacity from about 140 samples in nine months to around 8,000 samples per month, with outreach beyond Java.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱感染症：ウガンダの準備体制はインドネシアより迅速である
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHOによるPHEIC宣言済みのBundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラウイルス）がウガンダで確認されており、重篤性・国際的懸念・渡航制限リスクが明確である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダでのBundibugyo ebolavirus確認とWHOのPHEIC宣言を記述。インドネシアへの言及はゲノムシークエンシング能力の比較論であり、実際の感染症イベント発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。配信日時が2026年という将来日付であるため注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Una planta pública de Colombia inicia la producción industrial de un medicamento contra la malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A state-owned plant in Colombia begins industrial production of an antimalarial drug
article.articleSummary: Colombia’s state-owned University of Antioquia began industrial production of chloroquine, a key antimalarial, on May 12, 2026. The initial batch totals 1.7 million tablets, with 500,000 more than planned, and the drug already holds Invima registration since June 2025. The venture aims to strengthen national drug sovereignty and distribute through PAHO/OPS, with potential regional export to Latin America. The project also targets other essential medicines for neglected diseases, including benznidazole (Chagas) and praziquantel, and is developing niclosamide for intestinal cestode infections. Funding is about 2.0 billion COP (roughly $530,000) plus 400,000 million COP in government support. Malaria in Colombia affects vulnerable rural and indigenous populations, especially along the Pacific coast, Cauca and Sinú valleys, the Amazon, and Orinoquía, transmitted by Anopheles mosquitoes (Plasmodium spp.). The announcement coincides with health-system criticisms and a ruling permitting domestic manufacture of dolutegravir.

triage.headline_ja: コロンビアの公立機関がマラリア医薬品の工業生産を開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はコロンビアの医薬品製造施設によるマラリア・シャーガス病治療薬の生産開始に関する発表であり、新規感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、医薬品製造の進展事項である。疾患の流行や危機的状況を報告するシグナルではなく、保健政策・産業ニュースの性質が強い。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリア・シャーガス病の新規発生やアウトブレイクを報告するものではなく、コロンビアの医薬品製造施設による既知疾患の治療薬生産開始に関する政策・産業ニュースである。発生地域にはカナダ・コロンビアが含まれるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれず、実際のイベント発生国はコロンビアである。対象国中ではブラジルのみが記事内の参考背景情報として言及されているため verified_locations に含める。感染症危機管理シグナルとしての要件を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola a la República Democràtica del Congo: opcions d'expansió i riscos en ser una zona en guerra - 3CatInfo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: Expansion options and risks of being a war zone - 3CatInfo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 88 confirmed deaths and 336 suspected cases as of May 19, 2026, amid a war zone conflict with M23 rebels. The outbreak was declared by Africa CDC on May 15 with 65 deaths and 246 suspected cases in Ituri province's Mongwalu and Rwapara health zones; laboratory analyses of 20 samples confirmed Ebola in 13. The virus has been circulating since late April. Transmissions remain concentrated in Mongwalu and Rwapara near Uganda and South Sudan. Uganda reports two confirmed cases in Kampala, including one death; Western Equatoria in South Sudan reports another case. The situation is framed as a health emergency in a war zone with potential for further spread across regional borders.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ：拡大の選択肢と紛争地域であるリスク
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は高い公衆衛生影響（88人の確認死亡、336人の疑い患者）、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ・南スーダンでの確認患者）があり、渡航・貿易制限の対象となる可能性がある。
triage.notes: エボラ発生はイツリ州のモングワル・ルワパラヘルスゾーン中心だが、既にウガンダ（カンパラで2例確認、1死亡）および南スーダン（西エクアトリア地域で1例）への越境拡大が確認されている。紛争地域（M23反政府勢力）での発生であり、疫学的統制および患者追跡が困難な環境。高いリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: อีโบลา ระบาดหนักในคองโก คร่าแล้ว 100 ชีวิต ติดเชื้อพุ่งเฉียด 400 เฝ้าระวังประเทศใกล้เคียง
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak hits Congo hard, 100 dead; infections near 400 as neighboring countries on alert.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 May 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has killed at least 100 people and sickened more than 390, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. No approved treatments or vaccines exist; public health measures, including safe funeral practices, are urged. In Uganda, the CDC reports two laboratory-confirmed cases and one death. The WHO has declared the Bundibugyo outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though not a pandemic, with the outbreak centered in Ituri province, eastern DRC, posing high local and regional spread risk. An American physician diagnosed in the DRC will be treated in Germany; reports indicate about six Americans may have been exposed, with the CDC aiding safe evacuation, but exact figures remain unclear. The U.S. has Level 4 travel restrictions for DRC and is limiting entry for travelers who have been in DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan within 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴで猛烈に流行、100人が死亡；感染者が400人近くに迫る中、隣国は警戒態勢に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、予想外の大規模流行、複数国への国際的拡大、各国の渡航制限発動）。エボラウイルス病は高リスク病原体であり、既に米国・ドイツでも症例報告され、WHOが国際的懸念の公衆衛生事象（PHEIC）を宣言している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（イトゥリ州）が主要な発生地域として述べられており、ウガンダで2人の確定例と1人の死亡が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。エボラウイルス病の国際的懸念の公衆衛生事象（PHEIC）宣言、複数国への拡大、及び各国による旅行制限は、PHEIC対応の必須基準を全て満たしている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolos virusu užsikrėtęs JAV pilietis bus gydomas Vokietijoje
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A U.S. citizen infected with the Ebola virus will be treated in Germany.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease case in the United States will be treated in Germany. A U.S. citizen who worked in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) tested positive Sunday evening. To minimize travel time and leverage Germany’s experience in treating Ebola, the patient and six high-risk contacts are being moved to Germany for care; their nationalities were not disclosed, and the exact German facility remains unnamed. US media identify the patient as a physician; an International Christian Mission Organization said a U.S. healthcare worker contracted Ebola while treating patients in a hospital in the DRC. The World Health Organization has declared an international public health emergency for Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda. The outbreak is caused by a rare strain with no vaccine, heightening regional spread risk; Africa CDC says it likely began in the third week of April, with reports emerging in early May.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスに感染した米国市民がドイツで治療される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラは深刻な公衆衛生影響を持ち、国際的に拡大するリスクが高く、WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラ患者はDRCで感染し米国から検出された事例。DRCはWPRO対象国リストに含まれ、DRCおよび隣接のウガンダでWHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している。ワクチン未開発の稀な株による流行であり、フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Venezuela identifica un nuevo mosquito capaz de transmitir malaria en una zona minera
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Venezuela identifies a new mosquito capable of transmitting malaria in a mining area.
article.articleSummary: New malaria vector identified in Venezuela: Nyssorhynchus rondoniensis detected in Sifontes, Bolívar state, in informal mining settlements El Granzón, Tierra Blanca, and San Rafael, with additional rural settlements Puerto Beco, Pelota, Payapal, and Morrocoy. Venezuelan researchers confirmed Ny. rondoniensis as a local mosquito capable of transmitting Plasmodium falciparum—the parasite that causes the most severe malaria—marking a shift from the previous primary vector, Anopheles darlingi. The finding builds on samples from 2017, 2022, and 2023 sent to the Wadsworth Center in the United States; results were published in Acta Tropica. Ny. rondoniensis previously was recorded only in western Brazil (Acre and Rondônia) in 2022. The species now shows possible colonization: breeding in mining pits and water deposits, drought tolerance, peridomestic activity, and nighttime biting. Malaria remains a health concern in Sifontes, with repeated infections in a local child and mother, reflecting mobility linked to mining.

triage.headline_ja: ベネズエラがマラリア伝播能を持つ新しい蚊を特定、鉱業地域で確認
triage.triage_reason: 新規媒介蚊種(Nyssorhynchus rondoniensis)のマラリア伝播能力確認は異常・予想外の発見であり、流行しやすさ基準を満たす。鉱業地域での定着の可能性と国際的な拡大リスク(既にブラジルで記録)が存在し、地域的な公衆衛生上の重要な懸念である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはベネズエラでのNyssorhynchus rondoniensis検出を主題としており、既にブラジル(アクレ州、ロンドニア州)での記録を参照しているが、現在のイベントはベネズエラが主体。対象国リストではブラジル(3469034)が該当するが、サマリー上の主要な発生地はベネズエラであるため、verified_locationsはベネズエラのみ。ただしブラジルも歴史的発生地として認識される。新規媒介蚊種の確認と定着可能性、Plasmodium falciparumの伝播リスク増加により、公衆衛生上重大。

article.articleHeadline: GIS wydał komunikat o Eboli. "Trwa dochodzenie epidemiologiczne"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: GIS issued a statement about Ebola. "An epidemiological investigation is underway."
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD), a form of Ebola, is confirmed in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. WHO/GIS say the outbreak carries high national and regional, but low global, public health risk. By May 15, 2026, 77 suspected cases and 67 deaths were reported across DR Congo’s Mongbwalu, Rwampara, and Bunia Health Zones; 65 contacts identified, 15 high-risk; tracing hampered by security and movement limits. Most suspected cases are aged 20–39, with women over 60%. Twenty samples from Rwampara were negative; PCR/genome sequencing confirmed Bundibugyo virus. Uganda reported a lab-confirmed BVD in an older DR Congo resident seeking care in Uganda, plus a second imported case from a DR Congo traveler; no evidence of local transmission in Uganda yet. Incubation 2–21 days; symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle pains, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, organ failure, and bleeding. No licensed vaccine or specific treatment; ongoing R&D. Previous BVD outbreaks in Uganda/DRC had 30–50% mortality; last in Aug 2021 Orientale Province, DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: GIS がエボラ出血熱に関する声明を発表。「疫学的調査が進行中」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。Bundibugyo virus disease（エボラの一種）がDRCとウガンダで確認され、死亡率が高く（67死亡）、地域的拡大リスク、国際的影響が明確である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC とウガンダでの確認が明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。77疑い例、67死亡、接触者追跡の困難さ（セキュリティと移動制限）、過去の BVD 流行での 30-50% 死亡率を考慮すると高リスク。WHO/GIS による「高い国家・地域的公衆衛生リスク」評価も記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ancaman Pandemi Meningkat, WHO Sebut Situasi Global Masih Rentan dan Belum Siap
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Pandemic Threat Is Increasing, WHO Says the Global Situation Is Still Vulnerable and Unprepared.
article.articleSummary: Global health systems are increasingly slow to respond to rising outbreak threats, as warned by the Global Preparedness Monitoring Board (GPMB) in its latest report. The assessment highlights growing pandemic risk from climate crisis, conflict, and unequal access to health services, warning that preparedness investment is lagging. Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda have already resulted in at least 87 deaths, prompting WHO to declare a public health emergency of international concern. Separately, hantavirus aboard a cruise ship raises concerns about novel pathogens with rapid spread. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus notes these events reflect a broader crisis. On the ground, PPE stockouts have occurred in Kinshasa amid Ebola response. The report emphasizes global geopolitical fragmentation eroding health solidarity and international cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: パンデミック脅威が増加、WHOは世界情勢が依然として脆弱で準備不足と述べる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Ebola outbreaksがDRCとウガンダで87人の死亡者を出し、WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している。また、国際展開リスクと国際的な懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事ではDRCとウガンダでのEbola発生を言及しているが、ウガンダ（1269750でなく226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCのみ検証済み位置として列挙。Hantavirus on cruise shipについては特定の国の発生ではなく、国際的な船舶での事例のため地域検証の対象外。Kinshasa（DRC内）でのPPE不足も含まれている。

article.articleHeadline: Хвороба, від якої немає зареєстрованої вакцини, вбила понад 100 людей
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A disease for which there is no registered vaccine has killed more than 100 people.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri and North Kivu) has caused over 118 deaths and about 300 suspected cases as of May 19, 2026. The rare Ebola strain has no approved vaccines or therapeutics. Uganda has confirmed one death. The outbreak began in Ituri in late April; early testing focused on the Zaïre strain, delaying response. A U.S. physician, Peter Stafford, contracted the virus at Bunia Hospital and, with six others, will be evacuated to Germany for monitoring; his wife worked there. WHO is deploying experts and plans three Ebola treatment centers in Ituri; Rwanda closed its land border with Congo. The United States has imposed a 30-day entry ban on foreign nationals who visited Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan recently. Historical Bundibugyo outbreaks occurred in Uganda (2007–2008; 149 cases, 37 deaths) and Congo (2012; 57 cases, 29 deaths). Symptoms include fever, muscle pain, diarrhea, vomiting, internal bleeding; transmission via bodily fluids. Ituri hosts over 273,000 internally displaced people amid regional conflict; Bunia is over 1,000 km from Kinshasa, with poor roads.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチンが登録されていない病気が100人以上を殺害
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（稀なエボラ株）の大規模発生で118死亡、300疑い例、承認ワクチン/治療薬なし、国際的に感染者確認、渡航制限措置実施。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（稀なエボラ株）の発生。承認ワクチン・治療薬がなく、118死亡、300疑い例。ウガンダで1死亡確認、米国医師がドイツへ搬送予定。WHO介入、ルワンダが陸路国境閉鎖、米国が30日間の渡航禁止措置を実施。イトゥリ地域は27万3,000人以上の国内避難民を収容しており、対応が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: خبراء: الفيروسات مثل هانتا وإيبولا أصبحت أكثر شيوعا وفتكا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts: viruses such as Hantavirus and Ebola have become more prevalent and more deadly.
article.articleSummary: Global Preparedness Monitoring Board warns that infectious disease outbreaks are not only more frequent but deadlier, with climate crisis and armed conflicts driving spread. The latest assessment cites Ebola and Hantavirus as emblematic of rising threats, as authorities grapple with Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo that have caused at least 87 deaths. A Hantavirus outbreak has been reported aboard a cruise ship, highlighting travel exposures that complicate containment. WHO has exhausted PPE stocks in Kinshasa and plans an airlift of supplies from Kenya as it prepares an urgent science meeting in Geneva to consolidate knowledge on vaccines, diagnostics, and antivirals. Experts note that early tests may have targeted a wrong Ebola strain, enabling the virus to spread before alarms sounded. The report warns that funding cuts impede rapid response and that outbreaks erode trust in governments and civil liberties, while calls for equitable access to countermeasures intensify.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家：ハンタウイルスとエボラなどのウイルスはより一般的になり、より致命的になっている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の複数アウトブレイク、死亡87例以上、WHOの緊急対応、国際会議開催など、明確なシグナル特性を示している。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラアウトブレイク（死亡87例以上）を主題としており、対象国リスト内で検証可能。クルーズ船でのハンタウイルス報告は国を特定せず。ジュネーブでの会議はWHOの対応拠点だがイベント発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。記事配信日2026年5月19日（将来日時）だが、内容の重要性に影響なし。

article.articleHeadline: US responds to Ebola outbreak in Africa - ExBulletin
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the United States coordinates a response to the Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda. An interagency coordination cell and incident management system were set up in Washington, DC on May 15, with the DRC, Rwanda, South Sudan, and Uganda embassies joining to monitor developments and advise citizens. A Title 42 order restricting entry of foreign nationals who visited the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan within 21 days went into effect May 18; DHS will implement quarantine guidance. Within 48 hours, $13 million was allocated for surveillance, labs, risk communication, safe burials, screening, and clinical management. The U.S. is mobilizing additional bilateral funding, leveraging $1.8 billion in OCHA pooled funds (including $250 million for DRC/Uganda) and coordinating with the UN, EU, and UK to contain the outbreak before it reaches U.S. shores.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がアフリカのエボラ流行に対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限措置の実施）。DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ流行に対する米国の即座かつ高レベルな対応が記述されており、シグナル特性が明確である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはエボラ流行の発生地としてDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン、ルワンダを言及しているが、対象国リスト上ではDRCのみが該当する。米国のTitle 42命令（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン訪問者の入国制限）および$13百万の緊急資金配分など、公式な対応措置が実施されている。南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: נגיף ללא חיסון משתולל באפריקה - ארה"ב כבר נקטה בצעד קיצוני
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A vaccine-free virus runs rampant in Africa — the U.S. has already taken a drastic step.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization declares a Public Health Emergency of International Concern as the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola drives an outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province and spilling into Uganda. In Ituri, 395 suspected cases and 106 deaths have been reported; two laboratory-confirmed cases have been identified in Kampala, Uganda, with one death. An American physician, Peter Stafford, contracted Ebola in Bunia, DRC; his wife Dr. Rebecca Stafford and others are under monitoring, with seven people evacuated to Germany for isolation. The United States has activated Section 42 to restrict entry of foreigners for 30 days—the second use in the modern era. Bundibugyo Ebola has no approved vaccine or targeted therapy; symptoms include high fever, muscle pains, rash, and bleeding, with mortality estimates of 25–40%. The outbreak is worsened by ongoing conflict and surveillance gaps; this is Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976. The U.S. Embassy in Kampala has suspended visa services.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチンなしのウイルスがアフリカで猛威を振るう — アメリカはすでに極端な措置を講じている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限措置実施）。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言し、複数国への人的移動と米国による極端な入国制限が確認されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebolam株による大規模アウトブレイク。DRC Ituri州が主要な発生地で、ウガンダへの人的越境確認。米国が Section 42 を発動し30日間の外国人入国制限を実施（現代では2例目）。ワクチンや標的治療法なし、致命率25-40%。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。ウガンダの記事参照場所はあるが、実際の確認症例・死亡はDRCとウガンダ（対象国外）に限定されているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Focarul de Ebola din Congo creşte bilanţul deceselor asociate cu acest virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo raises the death toll associated with this virus.
article.articleSummary: 118 people have died in the Democratic Republic of Congo as Ebola cases surge across a broader region, with nearly 400 suspected infections reported. An American contracted the virus in Congo, prompting the United States to heighten airport health screenings and to coordinate possible repatriation to Germany for treatment. Washington also suspended temporarily visas for foreigners who have traveled to affected areas. The CDC says current population-level risk remains low but public health measures will be adjusted as needed. The World Health Organization has declared the Congo Ebola outbreak a global health emergency. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus notes ongoing difficulties among member states to reach consensus on a rapid information-sharing annex, complicating shared access to vaccines, diagnostics, and therapies. A 2024 global study cited by Reuters estimates the Congo strain kills about 30-40% of those infected, lower than the Zaire strain’s ~90% mortality.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ熱の流行がこのウイルスに関連する死亡者数を増加させている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的流行で複数国への拡大が確認され、死亡者数増加、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、渡航制限措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行。死亡者118名、疑い患者約400名。米国人感染者の報告あり。WHO総会議論での情報共有annexの課題指摘。対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当。対象国外の米国・ドイツは二次的影響のため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: อีโบลาระบาดถึงไทยไหม? หมอยงตอบชัด เหมือนหรือต่างจากโควิด เตือนอย่าวิตก
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Has the Ebola outbreak reached Thailand? Dr Yong Poovorawan gives a clear answer: Is it the same as or different from COVID-19? He urges not to panic.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak unlikely to reach Thailand, says Dr. Yong Poovorawan. Current transmission is in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with over 250 reported cases and more than 80 deaths, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus (moderate to high severity). The virus is a highly lethal member of the Filoviridae family; past outbreaks (2013–2016) in West Africa (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) with the Zaïre (Zaire) ebolavirus caused ~30,000 cases and ~11,000 deaths, prompting vaccine development for that strain. There is no vaccine yet for Bundibugyo. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected people or contaminated corpses, with funeral practices contributing to spread. Symptoms include abrupt fever, fatigue, headache, muscle pain, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, and bleeding, and the disease can kill quickly. Thailand remains distant; no need for panic, but awareness and WHO-led prevention are essential.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがタイに流行していないか？ヨン医師が明確に答える：COVIDと同じか異なるか？パニックに陥らないよう警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）がDRC・ウガンダで250例以上・死亡80例以上という重大な集団発生を示しており、IHR基準（公衆衛生への深刻な影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク）および WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度・長期曝露・流行容易性）の複数に該当。タイを含む多地域での懸念報道も社会的関心を示唆する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから実際の発生はDRCおよびウガンダであることが明記されており、タイは流行懸念地域として言及されているが現在の実発生地ではない。しかし、タイが記事の主題国（パニック回避メッセージの対象国）として prominent に扱われており、対象国リストに該当するため verified_locations に含める。過去の西アフリカアウトブレイク（2013-2016）での膨大な死亡数の歴史的背景と、現在の Bundibugyo 株の無ワクチン状態が深刻性を増している。

article.articleHeadline: ഹന്താ വൈറസും എബോളയും അതിവേഗം പടരുന്നു; രോഗവ്യാപനം കൂടുതൽ മാരകമാകുമെന്ന് ലോകാരോഗ്യ സംഘടനയുടെ മുന്നറിയിപ്പ് | Infectious diseases such as hantavirus and Ebola becoming more frequent | Madhyamam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus and Ebola spreading rapidly; WHO warns that the spread will be more deadly.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, global health authorities warn that capacity to curb outbreaks is waning as Ebola spreads rapidly in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with 87 Ebola deaths in Congo triggering an international health emergency. The Global Preparedness Monitoring Board notes climate change and internal conflict fueling outbreaks and cites funding cuts to the WHO and suspension of prevention programs that have eroded surveillance. Early confusion over the Ebola strain led to weeks of negative results before confirmation, allowing cross-border movement along major routes. In Congo’s Kinshasa, stocks of protective gear have run out, while efforts to bring supplies from Kenya continue. Hantavirus outbreak aboard the cruise ship MV Hondius raises global risk. Although mRNA vaccines are advancing, delays in delivery to poorer nations persist; mpox vaccination in Africa took up to two years. Developed countries' hesitation on defense pacts risks future disasters.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスとエボラが急速に拡散。ハンタウイルスとエボラなどの感染症がより頻繁に発生。世界保健機関が、感染拡大がより致命的になると警告。
triage.triage_reason: エボラとハンタウイルスの同時多発アウトブレイクの国際的拡大、87人の死亡、国際保健緊急事態の宣言があり、IHR基準を複数満たす。管理能力の低下（防護具の枯渇、資金削減）と社会的関心の高さから、フルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではエボラの主要な発生地がDRCのキンシャサとウガンダの国境地域と明記されているが、ウガンダ（対象国外）とケニア（対象国外）は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙。ハンタウイルスは巡洋船MV Hondiusでの発生も言及されているが、具体的な発生国が特定できないため除外。IHR基準4/4、WPRO基準5/5すべて該当する重大シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Directorul Organizației Mondiale a Sănătății (OMS), avertisment șocant pentru populație! Noua alertă globală, febra hemoragică fără tratament!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General issues a shocking warning to the public! New global alert: hemorrhagic fever with no treatment.
article.articleSummary: On May 18, 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned of dangerous global health times and declared an International Public Health Emergency over an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The latest reports indicate at least 90 deaths associated with the outbreak. The strain driving the current hemorrhagic fever is described as extremely contagious and, at the moment, there is no vaccine or specific treatment available. The WHO has designated the Congo–Uganda Ebola outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The warning underscores ongoing Ebola outbreaks in Africa, noting that the strain responsible has killed over 15,000 people on the continent in the last five decades. The report provides no further laboratory confirmation details or identified infection sources, nor information on imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長が国民に衝撃的な警告を発出！新たなグローバルアラート：治療法のない出血熱
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4項目すべてで満たし、エボラ出血熱のPHEIC宣言によるシグナル。DRCおよびウガンダでの国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態であり、フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（民主コンゴ）とウガンダでのエボラ発生が記述されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象外のため verified_locations から除外。WHO PHEIC宣言は最高レベルのシグナルであり、直ちにRRA実施が必要。ワクチン・治療法未確立という記述から管理困難性が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: ΗΠΑ: Κινητοποίηση για περιορισμό έξαρσης Εμπολα στην Αφρική
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S.: Mobilization to Contain the Ebola Outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: U.S. State Department mobilizes a comprehensive Ebola response to outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. By May 15, 2026, within 24 hours of confirmed cases, it established a joint response hub and incident management system; embassies in DRC, Rwanda, South Sudan, and Uganda set surveillance teams to monitor developments and notify U.S. citizens. In coordination with the CDC, a May 18 Title 42 travel order bars entry for nationals who visited the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the last 21 days, with DHS enforcing and CDC quarantine guidance.
