Within 48 hours, it activated its plan and deployed $13 million to strengthen surveillance, laboratories, risk communication, safe burials, screening, and clinical management. Earlier, the U.S. announced a $1.8 billion increase to OCHA Common Funds, including $250 million for DRC and Uganda. Additional bilateral funding and humanitarian aid are being arranged with UN agencies, EU and UK.

triage.headline_ja: 米国：アフリカのエボラ感染症拡大の抑制に向けた動員
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは高い致死率を持つ第一種感染症で、DRCおよびウガンダでの確定患者発生は公衆衛生上深刻な影響を有する。米国を含む多国間の対応体制の構築と旅行制限措置の実施から、IHR基準の複数項目に該当し、国際的な感染拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはDRC、ウガンダ、ルワンダ、スーダンが含まれているが、記事サマリーで主な発生地として明記されているのはDRCとウガンダである。DRCは対象国リストに該当するため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。米国は対象国リストに含まれていない。エボラは高致死率病原体であり、多国間協調による大規模対応体制の構築、旅行制限措置、$13百万の緊急資金配分が実施されており、強いシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: US releases $13m emergency aid over Ebola outbreak in Africa
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-19, the United States activated a comprehensive emergency response to the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, mobilising $13 million in foreign assistance within 48 hours. The Department of State says the plan leverages prior investments and existing humanitarian channels coordinated through the United Nations to enable rapid deployment of additional aid. The objective is to strengthen outbreak response coordination and provide humanitarian support in the affected countries. The announcement, issued via the U.S. Senior Advisor for Arab and African Affairs, underscores American leadership in addressing global health threats. No casualty or laboratory-confirmation details are provided in the statement, but the funding and coordination efforts reflect an immediate, cooperative approach to containing the Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がアフリカのエボラ出血熱流行に対して1300万ドルの緊急援助を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は高い致死率を持つ感染症であり、DRCとウガンダでの流行は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、国際支援の必要性が明らかである。IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、貿易制限リスク）。
triage.notes: 発生地域としてUgandaも記事に明記されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。米国からの緊急援助動員と UN 経由の調整体制が確立されており、国際的な即応体制が機能している。具体的な患者数や死亡数の記載がないが、エボラ出血熱の特性とコロナ後の国際支援体制の発動により高い優先度判定。

article.articleHeadline: Press Statement By the AU Commission Chairperson On the Ebola Outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease outbreaks declared in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda pose a growing regional spread risk. The African Union Commission Chairperson Mahmoud Ali Youssouf commends the governments of DRC and Uganda and frontline health authorities for swift responses under difficult conditions, and notes preparedness measures by neighboring countries, notably South Sudan. The AU fully supports leadership of its Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention in coordinating a continental response in close collaboration with Member States, the World Health Organization, humanitarian partners, donors, and relevant stakeholders. The Chairperson emphasizes protecting African lives and continental health security as the highest priority and calls on Member States and partners to intensify support for preparedness, surveillance, and rapid response in affected and at-risk countries. The AU remains committed to safeguarding Africa's public health security and strengthening preparedness and response architecture.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ連合委員会議長声明：コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラアウトブレイクについて
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は極めて高い致死率を持つ感染症であり、DRCとウガンダでの同時アウトブレイク宣言は国際的な公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威を構成する。IHR基準（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイクを述べているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダは対象外のため除外。Bundibugyo Ebola Virus（BDBV）は高い致死率を持つ亜種。AU（アフリカ連合）による高レベルの政治的支援表明と地域的拡大への警告が含まれている。南スーダンの準備措置言及により、周辺国への影響懸念が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Nigerian Scientists Urge Emergency Checks Over Ebola Risk * Okay News
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk prompts Nigeria's public health advisory issued May 18, 2026, urging immediate emergency preparedness to prevent transmission from the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. The Academy of Medical Sciences, Nigeria directs the Federal Ministry of Health, port health services, and domestic hospitals to adopt high alert status across health institutions. Signed by Prof. Obinna Onwujekwe and Emeritus Prof. Osato Giwa-Osagie, the document calls for rapid traveler screening with dedicated lanes, digital surveillance, temperature checks, exposure history assessments, and emergency isolation units at entry points. It notes recent Ebola outbreaks in DRC and Uganda pose cross-border transmission risk due to mobility and trade, and asks the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and state governments to reactivate emergency structures and isolation centers. It also urges Ebola-ready treatment zones, strict infection prevention, enhanced monitoring at airports, seaports, land borders, and adequate PPE/training for frontline staff.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアの科学者がエボラ出血熱のリスクに関する緊急チェックを要求
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱はCategory Aウイルス性出血熱であり、DRC・ウガンダでの流行がナイジェリアへの越境感染リスクを構成する緊急公衆衛生事象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでの最近のエボラ流行がナイジェリアへの越境感染リスクをもたらしていることを述べている。ただし、対象国リストではDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダ（1327865）は含まれていない。発生地域にはナイジェリアも列挙されているが、記事サマリーでは「リスク警告」が主眼であり、現在進行形の感染流行がナイジェリアで確認されたわけではない点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: क्या भारत में भी बढ़ रहा है इबोला वायरस? जानिए कैसे फैलता है Ebola Virus, कितना है खतरनाक
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is the Ebola virus spreading in India as well? Learn how the Ebola virus spreads and how dangerous it is.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the article notes no Ebola virus cases have been reported in India, with the threat considered minimal. Ebola virus disease is described as a severe, often fatal illness with internal and external bleeding. Natural hosts include fruit bats of the Pteropodidae family; other affected animals cited are chimpanzees, gorillas, monkeys, forest antelope, and porcupines. Transmission to humans occurs through contact with infected animal fluids (feces, blood, organs, and other body fluids). Human-to-human spread happens via close contact with fluids of an infected person, including blood, and can occur after death. The article covers symptoms and transmission, and emphasizes prevention and seeking medical advice. The content is informational and does not report an outbreak in India.

triage.headline_ja: インドでもエボラウイルスが増加しているのか？エボラウイルスがどのように拡散するのか、どの程度危険なのかを学ぶ
triage.triage_reason: インドでエボラウイルス症例は報告されておらず、脅威は最小限と明記されている。記事は一般的な情報提供であり、実際の感染症イベントではない。
triage.notes: 記事は教育的・情報提供的な内容であり、インドでの実際の感染症イベントは報告されていない。エボラウイルスの症状、感染経路、予防法について一般向けの説明記事である。

article.articleHeadline: 消息：一连串挑战失误导致刚果（金）疫情检测延误
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News: A series of missteps and challenges led to delays in epidemic testing in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Ituri Province, Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, began with a first known case who died on April 24 and was declared an outbreak on May 15. Two Congolese officials familiar with the response told Reuters that a cascade of missteps and testing delays allowed the virus to spread unnoticed into eastern government-opposition armed areas and even to Uganda's capital, Kampala. Funeral practices amplified transmission, and authorities only issued alerts later. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, but local laboratories tested for the wrong Ebola strain, and samples sent to Kinshasa were not properly stored or transported. WHO internal documents cited a four-week window between symptom onset and laboratory confirmation, indicating insufficient clinical vigilance. On May 17, WHO declared the Congo and regional outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース：一連の失敗と課題がコンゴ民主共和国の疫学検査の遅延につながった
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが2026年5月17日に国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。DRCおよび地域での深刻な影響、国際拡大（ウガンダのカンパラへの流入確認）、異常・予想外な発生、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが存在。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、主たる発生地はDRC（イトゥリ州ブニア）。ウガンダへの拡大も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DHR Congo はPHEIC宣言済みの活動中アウトブレイク。検査遅延による感染拡大、葬儀慣行による二次感染拡大、複数地域での感染報告など、重大な懸念事項が複合している。

article.articleHeadline: AfB Başkanı'ndan Ebola'ya ortak mücadele çağrısı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: AfB President Calls for a Joint Fight Against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province, eastern DRC) and Uganda prompted a joint appeal by African Union (AfC) Commission President Mahmud Ali Yusuf for unity, coordination, and collective action to protect Africa’s health security. Yusuf warned that the DRC and Uganda Ebola outbreaks heighten the risk of regional spread across the continent. He commended rapid responses by the affected governments, health authorities, and frontline workers, and welcomed neighboring countries’ preparedness, noting South Sudan’s measures as particularly important. The African Union reaffirmed solidarity with affected populations and governments, backing Africa CDC-led continental interventions in partnership with member states, the World Health Organization, humanitarian groups, and donors. He urged expanded preparedness, surveillance, and rapid-response resources. The Ituri outbreak in eastern DRC has caused 87 deaths; the WHO declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern after detection of an imported case.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ連合議長からエボラ出血熱に対する共同対策の呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の複数国での発生、死亡87例、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、国際的な拡大リスク、および地域的な連携要請がIHR基準3つ以上に該当。対象国DRCで確認されたシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（Ituri Province）でのエボラ出血熱発生が主題。ウガンダとスーダンも言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていない（DRCのみ対象国）。WHOによるPHEIC宣言により国際的な懸念が高い。87人の死亡が報告されており、重症度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: At least 120 dead in Ebola outbreak in DR Congo, official says
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo's eastern Ituri province, at least 120 deaths and hundreds of suspected Ebola cases have been reported amid an outbreak of the Bundibugyo strain, a rare form with no approved vaccine or specific treatments. First death recorded April 24 in Bunia; laboratory confirmation on May 14 and Bundibugyo strain identified May 15. The outbreak spans Bunia, Goma, Mongbwalu, Butembo and Nyakunde, with delayed detection after early tests searched for a different strain, yielding false negatives and slower response. No vaccine; experimental therapies may become available soon. Authorities plan three new treatment centres in Ituri; WHO is deploying experts. An American doctor is infected; seven Americans are being moved to Germany for monitoring. Ituri’s humanitarian crisis, with over 270,000 displaced, complicates response. This is the third Bundibugyo outbreak since its identification in Uganda in 2007.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで少なくとも120人が死亡、当局者が発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の株の出現、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。国際的な関心が高く、フルRRAへの進行が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株は稀で、承認されたワクチンや特異的治療法がない。アメリカ人医師の感染や国外への患者移送により国際的影響が増加。人道危機（27万人以上の避難民）により対応が複雑化。2007年のウガンダでの初出現以来3番目のアウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: 汉坦病毒埃博拉疫情双重爆发　世卫：全球新危机
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two simultaneous outbreaks of hantavirus and Ebola; WHO: a new global crisis.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, at the World Health Assembly in Geneva, two simultaneous outbreaks dominate the agenda: a new Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, and a hantavirus outbreak on the Dutch cruise Hondius off the Canary Islands. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus describes these as symptoms of a dangerous, fractured era, alongside ongoing crises from conflict, economic woes, climate change, and aid cuts. The assembly also confronts US withdrawal and about 21% budget reductions, with hundreds of jobs and programs cut. Spain facilitated evacuations from the Hondius, earning praise. Debates focus on reforming the Global Health Architecture and advancing a landmark pandemic treaty, including pathogen sharing and vaccine access, with negotiations possibly extending beyond 2025. The US owes about $260 million in WHO dues; Ghana’s President Mahama urged bold reforms to end an era and build the next.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスとエボラの二重爆発　WHO：新たな世界的危機
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4/4該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数の高リスク疾患（エボラ、ハンタウイルス）の同時発生であり、国際的な関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月19日のジュネーブでの世界保健総会を舞台としており、DRC内のエボラ発生（PHEIC指定）を主要なシグナルとして報告している。ハンタウイルス発生地（カナリア諸島沖オランダ船舶）は対象国外のため除外。DRCのエボラアウトブレイクが中心的な懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Bundibugyo, Strain Virus Ebola yang Memicu Wabah di Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bundibugyo, the Ebola virus strain that triggered an outbreak in Kongo.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain drives the outbreak in Kongo. By May 19, 2026, it has caused 118 deaths and 390 suspected cases. Ebola has three strains—Zaire, Sudan, and Bundibugyo; Bundibugyo is named after Bundibugyo Province in Uganda where it was first identified during the 2007–2008 outbreak, with a second outbreak in 2012 in Kongo. A 2024 global study estimates Bundibugyo’s case-fatality rate at 30–40%, lower than Zaire’s up to 90% mortality. Transmission occurs through close contact with bodily fluids of sick or deceased individuals (sweat, blood, feces, vomiting), with health workers and family caregivers at highest risk. Dr. Celine Gounder notes that while the CFR is lower, it remains alarming and experiences with Bundibugyo are limited.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョ：コンゴの流行を引き起こしたエボラウイルス株
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ株）による進行中の流行で、118人の死亡と390件の疑い例があり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは主にコンゴでのブンディブギョ株エボラの流行が主題。ウガンダは過去の株の発見地として言及されているが、現在の流行発生地はDRCであり、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。118人の死亡、390件の疑い例、CFR 30-40%という重篤度、ヒト-ヒト感染の高リスク、医療従事者と家族介護者の特に高いリスクが報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Kembali Muncul, Apa yang Harus Diwaspadai?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Is Re-emerging: What Should We Be Wary Of?
article.articleSummary: Ebola re-emerging: The World Health Organization designated Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province) and Uganda as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 17, 2026, amid hundreds of suspected cases and at least 80 deaths from Bundibugyo strain. In Ituri, eight confirmed cases, plus hundreds of suspected cases and dozens of deaths across Mongbwalu, Rwampara, and Bunia; two confirmed cases (one death) in Kampala, Uganda, linked to travel from Congo. WHO notes substantial uncertainty about total infections and spread. Africa CDC cites initial spillover in the mobile Mongbwalu mining region and spread as patients seek care. MSF warns of rising cases and cross-border risk; no vaccine or approved treatment for Bundibugyo. Transmission via direct contact with body fluids; incubation 2–21 days. Indonesia has strengthened surveillance; no cases detected. A Science Advances study identifies skin as a potential transmission route, with virus detectable on skin within three days.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱が再び出現：何に注意すべきか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱のPHEIC指定、複数国での確認、死亡者80名以上、国際的拡大リスク（国境を越えた事例確認、ワクチン・治療法なし）により、フルリスク評価が必須。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはインドネシア、ウガンダ、ルワンダが含まれるが、記事サマリーの主体はコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri Province）でのアウトブレイク。ウガンダでの確認は2例に限定（コンゴからの輸入事例）。インドネシアは症例なし、強化サーベイランスのみ。PHEIC指定（2026年5月17日）により、国際的関心と対応が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО прогласила ванредну ситуацију због еболе у Африци
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO has declared an emergency due to Ebola in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda prompted WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026. By May 19, 2026, the outbreak has caused over 100 deaths and about 395 suspected cases, centered in eastern DRC’s Ituri Province—specifically Mongwalu, Rwampara, and Bunia. Uganda has confirmed two cases, including one fatality, in travelers from DRC. There is no licensed vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; response hinges on early case detection, patient isolation, contact tracing, safe burials, and infection prevention in health facilities. The CDC notes one American exposed in DRC tested positive and is being transferred to Germany; the United States has enhanced surveillance and travel restrictions for those who recently visited DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan. The event underscores ongoing global preparedness gaps despite Ebola experience.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、アフリカにおけるエボラの発生を受け緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak with 100+ deaths、395疑似患者、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の新規株の出現、複数国への国際的拡大（DRC、Uganda、輸出症例がGermanyとUSAに検出）、WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言、渡航・貿易制限措置が実施中。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ボンディブギョエボラウイルス）による大規模流行。発生地域にはRwanda、Uganda、Sudanが列挙されているが、記事サマリーの主眼は東DRC（Ituri Province）での流行であり、Ugandaでは2症例（確定例1例）が確認された。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。WHOが公衆衛生上の国際的緊急事態（PHEIC）を2026年5月17日に宣言し、国際的な支援と対応が始まっている。

article.articleHeadline: 美加强旅行限制等措施防伊波拉病例输入|光华网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. tightens travel restrictions and other measures to prevent importation of Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the U.S. CDC announced intensified measures to prevent importation of Bundibugyo ebolavirus amid ongoing East and Central African Ebola outbreaks. Enhanced traveler screening and monitoring at U.S. ports of entry, and entry restrictions for non-U.S. passport holders who have traveled in the past 21 days to the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan, are in place for 30 days. The agency is coordinating with the Department of Homeland Security, airlines, and border officials to identify and manage travelers with potential exposure, while strengthening contact tracing, laboratory testing capacity, and hospital preparedness nationwide. CDC personnel continue to support outbreak areas. A U.S. healthcare worker who cared for patients in the Democratic Republic of Congo has tested positive for Bundibugyo ebolavirus and is being moved to Germany along with high-risk contacts. U.S. risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ病例の輸入防止のため渡航制限等の措置を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病の複数国での流行、米国への輸入事例、国際的な対応措置がとられている状況はフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはUganda、Sudan、Mozambique等も含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は東・中央アフリカでのエボラ流行に対する米国の防御措置であり、実際の流行が記事で詳細に述べられている国はDRCのみ。Uganda等は言及されているが感染事例の詳細報告はなく、confirmed locationではなく潜在的な感染地域として扱われている。DRCのみを verified_locations に含めた。

article.articleHeadline: 美加强机场筛查伊波拉 刚果（金）一美国人确诊 - 国际 - 即时国际
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. steps up airport screening for Ebola; an American diagnosed with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: U.S. tightens Ebola measures amid the DRC outbreak, expanding airport screening and temporarily suspending visa services for travelers from affected regions. CDC bans entry for non-citizens who have been in DRC, South Sudan, or Uganda in the past 21 days for 30 days, citing enhanced screening and travel controls. An American diagnosed with Ebola after exposure in the DRC, treated at Nyankunde Hospital; two other doctors, including his wife, are asymptomatic. WHO declares the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and is arranging transfer of the patient to Germany. U.S. plans to evacuate six more people for health monitoring; embassy staff in Congo about 25. In eastern DRC's Ituri province, 116 suspected deaths and 435 suspected cases are under investigation; most patients are aged 20–39, with over 60% female. No Ebola vaccine or specific therapy is available.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ熱のスクリーニング強化；コンゴ民主共和国で診断されたアメリカ人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の事態、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。また、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言し、複数国での対応が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRC（特にIturi州）でのエボラ熱アウトブレイクおよび米国の対応。US、Sudan、Uganda、Germanyは記事内で言及されているが、実際の発生地は対象国リストのDRCのみ。WHO PHEIC宣言、患者の国際転送、複数国での渡航制限実施により、国際的な緊急事態として扱われている。

article.articleHeadline: De ce este noul focar de Ebola un coÈ™mar pentru medici: tulpina rarÄƒ fÄƒrÄƒ vaccin È™i tratament se rÄƒspÃ¢ndeÈ™te rapid
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why the new Ebola outbreak is a nightmare for doctors: the rare strain with no vaccine or treatment is spreading rapidly.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, a new Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain with no approved vaccine or targeted treatment, has prompted the WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Africa CDC reports at least 100 deaths and over 390 suspected cases. The outbreak centers in Ituri's Bunia and Mongwalu, with transmission confirmed in Goma, the region's largest city under rebel AFC-M23 control. First confirmed case was a healthcare worker in Bunia who began symptoms on April 24; funeral rituals and handling of the deceased have accelerated spread. Symptoms start with fever, myalgia, fatigue, headache; later vomiting, diarrhea, rash, hemorrhage. Early tests often negative because of strain differences; no Bundibugyo-specific vaccine or treatments exist; vaccines for the Zaire strain may offer partial protection. Uganda and Rwanda have heightened border controls; Uganda reports cases in Kampala. WHO notes pandemic risk is unlikely.

triage.headline_ja: 新しいエボラ出血熱の流行が医師にとって悪夢である理由：ワクチンも治療法もない稀な株が急速に蔓延している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言、複数国への拡大確認、渡航制限措置あり）。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の新興流行で、ワクチン・治療法がなく、既に100人以上の死亡と390以上の疑い例が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCが主要な発生地として記載されており、ウガンダ（Kampala）にも症例確認とあるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。ルワンダは国境管理強化のみで発症者報告なし。Bundibugyo株のエボラ出血熱は非常に稀で、既存ワクチンが効果不十分である点が特に懸念される。WHOが既に国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言している。

article.articleHeadline: മലയാലപ്പുഴയിൽ തെരുവുനായ് ആക്രമണം; അഞ്ചുപേർക്ക് കടിയേറ്റു | Stray dog ​​attacks in Malayalapuzha; five people bitten | Madhyamam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Stray dog attack in Malayalapuzha; five people bitten
article.articleSummary: Five people, including two children, were bitten by a stray dog in Malayalappuzha, Pathanamthitta district, Kerala, on Sunday at around 4:30 pm. The victims are Deepu (44) and his mother Shanthamm (72); Krishna Jith (9); Shanthamm (67) of Plavara; and Dhruv Ranjith (5). Krishna Jith is being treated at Kottayam Medical College Hospital for severe facial and body injuries. Rabies is suspected, with confirmation awaiting laboratory results. The incident adds to a rising pattern of stray dog attacks in the district, with dogs seen as a threat to public safety, preventing people from going out. Three days earlier, in Omalloor, a child and others were bitten by stray puppies. Authorities have not yet announced any measures to curb the stray dog menace.

triage.headline_ja: マラヤーラプッザでの野犬攻撃；5人が咬まれた
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の疑い例として個別の感染症イベントだが、現時点では確認された症例ではなく、地域的な野犬問題に関連している。情報不足（検査結果待ち）により、フル評価前の経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはケーララ州パタナンティッタ地区の野犬攻撃事件を報じており、狂犬病が疑われているが検査結果はまだ保留中。複数の人員（5名）が咬傷を受け、少なくとも1名は重症（顔と体の重度損傷）。地区での野犬問題の継続的なパターンが報告されている。ただし確認された狂犬病症例ではなく、予防接種の実施状況や公衆衛生当局の対応についての情報が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola alarmı: Ölümcül salgın hakkında neler biliniyor?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert: What is known about the deadly outbreak?
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri province near Uganda and South Sudan borders. As of early May, 91 suspected deaths and about 350 suspected cases have been reported. Most affected are aged 20–39, with more than 60% of cases in women. Limited laboratory capacity means numbers rely on suspected cases. Mongbwalu health district is the outbreak’s center, roughly 90 km from Bunia, where the first case—a nurse presenting on 24 April—was recorded. Four health workers in Mongbwalu died within four days, triggering heightened alarm. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment; current Ebola vaccines target the Zaire strain. The outbreak has crossed into border areas beyond Ituri; Uganda reports a confirmed case and one death linked to two Congolese travelers. WHO declared an International Public Health Emergency at the second-highest level; Africa CDC warns of potential spread to East Africa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報：致命的な流行について何が知られているか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo Ebolavirus（新規ウイルス株）による大規模流行で、91死亡・350疑い例、国境越え拡大（ウガンダで確認例）、WHO最高警戒レベル宣言、ワクチン・治療法なし。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebolavirus株は現有ワクチン（Zaire株対応）では対応不可。DRCイトゥリ州が震源地だが、記事サマリーで「ウガンダで確認例・1死亡」と明示されている。ただしウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を最高警戒レベルで宣言済み。アフリカCDCによる東アフリカ地域への拡大警告もあり。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Watching climate patterns may help bolster dengue response - Society - The Jakarta Post
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Indonesia persists, with 30,465 cases and 79 deaths confirmed by mid-April 2026 across 401 of 514 regencies and cities. A March 17 study in PLOS Neglected Tropical Diseases proposes climate-based dengue forecasting to bolster public health responses, using precipitation and El Niño signals to map transmission and support early warning. Researchers analyzed province-level dengue surveillance data (2010–2024) alongside local climate variables to identify region-specific patterns. Lead author Bimandra Adiputra Djaafara cautions that treating Indonesia as a single entity for forecasting obscures regional dynamics. Findings show consistent outbreak timing across western Indonesia, with Sumatra often ahead of Java and Bali by several months. For example, North Sumatra peaks in October, while Jakarta, West Java, and Bali typically peak in April. Implications point to targeted, geography-aware surveillance and response strategies.

triage.headline_ja: 気候パターンの監視がデング熱対応の強化に役立つ可能性 - インドネシア
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生影響」（30,465例、79死亡）と「異常/予想外」に該当（2項目以上）。WPRO基準でも「重症度」「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」に該当し、国家レベルの対応戦略が進行中である。
triage.notes: 2026年4月中旬までに30,465例、79死亡が確認されており、インドネシア全土514地域のうち401地域が影響を受けている。記事はPLOS学誌の研究に基づき、気候予測による早期警戒システムの導入可能性を論じており、国家レベルの公衆衛生対応策の強化が進行中。Bluedot APIが抽出したSumatra（米国フロリダ州）は地理的誤認であり、verified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: الولايات المتحدة تعزز إجراءاتها الصحية بعد إصابة أمريكي بفيروس إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States steps up its health measures after an American is infected with the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompts U.S. health measures. An American contracted Ebola in DRC; symptoms appeared over the weekend and a positive test was confirmed late Sunday, with plans to move the patient to Germany for treatment. WHO has declared a global health emergency. The CDC will intensify precautions: enhanced airport screening for travelers from affected areas, temporary visa-service suspensions for some countries, and entry restrictions on non-U.S. passport holders who traveled to Uganda, DRC, or South Sudan within the past 21 days. Six additional individuals are to be evacuated for health monitoring; about 25 U.S. embassy staff are in DRC, with a CDC technical coordinator to be dispatched. Direct risk to the United States is assessed as low, though measures could be adjusted with new information. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for the current strain; roughly 350 suspected cases have been reported, predominantly ages 20–39, with over 60% female.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ人がコンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスに感染した後、米国が衛生対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当：重篤な公衆衛生影響（WHO グローバル医療上の緊急事態宣言）、国際的拡大リスク（米国・ドイツへの患者移送、複数国での症例）、国際的な渡航・貿易制限措置の実施。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ発生事象。米国・ドイツ・ウガンダ・南スーダンが発生地域として記載されているが、サマリーから実際のエボラ感染地域はコンゴ民主共和国が中心であり、米国・ドイツは患者移送先、ウガンダ・南スーダンは渡航制限対象国。従って verified_locations は DRC のみを記載。WHO グローバル医療上の緊急事態宣言、国際的な渡航制限措置、約350人の疑い患者報告など、重大なシグナルとして識別される。

article.articleHeadline: В Роспотребнадзоре рассказали о распространении хантавируса Андес
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor reports on the spread of Andes hantavirus.
article.articleSummary: Rospotrebnadzor reports Andes hantavirus circulation in New World countries with a summer peak linked to rodent population surges. Infected rodents may comprise 10–14% in spring, rising to around 60% in summer, then falling to about 2% in autumn. Hantaviruses are transmitted to humans via contact with rodents; Andes virus can affect the lungs and heart, with the long-tailed rice hamster identified as its primary carrier. In Eurasia, hantaviruses causing hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome are carried by house mice and red-backed voles. A separate outbreak tied to the Dutch cruise ship MV Hondius, traveling from Argentina to Cape Verde, resulted in three deaths; the ship reached the Canary Islands on May 10 and passengers were evacuated. By May 12, WHO reported 11 hantavirus disease cases, nine of them confirmed as Andes virus infections.

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナッツォールがアンデスハンタウイルス感染拡大について報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目以上該当（重症度・死亡あり、国際的拡大、異常性）＆ WPRO基準複数該当（重症度・流行性・管理可能性）。海上での集団発生で3死亡、国際移動リスク高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にスペイン（カナリア諸島）、アルゼンチン、カーボベルデが含まれるが、対象国リストに未含有。タイのみ対象国。記事主題は複数国間の国際的ハンタウイルス集団発生（海上のクルーズ船MV Hondius関連）。WHO報告による11例確認（Andes virus 9例）、3死亡。管理可能性が高い理由は船舶隔離対応がすでに実施されている点（乗客避難済み）だが、国際的な二次感染リスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Circulated for Weeks Before WHO Declared Emergency
article.articleSummary: Ebola circulated in eastern Congo's Ituri province for weeks before detection, with the rare Bundibugyo strain hindering containment. By 2026-05-19, the Congo health ministry reports at least 105 suspected deaths in Ituri and hundreds of possible cases across the region, with infections now reaching Goma in eastern Congo and Kampala, Uganda. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak a global health emergency as numbers continued to climb. Five neighboring countries have tightened border checks, and Rwanda has closed its border with Congo. The outbreak's delayed recognition and the spread to cross-border hubs underscore ongoing international public health challenges in the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスがWHOが緊急事態を宣言する数週間前から流行していた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo strain）の多国間流行で、死亡者105名以上、疑い例多数、複数国への国際的拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、ルワンダ等）が確認され、WHOが緊急事態を宣言。国境措置実施による渡航制限も発生。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのイトゥリ州での発生を主題としており、ゴマ（DRC内）やカンパラ（ウガンダ）への拡大も記載されているが、公式な患者報告のある国はDRCが明確。ルワンダは国境閉鎖を実施したが患者報告なし。ウガンダはカンパラでの感染確認が記載されているため、厳密にはUgandaも対象となるべきだが、提供対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: تقرير دولي يحذر من تزايد خطر الأمراض المعدية حول العالم
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An international report warns of the rising risk of infectious diseases worldwide.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, a global outbreak preparedness report warns that infectious diseases such as hantavirus and Ebola are spreading more widely and becoming deadlier. The Global Outbreak Preparedness Council, cited by The Guardian, says outbreaks are rising in frequency and severity and that risks outpace investments in preparedness, leaving the world less safe. Climate change and armed conflicts amplify outbreak potential, while geopolitical divisions and narrow commercial interests hinder coordinated responses. The report coincides with a hantavirus outbreak aboard a cruise ship and with Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo, which have prompted a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and at least 87 deaths. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus calls these crises a reflection of global health turmoil. A WHO scientific meeting is planned to prioritize vaccines, diagnostics, and therapeutics; concerns persist about inequitable access and politicized science.

triage.headline_ja: 国際報告書が世界中の感染症リスク上昇に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱による87人以上の死亡とPHEIC宣言、及び国際的な感染症準備態勢の低下について述べられており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の流行が明示され、87人以上の死亡とPHEIC宣言が報告されている。ハンタウイルスについてはクルーズ船での感染とのみ記載されており、特定の対象国での発生は明記されていないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。国際的な感染症準備態勢の低下が強調されており、社会的・政治的関心は高い。

article.articleHeadline: أمريكا تطور علاجًا بالأجسام المضادة لسلالة بونديبوجيو لفيروس الإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States develops an antibody-based treatment for the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, a U.S. citizen infected with Ebola virus disease during a mission in the Democratic Republic of Congo is being transported to Germany for treatment, with six additional exposed individuals also relocated there. US risk of entry remains low despite 105 Congo-related deaths. Dr. Peter Stafford, one of three caregivers at Nyankondi hospital, is infected; the other caregivers are asymptomatic. CDC teams from Atlanta are deployed to the affected area and are developing an antibody-based treatment as a potential option for the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus. Health experts warn of rapid spread amid 393 suspected Congo cases. The report notes international response and potential exported/imported exposure to Germany as the Bundibugyo outbreak in DRC progresses.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラウイルスのブンディブギオ株に対する抗体ベースの治療法を開発
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染確認（米国市民がDRCで感染）、国際的な患者移送、複数国への曝露リスク、公衆衛生対応の進行中など、IHR基準及びWPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAtlanta/Georgia/United States/Germanyが含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題は『DRC でのエボラ発生と、感染者の国際移送』である。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。米国・ドイツは患者搬送先および支援国として言及されているが、発生地は DRC。Bundibugyo株の確認、393疑い例、105死亡例、複数の曝露者が報告され、リスク評価の段階がフル RRA に値する。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Alert: US Tightens Curbs After Citizen Tests Positive
article.articleSummary: American citizen tests positive for Bundibugyo Ebola in Africa; symptomatic and laboratory-confirmed case prompts a full interagency response. The infected individual and six high-risk contacts will be evacuated to Germany for treatment at a specialised viral haemorrhagic fever facility. Immediate entry restrictions are imposed on non-US citizens who have recently traveled to Uganda, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Congo, or South Sudan. US officials reiterate there are currently no Ebola cases in the United States. Bundibugyo Ebola is a form of Ebola virus that can cause fever, vomiting, diarrhoea, and internal bleeding, spreading through direct contact with infected bodily fluids. The patient’s precise location within Africa is undisclosed, but the case is linked to the outbreak zone. The White House and CDC are coordinating an interagency response to containment efforts in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報：米国民のエボラ陽性判定後、米国が規制を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo）の確定症例、国際的拡大リスク（アフリカから米国への移動、ドイツでの治療）、渡航制限措置の実施、深刻な公衆衛生影響が認識される。
triage.notes: 米国市民の感染事例が記事の主題であるが、実際の感染発生地はアフリカ内（記事では『正確な位置は未公開』）であり、具体的にはUganda、DRC、South Sudanのいずれかに関連している。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみのため verified_locations に追加。Sudan（対象リストに含まれず）も発生地域に指定されているが、記事サマリー上では明確な感染確認が述べられていないため除外。White HouseおよびCDCによる全政府的対応が実施中であり、国際的な関心も極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Количество жертв лихорадки Эбола в ДРК превысило 100
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola fever in the DRC exceeded 100.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has resulted in at least 118 deaths and 435 suspected cases, according to official spokesman Patrick Muyaïya. He urged the public to strictly follow preventive measures and stay calm. On May 17, the World Health Organization declared the outbreak in the DRC and neighboring Uganda a public health emergency of international concern. As of May 19, 2026, authorities are intensifying containment and surveillance in the affected regions, with continued emphasis on prevention amid cross-border risk and regional spread concerns. U.S. President Donald Trump expressed strong concern about Ebola in Africa, warning that the problem could extend beyond the continent.

triage.headline_ja: DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）のエボラ熱の死者数が100人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な流行、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダに既に波及、WHO PHEIC宣言）、および渡航・貿易制限リスクを有する。
triage.notes: ウガンダはWHOのPHEIC宣言に含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダでの確認症例や死者数の具体的報告がないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。米国の懸念表明は社会的・政治的関心の高さを示すが、米国内での発症報告はない。DRCでの急速な流行拡大（118死亡、435疑い例）は極めて深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola vs COVID-19: Key differences Indians need to know -- symptoms, spread, treatment and prevention explained | Mint
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) and COVID-19 are distinct viral illnesses with different transmission, symptoms, and management. Recent Ebola outbreaks in Central and East Africa highlight a high lethality, with severe complications such as internal bleeding, organ failure, dehydration, and multi‑organ damage; outbreaks stem from poor infection control and delayed isolation. Ebola spreads by direct contact with infected body fluids (blood, vomit, sweat, saliva, urine) or contaminated surfaces; COVID-19 spreads mainly via respiratory droplets and shows rapid spread in crowded settings, though generally less deadly. COVID‑19 can cause severe pneumonia, lung damage, blood clots, and heart problems, with long COVID symptoms like fatigue and brain fog. Three Ebola species drive large outbreaks: EBOV, SUDV, and BDBV. Prevention includes vaccination, personal hygiene, isolation, and symptom management; the article notes relevance to India within global public health concerns.

triage.headline_ja: エボラとCOVID-19：インド国民が知っておくべき主な違い――症状、感染経路、治療、予防について説明
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は両疾患の比較解説であり、インドでの新規感染症発生事象ではなく、教育的・啓発的コンテンツ。現在のアウトブレイク・シグナルに該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は疾患比較の啓発記事であり、インドでの新規エボラまたはCOVID-19の発生事例を報告していない。中央アフリカのエボラアウトブレイクへの言及は過去の文脈であり、現在進行中のシグナルとは判断されない。対象国のうち India が地理的に言及されているが、サマリーの主題は「一般的な公衆衛生知識」であり、特定の発生事象ではないため verified_locations は空配列とする。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola emergency declared in DRC as hantavirus fears ease in SA | The Citizen
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus fears ease in South Africa after MV Hondius cruise-ship outbreak linked to Argentina: 173 exposed, 8 confirmed cases, 3 deaths; no secondary transmission detected in SA, though one additional suspected case in the Western Cape is under investigation. A British patient admitted to a Sandton hospital is recovering; a Western Cape high-risk contact tested negative and discharged. In parallel, Ebola in Africa has been declared a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC) by WHO Director-General Tedros), caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. As of 16 May, Ituri province (Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbwalu) reports 8 laboratory-confirmed cases, 246 suspected cases, and 80 suspected deaths; two laboratory-confirmed cases (one death) in Kampala, Uganda, on 15–16 May, travelers from the DRC. Neighboring countries at high risk; an emergency committee will advise on temporary recommendations for the DRC and Uganda outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラ緊急事態宣言、南アでハンタウイルス懸念は緩和
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラはWHOがPHEIC宣言した国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態であり、DRC・ウガンダでの確定・疑い症例と死亡が報告され、国際的拡大リスク（隣国への高リスク）と渡航・貿易制限の可能性が高い。シグナルとしてフルRRAに進める。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラ PHEIC宣言が主題。ウガンダでの2確定症例（うち1死亡）も記載されているがウガンダは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。南アのハンタウイルス（MV Hondius船上発症、アルゼンチン関連）は二次感染未検出で侵襲性低い。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（Zaire型以外の稀な型）であることに注意。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Virus इबोला विषाणूला रोखण्यासाठी भारतात कडक उपाययोजना, विमानतळांवर विशेष लक्ष
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Strict measures in India to curb the Ebola virus, special attention at airports.
article.articleSummary: India tightens measures to curb Ebola; airports under special attention. With the WHO declaring the Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda a public health emergency of international concern, India is monitoring closely. There are currently no Ebola cases in India, and the risk is very low. The Ministry of Health, National Centre for Disease Control, ICMR and other agencies reviewed the situation and strengthened public health preparedness, including inspection, surveillance, isolation, and case-management SOPs. The National Institute of Virology in Pune was selected for Ebola testing, with other labs being prepared. Authorities urge calm and caution against unverified information. Ebola transmission occurs via contact with blood, sweat, saliva, feces, urine or vomit of an infected person, and via consumption of infected wildlife such as bats; it is not airborne or waterborne.

triage.headline_ja: インドでエボラウイルスを抑制するための厳格な措置、空港での特別な注視
triage.triage_reason: インドではエボラ症例がなく現在の直接的リスクは低いが、DRCとウガンダでのWHO認定の公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事象（PHEIC）に対応する予防的措置が講じられており、情報不足を理由に継続的な経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主軸はインドの予防的対応であり、実際のエボラ症例はインドにはない。DRCでのPHEIC宣言はWHOレベルで懸念があるが、インド国内でのシグナルではなく、隣接するウガンダのアウトブレイク対応。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に追加。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Virus | ইবোলা নিয়ে বিশ্বজুড়ে রেড অ্যালার্ট! ভারতের সীমান্ত ও বন্দরে স্ক্রিনিং জোরদার, প্রস্তুত রাখা হলো আইসোলেশন ওয়ার্ড
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Virus | Worldwide red alert about Ebola! Screening at India's borders and ports intensified; isolation wards have been prepared.
article.articleSummary: On May 19, 2026, the Ebola virus outbreak continues to spread across several Central African nations, with the WHO declaring it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ituri and North Kivu provinces have seen more than 300 infections and 118 deaths, including a case in Ituri’s Bunia involving an American physician. In Uganda, two deaths have been reported. Ebola is highly fatal but not airborne; transmission occurs through direct contact with blood, body fluids or exposed materials. To curb spread, India has intensified screening at all international airports, seaports, and land borders, with suspected cases immediately isolated. National laboratories have been directed to operate 24/7, and hospitals are on alert to begin isolation and treatment. There are no confirmed cases in India yet; authorities remain vigilant and coordinate with states.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス | エボラに関して世界中で赤色警報！インドの国境と港でのスクリーニングが強化され、隔離病棟が準備されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数対象国での確認（DRC、Uganda）及びインドでの国境スクリーニング強化による準備態勢の明白な証拠。WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の危機として公式宣言している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、エボラアウトブレイクはDRC（Ituri、North Kivu州で300以上の感染、118死亡）、ウガンダ（2死亡）で確認されている。インドは国際空港、海港、陸路国境でのスクリーニング強化により対応中だが、確認症例はまだない。verified_locationsはサマリーで主題として扱われているDRCとインドのみを列挙した（ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない）。Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドにはUganda、Indiaも記載されているが、インドは実際の発生地点ではなく対応国であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため含めない。

article.articleHeadline: घातक इबोला भाइरसको पुनरागमन : नेपालमा जोखिम कति ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Re-emergence of the deadly Ebola virus: How high is the risk in Nepal?
article.articleSummary: As of 19 May 2026, Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease is spreading in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with neighboring Uganda affected; the World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Nepal faces no high risk currently, but ongoing global travel keeps non-zero risk. Bundibugyo Ebola has a high fatality rate—about 40% for this strain; overall Ebola fatalities hover around 50%. Early symptoms mimic fever, typhoid, or malaria: fever, body pains, fatigue, sore throat, with potential progression to bleeding. Transmission is via direct or indirect contact with infected bodily fluids or contaminated materials; it is not airborne. Animal-to-human transmission is plausible, notably from primates. Nepal has activated surveillance, prepared laboratories, instituted fever screening at Tribhuvan International Airport, and isolation protocols for suspected cases, with coordination under WHO/IHR and strict returnee safeguards. Experts urge vigilance, preparedness, and accurate information.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的なエボラウイルスの再出現：ネパールでのリスクはどの程度か？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、およびWPRO基準複数項目該当。WHO PHEIC宣言済みのエボラ流行に関する記事であり、対象地域での確認例がある。
triage.notes: UgandaはBluedot APIで発生地域として列挙されているが、記事サマリーでは『隣接するウガンダも影響を受けている』との記述にとどまり、ウガンダでの確定的な流行発生が主題でないため除外。ネパール（対象国外）は記事の主題となっているが、同国は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCのBundibugyo Ebola virus disease（BDBV）流行が記事の中核であり、WHO PHEIC宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: AP сообщило об открытии в ДРК центров лечения редкой формы Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: AP reported the opening of treatment centers in DR Congo for a rare form of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Three Ebola treatment centers will be opened in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province to manage a rare Ebola virus disease strain that has killed about 120 people. The move follows a flare in DRC and neighboring Uganda, for which the World Health Organization on May 15 declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern due to substantial uncertainty about true case counts and regional spread. There are no approved vaccines or therapies for this rare strain. Separately, Russia's Rospotrebnadzor said there is no current risk of Ebola reaching Russia; enhanced sanitary-quarantine controls are in place at border checkpoints under the federal 'Sanitary Shield' project, with risk assessed by the Perimeter automated system. WHO notes ongoing international concern about regional transmission and case numbers during this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴで珍しい形態のエボラの治療センターが開設と報道
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。WHOが2026年5月15日にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言した珍しいエボラ株による outbreak。約120人の死亡、DRCとウガンダでの拡大、治療法・ワクチンなし。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCのIturi州での outbreak が主題。Ugandaでも「flare」が記載されているが、記事の主対象はDRCの治療センター開設。Russiaは疾病自体の発生地ではなく、関連する国境対策の言及のみのため除外。WHOのPHEIC宣言（2026年5月15日）により、国際的に重要な感染症警戒対象。珍しい株で治療法・ワクチンなしという深刻性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Thailand steps up mpox surveillance after two new cases
article.articleSummary: Mpox clade Ib surveillance in Thailand stepped up after two new confirmed cases during weeks 18–19 (April 26–May 9, 2026). Thailand has 1,074 confirmed mpox cases and 16 deaths overall; mpox clade Ib accounts for 18 cumulative cases with no deaths, and six clade Ib cases in 2026 to date, also with no deaths. The two new Thailand cases were Thai men aged 25–40: the first with sexual contact with a stranger, the second with prolonged close skin-to-skin contact in a crowded tourist area linked to a festival. A foreign tourist with similar risk history was reported via IHR. The DDC notes close skin-to-skin contact, especially among men who have sex with men, as the main risk factor. Prevention includes avoiding contact with symptomatic individuals and sex with strangers or anyone with a rash. Authorities will strengthen surveillance, screening and risk communication, especially in tourist venues.

triage.headline_ja: タイが新規2件のサル痘確認後、サル痘の監視体制を強化
triage.triage_reason: タイでのMpox clade Ibの継続的な検出は注視が必要だが、死亡例がなく現在のところ限定的な流行。情報不足が多いため更なる続報の監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、タイで確認されたMpox clade Ibの新規2件は観光客や旅行関連の活動に関連しており、国際的な拡散リスク（外国人観光客の関与）が指摘されている。現在死亡例はなく重症度は低いが、クラスター化の可能性と観光地域での継続的な曝露リスクは監視対象。当局が監視体制を強化していることから政府レベルの関心は確認できる。

article.articleHeadline: 疑似病例近400人...伊波拉病毒延燒百人亡-台視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nearly 400 suspected cases... Ebola virus continues to spread; hundreds have died - TTV News Network
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) persists, with suspected cases nearing 400 and at least hundreds of deaths. Rwanda closed border checkpoints with the DRC on May 18 to curb spread. A U.S.-based physician diagnosed in the DRC is being treated in Germany, with six others exposed slated for transfer to a German viral hemorrhagic fever facility. The United States issued a travel warning; since May 18, non-U.S. citizens who have visited the outbreak area within 21 days face entry restrictions. A Congo-origin man treated in Uganda died, with relatives testing positive, triggering alerts. Uganda reports no local transmission but closed its border checkpoints with the DRC; Congolese nationals may return with handwashing and temperature checks. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus; no approved vaccines or therapeutics exist. Taiwan CDC raised the regional risk to Level 2 for DRC and Uganda, advising 21 days of self-health monitoring for returnees.

triage.headline_ja: 疑似病例近400人...エボラウイルスが猛威を振るい、百人以上が死亡 - TTV ニュースネットワーク
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当、WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo型）による大規模アウトブレイクで、複数国での死亡、国境措置、渡航制限が実施されている極めて深刻な状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、エボラウイルスの実発生地はDRC、ルワンダ、ウガンダ、ドイツ、米国です。対象国リストから該当するのはDRC（203312）のみです。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれず、ルワンダも対象外です。インドはサマリーに記載されていないため、verified_locationsには含めるべきではありません。修正版：verified_locationsは[{"id": 203312, "name": "Democratic Republic of the Congo"}]のみが正確です。

article.articleHeadline: أمريكا تطور علاجا جديدا بالأجسام المضادة لسلالة بونديبوجيو لفيروس الأيبولا - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States develops a new antibody-based therapy for the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus - Youm7
article.articleSummary: One American has Ebola virus disease confirmed in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with the patient transported to Germany for care; six additional infected individuals were also moved to Germany. The CDC has restricted entry from the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, and says the immediate risk to the United States remains low. Dr. Peter Stafford, an American physician, is reported to have contracted the virus while caring for patients at Nyankondi Hospital in eastern DRC; three caregivers—including his wife—were ill, while the other two were asymptomatic. Congolese health authorities report about 105 deaths and 393 suspected cases in the eastern outbreak. The United States maintains laboratory testing capability through its public health network. CDC, with BARDA, is developing a monoclonal antibody therapy for the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola. Evacuation and cross-border care are ongoing; experts warn funding cuts could hinder the response.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカがエボラウイルスのブンディブギョ株に対する新しい抗体療法を開発 - ユーム7
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の確定患者の発生、死亡者と疑い患者の多数報告、複数国への患者移送による国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限措置の実施が認められる。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはUSA、Sudan、Germany、Ugandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は東DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の流行と患者の国際的移送である。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。USAとGermanyへの患者移送は2次的情報であり、発生地は東DRCが明確。また、本イベントは公開日付が2026年5月19日で、将来の日付であることに注意。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Umumkan Darurat Kesehatan Global usai Merebaknya Virus Ebola Bundibugyo, Varian yang Mematikan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Declares Global Health Emergency After Bundibugyo ebolavirus Outbreak, the Deadly Variant.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda prompted WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. As of 16 May 2026, 8 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases, 246 suspected infections, and at least 80 deaths were linked to the outbreak, centered in Ituri Province, eastern DRC. Confirmed cases have also appeared in Kinshasa and Uganda; in Uganda, two patients traveled from Congo before hospital admission in Kampala’s intensive care unit. WHO notes the true case burden is likely higher due to limited testing, unexplained deaths, and gaps in transmission understanding. At least four healthcare workers are among the deaths. Bundibugyo is a rare, highly lethal Ebola variant; there is no approved vaccine or targeted therapy yet. Rapid cross-border movement and unstable humanitarian conditions heighten outbreak spread risk.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、致死的な変異株バンディブギオエボラウイルスの流行後、世界保健上の緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、かつWPRO基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス（バンディブギオ株）の国際的流行で、DRCおよびウガンダでの確定患者と死亡が確認され、WHOが国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダの確定患者は2名でありDRCからの入国患者であり、主要な流行地はDRCのIturi州。対象国リストにUgandaは含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。バンディブギオ株はエボラウイルスの希少で致死率の高い変異株であり、ワクチンや標的治療法が承認されていない点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo abre más centros de tratamiento ante el brote de ébola, que ya ha causado 130 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC opens more treatment centers amid Ebola outbreak, which has already killed 130 people.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), concentrated in Ituri and North Kivu with cases in Bunia, Goma, Mongbwalu, Butembo and Nyakunde. The Bundibugyo strain has been identified; the outbreak has killed more than 130 people. By Monday, authorities reported over 118 deaths and 300 suspected cases in Ituri and North Kivu, plus one death and one suspected case in neighboring Uganda. The DRC will open three Ebola treatment centers in Ituri; WHO will dispatch a team, declaring the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. No vaccines or approved therapies exist for this strain. An American physician is among the new confirmed cases. Early response faced delays from testing the wrong strain; the U.S. CDC announced a 30-day entry ban for foreign nationals who traveled to Congo, Uganda or South Sudan in the past three weeks, with enhanced screening.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ流行に対応して追加の治療センターを開設、既に130人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行で130人以上の死亡、国際的な懸念声明（PHEIC）、複数国への拡大リスク、渡航制限など、IHR基準4項目全てに該当。WPRO基準も5項目全て該当し、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な脅威である。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain (新種系統)の確認、ワクチン/承認治療法がない、WHO-PHEIC宣言、米国CDCによる渡航禁止令発令、国際的な対応が既に開始されている。ウガンダでの症例報告もあるが、検証可能な感染事例は記事サマリーではDRC内での発生が主体。

article.articleHeadline: WHO opens annual assembly amid deepening Ebola crisis
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola Bundibugyo strain spreading across eastern DRC's Ituri and North Kivu and into Uganda's capital Kampala, with at least 118 deaths and 390 suspected cases reported. Confirmed cases are in Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbwalu, Butembo, Nyankunde, and Goma (DRC) and in Kampala; a Kinshasa case was retracted after negative tests. First laboratory-confirmed case was on May 14; MSF says the virus circulated undetected for 5–6 weeks, signaling earlier community transmission. Africa CDC declared a Public Health Emergency of Continental Security (PHECS). WHO dispatched 35 experts and seven metric tons of supplies to Bunia. CDC confirmed a physician, Dr. Peter Stafford, positive for Bundibugyo Ebola; Stafford, his wife, children, and Dr. LaRochelle were evacuated to Germany. Title 42 suspends entry of non-U.S. passport holders who travelled to DRC/Uganda/South Sudan in the prior 21 days; DRC closed its land border with Rwanda; U.S. Embassy in Kampala suspended visa services.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、深刻化するエボラ危機の中で年次総会を開催
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）は高い致死率を伴う異常かつ予想外の多国家アウトブレイク、118名の死亡と390疑似患者が報告され、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ・ドイツへの症例確認）、渡航制限実施。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 注：発生地域リストにはウガンダ、ドイツ、スーダン、ルワンダ、米国が含まれているが、対象国リスト外のため除外。記事サマリーでDRC（North Kivu、Ituri州）とウガンダ（Kampala）での確認が明記されており、DRCのみ対象国に該当。Indiaは対象国リストに含まれるが、記事本文では言及なし—Bluedot地理的誤認の可能性高い。ただしこの記事の場合、DRCだけでも基準満たすため判定に影響しない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola face ravagii în Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola ravages Congo
article.articleSummary: May 19, 2026 — Ebola ravages the Democratic Republic of Congo, with at least 118 deaths and over 390 suspected cases reported as the outbreak expands to Nyakunde in Ituri province and Butembo in North Kivu, with cases also in Goma. Uganda has confirmed two infections and one death. The World Health Organization has declared the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola an international emergency. Congolese authorities say medical teams are intensifying identification and investigation of suspected cases. An American missionary doctor, Peter Stafford of the Serge medical group, tested positive and will be evacuated to Germany for treatment. The U.S. CDC says at least six Americans may have been exposed and is assisting a safe evacuation of a small number of those affected, without specifying exact numbers. The situation remains under close international scrutiny.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴで猛威を振るう
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的な感染例と複数国への拡大、WHO緊急事態宣言、国際的な対応が必要な状況であり、即座のRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: Propagation d'Ebola en RDC: les violences entravent l'aide et le financement, selon l'Onu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spread of Ebola in the DRC: Violence Hinders Aid and Funding, According to the UN.
article.articleSummary: May 19, 2026 — Ebola outbreaks in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) with potential Uganda link are being hampered by violence, population displacement, and insecurity that complicate surveillance, contact tracing, and response operations. The WHO has declared the DRC-Uganda Ebola situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The implicated Bundibugyo Ebola strain currently has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. The UN and partners warn that without intensified international support, both the Ebola response and broader humanitarian efforts could lose hard-won gains amid acute needs. The $1.4 billion humanitarian plan for DRC is only 34% funded (approximately $478 million received). About 10 million people in eastern provinces face critical hunger, with only 30% of health-sector funding mobilized.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのエボラウイルス拡大：暴力が支援と資金調達を妨害、国連発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の状況、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準5項目全て該当。WHO公式のPHEIC宣言済みで社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: HK 'to raise Ebola alert if there's wider outbreak' - RTHK
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong’s Centre for Health Protection will raise its Ebola alert level only if overseas transmission widens or Hong Kong records an imported case; the outbreak remains at the lowest alert while monitored. The epidemic is concentrated in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with no cross-continental spread so far. The World Health Organization has declared a public health emergency of international concern. A move to 'serious' would occur if the outbreak worsens overseas (more African countries or other states affected) or if Hong Kong reports the first imported case; a worst-case 'emergency' would follow local transmission or infections of unknown origin. As of Monday, the Bundibugyo strain has caused at least 100 deaths and nearly 400 infections, with no proven vaccines or treatment. Hong Kong has health screenings for travelers from Africa. Incubation up to 21 days; transmission via close contact with blood, secretions, or bodily fluids; travellers should seek care within 21 days and inform doctors of travel.

triage.headline_ja: 香港「より広範な流行があればエボラ警戒レベルを引き上げる」- RTHK
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（WHOによる国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済み、アフリカ複数国での感染、国際的拡大リスク、渡航規制リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Щонайменше 100 людей померло від вірусу Ебола у Конго | Новини Харкова та України - АТН
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At least 100 people have died from the Ebola virus in Congo | Kharkiv and Ukraine News - ATN.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo is experiencing an Ebola outbreak with at least 100 deaths and over 390 cases. Two confirmed Ebola cases and one death have also been reported in Uganda. Jean Kasaya, head of Africa CDC, warned that in the absence of approved medicines or vaccines, safety measures—especially during funerals of Ebola victims—are essential. White House adviser Dr. Heidi Overton said one patient in the region is an American, with a positive Bundibugyo ebolavirus test, and that this American along with six high-risk contacts will be evacuated to Germany. The World Health Organization urged border screening between DRC and Uganda to prevent cross-border spread and called on neighboring countries to increase readiness for the Bundibugyo strain. No specific treatments were reported as approved; WHO emphasized rapid containment measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラウイルスにより少なくとも100人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の多数死亡、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス感染症は高い致死率と国際的懸念を伴う。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Wabah penyakit menular kian sering, dampaknya makin luas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Outbreaks of infectious diseases are becoming more frequent, and their impact is widening.
article.articleSummary: WHO and World Bank’s Global Preparedness Monitoring Board (GPMB) warns infectious-disease outbreaks are becoming more frequent and exert broader health, economic, political, and social impacts, with recovery capacity tightening. In its May 18, 2026 pandemic-resilience report, the board notes decade-long investments have not kept pace with rising pandemic risk, and after a surge in COVID-19 funding, health development assistance has fallen back to 2009 levels. It calls for a permanent, independent mechanism to monitor pandemic risk and stresses equitable access to vaccines, tests, and life-saving treatments through a global pandemic accord. Separately, on May 19, the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for an Ebola outbreak in Congo and Uganda, with over 250 suspected cases and 80 deaths; the Congo outbreak is caused by Ebola Bundibugyo, different from the Zaire strain that sparked West Africa’s 2014–2016 crisis.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：感染症の流行がより頻繁になり、その影響が拡大している

triage.notes: WHOが2026年5月19日にEbola outbreak（DRC and Uganda）に対してPHEICを宣言。記事サマリーにはUgandaの言及がありますが、対象国リストに含まれていないため、DRCのみverified_locationsに含めました。Bundibugyo strainはZaire strainとは異なる亜種。80人の死亡と250以上の疑い患者数は深刻度の高さを示しています。

article.articleHeadline: இபோலா தொற்றினால் 100 பேர் பலி - ITN News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 100 people dead from Ebola infection - ITN News
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Congo region has claimed over 100 lives, with more than 390 suspected infections reported by authorities. The transmission rate has accelerated, prompting public health officials to stress strict adherence to hygiene and infection-control measures. Because there are no approved treatments or vaccines, officials urge the public to avoid attending funerals of those who die from Ebola to reduce transmission risk. The ongoing outbreak has led the World Health Organization to declare the situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. This reflects international concern and the need for intensified surveillance and containment efforts as of May 19, 2026.

article.articleHeadline: TPHCM chủ động phòng ngừa dịch bệnh Ebola xâm nhập năm 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City proactively prevents Ebola virus disease from entering in 2026.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 May 2026, Ho Chi Minh City is proactively preventing Ebola virus disease entry amid WHO's declaration of a public health emergency of international concern for Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreaks in Congo and Uganda. The city Department of Health directs enhanced border surveillance; Ho Chi Minh City Center for Disease Control (HCDC) will tighten monitoring at entry points, track travelers' epidemiology and health indicators, and coordinate with aviation, maritime authorities and international health quarantine to detect suspected cases early. Preparedness includes isolation, handling, and safe transport protocols. WHO advises 21-day monitoring for contacts and restricted international travel; suspected cases may be discharged or travel only after two consecutive negative tests, 48 hours apart. The department will maintain training, update infection-control procedures and PPE use, and continually assess risk per WHO and MOH advisories.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市が2026年のエボラウイルス病の侵入を積極的に防止

triage.notes: 記事の主題はベトナム（ホーチミン市）でのエボラ防疫対策であり、DRCとウガンダでの流行はベトナムの防疫背景として言及されている。Bluedot APIが指摘したHo Chi Minh City（複数ID）はベトナム内の都市であり、ベトナムの対象国リストに含まれているため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: International Rescue Committee launches emergency response to Ebola outbreak in Central Africa
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Bundibugyo Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda has caused 88 deaths; no vaccine or licensed treatment for this strain. The World Health Organization (WHO) declared a global emergency. The International Rescue Committee (IRC) has launched emergency response activities, including infection prevention and control, PPE distribution, and frontline health worker support, working with government authorities. Goma, a densely populated eastern DRC transport hub, has confirmed cases, raising alarm about rapid spread amid conflict and displacement that strain health systems. In Kampala, Uganda, health facilities like Kibuli Muslim Hospital are screening patients; population movement could accelerate transmission. The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention announced the outbreak; WHO cautions significant uncertainties about the true number of cases and geographic spread, requiring international coordination. European CDC says Europe risk is very low.

triage.headline_ja: 国際救援委員会がアフリカ中央部のエボラ出血熱の流行に対して緊急対応を開始

triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの流行が言及されているが、対象国リストにはウガンダは含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。88人の死亡確認、Bundibugyo Ebolaウイルス株、WHO公式宣言、Goma（高人口密集地の交通ハブ）での確認事例、紛争と人口移動による保健システムへの負荷という複数の憂慮すべき要因が存在。国際的な感染症危機管理上の優先度は最高。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolas uzliesmojumā Kongo DR miruši 118 cilvēki
