article.articleHeadline: Epidemija ebole u DR Kongu: Više od 118 mrtvih, zaraza se širi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the DR Congo: More than 118 dead, the outbreak is spreading.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has killed at least 118 people and is suspected in over 390 infections as cases spread to Nyakundea (Ituri), Butemba (North Kivu), and the city of Gomi in eastern DR Congo. Uganda reports two confirmed cases and one death (CDC). The WHO has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern, warning that true case numbers may be higher and that local and regional spread is possible. An American physician, Peter Stafford, linked to a medical mission, tested positive and will be treated in Germany; his wife Rebekah Stafford and another colleague were exposed and are in quarantine. The CDC is enforcing traveler screening and entry restrictions for non-passport holders who recently visited DR Congo/Uganda/South Sudan (past 21 days) and increasing testing capacity. Context: the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak infected ~28,600 and killed ~11,325.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行：118人以上が死亡、感染拡大中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の確定的な流行で、118人以上の死亡、390人以上の感染疑い例、複数国への国際的拡大（ウガンダ、ドイツ）、WHO PHEIC宣言、および渡航制限が実施されている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の確定的な流行で、Bundibugyo ebolavirus（通常は低い致死率の種だが、この流行では高い致死率を示している）が原因。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。ウガンダへの越境は確認されているが、サマリーの主題はDRC。ドイツの患者（医療従事者）はDRCでの感染ではなく海外での治療のため除外。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Noi centre deschise pentru tratarea Ebola în Congo, după aproape 120 de decese provocate de o tulpină rară
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New centers opened to treat Ebola in Congo, after nearly 120 deaths caused by a rare strain.
article.articleSummary: Three Ebola treatment centers will open in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, to bolster response to an outbreak caused by the Ebola Bundibugyo strain, a rare variant with no approved vaccines or treatments. As of 19 May 2026, authorities report at least 118–120 deaths and about 300 suspected cases across Ituri and North Kivu, with one death and a suspected case in neighboring Uganda. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Initial misdiagnosis delayed confirmation: Bunia samples were negative for Ebola Zaire; confirmation arrived on 14 May, with Bundibugyo identified on 15 May. Confirmed cases span Bunia, Goma, Mongbwalu, Butembo, Nyakunde. Transmission is via bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, muscle pains, diarrhea, vomiting, and sometimes hemorrhage. The outbreak unfolds in conflict-affected Ituri; Rwanda closed its border with DRC, Uganda tightened border surveillance. Past Bundibugyo outbreaks occurred in Uganda (2007–2008) and DRC (2012).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱の治療センターが新たに開設、珍しい株による約120人の死亡後
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。Bundibugyo株という稀なバリアントで、ワクチンや承認済み治療法がなく、複数国への拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施などから、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株は珍しいバリアント。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。ウガンダとルワンダでの確認例および国境対策強化から国際的拡大の懸念あり。紛争地域での流行という管理困難な状況も加味。

article.articleHeadline: کانگو میں ایبولا سے کم از کم 118 افراد ہلاک عالمی ہنگامی صورتحال کا اعلان
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: at least 118 people dead; global emergency declared.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports at least 118 Ebola deaths and more than 390 suspected cases amid a conflict-affected outbreak. No approved vaccines or therapeutics exist; emphasis is on public health measures including safe burials to curb transmission. CDC notes two confirmed Ebola cases and one death in Uganda linked to the outbreak. The current spread is due to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with the WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. An American doctor among the infected in Congo will be treated in Germany; at least six American contacts are exposed, with the CDC aiding safe evacuation, though numbers remain unconfirmed. The United States has issued a Level 4 travel advisory for Congo. Ebola transmits via bodily fluids; incubation ranges 2–21 days, beginning with fever, headache, and fatigue, advancing to vomiting, diarrhea, organ failure, and bleeding. Wildlife reservoirs, notably fruit bats, are implicated.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ熱：最低118人が死亡；世界的緊急事態が宣言される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ熱の重大発生で118人以上の死亡、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、複数国への拡大（ウガンダ確認症例、米国への搬送）、国際的な渡航制限発令により、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが米国とドイツを発生地域に含めているが、これらは患者の搬送先・治療地であり、実際の発生地はコンゴ民主共和国のみ。ウガンダについても、サマリーでは「linked to the outbreak」と述べられているが対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsには含めない。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、複数国への波及、高い死亡率（感染症の深刻性）、Bundibugyo ebolavirus（特定の病原体）により、シグナルトリアージの基準をすべて満たす。

article.articleHeadline: 快訊／台灣出現首例「變種M痘Ib子分支」　自泰國境外移入 | ETtoday健康雲 | ETtoday新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking News: Taiwan reports first case of the mpox Ib sublineage, imported from Thailand
article.articleSummary: Taiwan confirms its first mpox (monkeypox) case from the Clade I Ib sublineage, imported from Thailand. By May 19, 2026, Taiwan reports 14 mpox cases this year (12 locally acquired, 2 imported), all among men aged 20–50. The May 2026 confirmations include a northern Taiwan resident in his 40s, unvaccinated, with unsafe sexual contact and vesicular lesions, and an imported man in his 20s who had unsafe sex in Thailand in April and later developed genital vesicles and hand–foot rash; genotyping identified Ib. This marks Taiwan’s first Ib-type mpox since mpox became a notifiable disease in 2022; other cases are from Clade II. Globally, as of March 2026, 48 countries reported 1,235 new mpox cases and 5 deaths, with ~70% in Africa; Thailand has reported 1,032 Ib cases since 2022 through Jan 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 速報：台湾でMpox Ib亜系統の初症例を報告、タイから境外移入
triage.triage_reason: Mpox Clade I（高病原性）の新亜系統（Ib）が新地域（台湾）で初検出され、国際的拡大のリスクが高い。IHR基準3つ以上該当、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域に台湾（GeoNames ID: 1668284）が含まれていますが、台湾は対象国リストに未含有のため verified_locations に含めていません。タイは対象国であり、且つ記事の主要な感染源として明記されているため含めています。記事サマリーに基づき、タイでの大規模流行（1,032症例）とClade I Ibの国際拡大が確認されています。台湾は対象国外ですが、タイからの渡航・貿易関連リスクが高く、地域的な関心が集中しています。

article.articleHeadline: TPHCM tăng cường giám sát cửa khẩu, chủ động phòng nguy cơ dịch bệnh Ebola xâm nhập
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City strengthens border gate surveillance, proactively preventing the risk of Ebola entering.
article.articleSummary: On May 19, 2026, Ho Chi Minh City authorities intensified border surveillance and public health quarantine measures to prevent Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo strain) from Congo and Uganda, after WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern. The Ho Chi Minh City Department of Health directed the City CDC to tighten screening at entry points, assess travel and epidemiological histories, and coordinate with aviation, maritime, and quarantine teams to rapidly detect suspected cases and prepare isolation, treatment, and safe transport procedures. Early detection of suspected cases is key to preventing importation. WHO recommends monitoring close contacts for 21 days and restricting international travel for them; discharge or travel requires two consecutive negative tests at least 48 hours apart. Training, infection control, PPE use, and case management at facilities are being reinforced. Neighboring countries should boost readiness within 24 hours; non-border countries should avoid broad travel bans.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市、エボラ病流入リスクに備え国境検問所の監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。ザンビアで新規発生したコンゴタイプエボラウイルスが複数国を経由して侵入する可能性があり、国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナム（ホーチミン市）のエボラ対策強化を報じており、コンゴ・ウガンダからの輸入リスク対応が背景。ウガンダはリストに含まれない対象国のため verified_locations から除外。DRCおよびベトナムが主題の発生地域として確認。2026年5月のWHO国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言（PHEIC）に基づく積極的な防疫措置。

article.articleHeadline: Medic american infectat cu Ebola în Congo, după ce SUA au introdus restricții legate de focar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American doctor infected with Ebola in the Congo, after the U.S. imposed outbreak-related restrictions.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, an American missionary doctor, Peter Stafford, tested positive for Ebola in Bunia, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo. His wife Rebekah Stafford and another physician are under observation, with their four children under surveillance. The infection is caused by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine; WHO has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. Africa CDC reports over 100 deaths and about 395 suspected cases in the region, with Ituri affected; Kampala, Uganda, has confirmed cases including a death. MSF estimates a fatality rate of 25–40% for the Bundibugyo variant. The United States CDC activated Title 42 for 30 days to limit entry from affected areas; overall US risk remains low. Health authorities are mobilizing resources to contain the outbreak amid regional healthcare strains.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ人医師がコンゴでエボラに感染、米国が発生関連の制限を導入後
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限実施済み）。また、Bundibugyo亜型による確認患者・死亡発生、複数国への拡大、WHO緊急事態宣言により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri州Bunia）でのエボラ発生が主題。ウガンダにも確認患者がいるが、サマリーにおける焦点はコンゴでの発生とアメリカ人医師の感染。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHO緊急事態宣言、Bundibugyo亜型（治療法・ワクチンなし）、25-40%の死亡率という高リスク、米国Title 42導入による国際的影響が判定を強化。

article.articleHeadline: طوارئ دولية بعد تفشي سلالة نادرة من "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: International emergency after an outbreak of a rare Ebola strain.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the WHO declared an international health emergency over a Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. About 300 suspected cases and at least 88 deaths have been reported, with true numbers likely higher. Bundibugyo is a rare Ebola lineage that has caused only two previous outbreaks (Uganda and the DRC, 2007–2012). Case fatality is estimated at 30–40%. Symptoms include high fever, headache, muscle pains, diarrhea, vomiting, and sometimes internal and external bleeding. There are no specific treatments or vaccines for this strain; the globally licensed Ervebo vaccine does not protect against Bundibugyo. Containment relies on isolation and contact tracing, amid conflict in eastern DRC and limited access to affected areas, raising fears of spread to cities. Uganda-linked cases involved patients from Congo; one died in Kampala. The outbreak was formally announced May 5 after information circulated on social media.

triage.headline_ja: 国際的な緊急事態：レアな「エボラ」株の流行後
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。Bundibugyo型エボラの国際的な拡大、高い死亡率、治療薬なしという深刻な公衆衛生リスク、及び国際的な関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラは稀なリネージであり、過去2回のアウトブレイク（2007-2012年のウガンダ及びDRC）以来の発生。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言している。ウガンダのカンパラで死亡例が報告されているが、記事の主題はDRCでの発生。現地の紛争や医療へのアクセス制限により、都市部への拡大リスクが高い。有効なワクチンや特異的治療法がなく、管理可能性が低い。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στο Κονγκό: Πληθαίνουν οι νεκροί και τα κρούσματα -Μέτρα και για τις κηδείες
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: Deaths and cases rising — measures also for funerals.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with Bundibugyo strain: at least 118 deaths and over 390 suspected cases, as the outbreak expands geographically. Uganda has confirmed cases and a death. WHO has declared the Ebola outbreak in DRC and Uganda a global health emergency. CBS News reports at least six Americans have been exposed; the CDC is aiding safe evacuation of a small number of Americans, with discussions of transfer to a U.S. military base in Germany not confirmed. U.S. risk remains low, but measures to prevent entry will be implemented. The outbreak follows a wider West African spread, including Guinea, Sierra Leone, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Italy, with 11,325 deaths. African CDC chief Jean Kaseya notes nearly 400 suspected cases; emphasizes public health measures and funeral-management guidelines. WHO urged cross-border checks by DRC and Uganda; Rwanda to strengthen border controls; Nigeria monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱が蔓延：死者と患者数が増加——葬儀についての対策も
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRCとウガンダでの実例に基づき、WPRO基準でも全5項目に該当。WHO による国際保健緊急事態宣言が出ており、社会政治的関心も極めて高い。フルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は DRC とウガンダでのエボラ流行の主題だが、対象国リストに Uganda は含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。西アフリカでの過去の広がり（ギニア、シエラレオネ）やアメリカ・イタリア・イギリスでの例も言及されているが、これらは対象国外であり current outbreak の主要発生地ではないため除外。WHO による PHEIC 宣言、118 人以上の死亡、390 例以上の疑い例、国際的な警戒と対策強化が明記されており、多次元的なシグナルの強度が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Американец заразен со ебола во Конго, итно евакуиран на лекување во Германија - Trn.mk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American infected with Ebola in Congo, urgently evacuated to Germany for treatment.
article.articleSummary: An American physician with the Serge mission in the Democratic Republic of Congo has Ebola confirmed by the CDC and was evacuated to Germany for treatment. The patient, Dr. Peter Stafford, contracted the virus while treating at Nyankunde Hospital in Bunia, Ituri Province, and developed symptoms over the weekend. His wife Dr. Rebecca Stafford and two other Serge doctors were exposed but asymptomatic and quarantined; the Stafford family and four children are under medical surveillance. Since the eastern DRC outbreak, at least 118 deaths and over 390 suspected infections have been reported, with WHO declaring Ituri an international public health emergency. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain currently has no approved therapies or vaccines. CDC is coordinating evacuation of Americans; the US has imposed entry restrictions under Title 42 for visitors from Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. Symptoms appear 2–21 days after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ人がコンゴでエボラウイルスに感染、ドイツへ緊急搬送
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。確認患者の国際輸送と複数国での対応が必要。
triage.notes: Eastern DRC（イトゥリ州）での進行中のエボラ流行が主題。患者がドイツに搬送されているが、DRCが疾病発生地。WHO公式発表による「国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態」宣言、118死亡、390以上の疑い患者が記録されている。CDC・US Title 42による渡航制限実施中。WPRO地域外のイベントだがCEPRの監視対象として重要。

article.articleHeadline: 北京疾控提醒：如何远离校园水痘
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beijing CDC reminds: How to stay away from chickenpox on campus.
article.articleSummary: Varicella (chickenpox), caused by the Varicella-zoster virus, is highlighted by the Beijing CDC for schools and daycare centers where children are concentrated. The disease spreads via direct contact with vesicle fluid, respiratory droplets, and contaminated objects; contagious 1–2 days before rash until crusting. Incubation is 10–21 days, with fever and malaise preceding a highly pruritic rash that starts on the head/trunk and then limbs, usually resolving in about two weeks if uncomplicated. Prevention centers on vaccination, noting the vaccine is not part of the national immunization program; the recommended schedule for eligible children is two doses: first at 12–18 months and a second at 4 years, with adolescents who had one dose advised to complete a second. Schools should ensure ventilation, wet cleaning, frequent disinfection of toys/equipment, and morning/noon health checks; isolate suspected cases at home until recovery. If staff develop herpes zoster, avoid contact with susceptible children to prevent transmission in the campus.

triage.headline_ja: 北京疾病管理予防センターが注意喚起：キャンパスから水痘（水ぼうそう）を遠ざけるには
triage.triage_reason: 水痘は予想可能な季節性疾患であり、公衆衛生当局による予防啓発は通常の対応である。IHR基準の該当なし、スクリーニング基準も該当しないが、学校での感染集団が報告される場合は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は北京疾病管理予防センターによる学校での水痘予防に関する公式な啓発情報であり、感染症の異常な集団発生を報告するものではなく、定期的な公衆衛生予防メッセージと解釈される。水痘は既知の風土病であり、ワクチン接種率向上の推奨に関する内容。スクリーニング基準「流行しやすさ」に該当するが、他の懸念要因がなく、情報不足のため経過観察とした。

article.articleHeadline: Negli Usa cresce l'allarme per il nuovo Ebola del Congo: "Più pericoloso dell'hantavirus"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the United States, alarm grows over the Congo's new Ebola: "More dangerous than hantavirus".
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the United States faces rising concern over a new Ebola strain emerging in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, described as more dangerous than hantavirus. In the DRC, the outbreak has killed more than 100 people and produced hundreds of suspected cases. Infection of an American physician has been confirmed, and the virus has spread to Uganda. The strain has no approved vaccines and no proven effective specific treatments, and current diagnostic tests may fail to identify it quickly. The United States has announced entry restrictions for travelers from affected areas. Epidemiologists warn that poverty, war, and fragile health systems could enable wider international spread, heightening fears of a broader global outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 米国でコンゴの新型エボラへの警戒が高まる：「ハンタウイルスより危険」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。新型エボラ株による重大な公衆衛生上の影響（100人以上の死亡、数百の疑い例）、異常で予想外の病原体、複数国での国際的な拡大（DRC→Uganda→USA）、渡航制限の実施。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでエボラアウトブレークが発生しており、米国の医師感染も確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。新型エボラ株はワクチンなし、実証済みの有効治療法なし、診断検査の限界あり。貧困、戦争、脆弱な保健システムが国際的拡大を促進するリスク要因として指摘されている。フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）への進行を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Количество жертв лихорадки Эбола в ДРК превысило 100
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola fever in the DRC has surpassed 100.
article.articleSummary: Ebola fever outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached at least 118 deaths and 435 suspected cases, official spokesperson Patrick Muyaya said (preliminary data). The outbreak, spanning the DRC and neighboring Uganda, prompted the World Health Organization on May 17 to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Authorities urge residents to strictly follow preventive measures and remain calm. U.S. President Donald Trump expressed strong concern about Ebola in Africa and warned the risk could extend beyond the continent. The article provides only preliminary figures with no additional laboratory confirmation, infection source details, or information on imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ熱死者数が100人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2の4基準すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の爆発的流行で118人以上の死亡、435疑い例、WHOが5月17日にPHEIC宣言。国際的影響と貿易・渡航制限リスクが極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCおよびウガンダでの発生が明記されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。WHOのPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）により国際的レベルでの懸念が公式に認定されている。米国大統領の言及により政治的関心も高い。情報は初期段階（preliminary data）のため詳細なデータ確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: UK experts demand Ebola border checks over 'extremely worrisome' outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-19, UK experts urge enhanced border health screening over a Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak centered in Ituri province, eastern Congo near the Ugandan border. This Ebola strain has no proven licensed vaccine and no approved targeted treatment. The World Health Organization has declared a public health emergency of international concern as cases spread across wide distances; Africa's health authorities report 246 suspected infections and 65 deaths, though only a small number are laboratory-confirmed. Public health authorities warn the virus could spread beyond central Africa, prompting calls for vigilance at Britain's borders. Dr. Bharat Pankhania, a former Ebola surveillance lead, described the development as extremely worrisome, noting late recognition and the impact of regional conflict on outbreak detection.

triage.headline_ja: UK experts demand Ebola border checks over 'extremely worrisome' outbreak
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak with 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths, no effective vaccine/treatment, WHO宣言済み、国際的懸念あり。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, DRC with confirmed international concern. WHO has declared PHEIC. Uganda mentioned as bordering area but no cases confirmed in Uganda per article summary - therefore DRC only listed. UK border screening context is secondary to primary outbreak location. No approved vaccine or treatment available for this strain represents significant risk.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola revine în forță în Congo. Focar cu peste 390 de cazuri suspecte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is back in force in the Congo. An outbreak with more than 390 suspected cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo surpasses 390 suspected cases with at least 100 deaths, prompting international concern as transmission continues in affected areas. The African CDC director, Jean Kaseya, cited by BBC, confirms the rising case load and fatalities. Cross-border risk is evident, with Uganda reporting two confirmed cases and one death, signaling potential spread beyond the initial outbreak zone. WHO has declared the event a Public Health Emergency of International Concern due to high transmission risk and case severity. Authorities emphasize strict adherence to public health measures, particularly safe funeral practices, amid the absence of approved treatments or vaccines for this outbreak. An American physician infected in DRC is set for treatment in Germany; CBS News cites reports of at least six Americans exposed. The outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare but severe Ebola strain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴで勢いを取り戻す。390件以上の疑い例を伴う集団発生
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準でも全項目該当。エボラウイルス病の多国間拡大、高い死亡率、PHEICの宣言がある。シグナルとしてフルRRA対象となる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴでの集団発生が主題であり、ウガンダでの確認例も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。ドイツでの患者治療は輸出症例（二次的）であり主発生地ではない。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラウイルス種Bundibugyo）による集団発生で、WHO PHEICの宣言を受けている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, ick hör dir trapsen - F-NEWS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, I hear you creeping up on me - F-NEWS.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda trigger WHO international alarm as the Oxford Vaccine Group and partners develop multivalent filovirus vaccines targeting Ebola, Sudan virus, Bundibugyo virus, and Marburg virus. The project is funded up to $26.7 million by CEPI and Horizon Europe, leveraging ChAdOx vectors with Moderna contributing to vaccine development; Leipzig will design immunogens using AI. The effort feeds into CEPI’s Disease X Vaccine Library to prepare for unknown future filoviruses, aligning with a CEPI “100 Days Mission” to respond within 100 days of identifying a suitable pathogen. While firms test candidates against classic filoviruses, the WHO notes this is not a pandemic emergency. The EU funds global vaccine programs even as European healthcare systems face rising costs, prompting debate over global preparedness versus local health needs. The piece questions whether preparedness becomes perpetual alarm or pragmatic protection.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、忍び寄る気配を感じるか - F-NEWS
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当（異常性、管理可能性の課題）。DRC・ウガンダでの複数国アウトブレイクと、WHOが国際的警報を発令している点から、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイクが主題となっているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。ドイツ（Leipzig等）の言及は、ワクチン開発拠点として記載されており、エボラの発生地ではないため除外。WHOが「国際的警報」を発令し、複数国での同時アウトブレイク、高い致命率、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性がある点から、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに高スコア。

article.articleHeadline: DRC reports 118 suspected Ebola deaths as epidemic spreads - UPI.com
article.articleSummary: DRC reports 118 suspected Ebola deaths as the outbreak spreads. As of Monday, 11 laboratory-confirmed and 336 suspected cases are in the Democratic Republic of Congo, while Uganda reports two confirmed cases (one death), both linked to recent travel to the DRC. In North Kivu province, cases have appeared in two additional health zones, bringing the total to five. The World Health Organization on Saturday declared the DRC-Uganda Ebola outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. Residents are urged to avoid close contact, hugging or handshakes, and to report to a health facility if symptoms appear. WHO Africa Region delivered nearly 12 tons of emergency supplies to the DRC, including 4.7 tons from its Nairobi hub and 7 tons from Kinshasa, primarily personal protective equipment for frontline workers. Ebola mortality is around 50%, with transmission from wild animals and direct contact with blood and bodily fluids of infected individuals.

triage.headline_ja: DRC reports 118 suspected Ebola deaths as epidemic spreads - UPI.com（DRCがエボラ疑い死亡118件を報告、感染拡大中）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）が宣言された多国間の流行であり、即座にフルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は高い致命率（約50%）を持つ疾患。DRCで118件の疑い死亡、336件の疑い症例、11件の確定症例が報告されている。ウガンダへの越境感染（2確定症例、1死亡）も記事に明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。WHOはPHEIC宣言済みで、国際的な感染拡大リスク、管理可能性に懸念がある。記事にはNairobiからの支援物資供給も記載されているが、ナイロビはウガンダの国境近傍の物流ハブとしての役割であり、感染事例の発生地ではないため検証対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Salgono a 118 i decessi per l'epidemia di Ebola nella Repubblica Democratica del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll rises to 118 in the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: At least 118 deaths and over 390 suspected Ebola cases have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of May 19, 2026, according to local authorities and the BBC. Uganda reports two confirmed Ebola cases and one death, per the U.S. CDC. New infections have been identified in Nyakunde (Ituri Province), Butembo (North Kivu), and the city of Goma, widening the geographic spread. Congolese government officials say response teams are actively tracing and investigating suspected infections and emphasise there is no need for panic. The expanding outbreak underscores the urgency of surveillance, case management, and containment measures across affected districts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行での死亡者数が118人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて重篤で致命率が高く、DRC及びウガンダでの確認例と死亡者の報告は国際的な公衆衛生上の重大脅威であり、国際的な懸念と対応の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC内の複数地域（ニャクンデ、ブテンボ、ゴマ）での発生とウガンダでの確認例が述べられているが、実際の流行はDRC主体である。WPRO対象国ではウガンダ（対象外）のみ報告されているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。エボラ出血熱は異種間感染のリスク、限定的な治療選択肢、急速な伝播リスクから極めて危機的なシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: At least 118 dead in DR Congo Ebola outbreak as cases spread to wider area | LBC
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-19, the DR Congo Ebola outbreak in eastern Ituri province has caused at least 118 deaths, with suspected cases approaching 400 as infections spread to a wider area. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern but not a pandemic, warning it could become a much larger outbreak with local and regional spread. The US CDC is assisting the safe withdrawal of a small number of Americans and arranging quarantine; travel restrictions apply to non-US passport holders who have been in Uganda, DR Congo or South Sudan in the past 21 days. The agency will monitor travellers, and work on contact tracing, testing, and hospital preparedness. WHO urges cross-border screening with Uganda and stronger surveillance in neighboring countries; Rwanda tightens border checks, and Nigeria monitors. Africa CDC notes nearly 400 suspected cases and stresses avoiding funeral-associated transmission when vaccines or effective medicines are unavailable.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ熱流行で少なくとも118人が死亡、感染が広域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ熱という高リスク病原体による国際的懸念事項。WHO が国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、複数国への拡大リスクと渡航制限が既に実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから実際に流行が発生している国はコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri州）であることが明確。ウガンダ、ルワンダ、スーダン、ナイジェリアは隣国として監視・境界検査を強化している状況であり、流行地としては記載されていない。WHO が国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言済み。米国CDCが介入しており、国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: US restricts entry, pauses visas over deadly Ebola outbreak in DRC
article.articleSummary: US restricts entry and pauses visas amid an Ebola outbreak. CDC emergency protocols include airport screenings and a 21-day rule barring entry for non-US passport holders who traveled through the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan; the US Embassy in Kampala has paused visa processing. The WHO designated the surge as a public health emergency. An American in the DRC tested positive and will be evacuated to Germany; six more will be evacuated for health monitoring. Washington reinforces its 25-member field team in the DRC with a senior technical coordinator. Risk to the US public remains low; the virus has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. In the DRC, about 350 suspected cases and 91 suspected deaths, with more than 60% of cases in women aged 20–39. The State Department has mobilized $13 million in aid; critics say the measures are insufficient after US withdrawal from WHO and USAID cuts.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、DRCでの致死的なエボラ流行を受けて入国制限とビザ一時停止を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な感染拡大リスク、複数国での患者確認、WHO公衆衛生緊急事態宣言、米国による渡航制限措置の実施により、IHR基準3つ以上に該当。国際的な対応と社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでの流行状況が言及されているが、対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当。ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）は発生地域フィールドに含まれているものの、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。米国での患者確認と国際的な渡航制限措置は国際的な拡大リスクの証左として IHR 基準の「international_spread」「travel_trade_restriction」の判定に反映。WHO公衆衛生緊急事態宣言により重大性が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: USA pre epidémiu eboly v Kongu zaviedli sprísnené kontroly na letiskách. Vírus sa potvrdil u jedného Američana - SITA.sk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US tightens airport checks over Ebola outbreak in Congo. The virus has been confirmed in one American - SITA.sk.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) prompts the United States to tighten airport controls, screening travelers from affected areas, and suspend visa services after WHO declares a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. An American worker contracted Ebola in the DRC; symptoms appeared over the weekend and a positive test on Sunday confirmed infection. The patient is to be transferred to Germany; six more individuals are under medical monitoring. US CDC says immediate risk to the American public remains low, with ongoing assessment. Foreigners who traveled to Uganda, the DRC, or South Sudan in the past 21 days face entry restrictions. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for this Ebola lineage. In the DRC, health authorities report about 350 suspected cases and 91 deaths; most affected are aged 20–39, with over 60% women.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、コンゴのエボラ流行に対応して空港検査を強化。米国人1人がウイルス感染を確認 - SITA.sk
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は高い重症度と致死率を有し、WHOがPHEIC宣言した国際的に拡大するリスクの高い事象。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、スクリーニング基準複数該当、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: DRCで発生している主要なエボラ流行が記事の中心。記事ではウガンダと南スーダンも言及されているが、確認された流行地はDRCのみ。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。米国およびドイツへの患者移動は二次的な情報。WHOがPHEIC宣言しており、国際的影響が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв Эболы в Конго возросло до 131 на фоне распространения вируса | УНН
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in Congo has risen to 131 amid the spread of the virus | UNN.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, 131 deaths and more than 513 suspected Ebola cases are reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo, tied to the Bundibugyo strain. The virus has spread to new areas, including Nyakunde in Ituri, Butembo in North Kivu, and the city of Goma, with cross-border concerns as Uganda reports confirmed cases. An American physician working in DRC is among the confirmed cases, linked to a medical missionary group and the CDC. The CDC also reports two confirmed cases and one death in Uganda. The World Health Organization has declared the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak an international public health emergency. The developments indicate ongoing regional spread beyond DRC, underscoring heightened international coordination needs.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数が131人に増加、ウイルス拡散の中で | UNN
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的公衆衛生上の脅威、複数国への国境越え拡大、WHO による国際保健上の緊急事態宣言があり、シグナルとして確実にピックアップすべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにウガンダが含まれており、記事サマリーでもウガンダでの確認例が報告されているが、対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみが対象国リストに該当。エボラ出血熱は国際的に最も重大な感染症脅威の一つであり、死亡数131、疑い例513、複数地域への拡大、国境越え拡大、WHO による国際保健上の緊急事態宣言により、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準のすべてに該当する。

article.articleHeadline: 台灣首度驗出M痘Ib型！20多歲男泰國返台後冒水疱確診 | 生活 | Newtalk新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taiwan detects Monkeypox Type Ib for the first time! A man in his 20s who returned from Thailand developed vesicles and was diagnosed.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan confirms its first Monkeypox virus Type Ib case, imported from Thailand, and reports a second domestic case in May 2026. The imported patient, in his 20s, developed genital vesicles and a hand/foot rash after unsafe sex in April; genome sequencing identifies Ib subtype. The domestic case, a man in his 40s from northern Taiwan, presented with multiple vesicles. This is Taiwan’s first Ib-type mpox since it became a notifiable disease in 2022; previously all cases were Type II. Ib has a slightly higher fatality risk than II and transmission is linked to close contact. By May 18, 2026, Taiwan had 14 new mpox cases this year, total 530; about 90% of cases are unvaccinated. Public-funded vaccination is available at 312 clinics; two doses provide about 90% protection; one dose 40–80%. Incubation can be up to 21 days; exposure history and travel should be disclosed.

triage.headline_ja: 台湾が初のM痘Ib型を検出！20代男性がタイから帰国後に水疱で確診
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」の2基準に該当。Mpox Ib型は台湾初検出の新しい亜型であり、タイからの輸入症例と二次感染が発生。WPRO基準では「異常/予想外」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」に該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: Mpox Ib型は台湾初検出であり、従来はType IIのみが報告されていた。ワクチン未接種率が約90%と高く、感染リスクが懸念される。タイからの輸入症例と二次感染の確認により、東南アジア地域での拡大の可能性が示唆される。なお、Taiwanは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはThailandのみを含める。

article.articleHeadline: نقل مواطن أمريكي مصاب بفيروس إيبولا إلى ألمانيا لتلقي العلاج
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Transfer of an American citizen infected with the Ebola virus to Germany for treatment.
article.articleSummary: An American doctor infected with Ebola has been transferred to Germany for treatment. The patient, who worked in the Democratic Republic of Congo, tested positive late Sunday, per the U.S. CDC. Because of the short flight and Germany’s Ebola care expertise, the patient will travel with six high-risk contacts. No information was released on the other travelers’ nationalities or the exact treatment facility in Germany. American media report the patient is a medical worker who contracted Ebola while treating patients in a hospital in the DRC. The WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda. The outbreak involves a rare strain with no vaccine; Africa CDC says it likely began in mid-April and was announced in early May.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスに感染したアメリカ人をドイツに移送して治療を行う
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み、稀なワクチンなし株、複数国での多重接触者の移動。
triage.notes: DRCでエボラウイルス（稀なワクチンなし株）が発生。WHO PHEC宣言済み。米国医療従事者が感染し、ドイツへの国際移送。6人の濃厚接触者の移動に伴う国際的拡大リスク。ウガンダでの発生も報告されているが、記事の主題はDRCのアウトブレイク。発生地域リストに米国とドイツが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは両国での発生は確認できない（米国からの患者移送のみ）。対象国ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: สธ. เผย ต่างชาติเที่ยวไทย ติดฝีดาษวานร หลังมีสัมพันธ์กับคนแปลกหน้า
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Public Health reveals foreigners visiting Thailand contracted Monkeypox after having sexual relations with strangers
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (Mpox) outbreak in Thailand as of 19 May 2026 reports 1,074 laboratory-confirmed cases and 16 deaths. Mpox clade Ib is circulating, with two new Thai cases in weeks 18–19 (Apr 26–May 9): one man with sex with strangers and another man with close contact in a crowded, tourist-oriented festival area. International surveillance notes a foreign traveler, aged 25–40, who contracted Mpox through sex with strangers at tourist venues; this case involves mpox clade Ib. Since 2024, mpox clade Ib cases in Thailand total 18 with no deaths; 2026 total reports include six cases with no fatalities. Public health authorities emphasize prevention via avoiding close skin-to-skin contact and sex with strangers, personal hygiene, condom use, not sharing personal items, and seeking prompt medical testing for fever, rash, or lesions within 21 days of risk exposure. Enhanced surveillance and targeted risk communication are ongoing; 1422 hotline provided.

triage.headline_ja: タイ保健省が発表：タイを訪れた外国人が見知らぬ人との性的接触後にサル痘に感染
triage.triage_reason: タイにおけるMpoxクレード Ib の継続的な流行が確認され、国際的な旅行者への感染が記録されている。IHR基準で異常性と国際的拡大リスクが認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 2026年5月19日現在、タイで1,074件の確定症例と16死亡が報告されている。特に国際旅行者への感染と観光地での感染拡大が懸念される。クレード Ib は高い伝播性を示し、人-ヒト感染が活発である。保健当局による監視強化とリスク通信が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Alertă sanitară mondială: Epidemia de Ebola din RD Congo se extinde! Cel puțin 131 de decese până acum - MyTex.ro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global health alert: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading! At least 131 deaths so far.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has caused at least 131 deaths and over 513 suspected cases, with rapid geographic spread. The outbreak has crossed into Uganda, where the CDC has confirmed two cases and one death. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though not a pandemic, warning the true magnitude may be greater than reported. There is no licensed vaccine or widely effective treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola; control relies on isolation, infection control, and safe funeral practices. An American missionary doctor, Peter Stafford, tested positive in DRC and will be evacuated to Germany for specialist care; two other doctors (including his wife) are in quarantine. About six Americans have been exposed; transfers to a U.S. military base in Germany are being arranged. Travel advisories and border controls: U.S. Level 4 for RD Congo; Rwanda tightening; Nigeria monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健上の警告：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が拡大！これまでに少なくとも131人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の地理的拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）、WPRO基準も複数該当、WHO公式宣言、複数国での確認、国際的な支援実施中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）が主要な発生地として明記されており、ウガンダへの拡大も記述されているがウガンダは対象国リストに未含。米国、ドイツは医療搬送先であり発生地ではないため除外。WHO宣言済み、複数国での感染確認、医療従事者を含む国際的な感染者発生により、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Emergencia sanitaria internacional y medidas en Uganda y DRC - Notiulti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: International health emergency and measures in Uganda and DRC - Notiulti
article.articleSummary: The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. As of May 16, eight laboratory-confirmed cases, 246 suspected cases, and 80 suspected deaths were reported, concentrated mainly in Ituri province, eastern DRC. The outbreak has spread to Kinshasa and crossed the border into Uganda, with patients in intensive care. International measures include U.S. border controls and the embassy in Uganda suspending all visa applications. The WHO cautioned that the true scale may be larger than detected, noting clusters of unexplained deaths and limited understanding of transmission. Healthcare workers have suffered at least four fatalities. Morocco has been urged to enhance surveillance, while other countries review their response protocols.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態およびウガンダとDRCにおける措置
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的懸念事項である公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言。IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、DRCおよびウガンダでの確定例・疑い例・死亡報告があり、すでに国際的に拡大している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでの患者と国際的対応が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCはエボラアウトブレークの主要発生地であり、対象国リストに含まれる。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、複数国への拡大リスク、医療従事者の死亡を含む重症例があり、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Кількість жертв Еболи в Конго зросла до 131 на тлі поширення вірусу | УНН
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola death toll in the Congo has risen to 131 amid the spread of the virus | UNN
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has 131 deaths and over 513 suspected cases, driven by the Bundibugyo strain. The virus has reached new districts, including Nyakunde in Ituri Province, Butembo in North Kivu, and the city of Goma, with a confirmed case in an American physician working in DRC, per a medical missionary group and the CDC. Across the border, Uganda reports two confirmed cases and one death. The World Health Organization has declared the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数が131人に増加、ウイルス拡大の中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な多国家拡大、重篤な健康被害、WHOによるPHEIC宣言があり、フルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも確認症例があるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCが主要な発生地域。WHOのPHEIC宣言済みで国際的に深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威である。米国医師の感染確認も報告されており、国際的な懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情扩散 疑似死亡病例达118例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreads in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; suspected deaths reach 118.
article.articleSummary: Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, is experiencing a spreading Ebola outbreak. As of May 18, suspected deaths reach 118 per the Health Ministry; on May 15 it was 80, rising by about 40 in three days, with two additional health zones affected. BBC reports more than 390 suspected cases. Uganda records two laboratory-confirmed cases (May 15–16), including one death, both travelers returning from Congo, indicating imported transmission. On May 17, the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for the Congo–Uganda outbreak, highlighting regional spillover risk. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a less common strain, transmitted via blood and other body fluids and contaminated surfaces, causing Ebola virus disease with a 25–40% case-fatality rate, lower than some other Ebola types.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ（金）のエボラ疫情が拡散、疑似死亡病例が118例に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO緊急事態宣言済み。区域拡大、死亡急増、国境越え事例確認。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）は記事に言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。WHOがすでにPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言済み。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による比較的低い致死率（25-40%）だが、急速な拡大、地域的スピルオーバー、健康労働者の曝露リスクが存在。

article.articleHeadline: Over 90 deaths in latest DR Congo Ebola crisis: this is what we know
article.articleSummary: WHO has declared the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province) an international health emergency after more than 90 suspected deaths and about 350 suspected infections. The current outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment. 91 deaths are suspected to be linked to the outbreak, with cases confirmed outside the northeastern epicenter, including a case in Goma. Ugandan authorities report one confirmed case and one death among Congolese nationals who travelled from DR Congo. Hospitals, including Kyeshero Hospital in Goma, have instituted infection prevention measures (handwashing, pre-triage, isolation), but PPE shortages persist. The Africa CDC warns of high regional spread risk to East Africa. Rapid detection, isolation, and hygiene are the main containment tools; local beliefs initially delayed care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ危機で90人以上が死亡：これまでのところの情報
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言した深刻なエボラ感染症クライシスであり、地域的な拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはUgandaとMozambiqueも含まれているが、記事サマリーではUgandaの1例（死亡1例）が言及されているのみで、主体的な発生地はDRC（Ituri州）である。Mozambiqueについてはサマリーに記載がないため除外した。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ワクチン未存在のBundibugyo株、高い地域的拡大リスク（East Africa）、PPE不足による管理困難性が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Demokratik Kongo: Ebola salgınında en az 131 kişi hayatını kaybetti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: At least 131 people have died in the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak escalates with at least 131 deaths and over 513 suspected cases across the Democratic Republic of the Congo, as infections spread beyond initial areas into Nyakunde (Ituri) and Butembo and Goma (North Kivu). The U.S. CDC reports two laboratory-confirmed cases and one death in Uganda, indicating cross-border transmission. The World Health Organization has declared an international public health emergency for the Bundibugyo virus–driven Ebola outbreak. African Union Commission Chair Mahmud Ali Yusuf urged a coordinated regional response. Surveillance includes traveler screening, with entry restrictions to the United States in the past 21 days for non-U.S. citizens who have been in Uganda, DR Congo, or South Sudan. Context notes the 2014-2016 West Africa Ebola outbreak, but focuses on the current multi-country event; infection source and precise laboratory confirmation beyond Uganda remain unspecified.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラウイルス感染症の流行で少なくとも131人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラ出血熱は国際的に重大な懸念事項であり、複数国での確定患者、WHOの国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、米国の入国制限実施により、フルリスク評価が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに明記されているウガンダでの確定患者（2例、死亡1例）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみが対象国である。エボラ出血熱は高い致死率、国際的拡大の可能性、複数国での確認により、緊急の監視・対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak sparks global health emergency as deaths rise in Africa
article.articleSummary: On May 19, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, linked to Bundibugyo virus, prompted WHO to declare a public health emergency of international concern. The outbreak centers in northeastern Congo near the Ugandan border, with spillover cases reported in Uganda's capital Kampala. Across both countries, 395 suspected cases and 106 associated deaths have been recorded. The WHO notes the outbreak does not yet meet pandemic emergency thresholds, but concern rises due to the Bundibugyo strain lacking an approved vaccine or treatment. MSF emergency manager Trish Newport called the rising case and deaths across multiple health zones and cross-border spread extremely concerning. The United States has imposed travel restrictions after one American citizen tested positive in Congo. Ebola spreads via direct contact with infected bodily fluids and causes fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカで死者数が増加する中、エボラ出血熱が世界保健上の緊急事態を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言し、複数国での確定・疑い例、死亡例、ワクチン/治療法なし、国際的な移動制限措置が講じられている。
triage.notes: ウガンダはGeoNames ID 226074が記事内容に該当する場所として位置づけられているが、CEPR SOP対象国リスト（11カ国）に含まれていないため、verified_locationsには DRC のみ含める。記事サマリーではウガンダでの症例も明記されているが、対象国リストの制約により除外。本イベントはWHOにPHEIC指定されており、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: الولايات المتحدة تفرض إجراءات مشددة على حدودها بعد تفشي إيبولا في دول أفريقية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States imposes strict border controls after Ebola outbreaks in African countries.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the United States tightened border controls following Ebola outbreaks in Africa after the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak. The CDC says direct risk to Americans remains low but may adjust measures as more information becomes available. An American who contracted Ebola while working in the DRC is reported; symptoms appeared over the weekend and lab confirmation came Sunday evening. Efforts are underway to move the patient to Germany for treatment, with six additional individuals being evacuated for health surveillance. The CDC will impose entry restrictions on non-U.S. passport holders who have traveled to Uganda, the DRC, or South Sudan in the past 21 days, alongside enhanced airport screening.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がアフリカでのエボラ熱流行を受けて国境対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱による複数国での流行、WHO国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、国際的な症例発生（米国人患者）と渡航制限措置の実施により、IHR基準3つ以上が該当。
triage.notes: 米国とドイツでの患者発生は対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。ウガンダとスーダンは発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーの主要なイベント（「流行」outbreaks）はDRCでの発生を中心に述べられており、これら隣国での流行の詳細は記載されていないため、確認可能な検証済み発生地は DRC のみとする。WHOによる国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言およびCDCによる渡航制限の実施により、高い政治的・国際的関心がある。

article.articleHeadline: Z ebolo okužen ameriški zdravnik, ki je pomagal bolnikom v DR Kongo | 24ur.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola-infected American doctor who helped patients in DR Congo | 24ur.com
article.articleSummary: American physician Peter Stafford contracted Ebola while treating patients at Nyankunde Hospital in Bunia, Democratic Republic of Congo, and has been evacuated to Germany for treatment. His wife, Rebekah Stafford, was also exposed but remains asymptomatic. The central Africa Ebola outbreak has killed at least 131 people and sickened more than 510 suspected cases. U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention is coordinating the evacuation of at least six additional Americans who were exposed. Stafford is affiliated with humanitarian group Serge, which confirmed he is one of their doctors; two other Serge physicians exposed during patient care have not shown symptoms and are under quarantine—one of them is Rebekah. Peter and Rebekah met at Ohio University and married in 2013. They moved to Africa in 2019, also working in Togo, with Peter a general surgeon and Rebekah an obstetrician/gynecologist.

triage.headline_ja: エボラに感染した米国人医師、DRコンゴで患者を治療中に感染 | 24ur.com
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の確認症例、国際的な患者輸送、131人の死亡、510人以上の疑い患者を報告。重大な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的な拡大リスクが認められ、フルリスク評価が必須。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが報告した発生地域には米国（オハイオ州）、ドイツが含まれるが、記事サマリーによると疾患の実際の流行地はDRコンゴ（ブニア）である。米国とドイツは医療輸送・治療地であり、実際の発生地ではない。本イベントは進行中のエボラ集団発生（131死亡、510以上の疑い患者）を報告しており、医療従事者への職業曝露リスク、国際輸送、CDC主導の対応が確認されている。対象国リストにはDRコンゴ（203312）のみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ объявила международную тревогу из-за Эболы: что это значит и как должны действовать страны
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over Ebola: What does this mean and how should countries respond?
article.articleSummary: WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Ebola causes a severe viral illness with high mortality; transmission requires close contact with blood or other bodily fluids. The PHEIC is the highest level of alert under the International Health Regulations, signaling cross-border risk and necessitating urgent, coordinated action. WHO can issue temporary recommendations, coordinate lab equipment, PPE and diagnostics, deploy epidemiologists, and accelerate access to vaccines and therapeutics under emergency use. Countries should strengthen border screening, inform clinicians, ensure diagnostic readiness, update emergency plans for imported cases, and report data to WHO; broad border closures are not routinely advised. In DRC >100 deaths and >500 suspected cases; two cases in Kampala, Uganda from Congo.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ熱に関する国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言：この意味と各国が取るべき行動
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOが既にPHEIC宣言している最高レベルのシグナル。DRCで100死亡以上、500疑い症例、ウガンダへの越境確認。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、DRC（200死亡以上、500疑い症例以上）でのエボラ（Bundibugyo株）アウトブレイク、ウガンダ（Kampala）への越境拡大を確認。WHOが既にPHEIC宣言済み。Bundibugyo株はワクチンなし。注：Bluedot発生地域にはUgandaが明記されており、サマリー上「two cases in Kampala, Uganda from Congo」で越境確認されているため、Ugandaを対象国として含める。

article.articleHeadline: 快訊／國內出現首例「變種M痘」　20多歲男自泰國返台確診 | 首頁 | 三立新聞網  SETN.COM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking News: First domestic case of 'Variant Mpox' — man in his twenties who returned to Taiwan from Thailand diagnosed
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reported two mpox cases in May 2026, including the first domestic infection of Type Ib and an imported Ib case from Thailand. By May 18, 2026, Taiwan confirmed 14 new mpox cases that year (12 local, 2 imported), for a total of 530 cases (493 domestic, 37 imported). The domestic patient is a northern man in his 40s with unprotected sex; the imported patient is a northern man in his 20s who had unsafe sex in Thailand in April. Genotyping confirmed the imported infection as Type Ib, the first Ib-type detected since mpox became a notifiable disease in 2022; most prior Taiwan cases were Type II. Globally, mpox has affected 144 countries with about 179,000 cases and 503 deaths; Ib-type infections have appeared outside Africa, including Thailand (cumulative Ib cases ~1,032 since 2022). Incubation up to 21 days; transmission may occur 1–4 days before symptoms. Two-dose vaccination offers ~90% protection; Taiwan provides free vaccination to eligible groups at 312 facilities; seek care promptly if rash, fever, or lymphadenopathy with exposure history.

triage.headline_ja: 速報／国内で初の「変異型M痘」確認　20代男性がタイから台湾に帰国して感染確認
triage.triage_reason: Mpox Type Ib（アフリカ外での新興タイプ）の国際拡大と新規検出により、IHR基準3項目以上該当。台湾での初の国内感染、タイからの輸入例、グローバルな影響拡大がある。
triage.notes: Type Ib Mpoxはアフリカ外での新興タイプであり、グローバルな懸念事項。台湾での初の国内感染とタイからの輸入例が同時報告。2022年以来の国内Type Ib初検出。国際的な拡大と複数国への波及リスクが高い。タイは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Congo, sale il bilancio dell'epidemia: 131 morti. Il contagio si estende - InLibertà
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo, the epidemic's death toll rises to 131. The contagion is spreading.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo: as of May 19, 2026, the death toll has risen to 131, with at least 513 suspected cases. Kinshasa government spokesperson said infections have spread to eastern areas beyond the initial cases in Ituri province. The outbreak’s expansion in eastern Congo marks a widening transmission zone. Separately, the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) reported two confirmed Ebola cases and one death in Uganda linked to the outbreak, which the World Health Organization (WHO) has declared an international emergency. These figures underscore ongoing concerns about containment challenges and cross-border risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、死者数が131人に。感染が拡大中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つ全て満たす。エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大、高い致死性、複数国への国際的波及、WHO国際的緊急事態宣言があり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の拡大局面。コンゴ民主共和国内でキンシャサおよびイトゥリ州での複数地域への波及、ウガンダへの国際的波及が報告されている。WHOによる国際的緊急事態宣言がなされており、複数国での確認ケース・死亡者が報告されている。社会・政治的関心も極めて高い。記事サマリーではウガンダでの2確認例1死亡が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情升溫WHO列緊急事件　川普推平價藥納600種學名藥 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak intensifies as WHO declares Public Health Emergency of International Concern; Trump promotes affordable drugs, adding 600 generic medicines.
article.articleSummary: WHO declares the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), driven by the Bundibugyo strain, with at least 80 deaths. The CDC confirms a U.S. national medical missionary, Peter Stafford, contracted Ebola and is being transferred to Germany for treatment. In the United States, President Trump expands TrumpRx.gov to include over 600 affordable generic medicines, including common cholesterol- and diabetes-treating drugs; the Supreme Court upholds Biden-era Medicare drug-price negotiations. International updates include a luxury cruise ship with hantavirus arriving in the Netherlands for decontamination and isolation. Separately, Takeda faces an $885 million verdict for alleged monopolistic practices delaying generics; Merck reports a cervical cancer drug that significantly extends patient survival in trials.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疫情がWHOにより国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態と宣言、トランプ大統領が600種類の学名医薬品の廉価化を推進
triage.triage_reason: WHO がEbola をPHEIC に宣言、DRC とウガンダでの死亡例あり（IHR基準4つ全て該当）。複数国への国際的拡大が確認され、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラウイルスの発生地はDRC とウガンダである。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。米国とオランダで関連事象（患者転送、クルーズ船）が報告されているが、これらは発生地ではなく影響国であるため除外。Hantavirus（オランダのクルーズ船）は対象国外の事象であり、評価対象外。PHEIC宣言により国際的な懸念が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Nouvelle épidémie d'Ebola en RDC: ce que l'on sait
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola outbreak in the DRC: What we know.
article.articleSummary: An outbreak of Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo strain) is unfolding in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 91 deaths among about 350 suspected cases on May 19, 2026. The epicenter is Ituri province, northeast near the Uganda and South Sudan borders, a mining region with mobility and security challenges. A confirmed case has appeared in Goma (North Kivu); Uganda has one confirmed case and one death in two Congolese travelers; no local transmission in Uganda. Lab confirmation exists for three cases; most reports rely on suspected cases. The outbreak has spread beyond Ituri and the DRC. The first known case was an April 24 nurse in Bunia; epicenter is Mongbwalu, about 90 km away. WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern. Bundibugyo Ebola has no vaccine or specific treatment; vaccines target Zaïre strain, which does not protect against Bundibugyo. Most patients are aged 20–39, with 60% female.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国での新しいエボラ出血熱流行：現在分かっていること
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱の多国家拡大、WHO によるPHEIC宣言、高い死亡率、国際的拡大リスクが確認される。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言済み。Bundibugyo株でワクチン未対応。ウガンダへの越境事例あり（ただしウガンダは対象国外であるため verified_locations に含めず）。鉱山地域での高い人口流動性と治安問題が封じ込めを困難にしている。死亡率26%（91/350suspected）。

article.articleHeadline: Congo opent extra ebolacentra na 118 doden door virusuitbraak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo opens additional Ebola centers after 118 deaths from Ebola virus outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, three Ebola treatment centers were opened in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, to manage an outbreak of the rare Bundibugyo variant, which has caused 118 deaths. The World Health Organization has designated the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. Over 300 suspected infections are reported in Ituri and North Kivu, with one death and a suspected infection in Uganda. An American physician who treated patients in Bunia is among the confirmed cases; he and six other Americans are being moved to Germany for monitoring. The first infection was confirmed on May 14, and the next day the strain was identified as Bundibugyo. The index patient died April 24 in Bunia and was moved to Mongbwalu. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo; control is hindered by instability and armed groups in East Congo. The UN reports more than 273,000 displaced.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラウイルスの流行により118人の死亡後、追加のエボラセンターを開設
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において4項目すべて該当。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態として指定し、死亡者が118人、疑い患者が300人以上と深刻な規模。稀なBundibugyo変異株による国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ、ドイツでも確認）とワクチン・治療法なし。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダとドイツが含まれているが、サマリーではウガンダで1死亡・疑い感染のみで主要発生地ではなく、ドイツは患者移送の受け入れ国。主要な流行地はDRC（イトゥリ州・北キヴ州）。Bundibugyo変異株は稀で、ワクチン・治療法がなく、地域の不安定性が対策を妨げている。WHO緊急事態認定済み。

article.articleHeadline: SZO proglasila vanrednu situaciju zbog ebole u Africi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Declared a State of Emergency Over Ebola in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugy o Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) by the World Health Organization on 17 May 2026. About 395 suspected cases and 106 deaths are reported, mainly in Ituri Province's Mongvalu, Bunia and Rwampara zones in eastern DRC. Uganda confirms two cases, with one death, among people arriving from DRC. An American exposed in DRC tested positive and is to be treated in Germany. U.S. authorities have tightened health surveillance and restricted travel for recent travelers from DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan. There is no licensed vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo Ebola; control relies on early detection, isolation, contact tracing, safe burials, and infection control. Health workers' deaths suggest possible nosocomial transmission. A global preparedness assessment notes rising outbreak risk and mentions ‘Disease X’.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、アフリカのエボラウイルスについて緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。DRC及びウガンダでエボラアウトムイヤウイルス感染症の集団発生がPHEIC指定され、WHO緊急事態宣言が出ており、複数国への二次感染確認あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示的に報告されているのはDRCとウガンダであるが、対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。米国、ドイツ、南スーダンは二次的な報告対象国であり、実際の発生地はDRC及びウガンダ。PHEIC指定とWHO緊急事態宣言により、本シグナルは優先度最高のPICKUP対象。

article.articleHeadline: Western Equatoria seeks Mpox response support - Radio Tamazuj
article.articleSummary: Mpox outbreak in Western Equatoria State, South Sudan, with Yambio County reporting 24 confirmed Mpox cases and eight suspected under investigation; additional counties report cases. Authorities deployed rapid response teams and border screening at Nabiabai, Sakure, Nabanga, and along borders with the Democratic Republic of Congo and Central African Republic; plan to establish another screening center in Maridi County near Congo to detect travellers early. Persistent funding shortages hinder the response; appeals for humanitarian partners to provide financial support, medical supplies, drugs, transport, and incentives for frontline workers. Coordination with WHO, UNICEF, CMMB, AMREF Health Africa and others seeks emergency funding from international donors. No confirmed Ebola cases in Western Equatoria yet, but an emergency committee has been formed to bolster Ebola preparedness due to a neighbouring Congo outbreak. Residents urged to report symptoms and cooperate with authorities to prevent community transmission of Mpox.

triage.headline_ja: 西赤道州がポックス対応支援を要請 - ラジオ・タマズジ
triage.triage_reason: 南スーダン西赤道州でのMpox確定例24例および疑い例8例の報告。IHR基準3つ該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準複数該当。資金不足による対応困難が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事はMpox outbreakが南スーダン西赤道州を主題としており、DRCとの国境での対応が述べられている。フランス（Saclay）はBluedot APIが付与しているが、記事サマリーに具体的言及がなく、研究機関等での検査に関連する可能性があるため除外。資金不足による対応困難の報告は管理可能性の低さを示し、国際的支援ニーズが明確。

article.articleHeadline: Mit Ebola infizierter US-Amerikaner soll in Deutschland behandelt werden
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. citizen infected with Ebola to be treated in Germany.
article.articleSummary: An American infected with Ebola will be treated in Germany, according to the CDC, after testing positive last weekend. The patient worked in the Congo; six contacts—nationalities and treatment details not disclosed—will also be treated in Germany. The CDC notes Germany’s shorter flight path from the Congo and its medical expertise. Media reports identify the patient as a physician; a Christian missionary group says he treated patients in a Congolese hospital. Ongoing Ebola outbreaks are reported in the Congo and Uganda, with the Congolese health authority citing 118 deaths and more than 300 infections; Uganda has two deaths. WHO has declared a health emergency; there is no vaccine for the current variant. Africa CDC estimates the first outbreaks began in the third April week, reported May. Ebola spreads via contact with body fluids; no airborne transmission; the risk to Germany is extremely low, and importation would be detected and isolated.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスに感染した米国人がドイツで治療を受ける予定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当：深刻な公衆衛生影響（複数国での流行、死亡・感染報告）、予想外の国際拡大（米国人患者の国際移送）、国際的拡大リスク（複数国での同時流行）、渡航・貿易制限リスク（WHOが公式宣言）。スクリーニング基準も全項目該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの詳細分析：DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）で118人の死亡と300人以上の感染が報告され、ウガンダでも2人の死亡が確認されている。患者は米国人医師でDRCで就職していたため、実際の発生地はDRCとウガンダ。ただし対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみ該当。患者の転送先はドイツと米国だが、これらは発生地ではなく治療地点。WHOが公式に保健上の緊急事態を宣言し、現在のバリアントにはワクチンが存在しない。この記事は国際的に重大な感染症危機の一環を報じており、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: SC allows euthanasia of rabid, incurable dogs to curb threat to human life
article.articleSummary: India's Supreme Court upheld the November 2025 directive to remove stray dogs from public institutions and other high-footfall public spaces, refusing to dilute the ruling. A bench of Justices Vikram Nath, Sandeep Mehta, and NV Anjaria ruled that the state should not hesitate to euthanise stray dogs deemed rabid and incurable if necessary to curb the threat to human life. The decision stresses protecting citizens in public spaces and acknowledges realities faced by vulnerable populations, invoking a 'survival of the fittest' rationale. No specific rabies case counts or infection sources are cited in the article. The ruling reinforces ongoing public health measures to reduce rabies exposure by removing dangerous dogs from crowded environments, including euthanasia for those identified as rabid or incurable.

triage.headline_ja: 最高裁がヒトの生命への脅威を抑制するため狂犬病に罹患した治療不可能な犬の安楽死を認可
triage.triage_reason: 記事は狂犬病対策としての犬の安楽死に関する司法判断であり、公衆衛生上の関心はあるが、具体的な狂犬病患者発生例やアウトブレイク情報が示されていない。社会的関心は存在するが、シグナル化には情報不足。
triage.notes: 本記事は狂犬病感染の発生報告ではなく、狂犬病リスク軽減のための司法的な犬の管理政策に関する報道。インドにおける狂犬病は常在的な公衆衛生課題であり、記事は継続的な曝露リスク（prolonged_exposure）と感染しやすい環境条件（epidemic_prone：路上犬との接触）を示唆している。しかし具体的な感染者数、死亡例、アウトブレイク情報がないため、シグナル化には至らないが、インドのように狂犬病が既知の脅威である地域における対策強化の動きとして経過観察の価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Makin Sering, WHO Ingatkan Dunia Belum Aman dari Pandemi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreaks Are Increasingly Frequent, WHO Warns the World Not Yet Safe From a Pandemic.
article.articleSummary: Outbreaks are occurring more frequently worldwide, says the Global Preparedness Monitoring Board (GPMB), a joint WHO–World Bank panel. In its May 2026 pandemic resilience report, the GPMB warns that rising frequency of infectious disease outbreaks expands health, economic, political, and social impacts and that investments over the past decade fail to keep pace with rising pandemic risk. After COVID-19 funding surge, development assistance for health has fallen back to 2009 levels. The board calls for a permanent independent monitoring mechanism and emphasizes equitable access to vaccines, tests, and lifesaving medicines through a global pandemic agreement. Separately, the WHO has declared the outbreak status as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) while not yet a pandemic. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, more than 250 suspected Ebola cases and 80 deaths have been reported, attributed to the Bundibugyo strain, distinct from Zaire.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症の流行がますます頻繁に、WHOはパンデミックからまだ安全ではないと警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。WHOがPHEIC宣言し、DRC内でエボラウイルス病（ブンディブギョ株）での250以上の疑い症例と80人の死亡が報告されており、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）のDRCでの発生に焦点を当てており、WHOによるPHEIC宣言と250以上の疑い症例・80人の死亡が報告されている。また、COVID-19と並行して言及されているが、主要なシグナルはDRCでのエボラ流行。グローバルレベルの大流行頻度増加についての警告も含まれているが、具体的な発生地はDRCに限定されている。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ: вспышки инфекций в мире становятся всё более частыми
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: outbreaks of infectious diseases worldwide are becoming increasingly frequent.
article.articleSummary: Outbreaks of infectious diseases worldwide are becoming more frequent and damaging, according to a joint report by the Global Preparedness Monitoring Board and the World Bank, cited by RIA Novosti. As of May 19, 2026, the document warns humanity is on the brink of a devastating pandemic as outbreak frequency and severity rise, with broader impacts on health systems, economies, politics, and society, while resilience to recover weakens. New readiness initiatives have improved some aspects of preparedness, but global geopolitical fragmentation, ecological shocks, and rising international travel offset these gains. Development assistance has fallen to levels not seen since 2009, undermining response capacities. Earlier, the World Health Organization declared the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda an emergency.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：世界的な感染症アウトブレイクがますます頻繁になっている
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC及びウガンダで発生し、WHOが緊急事態を宣言した。IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクが認められ、複数基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示的にDRCとウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイク及びWHOによる緊急事態宣言が言及されている。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダは対象国に含まれないため verified_locations から除外。複数のIHR基準とWPRO基準に該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: واشنطن تتحرك لمواجهة إيبولا.. فحص للمسافرين وتعليق تأشيرات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Washington moves to confront Ebola: traveler screening and visa suspensions
article.articleSummary: U.S. tightens Ebola controls amid the Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak: enhanced traveler screening from affected regions and temporary visa suspensions for selected countries. The measures follow the World Health Organization declaring an international health emergency over Ebola in the DRC, with the CDC stating the goal is to curb transmission and bolster port surveillance. WHO incident manager Satish Pillay said a U.S. citizen contracted Ebola while working in the DRC; symptoms appeared over the weekend and laboratory confirmation came on Sunday. The patient is being arranged for treatment in Germany. U.S. authorities are evacuating six additional individuals for health monitoring, reflecting concerns about broader spread.

triage.headline_ja: ワシントンがエボラに対応：渡航者スクリーニングとビザ停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。DRCでのエボラ発生、確認患者の国際移動（米国市民がドイツで治療予定）、WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言、米国がビザ停止と渡航制限を実施。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ発生が主題。米国とドイツは対応国として記載されるが、サマリーでの実際のイベント発生地はDRCのみ。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCだけであるため verified_locations はDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: EE.UU. aplica controles de detección de ébola en aeropuertos - Analitica.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. implements Ebola screening at airports.
article.articleSummary: Ebola screening at U.S. airports and visa restrictions are being implemented after the World Health Organization declared the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) an international health emergency. CDC officials confirmed a U.S. worker in the DRC contracted the virus, prompting heightened precautions. The CDC says the immediate risk to the general public in the United States remains low. In addition to enhanced airport screening for travelers from affected regions, the United States will temporarily restrict entry for non-U.S. passport holders who have traveled to Uganda, the DRC, or South Sudan in the last 21 days. President Donald Trump described the outbreak as currently limited to Africa but expressed concern. The U.S. position follows its withdrawal from the WHO earlier this year.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ出血熱検査スクリーニングを空港で実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は国際保健上の緊急事態として宣言され、米国が空港スクリーニングと渡航制限を実施するなど国家的対応が取られている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRCにおけるエボラ流行への米国の対応。DRCでの流行が国際保健上の緊急事態として宣言され、米国労働者の感染事例が確認されている。スーダンとウガンダが発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは両国の流行状況については明確に述べられておらず、主要な発生地はDRCである。該当対象国リストにはDRCのみが該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Bunia : la prison centrale sous surveillance sanitaire
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Bunia: The Central Prison Under Health Surveillance
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak declared in Ituri province, DRC, with Bunia among affected health zones. Bunia Central Prison, designed for 500 inmates, houses about 2,202 people, including women and infants, creating extreme overcrowding that heightens transmission risk and complicates infection-control efforts. On May 18, 2026, UN MONUSCO’s Prison Unit assessed preparedness and urged stronger prevention, requesting additional protective equipment for an effective response. The Congolese government announced on May 15, 2026 the 17th Ebola outbreak in the health zones of Rwampara, Mongwalu, and Bunia in Ituri, with over 100 deaths in the province since the outbreak began. Authorities are reinforcing measures in Bunia prison to limit spread amid the ongoing outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ブニア中央刑務所がエボラ対策の衛生監視下に置かれる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の集団発生（イトゥーリ州、ブニア）で、IHR基準4つ全て該当。死亡者100人以上、刑務所での極度の過密状態による急速な感染拡大リスクが高く、国際的な支援が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはKigali Province（ルワンダ）も含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCのイトゥーリ州ブニアのエボラ集団発生である。DRC限定の対象国のため verified_locations に含める。記事では2026年5月15日に第17次エボラ集団発生が宣言され、100人以上の死亡が報告されている。刑務所内の極度の過密（収容能力500人に対し2,202人）は感染リスクの重大な増幅因子。フルRRAに進むべき重大シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: إصابة أمريكي بفيروس إيبولا تثير قلق ترامب
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American infected with the Ebola virus raises Trump's concern.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the US CDC confirmed one American was infected with Ebola virus while in the Democratic Republic of Congo, involving Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The World Health Organization states the current Ebola outbreak affecting both the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) under the IHR, though it does not meet the criteria for a pandemic. The announcement notes ongoing transmission in both countries. In a White House event promoting the Trump RX consumer drug site, former President Donald Trump said he is concerned about Ebola and that the virus remains contained in Africa. The article also recalls Trump’s 2014 criticisms of Barack Obama regarding the Ebola outbreak on social media.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人がエボラウイルスに感染、トランプ氏の懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。既に PHEIC 宣言済みで、複数国での継続的な伝播が確認されている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は既にPHEIC宣言されており、DRCとウガンダでの継続的伝播が確認されている。米国での症例報告により、国際的な懸念が高まっている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго зарегистрировали уже более 100 жертв лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, there have already been more than 100 Ebola deaths.
article.articleSummary: 118 people have died from Ebola in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with officials reporting 435 suspected cases in Ituri and North Kivu. Signals of the outbreak began in Ituri on May 5; nine days later scientists identified the pathogen as Ebola Bundibugyo virus. The flare-up spread to neighboring Uganda, and the WHO declared an international public health emergency on May 17. Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor says the risk of Ebola spreading to Russia is absent and maintains global monitoring in cooperation with African countries on Ebola, Lassa fever, and Marburg. The Russian embassy in the DRC advised citizens to avoid mass gatherings due to Ebola and to contact the embassy promptly in life-threatening situations.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ熱の死者が100人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク）。WHO により国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。フルRRA推奨。
triage.notes: 118人の死者、435人の疑いケース。Ituri及びNorth Kivuでの発生。ウガンダへの拡大確認。Ebola Bundibugyo virus確定。WHO PHEIC宣言済み（2026-05-17）。ロシア国内リスクは低いとの評価だが、グローバル監視体制継続中。発生地域リストにはウガンダとロシアも含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCが主要な発生地である。ウガンダは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めず。

article.articleHeadline: بعد إصابة أمريكي.. إيبولا يثير قلق ترامب
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After an American was infected, Ebola worries Trump.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, President Trump voiced concern about Ebola following the CDC’s report that one American was infected with Ebola while in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The World Health Organization (WHO) had earlier declared the outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, affecting both the DRC and Uganda, a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) under the International Health Regulations, though not a pandemic under the IHR. The article links the infection discussion to a White House event promoting a consumer health site, and mentions prior criticisms of how Ebola was handled in 2014. The situation highlights an active Ebola outbreak across the DRC and neighboring Uganda with confirmed human infection in the United States.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ人が感染した後、エボラはトランプ氏の懸念を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）として既にWHOが宣言。複数国（DRC、ウガンダ、米国）での確認ケースあり、国際的影響と政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUSAとUgandaも含まれるが、対象国リストに該当しないため除外。DRCのみverified_locationsに含める。WHOがすでにPHEICを宣言している公式なアウトブレイク。複数国での感染確認と大統領級の政治的関心により、高優先度シグナルとして判定。

article.articleHeadline: 致命埃博拉疫情爆发，全球紧急展开疫苗研发行动 - FT中文网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly Ebola Outbreak Triggers Global Vaccine Development Drive
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda have infected hundreds and killed more than 80, triggering a global vaccine-development drive for a strain with no available vaccine. As of May 19, 2026, the World Health Organization says a senior advisory group will meet on Tuesday to identify vaccines to prioritize for clinical trials, evaluating data including analyses from the Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations (CEPI). CEPI, formed after shortcomings in the last Ebola response, is coordinating the rapid vaccine response amid ongoing outbreaks. International health funding has been cut, but CEPI's effort to deliver a vaccine capable of being deployed within 100 days to counter pandemic threats remains a key benchmark. No vaccine exists yet for this Ebola strain, with the outbreaks concentrated in the DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的なエボラ疫情爆発、ワクチン開発グローバルドライブを引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラは未承認ワクチン株、数百人感染、80人超死亡、国際的拡大リスク、貿易制限リスクが明確。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示的にDRC（Democratic Republic of the Congo）とウガンダでのエボラ爆発が述べられているが、ウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。発生地域フィールドにはウガンダが含まれているが、CEPRの対象国ではないため除外。アメリカで急速なワクチン開発が進む背景があるが、イベント発生国の確認に焦点を当てた。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果內戰+檢測困難 伊波拉疫情被拖延3周才確認 | 聯合新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congolese Civil War + Testing Difficulties: Ebola Outbreak Confirmed Only After a Three-Week Delay | United News Network
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has accumulated 393 suspected cases and at least 120 deaths, with confirmation delayed by about three weeks due to civil conflict and testing difficulties. The World Health Organization has declared the event a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), underscoring the need for international cooperation while noting this is not a COVID-19-scale pandemic. The outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo virus; initial tests were negative and only precise laboratory techniques confirmed the pathogen. Incubation is 2–21 days; early symptoms resemble influenza—fever, headache, fatigue—progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, organ failure, and hemorrhage. No approved antiviral drugs exist; care relies on optimized supportive therapy. The first case is a nurse who developed symptoms on April 24, with three weeks elapsing before confirmation, prompting concern from researchers Amanda Rojek, Trudie Lang, and Anne Cori.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ内戦+検査困難 エボラ疫情が3週間の遅延後に確認 | 聯合新聞網
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WHO PHEIC宣言、393疑似症例・120人以上の死亡、DRCは対象国。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo virus系統）の確定例。393疑似症例、120人以上の死亡。WHOが既にPHEIC宣言。内戦と検査困難による3週間の診断遅延が懸念材料。国際協力の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: الولايات المتحدة تفرض إجراءات مشددة على حدودها بعد تفشي إيبولا في دول أفريقية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States imposes stricter border measures after an Ebola outbreak in African countries.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 May 2026, the United States tightened border and screening measures in response to an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan after the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The CDC says the direct risk to Americans remains low but could be adjusted as more information becomes available. An imported U.S. case: a citizen contracted Ebola while working in the DRC, with symptoms emerging over the weekend and a laboratory-confirmed positive result on Sunday evening. Efforts are underway to fly the patient to Germany for treatment, while six additional people are being evacuated for health monitoring. Measures include temporary suspension of some visa services and enhanced airport screening for travelers arriving from Uganda, the DRC, or South Sudan within the previous 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、アフリカ諸国でのエボラ拡大受け国境措置を強化
