triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WPRO基準でも全5項目該当。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みで社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ拡大が主題だが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。米国・ドイツ・スーダン・ウガンダが発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーの主題はアフリカ（特にDRC）での発生とそれに対する米国の対応措置である。WHOのPHEIC宣言済み、米国での輸入症例確認、複数国での同時多発発生という特徴から高度のピックアップ判定。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Wabah Penyakit Menular Semakin Sering Terjadi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Outbreaks of Infectious Diseases Are Occurring More Frequently.
article.articleSummary: GPMB warns infectious disease outbreaks are more frequent with broader health, economic, political, and social impacts. In its May 18, 2026 pandemic-preparedness report, it says rising outbreak frequency comes with widening consequences and limited recovery capacity, and that a decade of investments and reforms remains insufficient. COVID-19-era funding surged but did not endure, slipping toward 2009 levels as a share of development aid. The board calls for an independent, permanent monitoring mechanism and for equitable access to vaccines, tests, and treatments via a global pandemic accord. Separately, WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026 for Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 250+ suspected cases and at least 80 deaths; Bundibugyo, not Zaire, is involved. The outbreak is not yet a pandemic, but cross-border spread risk remains.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：感染症の流行がより頻繁に発生している
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo型）が5月17日にWHOによってPHEIC宣言された。250以上の疑い例と80人以上の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）を複数満たす。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo型）の公式PHEICが2026年5月17日に宣言された。250以上の疑い例と80人以上の死亡が記録されており、国際的な拡大リスクが懸念される。記事ではCOVID-19とエボラが両立して言及されているが、現在のシグナル内容の中心はDRCでのエボラアウトブレイク。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: US and UK aid cuts hit response to Ebola - amplifying 'dangerous' threat of outbreak
article.articleSummary: East DRC's Ituri province reports more than 390 suspected Ebola cases and at least 100 deaths, with cases also detected in other parts of DRC and in Uganda; Rwanda and South Sudan are on high alert. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo ebolavirus), confirmed on 14 May, and the WHO declared it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over the weekend. There is no approved vaccine or targeted treatment for this strain, and true infection numbers are believed to be higher than official figures. Illness onset followed an April period marked by large open-casket funeral proceedings, leading to a cascade of deaths. U.S. CDC says a small number of Americans directly affected are being withdrawn; USAID dismantling and UK aid cuts are criticized as undermining outbreak detection, response, and preparedness, potentially worsening this and future outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 米国と英国の援助削減がエボラ対応に打撃、アウトブレークの「危険な」脅威を増幅
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOがPHEIC宣言した確認済みエボラアウトブレーク。DRC（対象国）での390例以上の疑い例と100人以上の死亡が報告されており、国際的な懸念と支援ニーズが高い。
triage.notes: WHO による PHEC 宣言済み。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による新規アウトブレーク。サマリーでは Uganda、Rwanda、South Sudan への拡大リスクが言及されているが、対象国は DRC のみ。米国・英国の援助削減が対応能力を低下させるリスクとして指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Užsikrėtus vienam amerikiečiui, JAV skelbia apie patikras oro uostuose dėl Ebolos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After one American becomes infected, the United States announces airport screenings for Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-19, the United States announced enhanced Ebola measures after the World Health Organization declared an international public health emergency over the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). One American contracted Ebola after work-related exposure in the DRC; symptoms appeared over the weekend and a positive test followed on Sunday. He is being transported to Germany for treatment; six more people are under health surveillance in the United States. CDC says direct risk to the US public remains small, but surveillance continues. Measures include airport screenings for travelers from affected regions and entry restrictions for non-US passport holders who have visited Uganda, the DRC, or South Sudan in the prior 21 days; the US Embassy in Kampala has suspended visa issuance. In the DRC, about 350 suspected cases and 91 deaths have been reported; most patients are 20–39 years old, over 60% are women; there is no vaccine or specific treatment. Experts criticized the response as insufficient and called for stronger international coordination.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人1人が感染、米国がエボラウイルス対策強化を発表—空港検査を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的な拡大リスク、WHOによる国際的保健上の公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、複数国への拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、米国、ドイツ）が確認され、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事のサマリーから、主な発生地域はDRCであり、DRCでの約350例の疑い患者と91例の死亡が報告されている。ウガンダおよび南スーダンは言及されているが、これらは制限の対象となる国として記載されており、実際の発生地域としてのサマリー内での明確な記載がないため、verified_locationsに含めていない。米国とドイツは国際的な事例地であるが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Travel Ban Invoked for First Time Since COVID After American Doctor Tests Positive in Congo
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has prompted the first Title 42 invocation since COVID, with a 30-day travel ban through 17 June on non-US passport holders who have been in DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan within 21 days. As of 2026-05-19, WHO reports over 300 suspected cases and 88 deaths in the DRC, with two confirmed cases and one death in Uganda; true caseload likely higher after initial tests missed the Bundibugyo strain (diagnostics were calibrated for the Zaire strain). The Bundibugyo strain carries a 30–50% fatality rate; no approved vaccine or treatment exists. Two monoclonal antibodies are in animal studies, with no human trials yet. An American doctor, Dr Peter Stafford, treating patients at Nyankunde Hospital near Bunia, tested positive in the DRC; seven Americans linked to the case evacuated to Germany. WHO PHEIC; treatment centers to open; risk to U.S. public is low.

triage.headline_ja: COVID後初のTitle 42発動、アメリカ人医師がコンゴでエボラ陽性判定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の流行で深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限措置が実施されており、複数国での確認により国際的懸念が顕著。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in DRC with secondary cases in Uganda and Sudan also mentioned in article. However, per verified locations instruction, only DRC (target country 203312) is included as the primary outbreak location. Uganda and Sudan are not on the target country list. WHO PHEIC declared. No approved vaccine/treatment available. Fatality rate 30-50%. Title 42 invocation indicates significant public health and political response.

article.articleHeadline: Uganda: Suspected Ebola Case Reported in Hoima
article.articleSummary: A suspected Ebola Virus Disease case has been reported in Hoima district, Uganda, as of 19 May 2026. A 50-year-old man from the Runga landing site on Lake Albert’s shores (Kiganja sub-county) was isolated at Hoima Regional Referral Hospital after presenting Ebola-like symptoms: severe headache, fever, loss of appetite, vomiting blood, and epistaxis. Blood samples were collected and sent to the Central Emergency Surveillance and Response Support Laboratory in Wandegeya for testing; results are pending. Health authorities have deployed screening teams at Lake Albert entry points to monitor people entering from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where Ebola is declared in Ituri Province. The public is urged to avoid contact with the sick or deceased, practice hand hygiene, and report symptoms promptly. Contact tracing is underway. Ebola transmission occurs through direct contact with blood or body fluids, contaminated surfaces, the bodies of the deceased, and infected animals such as bats and non-human primates.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ：ホイマ地区でエボラ疑い患者が報告される
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い患者がウガンダで報告され、同時にコンゴ民主共和国のイトゥリ州で宣言されているエボラ流行との関連性がある。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として認識される。
triage.notes: Lake AlbertはウガンダとDRCの境界に位置し、DRCからの人的移動が報告されている。スクリーニング体制が既に展開されており、接触者追跡が開始されている。検査結果待機中だが、臨床症状と流行地との地理的近接性から優先的なフルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 से नहीं लिया सबक! अलगी महामारी के लिए कितनी तैयार दुनिया, WHO की रिपोर्ट ने मचाई खलबली
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: No lessons learned from COVID-19! How prepared is the world for the next pandemic? WHO report sparks alarm.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the Global Preparedness Monitoring Board, with WHO and World Bank support, warns that the world is increasingly ill-prepared for the next pandemic. In their report A World on the Edge: Priorities for a Pandemic-Ready, Resilient Future, rising infection risks are driven by geopolitical tensions, climate disruptions, rising travel, and shrinking development funding. The review of Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda notes the Bundibugyo strain and that the WHO has declared a public health emergency for these outbreaks. It also cautions about Ebola, Monkeypox, Hantavirus, and avian influenza threats. The report finds global capacity to respond is uneven, vaccines and medicines remain inaccessible to poorer nations—Monkeypox vaccines took about two years to reach them, longer than COVID vaccines. It calls for strengthened surveillance, rural health, emergency funding, and equitable access, with India underscored due to dense population and internal migration.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19から教訓を学ばず！次のパンデミックに世界はどの程度準備できているのか？WHOレポートが警鐘を鳴らす
triage.triage_reason: WHO支援による世界的パンデミック準備状況に関する公式レポートであり、複数の新興感染症（Ebola、Mpox、Hantavirus、Avian Influenza）の実際の流行（DRC、ウガンダでのEbola宣言）を言及。IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に複数該当し、WHO公式警告として高い社会的・政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOおよび世界銀行支援による公式パンデミック準備監視委員会レポートであり、DRCとウガンダでのEbola流行の実際の発生を言及している。ウガンダは対象国リストにないため verified_locations から除外。インドは稠密な人口と内部移動リスクにより明示的に言及されている。複数の病原体（Ebola、Mpox、Hantavirus、Avian Influenza）への警告があり、グローバルな準備体制の不均衡が重要な焦点。

article.articleHeadline: Así es el virus Bundibugyo, la rara especie de ébola que ya ha matado a más de 130 personas  en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This is the Bundibugyo virus, the rare Ebola species that has already killed more than 130 people in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus, a rare Ebola species, is driving an ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with almost 120 deaths reported. Identified in 2007, Bundibugyo has caused two prior outbreaks in the Congo River basin; this current event follows a familiar pattern: transmission through close contact with bodily fluids of infected or deceased individuals, putting healthcare workers and family caregivers at highest risk. Estimates place the case fatality around 30% or higher, though precise figures are uncertain due to limited experience. Early case finding, isolation, protective equipment, and supportive care with large volumes of IV or oral fluids can reduce mortality. Public health measures—contact tracing, community education, and safe burial practices—are crucial. All Ebola outbreaks in the DRC have been stopped to date, highlighting the importance of rapid response even for rare strains.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョウイルス、130人以上を殺害したコンゴの稀なエボラ種
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の稀なウイルス種、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。WPRO基準でも5項目全て該当。エボラウイルスの国際的関心は極めて高い。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョウウイルスはエボラウイルスの稀な種で、2007年に初めて特定された。記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでの発生を述べているが、ウガンダ（対象国リストに未含）は確認情報がないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。死亡数120～130人以上、致命率約30%以上という深刻な数値が報告されており、ヒト-ヒト感染による継続的な流行の危険性がある。全エボラアウトブレイクがDRCでこれまで制御されているとの情報は安心材料だが、稀な株の出現と国際的関心を勘案すればフルRRA対象とするべき。

article.articleHeadline: Еболата во ДР Конго брзо се шири - досега најмалку 118 мртви
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading rapidly - at least 118 dead so far.
article.articleSummary: 118 deaths and over 390 infected in a Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with spread to Nyakunde (Ituri), Butembo (North Kivu), and Goma. Uganda reports two confirmed cases and one death. WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. A US doctor treating patients in DRC, Peter Stafford, tested positive and will be evacuated to Germany; his wife Dr Rebecca Stafford and another colleague are quarantined, with the organization confirming exposure. CDC notes several US nationals exposed; evacuation discussions are underway. US authorities have implemented enhanced entry screening for travelers from Uganda, DRC, or South Sudan in the last 21 days and are restricting entry for non-US passport holders from those areas. They are coordinating with airlines on contact tracing and boosting testing and hospital readiness; CDC has issued a Level-4 travel advisory for the DRC. Rwanda and Nigeria are tightening border controls. The West Africa 2014–2016 outbreak had about 28,600 cases and 11,325 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱が急速に拡大 - 現在までに最少118人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外の事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラ出血熱の多国家感染事例で、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言済み。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで発生地域として列挙されているUS、Sudan、Rwanda、Germany、Ugandaなどは、DRC発症例の隣国への波及報告または患者搬送先に過ぎない。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる感染爆発で、実際の主要発生国はDRCのみ（Ituri州、North Kivu州）。WPRO評価対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: 漢他病毒再增1例！林口男工作時遭老鼠咬傷   疾管署：40歲以上男性占多數 - 自由健康網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another hantavirus case reported! A man in Linkou was bitten by a rat at work; Taiwan CDC says men over 40 account for the majority.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 May 2026, Taiwan reports its third hantavirus syndrome case this year: a man in his 40s from Linkou, New Taipei, who was bitten by a rat while working in Keelung. He developed fever, chills and limb weakness; hospital tests confirmed hantavirus syndrome. Eleven nearby contacts at home and work are under health monitoring but show no symptoms. The case follows ongoing rodent-control efforts at home and workplace. Since 2017 Taiwan has documented 46 hantavirus cases, with 31 males (67.4%) and 31 patients aged 40+ (67.4%), including one imported case from Indonesia. Transmission occurs via inhalation of dust contaminated with rodent excreta, urine or saliva, or through direct bites. Prevention centers on not inviting mice, safe food storage, and careful cleaning using ventilation, masks, gloves, and a 1:9 bleach solution, avoiding sweeping or vacuuming.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス感染症がさらに1例増加！林口の男性が仕事中にネズミに咬まれる 疾管署：40歳以上の男性が大多数を占める
triage.triage_reason: 台湾でハンタウイルス症候群の散発例が報告されており、ヒト-ヒト感染ではなく動物由来感染症として低い流行リスク。ただし確認された症例数、地域内での接触者追跡が実施されており、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 台湾はWHO対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列。記事は香港・マカオではなく台湾での発生であり、China に含めない。ハンタウイルスは通常ヒト-ヒト感染せず、接触者11名は症状なし。散発例の継続報告として経過観察推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемија на ебола во Конго: Над 118 мртви, заразата се шири - 24info.mk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in Congo: Over 118 dead, the infection is spreading.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed at least 118 and infected more than 390, with spread to Nyakunde (Ituri), Butembo (North Kivu), and Goma. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain is involved, and the World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. In neighboring Uganda, two confirmed cases and one death have been reported. An American physician working in DRC tested positive for Ebola and will be treated in Germany, with the CDC confirming the case; the medical mission organization involved says his wife and another colleague were exposed and are in quarantine. CBS reports at least six American nationals have been exposed. The CDC is coordinating enhanced entry screening for travelers from the affected areas within 21 days, expanding testing capacity, and advising airlines on contact tracing; the U.S. has a Level 4 travel advisory for the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行：118人以上が死亡、感染が拡大している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルスの多国間の国際的な拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、米国への輸出例）と公衆衛生上の重大な影響が確認されており、WHOがPHEIC宣言を行っている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはウガンダと米国での確認例が記載されているが、発生地は DRC が主体であり、対象国リストでは DRC のみに該当。PHEC宣言済み、118人以上の死亡、390人以上の感染が確認されており、Bundibugyo ebolavirus株が特定されている。米国の Level 4 旅行勧告およびCDCの入国スクリーニング実施は国際的な関心・対応の高さを示す。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak, but no vaccine; WHO declares international emergency over rare strain spread
article.articleSummary: WHO declares Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) over the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province) and Uganda, with rapid cross-border spread and no approved vaccine or specific antiviral for this strain. The Bundibugyo virus (BVD) is rarer than Zaire Ebola and had been reported previously in 2007 and 2012; fatality prior outbreaks ranged 30–50%. Origin traced to early May 2026 in Ituri near Uganda and South Sudan borders. By May 15, DR Congo’s Ituri reported 246 suspected cases and 80 suspected deaths, with eight laboratory-confirmed infections; the virus also appeared in Mongbwalu, Rwampara, and Bunia. Uganda confirmed two imported cases, including at least one death, in Kampala. Reuters cited over 300 suspected cases and more than 100 fatalities overall. WHO recommendations: activate surveillance, cross-border screening, contact tracing, infection prevention, safe isolation/treatment centers, and community risk communication; borders should not be broadly closed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの発生だが、ワクチンなし。WHO は希少株の蔓延に対して国際緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で該当。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的な拡大、WHO による PHEIC 宣言があり、フルリスク評価（RRA）を実施すべきシグナルである。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola（BVD）の発生は希少で、致死率30～50%の高リスク株。Ituri州が主要な発生地であり、ウガンダへの越境拡大が確認されている。WHO が PHEIC を宣言し、ワクチンおよび治療薬なし。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Symptoms of Ebola and how it spreads as officials confirm 131 dead in major outbreak
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo centered in Ituri province, caused by Bundibugyo strain. As of now, 131 deaths and about 500 infections since the outbreak began. WHO has labeled it an international emergency with potential to spread further. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment; fatality without treatment is around 90% generally, with Bundibugyo lethality potentially up to 50%. Symptoms range from incubation 2-21 days; typical onset 8-10 days, starting with dry symptoms that progress to severe wet symptoms, making diagnosis difficult. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids; not airborne. Six American citizens are believed exposed; CDC says they are attempting safe withdrawal; one American tested positive and was transported to Germany for care. The outbreak centers on DRC's Ituri, the country's 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976; CDC warns travelers to Congo and Uganda to exercise enhanced precautions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ症状と感染方法：当局が大規模な流行で131人の死亡を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルスは公衆衛生上の重大な脅威であり、複数国への国際的拡大が既に認識されており、WHO国際緊急宣言対象である。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）によるDRC東部イトゥリ州での大規模流行。死亡者131名、感染者約500名。WHO国際緊急事態宣言済み。アメリカ国民6名が曝露、1名が確認感染しドイツに搬送。国際的拡大リスクが高い。CDCは旅行者にコンゴとウガンダへの強化警戒を勧告。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고·우간다서 에볼라 사망자 130명 넘어...WHO, 비상사태 선포
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths exceed 130 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda... WHO declares a state of emergency.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak across the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda has surpassed 130 deaths. The DRC Ministry of Health reports at least 131 fatalities and over 390 confirmed cases as of May 18. The Bundibugjo (Bundibugyo) strain, first identified in Uganda in 2007 and previously seen in DRC in 2012, currently lacks a vaccine or approved therapy, making containment rely on standard infection prevention measures. The northeast Ituri region near the Uganda border, including Mongualu, Lewampara, and Bunia, is affected, with additional confirmed cases in Goma and two Ugandan cases in Kampala (one fatal). WHO declared an International Public Health Emergency (PHEIC) the day before, though not a pandemic. Neighboring nations—Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania—tightened border surveillance, while South Africa heightened airport/port screening. A U.S. missionary physician contracted Ebola and was evacuated to Germany; the U.S. plans to repatriate Americans and suspend visa processing related to Uganda/DRC."

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴ・ウガンダでエボラ死者130名超え...WHO、非常事態宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症の多発死亡事例、国際的拡大リスク、WHOによるPHEIC宣言があり、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラウイルス感染症の最初の発生国は民主コンゴとウガンダであることが確認できる。隣接国（ルワンダ、ブルンジ、タンザニア）は監視体制強化だが、本発生地はDRCとウガンダに限定。米国とドイツに避難した患者は2次症例でない。WHOによるPHEIC（Public Health Emergency of International Concern）宣言は国際的対応の必要性を示している。

article.articleHeadline: Американец е заразен с ебола, докараха го в Европа
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American infected with Ebola was brought to Europe
article.articleSummary: An American doctor with the medical missionary group SERG tested positive for Ebola after exposure while treating patients at Nyankunde Hospital in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo. He was evacuated to Germany for treatment after developing symptoms over the weekend, the CDC said. The DRC outbreak has killed at least 131 people and involves more than 513 suspected cases. Two other doctors exposed, including Dr. Rebecca Stafford, are asymptomatic and quarantined; the Stafford family and their four children are under risk monitoring. The CDC is evacuating at least six additional exposed Americans. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with no approved medicines or vaccines. WHO has declared it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; the United States has travel restrictions for visitors who recently entered DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan. Symptoms appear 2–21 days after exposure, including fever, headache, and fatigue.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染のアメリカ人医師がヨーロッパに搬送された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラ出血熱は国際的影響が極めて深刻で、WHO-PHEICが宣言されており、死亡例と多数の疑い症例を伴う。国際的拡大リスク（患者のドイツ搬送、複数国への渡航制限）が顕著。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、実際のイベント発生地は DRC（Bunia, Ituri州）のみ。患者搬送先のドイツ・アメリカは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。Sudan・Uganda は発生地域に含まれるが、サマリーでは「渡航制限対象国」として言及されるのみで、実際の症例発生地ではないため除外。スーダンとウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、DRC のみ確認。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ alarm verdi: Ebola salgını küresel halk sağlığı acil durumu ilan edildi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Raises Alarm: Ebola Outbreak Declared a Global Public Health Emergency
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak centered in the Ituri region of the Democratic Republic of the Congo near the Uganda border, prompting the WHO to declare a Global Public Health Emergency. Africa CDC reports 395 suspected cases and 106 deaths in the DRC and Uganda; Kampala, Uganda, has two lab-confirmed cases, one fatal. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle and throat pain, progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, and bleeding. Bundibugyo ebolavirus carries a 25–40% case fatality rate; Ebola mortality historically ranges 25–90%. No approved vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo. CDC has activated Title 42, expanding screenings and possible entry restrictions for travelers from Uganda, DRC, and South Sudan, especially for non-U.S. citizens who have been in those countries in the prior three weeks. WHO cautions that confirmed plus suspected cases indicate a larger outbreak, and ongoing conflict and weak health systems hinder control.

triage.headline_ja: WHO警告を発出：エボラアウトブレイクが世界保健上の緊急事態として宣言された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス疾患の大規模国際的蔓延が示唆されている。WHO が Global Public Health Emergency を宣言した最高レベルのシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、エボラアウトブレイクの主要発生地はコンゴ民主共和国(Ituri region)であり、ウガンダへの波及が確認されている。しかし評価対象国リストではDRCのみ該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみを記載。本イベントはWHOによる Global Public Health Emergency 宣言、複数国への国際的拡大、高い致死率、ワクチン・治療法の不在、米国による入国制限措置(Title 42)の発動など、すべての基準で最高レベルのリスクを示唆している。フルRRA即時実施推奨。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: 40 νεκροί σε μία μόλις ημέρα στο Κονγκό - Τουλάχιστον 131 θάνατοι συνολικά
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 40 dead in a single day in Congo - at least 131 deaths overall.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has caused at least 131 deaths among more than 513 reported cases, with 24 deaths in a single day yesterday. Congolese authorities say the outbreak now spans a broader area. Two confirmed cases and one death have been reported in Uganda, per the CDC. The circulating variant is rare, leaving fewer tools to stop the virus, killing about one-third of those infected. The outbreak has expanded for weeks in a region troubled by civil conflict. The WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though risk remains low and not a Covid-like pandemic; during the 2014-2016 outbreak the United Kingdom had only three cases, all healthcare workers. Neighbouring countries Uganda, South Sudan, and Rwanda are high risk due to trade and travel links. Experts warn the epidemic could escalate toward West Africa’s 2014-2016 scale, underscoring the need for international coordination.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴで1日で40人が死亡 - 総死亡数は少なくとも131人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。WHO公開衛生上の危機宣言済みであり、複数国での確認と国際的拡大リスクが顕著。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでエボラ出血熱の発生地として明確に記述されているのはDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）。ウガンダでは2例の確認と1死亡が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。スーダン、アンゴラ、ルワンダは発生地域リストに含まれているが、記事サマリーでは当該国での発生が記述されておらず、対象国に含まれないため除外。公式なPHEIC宣言済みで、高い死亡率（感染者の約1/3が死亡）と複数国への波及可能性が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola returns, Nepal weighs its risks
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus is spreading rapidly in Congo, with cases reaching Uganda; WHO has declared a public health emergency. The Bundibugyo strain is highly dangerous and spreads through direct or indirect contact with infected bodily fluids (blood, vomit, urine, feces, saliva, sweat, semen) or contaminated materials; it is not airborne. Early symptoms resemble fever, typhoid, or malaria, with fatigue, sore throat, and body aches; later stages can include severe bleeding. The fatality rate for Bundibugyo is around 40%, while overall Ebola mortality can approach 50%. In Nepal, the immediate risk is low but not zero due to global travel. Preparations include central surveillance, standby laboratories, fever screening at Tribhuvan International Airport, isolation of suspected cases, and rapid response teams, with coordination under WHO and IHR and strict protocols for travelers from Africa. Authorities urge caution but not panic; no vaccine or specific treatment is yet available for this strain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱が再発、ネパールがそのリスクを検討
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO緊急事態宣言済みで、複数国での進行中の感染確認。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴでのエボラウイルス拡大およびウガンダへの拡大が明示されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ（ウガンダは対象外）。ネパールはリスク評価国として記載されるが、発生地ではなく対象国でもないため verified_locations に含めない。WHO緊急事態宣言済み、致死率40～50%の高リスク病原体、複数国での流行進行中という重大性から PICKUP 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемија на ебола во Конго, повеќе од 118 починати
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Epidemic in Congo, More Than 118 Dead.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed at least 118 people and infected more than 390, with spread to Nyakunde (Ituri), Butembo (North Kivu), and the city of Goma. In Uganda, two confirmed cases and one death are reported per the CDC. The World Health Organization has declared the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Congolese authorities stress ongoing surveillance and contact tracing and urge calm amid confirmed new cases. An American physician working in DRC, Peter Stafford, tested positive for Ebola; his wife Dr. Rebecca Stafford and another colleague were exposed and placed in quarantine. Stafford will be transported to Germany for treatment, according to CBS News; the CDC has not released his identity. This outbreak highlights cross-border risk and the need for continued international public health response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行、118人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症の国際的な公衆衛生上の危機であり、複数国への拡大、国際的な支援体制が確立されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでの症例報告、ドイツへの医療搬送言及があるが、発生地は明確にDRCであり、ウガンダはPHEIC宣言の文脈での言及。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。Bundibugyo strain のPHEIC宣言、118人以上の死亡、390人以上の感染、北キブ州・イツリ州・ゴマでの拡大が記述。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Horror in DR Congo: 120 Dead as Outbreak Spreads - Is There a Cure for the Deadly Virus?
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 120 deaths as the outbreak spreads. As of 2026-05-19, health officials report that delayed diagnosis was a major challenge, with early laboratory tests looking for the wrong Ebola strain, producing false-negative results and allowing the virus to circulate undetected for weeks. Matthew M. Kavanagh of Georgetown University, cited by the Associated Press, warned that missed or delayed identification leaves communities vulnerable to rapid transmission. Public health specialists note that even small delays in outbreak detection can worsen spread in settings with limited healthcare access and high population movement. The piece underscores diagnostic accuracy and timely laboratory confirmation as critical to curbing transmission, highlighting the need to align tests with circulating strains to prevent further losses.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ恐怖がDR コンゴで発生：120人が死亡、感染が拡大 - この致命的なウイルスに治療法はあるのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響（120人の死亡）、異常な発生、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限リスクを有するため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の確認症例で120人の死亡が報告されている。診断の遅延と誤った検査が流行の拡大を助長しており、公衆衛生上の重大懸念。Georgetown大学の専門家も引用されており、社会的・政治的関心も高い。ただし記事が2026年の日付となっており、時系列の検証が必要。

article.articleHeadline: SC's Big Directive: Euthanasia Allowed For Rabid And 'Dangerous' Stray Dogs
article.articleSummary: Rabid and dangerous stray dogs may be euthanized, as the Supreme Court ruled on May 19, citing the stray dog menace as at alarming proportions. The directive allows authorities to pick up stray dogs across districts, sterilize and vaccinate them, and release them back into the same areas. However, dogs removed from sensitive public spaces—hospitals, schools, and bus stands—must not be released at those locations after treatment. The ruling seeks to curb rabies transmission and aggressive incidents by combining euthanasia for the most dangerous cases with population control through sterilization and vaccination, establishing a framework for immediate intervention across districts.

triage.headline_ja: 最高裁の大きな指令：狂犬病に感染した危険な野犬に対する安楽死が許可
triage.triage_reason: インドの最高裁によるペット動物（野犬）の狂犬病対策指令に関する記事であり、公衆衛生に関連する政策決定を扱っている。しかし、実際の狂犬病発生事例や患者・動物の具体的な状況に関する情報が記事サマリーに含まれておらず、感染症の「イベント」というより政策判断の報道である可能性が高いため、追加情報による判定を要する。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病対策の司法判断に関する報道であり、進行中の感染症アウトブレイク情報ではなく、既存の公衆衛生課題への対応策の記事と判断される。狂犬病は人獣共通感染症で拡大リスクが存在するため、ただし実際の発生規模や死亡者数等の疫学情報が不足しているため WATCH とした。続報があれば、実際の患者数・死亡数など具体的な疫学情報の追加により判定を変更される可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Inside Biotech: Island Pharmaceuticals pushes deeper into US biodefence as Ebola fears spark interest
article.articleSummary: Central Africa's Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda prompted the WHO to declare an international public health emergency, reigniting investor interest in Island Pharmaceuticals Ltd (ASX:ILA, OTC:ILA) as it deepens engagement with US biodefence-linked Marburg virus programs. Island's antiviral candidate Galidesivir, with prior activity across Ebola, Marburg, MERS, Zika and yellow fever, is being advanced toward FDA Animal Rule studies for Marburg while the Ebola outbreak broadens interest in its biodefence potential. A sharp Monday rally (stock up >20%), followed by a modest retreat after a biodefense update, underscores market sensitivity around regulatory milestones and outbreak headlines. Island appointed Mark Herzog as senior global health security adviser and secured seats on Medical Countermeasures Coalition working groups to align with US stockpiling frameworks. While Marburg remains the primary focus, Ebola headlines emphasize antiviral preparedness and government procurement pathways.

triage.headline_ja: バイオテック最新情報：エボラ懸念が高まる中、Island Pharmaceuticalsが米国バイオディフェンスへの関与を深める
triage.triage_reason: 複数の高リスク感染症（エボラ、マールブルグ）が中央アフリカで発生し、WHO国際公衆衛生緊急事態宣言の対象となっており、IHR基準2つ以上に該当。国際的拡大リスクと深刻な公衆衛生影響が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは主にエボラおよびマールブルグウイルスの中央アフリカ（DRC・ウガンダ）での発生と、それに伴うWHO国際公衆衛生緊急事態宣言に焦点を当てている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。米国の記載は製薬企業の本拠地・規制枠組み関連であり、実際の疾病発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC declares Ebola outbreak public health emergency of continental security
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, Africa CDC declared the latest Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda a public health emergency of continental security. About 395 suspected cases and 106 associated deaths have been reported in the DRC, concentrated in Mongwalu, Rwampara, and Bunia health zones, with Kampala, Uganda recording two cases and one death. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which no strain-specific vaccine is currently available, signaling a high risk of regional spread. The declaration aims to strengthen regional coordination, mobilize emergency resources, and accelerate preparedness in neighboring countries. Cross-border movement, insecurity in affected areas, and weak infection control could amplify transmission. Africa CDC has deployed emergency response teams to support containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: Africa CDCがアフリカ大陸の保健安全保障上の公衆衛生上の緊急事態としてエボラ集団発生を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で肯定される。エボラウイルス病の大陸規模の公式宣言、複数国への拡大、高い死亡率、地域的脅威は確実なリスク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、DRCとウガンダでのエボラ集団発生が述べられている。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみを含める。ウガンダはリストに含まれていないため除外。Bundibugyo株は特定のワクチンがなく、地域的拡大リスクが高い。Africa CDC宣言は高い政治的・社会的関心を示す。

article.articleHeadline: ONU speră că focarul de Ebola din Uganda și RDC poate fi ținut sub control
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UN hopes that the Ebola outbreak in Uganda and the DRC can be brought under control.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the United Nations hopes the Ebola outbreak affecting Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo can be brought under control, per UN Deputy Spokesperson Farhan Haq. The World Health Organization previously designated the outbreak in DRC and Uganda as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Haq noted UN readiness to confront the virus in other African countries and said, at this stage, there is no reason to believe this Ebola strain could spread so far. The report underscores international concern about cross-border transmission, with no case counts provided. The focus remains on containment and international coordination.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、ウガンダとコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行が管理下に置けることを期待
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）し、WHO公式にPHEIC指定されているため、即座にフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: Uganda(発生地域に含まれているが対象国リストに未含)での発生も記事で言及されているため、DRCのみ verified_locations に含める。WHOによるPHEIC指定済みで、既に正式なグローバル関心事項である。ウイルス株の拡散リスクについてはまだ限定的との評価だが、国境を越えた感染の懸念は明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: हंतावायरस और इबोला से लेकर जंग तक, लॉकडाउन जैसे हालात के लिए घर में पहले से रखें ये लाइफ सेविंग गैजेट्स
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From Hantavirus and Ebola to War, Keep These Life-Saving Gadgets at Home in Advance for Lockdown-Like Situations.
article.articleSummary: May 19, 2026: Hantavirus concerns re-emerge globally as cases linked to rodent exposure—transmission via contaminated rodent urine, feces or saliva, and potentially airborne particles in confined spaces. Early symptoms resemble fever and body pains; severe cases can cause breathing difficulties. Ebola virus is spreading, with the WHO declaring it a health emergency. Iran–United States tensions over undersea internet cables threaten internet service, online work, and fuel prices. Although India shows no lockdown directives yet, lockdown-like scenarios are anticipated, prompting readiness for work-from-home continuity. For households, key preps include strong internet connectivity with a backup mobile data/hotspot, reliable computer, power backup (inverter/power bank), webcam, and earphones for online meetings. Health devices such as a digital thermometer, pulse oximeter, blood pressure monitor; nebulizer and steam apparatus for breathing issues. Sanitation items: sanitizer, masks, gloves; a basic medicines and first-aid kit.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスとエボラからも戦争まで、ロックダウンのような状況に備えて自宅に事前に用意しておくべき命を救うガジェット
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルスとエボラの両方が言及されており、エボラは WHO が健康上の緊急事態を宣言している。しかし、記事は主に家庭の備品ガイダンスであり、具体的な流行の詳細や被害規模が不明。検証可能な対象国内での実際の発生状況の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は複数の疾患（ハンタウイルス、エボラ）を言及しているが、サマリーからは具体的な確定患者数や死亡数、インドでの直接的な流行の証拠が不明確。エボラについて WHO が緊急宣言したとの記述があるが、発生地域の明示がない。記事の主目的は家庭の備品ガイダンスであり、公衆衛生リスク評価というより社会的なアドバイス記事の性質が強い。インドでのロックダウン指令はまだないとも記述されている。続報で感染数、死亡数、インド国内での実際の流行状況を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Bahaya Hantavirus, Jangan Langsung Sapu Kotoran Tikus Kering
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus Danger: Do Not Sweep Up Dry Rat Droppings Directly
article.articleSummary: May 19, 2026 — Indonesian health authorities warn against sweeping dry rat droppings to prevent airborne Hantavirus particles. Hantavirus is a zoonosis known in Indonesia since the 1980s, transmitted through urine, feces, and saliva of infected rats, mainly when people inhale contaminated dust or contact droppings. Do not sweep or suction dry nests and droppings; dampen the area with disinfectant first. Early symptoms include fever, muscle pains (thighs, back, shoulders), and malaise with headache. In the later stage (4–10 days), patients may develop acute shortness of breath from fluid buildup in the lungs. Preventive measures focus on environmental cleanliness to deter rats and handwashing with soap after activities in risk areas. The warning emphasizes vigilance rather than panic, noting the virus’ long-standing presence in the country.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスの危険性：乾いたネズミの排泄物を直接掃除しないでください
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでハンタウイルス感染症に関する公衆衛生警告が発令されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常/予想外、重症度、流行しやすさ）に複数該当する。ただし具体的な患者数や確定患者の報告がなく、情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ハンタウイルスはインドネシアで1980年代から既知の風土病であり、新規発生ではない。記事は公衆衛生警告・啓発の性格が強く、患者の集団発生やアウトブレイク報告は明示されていない。確定患者数、死亡数、地域の拡大状況などの詳細情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ο ΠΟΥ κήρυξε κατάσταση έκτακτης ανάγκης για τη δημόσια υγεία λόγω του Έμπολα | MEGA TV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO Declared a Public Health Emergency Due to Ebola | MEGA TV
article.articleSummary: WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Transmission is via close contact with bodily fluids, not airborne. The declaration reflects international concern amid large regional population movements and cross-border travel. Proposed measures include airport temperature screening and brief traveler questionnaires. Greece's National Public Health Organization (EODY) has activated its mechanisms and will issue updated travel guidance. There is no specific antiviral treatment for this Ebola strain; care is supportive. Theodoros Vasilakopoulos notes the outbreak has occurred before in the DRC and emphasizes border-control measures to limit spread. The article underscores the risk to neighboring countries and the need for heightened surveillance and public health measures at points of entry.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラ出血熱に関連する公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言 | MEGA TV
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO公式の国際保健上の事例報告であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事は主としてDRCでのエボラ発生に関連するWHOの国際保健上の事例報告（PHEIC）について述べている。ギリシャ（Hellenic Republic）はサマリーに記載されていますが、それは対応国として言及されているのみであり、発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。DRCは対象国リスト外であるが、WHO公式PHEIC宣言であるため PICKUP 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: WHO ने इबोला को क्यों माना 'ग्लोबल हेल्थ इमरजेंसी'? | Who Declared Ebola Global Health Emergency Know Why
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why did WHO regard Ebola as a 'Global Health Emergency'?
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the World Health Organization has declared Ebola a Global Health Emergency. The outbreak spans the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province) and neighboring Uganda. The rare Bundibugyo strain is responsible; this strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. There have been 246 suspected Ebola cases and 88 deaths reported to date. The outbreak began in Ituri Province, DRC, but has crossed into Uganda, signaling cross-border transmission. Public health authorities are concerned the situation could spiral, especially in conflict-affected areas where response is hampered. The lack of a licensed vaccine or targeted therapy for Bundibugyo Ebola complicates containment. Ongoing monitoring and cross-border coordination are essential to prevent wider spread, with emphasis on rapid case finding, safe burials, and infection control in affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラを「グローバルヘルスエマージェンシー」と宣言した理由は？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラの国際宣言、稀な株による国境越境感染、死亡率の高さ、ワクチン・治療法の欠如により公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明確に DRC(Ituri Province)と Uganda での発生が報告されている。Uganda は対象国リストに含まれていないため、DRC のみを verified_locations に含める。稀な Bundibugyo 株による初の国際的なエボラ宣言で、ワクチン・治療法の欠如、紛争地域での対応困難、越境感染リスクが複合的に存在。WHO による PHEIC 宣言により国際的警戒レベルが最高度に引き上げられている。

article.articleHeadline: Authorities close Ishasha-Kyeshero border over Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC prompts Uganda to close Ishasha-Kyeshero border posts to curb cross-border transmission as of May 19, 2026. Ugandan authorities, including the Kanungu District Resident District Commissioner, beef up border monitoring and deploy patrols along porous borders. Kisoro District officials discussed extending controls to the Busanza-Kitagoma and Bunagana borders after convening an Ebola task force; health alerts were issued via social media to village health teams and traders. Local leaders advised Ugandans crossing into DRC for farming to exercise caution, and the Mupaka Town Council urged vigilance among border communities. No case or death counts are provided in the report; authorities emphasize preventive measures, surveillance, and potential additional border closures to protect Ugandans from Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: 当局がエボラをめぐってイシャシャ・キェシェロ国境を閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準で3項目該当。エボラウイルス病の流行による越境感染リスクが高く、複数国境での管理措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行がウガンダの国境管理措置を引き起こしたことを明示。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず。越境感染リスクと複数国境での予防的措置が確認される。現在のところ確定患者数は報告されていないが、公式な感染症警報が発令されている。

article.articleHeadline: الولايات المتحدة تعزز إجراءاتها الصحية بعد إصابة مواطن أميركي بـ"إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States steps up its health measures after an American citizen contracted Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On May 19, 2026, the United States tightens health measures after an American contracted Ebola while working in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, marking an imported case amid an ongoing outbreak there. The World Health Organization has declared an international health emergency over Ebola in the DRC. In response, the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention announced enhanced precautions including screening travelers from affected areas and a temporary suspension of visa services for several countries. The CDC assessed the direct risk to Americans as low, with potential adjustments as new information emerges. President Donald Trump expressed concern but suggested the outbreak remains confined to Africa for now. This incident underscores heightened vigilance during an active Ebola transmission period in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 米国民がエボラに感染した後、米国は健康対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱のDRCでの流行に伴う輸入症例であり、米国による厳格な対応が開始されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは米国でのエボラ輸入症例が報告されているが、実際の流行発生地はDRCであり、米国は対応国として記載。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。米国はリスト外のため除外。WHOによる国際保健緊急事態宣言とCDCの強化措置により、社会的・政治的関心は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Cel puțin 131 de morți în urma focarului de Ebola din Congo. OMS: O urgență internațională
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At least 131 dead as a result of the Ebola outbreak in Congo. WHO: An international emergency.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, at least 131 deaths are linked to an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with more than 513 suspected cases and spread across Nyakunde (Ituri), Butembo (North Kivu), and Goma, indicating multi-province transmission. Uganda reports two cases and one death, signaling regional spread. The Bundibugyo strain is implicated, and the WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Operators warn the outbreak could escalate beyond current estimates as surveillance and contact tracing expand. An American physician, Peter Stafford, tested positive and will be treated in Germany; his wife Dr. Rebekah Stafford and two exposed colleagues are in quarantine. The CDC is aiding safe evacuation of a small number of U.S. citizens and implementing travel measures: enhanced traveler screening, restrictions for non-U.S. citizens who recently traveled to DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan within 21 days, and airline contact tracing. Rwanda tightened border checks; Nigeria monitors. Context references the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (over 28,600 cases, 11,325 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ熱感染拡大で少なくとも131人が死亡。WHO：国際的な保健上の緊急事態
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ熱は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、複数州での多数の死亡と地域的拡大（ウガンダへの流入）が確認されており、WHOが国際的保健上の緊急事態を宣言している。
triage.notes: エボラ熱の急速な地域拡大、多数の死亡、WHO国際的保健上の緊急事態宣言、米国を含む国際的対応の実施が確認される。ウガンダへの流入も報告されているが、サマリーの主題はDRCの発生であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Virus Disease: क्या है इबोला वायरस? भारत पर मंडरा रहा खतरा! जानें लक्षण, कारण और बचाव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Virus Disease: What is Ebola virus? A looming threat to India! Learn the symptoms, causes and prevention.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) is a highly dangerous pathogen affecting humans and animals. The virus group Orthoebolaviruses, historically called Ebola virus, was first identified in 1976 near the Ebola River in Africa. Transmission occurs person-to-person through blood, sweat, and other body fluids, with infection risk from animals. Symptoms typically appear 2–21 days after exposure and include high fever, weakness, headache, vomiting, and diarrhea; as illness advances, internal or external bleeding may occur. Currently, most cases are reported in African countries, with the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda the most affected, while some neighboring nations are under investigation. Prevention emphasizes avoiding contact with infected fluids, regular handwashing with soap and water or sanitizer, and using gloves and masks when caring for the sick. Health authorities monitor spread and urge prompt medical care and isolation for suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病：エボラウイルスとは何か？インドに迫る脅威！症状、原因、予防を学ぶ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスは極めて高い公衆衛生的影響を持つ予想外の感染症であり、複数アフリカ国での発生報告、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性がすべて認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダが最も影響を受けていると述べられているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。見出しでインドへの脅威を強調しているが、実際の発生地はアフリカ諸国であり、インドは対象外。記事配信日が2026年5月であり、将来日時となっているが、評価基準には影響しない。

article.articleHeadline: US responds to Ebola outbreak in Africa
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda triggers a U.S.-led, multi-agency response to contain transmission and protect Americans. On May 15, 2026, the State Department activated an interagency coordination cell in Washington, with the DRC, Rwanda, South Sudan, and Uganda embassies forming monitoring groups and meeting daily. Travel advisories were updated, and a Title 42 order issued May 18 prohibiting entry to foreign nationals who visited the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the prior 21 days. CDC and DHS guidance on quarantine and possible repatriation of exposed Americans are coordinating with the Department. Within 48 hours, the U.S. mobilized $13 million for surveillance, lab capacity, risk communication, safe burials, screening, and clinical management. May 14 announced $1.8B for OCHA pooled funds, including $250M for DRC and Uganda, to support humanitarian and outbreak response with UN partners and allies as part of the America First global health strategy.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、アフリカのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。WPRO基準でも重症度・流行可能性・管理可能性で該当。社会的・政治的関心も高く、対象国（DRC）での実感染症イベント。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイクが明記されているが、対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが含まれるため verified_locations に登録。米国の対応（Title 42命令、予算措置）は地政学的関心を示唆。エボラウイルスの国際的拡大リスク、深刻な感染症による公衆衛生への影響、渡航制限措置の実施が確認され、シグナル基準を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: DRC reports 118 suspected Ebola deaths as epidemic spreads
article.articleSummary: DRC reports 118 suspected Ebola deaths as outbreak spreads. As of 2026-05-19, the DRC has 11 laboratory-confirmed and 336 suspected cases; Uganda has 2 confirmed cases (including 1 death), both with recent travel to the DRC. Cases have been reported in five health zones, with North Kivu specifically cited. The WHO declared the Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda a public health emergency of international concern. Authorities urge reduced close contact and prompt reporting of symptoms. WHO Africa Region has delivered nearly 12 tons of emergency supplies to the DRC, predominantly PPE. The African Union Commission calls for intensified support for preparedness, surveillance, and rapid response. Ebola mortality is about 50%; transmission occurs from wild animals and via direct contact with blood and other bodily fluids of infected individuals. Ugandan cases are linked to travel from the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: DRCがエボラウイルスによる118件の疑い死亡例を報告、流行が拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラウイルスの国際的拡大（DRC→ウガンダ）、WHOによる国際的関心喚起（PHEIC宣言）、高い死亡率（約50%）と重症度から、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダはGeoNames対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。ただし記事では「DRCとウガンダ両国での確認」が明示されており、国際的拡大の重要な要素。DRCのみを対象国として認定するが、ウガンダへの拡大は深刻度を大きく高める。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, oltre 130 morti in Congo: Oms dichiara emergenza globale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, over 130 dead in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: WHO declares global emergency.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused at least 131 deaths with hundreds of suspected cases, prompting the World Health Organization to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The disease is spreading beyond initial foci into eastern Congo and has confirmed cases in neighboring Uganda. The outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo strain, a rare variant for which there is no effective vaccine or specific cure. Border controls are being strengthened to curb cross-border transmission. The international emergency underscores a coordinated, accelerated response, surveillance, and containment efforts across affected areas and neighboring regions, as laboratory-confirmed cases in Uganda confirm cross-border spread and ongoing transmission remains a concern as new infections are reported.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴで130人以上の死亡：WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な健康影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）、WHO PHEIC宣言、複数国への確認事例、高い社会的・政治的関心がある。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）は発生地域に含まれているが、対象国リストに該当しないため除外。DRC はリスト内の対象国（203312）として verified_locations に含める。WHO PHEIC宣言により国際的な重大性が確認されている。Bundibugyo株は有効なワクチンがない稀な株であり、管理可能性が低い。

article.articleHeadline: الولايات المتحدة تعزز إجراءاتها الصحية بعد إصابة أمريكي بفيروس إيبولا في الكونغو الديموقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States steps up health measures after an American contracts Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo triggers stepped-up U.S. health measures. The U.S. will implement airport screenings and restrict entry for non-U.S. passport holders who have traveled to Uganda, DRC, or South Sudan in the past 21 days. The WHO has declared an international health emergency. A U.S. citizen contracted Ebola in DRC; symptoms appeared over the weekend and testing was positive late Sunday. The patient is being relocated to Germany for treatment; six more Americans are to be evacuated for health monitoring. About 25 people work at the U.S. Embassy in DRC, and the CDC will send an additional technical coordinator. Direct risk to the United States is considered low, but measures may be adjusted with new information. No vaccine or approved treatment exists for the current strain. Roughly 350 suspected cases, mostly ages 20–39, with over 60% female.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスに感染した米国人の後、保健措置を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の国際保健上の緊急事態宣言、複数国での確認症例、米国を含む国際的対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで確認されたエボラウイルス病のアウトブレイクの主要発生地はコンゴ民主共和国。ウガンダとスーダンは記事に言及されているが、主要な発生地としての明確な確認がないため verified_locations に含めない。WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言済み。患者数約350名（疑い症例含む）、致死率が高い感染症であり重症度は高い。米国で患者確認および国家レベルの対応が実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Watching Ebola Return
article.articleSummary: Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo, is at the center of the current Ebola outbreak with Bundibugyo strain confirmed on 15 May after a 5 May alert in Mongbwalu Health Zone. By 16 May, WHO reported eight laboratory-confirmed cases, 246 suspected cases, and 80 suspected deaths across Bunia, Rwampara and Mongbwalu; Uganda confirmed two imported cases from the DRC, including one death, and authorities noted local transmission reaching Kampala. WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 17 May, though not a pandemic. Early symptoms resemble malaria or flu, with progression to vomiting, diarrhoea, organ dysfunction, and sometimes bleeding. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected fluids; fruit bats are a likely reservoir, with animal spillover initiating human infections. There is no licensed vaccine or specific approved treatment for Bundibugyo virus disease. Weakened funding and strained health systems can undermine surveillance, testing, contact tracing, and isolation, elevating regional risk but limiting sustained global spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの再出現を監視中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。確定症例・疑い例・死亡例が多数報告され、ウガンダへの国際的波及が確認されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスの流行。DRCのイトゥリ州に加え、ウガンダへの越境事例と現地伝播がKampalaで確認。5月15日確定、5月17日にWHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言。ワクチン・特異的治療法なく、地域衛生システムが脆弱。ルワンダは地理的に隣接するため含まれているが、記事サマリー上ではDRCとウガンダのみが主題。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго уже как минимум 100 погибших от Эболы - Версии.com Фабрика аналитики
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, at least 100 have already died from Ebola - Versii.com Analytics Factory
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola outbreak has killed at least 100 people and infected more than 390, according to Africa CDC head Jean Kasaya. Uganda reports two confirmed cases and one death. With no approved medicines or vaccines, officials warn about heightened risk and emphasize safe burial practices. U.S. official Heidi Overton said one American shows Ebola symptoms with a positive test for the Buji-Budja Ebola strain; this patient and six other high-risk contacts will be evacuated from the region to Germany. The World Health Organization urges Congo and Uganda to conduct border screening and to heighten readiness among neighboring countries. Rwanda plans stronger border controls with DRC as a precaution, while Nigeria says it is monitoring the situation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴですでに少なくとも100人がエボラで死亡 - Versii.com分析工場
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：100人以上の死亡、予想外の大規模流行、国際的な拡大リスク顕在化、渡航制限の可能性）。エボラは最高リスク病原体であり、複数国での確認と米国での疑い患者発生により、直ちにフルRRAを実施する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、ドイツ、ルワンダ、ナイジェリアが言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（203312）のみ。エボラ出血熱は非常に高い致死率を有し、国際的警戒が必要。WHOが勧告を発出し、複数国が対応策を講じている状況が確認される。米国官関者により米国人患者の疑い事例も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Mỹ siết chặt quản lý biên giới sau khi phát hiện công dân nhiễm Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. tightens border controls after detecting Ebola-infected citizens.
article.articleSummary: A U.S. citizen tests positive for Bundibugyo Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, prompting unprecedented border controls and the first-ever U.S. use of an entry ban to curb an Ebola outbreak. The CDC imposes a 30-day entry ban on foreign nationals who have stayed in Uganda, the DRC, or South Sudan within the past 21 days. The patient, plus six Americans at high exposure risk, will be evacuated to Germany for treatment at a specialized hemorrhagic-fever facility. WHO has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. In Africa, the outbreak exceeds 300 suspected cases with at least 88 deaths; Bundibugyo Ebola has no vaccine and a 25–50% fatality rate. U.S. isolation facilities (e.g., Nebraska National Isolation Center, ~20 beds) remain on high alert, with enhanced airport screening and international coordination.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ感染者を検出した後、国境管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス感染症（PHEIC宣言済み）の国際的な拡大、複数国での患者発生、渡航制限の実施が確認される。スクリーニング基準も全項目該当し、社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言済み。ブンディブギョエボラウイルスはワクチン未承認で致死率25～50%と極めて高い。米国市民の感染者検出と国防総省による特殊隔離施設の設置により、国際的な対応が急速に強化されている。記事では北米（米国）とアフリカ（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）での発生が述べられているが、サマリーの主題はDRCでの発生と米国の対応策であるため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Η Ουάσιγκτον ανακοίνωσε την επιβολή υγειονομικών ελέγχων στα σύνορα - Μολύνθηκε Αμερικανός γιατρός | Η Εφημερίδα των Συντακτών
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Washington announced the imposition of border health checks - An American doctor was infected
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-19, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri and North Kivu provinces) has caused 91 deaths among about 350 suspected cases, with two deaths reported in neighboring Uganda. The Bundibugyo strain is implicated, and health officials believe transmission escalated weeks before detection; no vaccine or treatment exists. The United States imposed airport border health checks and entry restrictions for foreigners who have traveled to Uganda, the DRC, or South Sudan in the last 21 days. The US Embassy in Kampala temporarily suspended visa issuance. President Trump voiced concern, but officials say the immediate risk to the US public is low. CDC actions include deploying staff to support testing and contact tracing in affected areas; the State Department released $13 million for immediate intervention. Critics deem border checks largely theatrical, while the US has reduced funding through USAID and distanced from WHO, complicating international outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ワシントンが国境検疫を発表 - アメリカ人医師が感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラは高優先度疾患であり、複数国への拡大、死亡確認、米国の公式対応実施により、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（イトゥリ・北キブ州）が主な発生地であり、ウガンダに2件の死亡が報告されている。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。米国の対応は国境検疫実施などの公式措置であり、国際関心が極めて高い。Bundibugyo株の検出と治療法不在という点でも重大。

article.articleHeadline: OMS decreta nova emergência global por surto de Ebola na África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO declares a new global emergency due to Ebola outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: WHO declared a new global health emergency (PHEIC) on May 17, 2026, announced May 19, over an Ebola outbreak in Africa, focusing on the Bundibugyo strain. In the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province, 246 cases and 80 suspected deaths are reported. Uganda’s capital Kampala confirmed two laboratory-confirmed cases linked to travel from the DRC, including one death. This marks the ninth invocation of the PHEIC since 1969, though it is not classified as a pandemic. The emergency aims to marshal funding, enhance surveillance, isolate cases, trace contacts, and bolster health systems to curb cross-border spread. Notably, there are no vaccines or specific treatments for the Bundibugyo strain, underscoring the urgency of international coordination to contain the outbreak and protect neighboring regions.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがアフリカのエボラ出血熱流行に対する新たなグローバル緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで、DRCとウガンダで確認された多数の症例死亡、国際的拡大リスク、越境感染制御の必要性があり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Kampala）も地理的に確認されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのIturi州での246症例80死亡の報告、ウガンダへの越境感染確認により、明らかにシグナル基準を満たす。Bundibugyo株でのワクチン・特異的治療なしという情報は管理可能性の懸念をさらに強調している。

locations.name: Free and Hanseatic City of Hamburg

article.articleHeadline: Американски лекар се зарази с ебола, евакуират го спешно за лечение
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American doctor contracted Ebola and is being urgently evacuated for treatment.
article.articleSummary: An American doctor contracted Ebola virus disease during a humanitarian and medical mission in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Symptoms appeared late in the week; lab confirmation came late Sunday. The CDC confirmed the case; Satish Pillai, head of the U.S. Ebola response, says an urgent logistical operation is organizing an isolating medical flight to Germany for specialized treatment in a tightly controlled setting. DR Congo periodically endures Ebola outbreaks, with eastern and northwestern provinces among hardest hit due to forest-dwelling fruit bats, the virus' natural reservoir. Transmission occurs through direct contact with blood, body fluids, or tissues of infected humans or animals. Despite vaccines such as Ervebo, health workers remain at high risk. Germany offers high-containment facilities (negative-pressure rooms, filtration). The patient is slated for admission to Berlin Charité clinic or a unit in Frankfurt or Hamburg, where monoclonal antibodies like Inmazeb and Ebanga plus supportive care could be used.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ人医師がエボラに感染し、治療のため緊急搬送される
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確定症例（医療従事者）が発生し、国際的移動・治療支援が伴う。IHR基準3項目該当し、異常性・重症度・国際拡大リスクが明確。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCでのエボラ感染とドイツへの搬送であり、DRCにおいて実際の感染イベントが発生している。ドイツ（Hamburg、Berlin等）は治療受入国であり感染発生地ではないため除外。医療従事者の感染は職業的高リスク集団に該当し、人畜共通感染症の警告シグナルとなる。確定診断済みであり、疫学情報が良好。

article.articleHeadline: Alertă sanitară în Africa: Ebola face ravagii în Congo: peste 100 de morți și sute de cazuri suspecte. OMS declară urgență internațională
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health alert in Africa: Ebola is ravaging Congo: more than 100 deaths and hundreds of suspected cases. WHO declares an international emergency.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 100 deaths with over 390 suspected cases, signaling a rapidly worsening epidemic investigated by authorities. The World Health Organization has declared the Bundibugyo strain a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, reflecting risk of regional spread, including cross-border transmission to Uganda where two cases and one death have been confirmed by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. An American healthcare worker infected in Congo is slated for transfer to Germany for specialized treatment; CBS News notes at least six U.S. citizens may have been exposed. Authorities warn there are no vaccines or approved treatments for this strain, and adherence to public health measures—especially safe funeral practices—is critical to curb transmission, as the virus spreads through contact with infected bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの保健警報：エボラがコンゴで猛威：100人以上の死亡と数百件の疑わしい症例。WHOが国際的緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。WHO国際緊急事態宣言により社会的・政治的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC内での発生を主題としており、ウガンダへの越境感染確認、米国民の曝露、ドイツへの患者転送は二次的情報。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC)宣言により、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: ΗΠΑ: Υγειονομικοί έλεγχοι στα σύνορα λόγω Έμπολα σε γιατρό από Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: USA: Border health screenings due to Ebola in a doctor from Congo.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri and North Kivu, centered on Bunia) has caused about 350 suspected cases and 91 deaths, with two deaths in Uganda. The Bundibugyo strain is implicated; early tests misidentified the strain, delaying response. A U.S. citizen doctor, working since 2023 at a Bunia hospital, contracted Ebola and tested positive late Sunday; he is being transported to Germany for care. WHO declared the Congo outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The U.S. CDC says the immediate risk to the American public is small, but border screenings have been intensified and 21-day entry restrictions imposed for foreigners who traveled to Uganda, DRC, or South Sudan; the U.S. embassy in Kampala suspended visa issuance. No vaccine or specific treatment exists for this strain; ongoing testing, contact tracing, and international cooperation are prioritized.

triage.headline_ja: USA: コンゴの医師のエボラ感染に伴い、国境での保健スクリーニングを実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威が確認されており、IHR基準4項目全て該当、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全て該当。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで、複数国への拡大リスクと国際的な対応が既に進行中。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の確定的な国際的クライシス。DRC（イトゥリ州、北キブ州）での350例以上の疑い患者と91人の死亡が報告されており、ウガンダへの波及（2死亡）も確認。Bundibugyo株が関与し、初期の検査の誤認により対応が遅延した。米国市民医師の感染により、米国も直接関連国となっている。WHO PHEIC宣言、米国CDC による国境スクリーニング強化、入国制限など多くの国が対応を実施中。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: ΗΠΑ- Έμπολα: Η Ουάσινγκτον ανακοίνωσε την επιβολή υγειονομικών ελέγχων στα σύνορα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. - Ebola: Washington announced the imposition of health checks at the borders.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri and North Kivu) drives U.S. border health measures. A U.S. citizen, a physician who has worked in Bunia since 2023, contracted Ebola while treating patients and tested positive late Sunday; he will be moved to Germany for care. The CDC is implementing airport health screenings for travelers from affected African countries and is restricting entry for foreigners who have recently traveled to Uganda, the DRC, or South Sudan within 21 days. WHO has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. In the DRC, 91 deaths and about 350 suspected cases have been reported, mainly in Ituri and North Kivu, with two deaths in Uganda. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain is implicated, and there is no vaccine or specific therapy. The United States pledges support and funds; some officials criticize border measures as largely performative.

triage.headline_ja: 米国 - エボラ：ワシントンが国境での健康チェック実施を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大（米国で確認例あり）、WHO による国際懸念事項の宣言、複数国での流行（DRC、ウガンダ）により IHR 基準 4/4 該当。また WPRO スクリーニング基準も全て該当し、国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではエボラ流行の主要な発生地は DRC（Ituri および North Kivu）であり、ウガンダでの確認（2 死亡）は副次的。米国での確認例は DRC から帰国した医療従事者による。対象国リスト内では DRC のみが該当。Sudan と Uganda は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHO による PHEIC 宣言、350 件の疑い症例、91 死亡、ワクチンなし、という重篤性が確認され、フルリスク評価（RRA）への進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Η Ουάσινγκτον ανακοίνωσε την επιβολή υγειονομικών ελέγχων στα σύνορα - Dnews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Washington announced the imposition of health checks at the borders
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri and North Kivu, prompted WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. By May 2026, about 350 suspected cases and 91 deaths have been reported, with two deaths in neighboring Uganda; the Bundibugyo strain is implicated. An American doctor, working in Bunia since 2023, contracted Ebola while treating patients and was confirmed positive; he is being transferred to Germany for care. The CDC says immediate risk to the U.S. remains low, but surveillance continues and measures could be adjusted. The United States will implement enhanced airport health screenings for travelers from affected African countries and temporarily restrict visa issuance for foreigners who have recently traveled to Uganda, the DRC, or South Sudan; the U.S. embassy in Kampala suspended visa services.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：ワシントンが国境での衛生検査の実施を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。コンゴ民主共和国を中心としたエボラ出血熱の流行で350例の疑い例と91人の死亡が報告され、公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事由（PHEIC）が宣言されており、米国を含む複数国での対応が開始されている。
triage.notes: DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）における確認された流行地。サマリーではIturi、North Kivu地域での発生が記載されている。ウガンダでの2例の死亡報告があるが、記事の主題はDRC中心のエボラ流行と米国の対応措置であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。米国、ドイツは対応国だが発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Огнището на ебола: 30-дневни ограничения за пътуване в САЩ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak: 30-day travel restrictions to the United States.
article.articleSummary: An American physician contracted Ebola while working in the Democratic Republic of Congo. He developed symptoms over the weekend and tested positive late Sunday; he is being transferred to Germany for treatment. The CDC announced a 30-day travel entry ban to the United States for travelers who have recently visited regions with an ongoing Ebola outbreak. The restriction does not apply to U.S. citizens or permanent residents returning from the affected areas. Under Title 42, non-U.S. passport holders who have been in Uganda, the DRC, or South Sudan within the last 21 days will face entry restrictions for one month. The measures reflect ongoing Ebola outbreak concerns and aim to limit cross-border transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：米国への30日間の渡航制限
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラ出血熱の確認患者発生と複数国への拡大リスクがあり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Sudan, Uganda は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。米国内での患者発生も記載されているが、対象国ではないため除外。DRCでの流行と患者の国際移動（DRC→Germany）が確認される。複数国での渡航制限措置が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : Les personnels de santé se mobilisent pour faire face à l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Health workers mobilize to respond to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of May 18, 2026, Ebola is spreading in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, prompting health worker mobilization. In Ituri province, 105 deaths and 393 suspected cases have been reported, with eight laboratory-confirmed infections; another case has been confirmed in Goma, North Kivu, per M23 rebels who control the city. The CDC says an American tested positive in DRC and will be transferred to Germany for treatment. A delegation led by Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba arrived in Bunia with tents to set up treatment centers as hospitals overflow. WHO has exhausted PPE stocks in Kinshasa and plans to ship more supplies from Kenya. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no specific treatment or vaccine. The episode follows the 2018–2020 North Kivu–Ituri outbreak; Uganda postponed Martyrs’ Day celebrations due to the epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ流行に対応するため医療従事者が動員される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目該当。エボラウイルス病の確認症例、死亡者、複数州での拡大、ワクチン・治療法なし、国際的な支援動員が報告されている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の確認症例（ラボ確認8件、疑い393件、死亡105件）。Bundibugyo亜種でワクチン・特異的治療法なし。米国人患者の発生と国際的な患者移送。WHOが対応を主導し、PPE不足が報告されている。ウガンダでの祝日延期など地域的な社会的影響も見られる。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: Les personnels de santé se mobilisent pour faire face à l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Health workers mobilize to respond to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) triggers urgent international response. In Ituri Province, authorities report 105 deaths and 393 suspected cases, with eight laboratory-confirmed infections; a separate case has been confirmed in Goma, North Kivu. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which there is no specific treatment or vaccine, unlike the Zaïre (Zaire) strain. Two cases linked to Kampala, Uganda, prompted WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. An American missionary tested positive in the DRC and will be transferred to Germany for treatment. A government delegation arrived in Bunia to set up treatment centers; UN agencies report depleted PPE stock in Kinshasa and are routing supplies from Kenya. Past Ebola outbreaks in North Kivu and Ituri (2018–2020) caused nearly 2,300 deaths. The RDC notes funding shortfalls risk delayed detection.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ流行に対応するため保健職員が動員される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPRO基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルスのアウトブレイク、複数国への拡大（ウガンダ、ドイツ）、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、深刻な死亡率と国際的な対応が必要な状況。
triage.notes: WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。ブンディブギョエボラウイルス（ワクチンなし）による重篤なアウトブレイク。複数国への越境例（ウガンダ、ドイツへの搬送予定）を確認。記事はコンゴ民主共和国が主要な発生地であり、ウガンダおよびドイツは二次的な関連（ケース検出地）であるため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 확산 공포...민주콩고·우간다서 사망자 120명 육박(종합2보) | 연합뉴스
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fear of Ebola spread... Death toll near 120 in DR Congo and Uganda (Updated 2nd bulletin) | Yonhap News
article.articleSummary: On May 18, 2026, Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda neared 120, with more than 300 suspected cases reported in the DRC and at least 118 fatalities. Limited testing means not all suspected cases are confirmed. The outbreak centers are Ituri Province in eastern DRC, notably Bunia, Lwampara, and Mongwalu, with additional cases in North Kivu's Goma. A U.S. physician at Nyankunde Hospital in Congo is among the newly confirmed infections. The Bundibugyo strain is responsible; it currently has no vaccine or treatment. Early symptoms resemble flu or malaria, delaying detection. WHO declared a PHEIC, dispatched emergency supplies, and a vaccine-candidate review is scheduled for May 19 by a WHO advisory group. Neighboring countries tightened borders and surveillance; Uganda suspended all visa operations; Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania increased border controls; South Africa heightened airport screening; Germany updated travel advisories.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染拡大の恐れ...民主コンゴ・ウガンダで死者120人に迫る（総合2報）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱はPHEIC宣言済みで、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限が明確。フルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言済み。ブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱、ワクチン・治療法なし。Ituri州（Bunia等）とNorth Kivu州（Goma）を中心に発生。複数の隣国で渡航制限・ビザ停止等の対応。記事サマリーでDRC主体とされており、他の発生地域（Uganda、Rwanda等）は隣国としての対応が中心であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: 台灣首例！境外移入Ib型M痘確診 20歲男四月在泰國不安全性行為 - 生活
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taiwan's first case! Imported Type Ib monkeypox confirmed; a 20-year-old man had unsafe sex in Thailand in April - Lifestyle
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports its first imported Monkeypox Type Ib case: a man in his 20s from the north who, after unsafe sex in Thailand in April, developed genital vesicles and hand-foot rashes; classification confirms Branch I, Sub-branch Ib. It is the first Ib-type detected since mpox became a notifiable infectious disease in 2022; other local cases are II-type. By May 18, 2026, Taiwan added 14 confirmed mpox cases that year (12 domestic, 2 imported), all male and aged 20–50, with most unvaccinated. The total since 2022 is 530 cases (493 domestic, 37 imported). Globally, mpox has affected 144 countries with over 179,000 cases and 503 deaths; Ib-type is slightly more lethal than II, though outcomes depend on immunity. Vaccination: two-dose mpox vaccine ~90% protective for both lineages; one dose 40–80%. 312 clinics offer free vaccination; 8 travel-medicine clinics offer paid vaccination. Incubation up to 21 days; transmission possible before symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 台湾で初例！境外移入Ib型M痘確診 20歳男性4月にタイで不安全な性行為
triage.triage_reason: 台湾で初のMpoxクレイドIb型の輸入症例が確認された。既に国内でII型が流行している中での新クレイドの出現は異常かつ予想外であり、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、流行しやすさ）に合致する。IHR基準でも国際拡大リスク、渡航関連のリスクが該当する。

verified_locations.name: Taiwan（対象国外だが発生確認地）

triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは技術的にはThailandのみとなるが、本イベントの主題は台湾での輸入症例確認である。Mpoxクレイドの多様性拡大を示す重要なシグナル。タイでの感染源確認が重要。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉新病毒株罕見 無藥治、無疫苗 防疫難度大增 | 聯合新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rare new Ebola virus strain; no treatment, no vaccine; epidemic containment becomes much more difficult | United News Network
article.articleSummary: On May 17, the World Health Organization declared the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). As of May 16, 393 suspected cases and at least 120 deaths have been reported; two cases are in Uganda, the rest in DRC. The strain is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare variant previously seen in Uganda (2007–2008) and the DRC (2012). There is no licensed vaccine or proven specific therapy. Ebola spreads from wildlife to humans and between people via contact with blood, vomit, sweat, semen, or contaminated bedding, clothing, or medical equipment. Symptoms include high fever, diarrhea, vomiting, and muscle pains; severe bleeding can occur. The outbreak began in Mongwalu area in Ituri, with spread to Bunia and Rwampara; Bunia is near the Uganda border. Ongoing displacement heightens tracing. WHO does not yet recommend border closures or travel bans.

triage.headline_ja: 稀有なエボラ新変異株；治療薬なし、ワクチンなし；疫病対策の難度が大幅に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、稀有な新変異株、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言し、複数国での確定症例と高い死亡率が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのエボラ発生が述べられているが、ウガンダ（206名の対象国リストに非含有）は対象国外のため除外。DRCのみ verified_locations に含める。Bundibugyo ebolavirus という稀有な変異株、治療薬・ワクチン欠如、WHO PHEIC宣言、複数国への拡大リスク、および開発途上地域での管理困難性がすべてのシグナル基準を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, l'Ecdc attiva la task force sanitaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, the ECDC activates its health task force.
article.articleSummary: EBOLA outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province: as of 16 May 2026, 246 suspected cases and 80 suspected deaths reported across at least three health zones; Uganda reports two additional cases with travel history from DRC. The Bundibugyo virus drives the epidemic; no licensed vaccines or specific treatments exist. The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) activates its health task force, sending an EU expert to Africa CDC to support coordination and operational planning, with possible deployment of further experts in infection prevention, epidemiology, surveillance, and risk communication via the EU Civil Protection and Humanitarian Aid operations and the Global Outbreak Alert and Response Network. Ongoing response faces insecurity and humanitarian challenges in affected areas, hindering mitigation efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、ECDCが保健タスクフォースを活動化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。DRC及びウガンダでのエボラ（Bundibugyo virus）の多数の疑い例と死亡、国際的な広がり、国際支援の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのIturi州での主要な発生に焦点を当てており、ウガンダの2事例は「DRCからの旅行歴」として言及されているが、ウガンダは記事の主題の感染症イベント発生地ではなく、国境を越えた関連例として扱われているため verified_locations から除外した。ただしウガンダへの流行拡大リスクは高い。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（BDBV）は深刻で、有効なワクチンや特異的治療法がないことが強調されている。ECDCの国際的な支援活動が既に開始されており、公式なリスク評価及び対応の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Συναγερμός στις ΗΠΑ για τον Εμπολα: Εκτακτα μέτρα στα σύνορα - ασθενής ένας Αμερικανός | Protagon.gr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm in the U.S. over Ebola: Emergency measures at the borders - a patient, an American.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri and North Kivu; Bundibugyo strain) prompts the U.S. public health emergency and border controls. An American healthcare worker contracted the virus while caring for patients in Bunia, Ituri, and is being transported to Germany for treatment; CDC says risk to the U.S remains small, with ongoing reassessment. WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.
