In response, the U.S. will implement airport health screenings for travelers arriving from Africa and restrict entry for foreigners who traveled to Uganda, DRC or South Sudan in the past 21 days; the U.S. embassy in Kampala also suspended visa services. As of reports, 91 deaths and about 350 suspected cases in DRC, with two deaths in Uganda. CDC is scaling up testing and contact tracing; State Department has released $13 million for immediate intervention. Critics question the effectiveness of border measures.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ熱で警戒態勢：国境での緊急対策 - 患者は米国人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当：深刻な公衆衛生上の影響（91死亡、350疑い例）、予想外の国際的拡大（米国の医療従事者感染）、国際的感染リスク、渡航・貿易制限の実施。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ、スーダン、米国、ドイツも含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCでのアウトブレイク。米国の感染者は医療従事者で既に国外に搬送されており、DRCが原発地。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、CDC対応進行中。

article.articleHeadline: PH not 'high risk' for Ebola outbreak, says infectious disease expert
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda prompted the WHO to declare a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC) after about 80 suspected deaths. The causative agent is Bundibugyo virus. The WHO notes higher risk for neighboring land-border countries but says the situation does not meet pandemic emergency criteria. The Philippines is not considered high-risk; risk would rise only if a symptomatic, infected traveler arrives from affected areas. The Department of Health will strengthen border surveillance, including fever and symptom checks and origin screening at points of entry. Philippine infectious disease expert Rontgene Solante says the country is prepared, drawing on COVID-19 and other outbreak responses and emphasizing reinforced protocols. Early Ebola symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle pain, headache, sore throat, progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and organ impairment.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンはエボラ流行の「高リスク」ではないと感染症専門家は述べている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WHOがPHEIC宣言し、複数国での確認と境界国への高リスク評価があり、対象国DRCおよびPhilippinesに該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行が確認され、WHOがPHEIC宣言。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。フィリピンは記事の主題国として含める（高リスク評価対象）。Bundibugyo virus型で約80例の疑い死亡が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Warning over growing number of cases of Ebola in Africa | Beat102103.com
article.articleSummary: On May 19, 2026, Ebola outbreaks in Africa prompted UNICEF to activate its highest-level emergency response as the World Health Organization declared the Democratic Republic of the Congo (eastern region) and Uganda outbreaks a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. In eastern DRC, there are 246 suspected cases and 80 suspected deaths; Uganda has confirmed two cases, including one death. UNICEF warns children are especially vulnerable to caregiver loss, disruption to healthcare and education, and psychological trauma. The agency has deployed emergency teams and nearly 50 tonnes of medical and sanitation supplies, but stresses that more resources and humanitarian access are urgently needed to contain the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカにおけるエボラ患者数の増加に対する警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHOがPHEIC宣言し、複数国での同時アウトブレイク、高い死亡率、国際的支援の必要性が確認される。
triage.notes: ウガンダはWHO通知の対象外（GeoNames IDが対象国リストに含まれていない）。DRCのみ対象国として計上。DRCの東部地域で246疑似症例、80疑似死亡、ウガンダで確認症例2件（死亡1件）が報告されている。WHOによるPHEIC宣言が重要な要素。UNICEFが最高段階の緊急対応を発動し、人道支援ニーズが急速に増加している。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : Ebola, le retour d'une épidémie sans fin ? [Africanews Today]
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ebola, the return of a never-ending epidemic?
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo is grappling with an Ebola outbreak driven by a highly lethal variant for which no vaccine exists. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak at its second-highest level of an international alert. The epidemic has claimed more than 88 lives. A confirmed case has been reported in Goma, in the eastern part of the country, indicating continued transmission in the region. The report emphasizes the severity of this outbreak and the absence of a vaccine for this variant, highlighting the ongoing public health challenge posed by Ebola in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ、終わりなき流行の再来？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の高致死性新規変異株による流行で、88人以上の死亡、ワクチン未対応、WHO第2レベルアラート、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性が高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は極度に危険な感染症。本件は既知変異株の新規発生ではなく、ワクチン未対応の高致死性変異株による拡大という重大なシグナル。Goma市への拡大確認は域内国への二次伝播リスク増大を示唆。即座のフルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة ضحايا "إيبولا" فى الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 118 حالة وفاة - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 118 deaths - Youm7
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has climbed to 118 deaths, with more than 390 suspected cases reported as officials indicate transmission across multiple areas. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, reflecting international concern given rising cases and the appearance of two cases in neighboring Uganda. The disease is transmitted via direct contact with infected bodily fluids and is life-threatening. The report highlights ongoing surveillance and testing efforts, as well as public health measures to contain spread and track new infections. Authorities are monitoring the situation closely and responding to the surge in suspected infections, noting the need for continued cross-border coordination to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で118人の死亡者に達す - Youm7
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが公衆衛生上国際的に懸念される事態（PHEIC）として宣言。複数地域での伝播、隣国ウガンダへの越境拡大、国際的な支援・調整の必要性が確認されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみを対象国として列挙。118人の死亡、390以上の疑い例、複数地域での伝播、越境事例の存在、WHOによるPHEIC宣言により、極めて高いリスク評価が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Dünyayı alarma geçiren ölümcül virüste yeni dalga! Can kaybı 131'e yükseldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New wave of the deadly virus that has alarmed the world! The death toll has risen to 131.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus–driven Ebola outbreak has crossed from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) into Uganda, triggering a global health alarm as the World Health Organization declares a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). As of the morning of May 19, 2026, DRC health authorities report 513 suspected Ebola cases and 131 deaths. The deadly hemorrhagic fever is caused by the Ebola virus, with Bundibugyo virus identified as the trigger. Cross-border spread elevates the outbreak to international concern, with intensified surveillance and response measures under way. The situation is evolving, and authorities warn that updates are pending as more cases are confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: 世界に警報を鳴らした致命的ウイルスの新しい波！死亡者数が131人に増加
triage.triage_reason: Ebola/Bundibugyo virus により DRC と Uganda で 131 人の死亡を含む 513 人の疑い患者が報告されており、WHO が PHEIC を宣言した国際的な感染症事象。IHR 基準の 4 項目すべてに該当し、WPRO スクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC と Uganda での発生が記載されているが、対象国リストに Uganda は含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。WHO による PHEIC 宣言、死亡率の高さ、国境を越えた拡大、Bundibugyo virus による Ebola 出血熱という要素から、フルの RRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）に進むべき高優先度シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, Usa vietano ingresso dai Paesi colpiti per 30 giorni * Imola Oggi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: U.S. bans entry from affected countries for 30 days.
article.articleSummary: U.S. bans entry for foreign travelers who have been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan in the last 21 days, for 30 days, due to a rapidly spreading Ebola outbreak. The measure, announced by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), aims to prevent Ebola cases from entering the United States. It was signed by Jay Bhattacharya, described as director of the National Institutes of Health and a senior CDC official, and will remain in effect for 30 days. The policy reflects heightened U.S. public health precautions amid ongoing Ebola transmission in Africa. This action highlights the outbreak's African focus and the U.S. readiness to limit importation of cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：米国が影響を受けた国からの入国を30日間禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラは重篤で異常な感染症であり、複数アフリカ国での急速な流行、国際的拡大リスク、米国による渡航制限措置が確認されており、フルRRA実施の対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで確認された実際の発生地はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンの3ヶ国。対象国リストからはDRCのみ該当。ウガンダ・南スーダンは対象国に含まれないため verified_locations から除外。米国は対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : aucun cas suspect signalé au Gabon, mais la surveillance sanitaire renforcée | Gabonreview.com | Actualité du Gabon |
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: no suspected case reported in Gabon, but enhanced health surveillance.
article.articleSummary: Gabon reports no suspected Ebola case on its territory as of May 18, 2026, amid a new Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The DRC outbreak, declared May 15, 2026 in Ituri Province near Uganda and South Sudan, has 8 laboratory-confirmed cases, 80 deaths, and 246 suspected cases. It is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, notable for high case-fatality and the absence of a vaccine. On May 17, 2026, the WHO declared the situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and urged strengthened preparedness. Gabon has reinforced national surveillance (COUSP put on alert) and expanded diagnostic capacity at Libreville’s National Public Health Laboratory (LNSP), Lambaréné’s CERMEL, and CIRMF in Franceville. Public awareness campaigns and strict hygiene measures are being promoted; health workers urged to report suspected cases promptly and maintain hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：ガボンで疑い例は報告されていないが、保健監視が強化されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。コンゴ民主共和国で宣言されたエボラ熱の新規流行（Bundibugyo株、高い致死率、ワクチン不在）はWHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態と認定しており、地域内の複数国で警戒体制が構築されている。
triage.notes: DRCで確認された流行（Ituri州、8確認例、80死亡、246疑い例）がWHO-PHEICとして宣言されている。ガボンは検査体制強化を実施中だが現時点で確認例なし。ウガンダ、南スーダンとの国境近接地域での流行であり、地域内の感染拡大リスクが懸念される。記事はガボンが対象国でないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Faut-il craindre une épidémie d'Ebola dans l'océan Indien ? "Le degré de risque est très très faible" selon le Dr Mavingui
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Should we fear an Ebola outbreak in the Indian Ocean? "The risk is very, very low," according to Dr. Mavingui.
article.articleSummary: Ebola variant Bundibugyo circulating in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) prompted the WHO to declare an International Health Emergency at level 2 on May 17, 2026. By May 18, the DRC reported 91 deaths and 350 suspected cases. In Mayotte and Réunion, authorities fear potential spillover among migrant populations, though no cases have been detected in either French territory. CNRS researcher Dr. Patrick Mavingui urged caution, stating the overall risk to Mayotte is very, very low, but not zero, and that infections would likely be detected before reaching zones like Réunion due to incubation and travel patterns. The Bundibugyo strain, less lethal than Zaïre, has caused micro-epidemics in Uganda (2007) and DRC (2012). If introduced, control and isolation measures could be strained in Mayotte. The outbreak follows new US health-checks for air travelers from affected African countries after a case in DRC.

triage.headline_ja: インド洋でエボラ流行を懸念すべきか？「リスク度は非常に低い」とマヴィングイ博士が述べる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当：公衆衛生への深刻な影響（WHO PHEIC宣言、高い死亡率）、異常・予想外性（新たなBundibugyo株の流行）、国際的拡大リスク（複数国への波及懸念）、国際保健規制への影響（米国による健康チェック導入）。また、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、政府・国際関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、エボラウイルス Bundibugyo 株の流行は DRC（民主共和国コンゴ）で主要な発生地として述べられており、他の発生地（米国、フランス、レユニオン、ウガンダ）は波及懸念または健康措置の実施地として記載されている。対象国リストに含まれるのは DRC のみである。WHO PHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日、レベル2）、91名の死亡、350名の疑い例が報告されており、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Svetová zdravotnícka organizácia vyhlásila pre ebolu mimoriadny stav. Nebezpečný vírus sa šíri Afrikou
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The World Health Organization has declared an Ebola emergency. The dangerous virus is spreading across Africa.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization declares an international public health emergency for a Bundibugyo variant Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri province near the Uganda and South Sudan borders. The outbreak has caused over 80–100 deaths with hundreds of suspected cases; the true scale may be higher in hard-to-reach areas, where conflict and weak infrastructure hinder testing and care. A confirmed case has appeared in Goma, a major eastern city, raising regional alarm, while Uganda reports cases and has halted a large religious gathering. There is currently no approved vaccine or specific treatment for this Ebola variant. Estimated case fatality ranges 30–50%. Prompt case finding and isolation are critical, as early symptoms resemble malaria or influenza. Africa-wide, Ebola has caused about 15,000 deaths, with DRC hosting its seventeenth outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関がエボラ出血熱に対する緊急事態を宣言。危険なウイルスはアフリカ全域に広がっている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的緊急事態宣言、高い致死率、複数国への拡大、ワクチン・治療法なし。WHOによる緊急宣言は最高レベルのシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（Ituri州、Goma市）中心に述べられており、Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスの国際的公衆衛生緊急事態。ウガンダ、スーダンは周辺国として言及されているが、記事主題のイベント発生地はDRC。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。WHOによる正式な緊急宣言という最高レベルの社会政治的シグナルであり、ただちにフルRRAに進むべき。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: 40 νεκροί σε μία μόλις ημέρα στο Κονγκό - Τουλάχιστον 131 θάνατοι συνολικά
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 40 dead in a single day in Congo — at least 131 deaths overall.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has caused at least 131 deaths and more than 513 cases. Yesterday’s toll reached 91 deaths, including 24 in a single day, with cases now reported across a wider region due to ongoing conflict hampering response. Two confirmed Ebola cases and one death have also been recorded in Uganda, per the U.S. CDC. The circulating strain is rare, leaving limited tools to halt a virus that kills roughly one in three infected individuals. Experts warn the outbreak could unfold toward levels seen in 2014–2016 West Africa, which sickened about 28,600 people. A WHO public health emergency of international concern does not imply a Covid-scale pandemic. Neighboring countries at high risk due to trade and travel links include Uganda, South Sudan, and Rwanda.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: コンゴで1日で40人死亡 - 合計で少なくとも131人死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、かつWPRO基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラの大規模集団発生であり、高い重症度（致死率約33%）、複数国への拡大（DRC・ウガンダ・隣接国への脅威）、国際的な懸念が明確。
triage.notes: DRCで確認されたエボラの大規模集団発生。ウガンダでも2例確認されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。稀な株系統で治療選択肢が限定的。2014-2016年の西アフリカ集団発生（約28,600人）に匹敵する規模への懸念あり。WHO緊急事態宣言対象の可能性が高い。

locations.name: Free and Hanseatic City of Hamburg

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Scare Deepens as Infected American Is Rushed to Germany in High-Security Transfer: CDC Confirms
article.articleSummary: American physician Dr. Peter Stafford, infected with the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, was evacuated from the Democratic Republic of Congo to Germany for specialist care in a high-level isolation unit after testing positive while working with a medical missionary group near the Congo–Uganda border and Nyankunde Hospital in Bunia. The broader outbreak in Central and East Africa, centered in DRC and Uganda, has intensified with hundreds of suspected infections under investigation and 88–118 reported deaths. No approved vaccine exists for Bundibugyo, complicating treatment. The transfer, conducted under strict biosecurity, involved medical teams in full PPE and flights to advanced German facilities such as St. Georg Clinic (Leipzig), University Medical Center Hamburg-Eppendorf, or Frankfurt University Hospital. The US CDC is tracing contacts, and travel advisories are under review as officials warn transmission occurs via close contact, not airborne. WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染のアメリカ人医師がドイツに高度な隔離態勢で緊急搬送：CDC確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の海外搬送、複数国での国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）。WHOによる国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはドイツ（Hamburg、Leipzig、Frankfurt）も含まれているが、これらは患者の搬送先地点であり、実際のエボラ発症地は DRC（Bunia）および Uganda 周辺。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみ。WHO公式の国際保健上の緊急事態宣言により最高優先度のシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: خبراء مغاربة يحذرون من انتشار "إيبولا" بمناطق حدودية مضطربة بإفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Moroccan experts warn of the spread of Ebola in Africa's unstable border regions.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization declares Ebola outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo a Public Health Emergency of International Concern due to rising cases and cross-border transmission risk. The current Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has no licensed vaccine or approved antiviral. Although containment remains feasible with strengthened surveillance, rapid contact tracing, and bolstering local health systems, the border region’s high mobility, mining activity, and conflicts raise transmission risks to neighbors. The fatality rate for this strain approaches 50%; early symptoms include fever and joint pain, advancing to diarrhea, vomiting, bleeding, and a rash, with a major risk at burial where mourners may be exposed to infected fluids. Morocco has activated stringent airport and border controls—aircraft disinfection and health declarations for arrivals from risk areas within the 21-day incubation window—while awaiting international containment efforts. Mustapha al-Naji notes Ebola’s 1976 origin in DRC; outbreaks have occurred in Nigeria and Sierra Leone.

triage.headline_ja: モロッコの専門家がアフリカの不安定な国境地域でのエボラ出血熱の拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念事項（PHEIC）と宣言した複数国でのエボラアウトブレイク、国境を越えた感染リスク、50%の致死率、国際的な感染拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施を確認。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストに複数国が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は『ウガンダとDRCでのエボラアウトブレイク』。Sierra Leone、Morocco、Nigeriaは歴史的言及または警告の文脈のため、現在の発生地の対象国はDRCのみ。モロッコは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHOがPHEIC宣言していることが確認され、国際的な重大事案。

article.articleHeadline: Die Rückkehr der Syphilis: Deutschlands stille Sex-Epidemie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Return of Syphilis: Germany's Silent Sex Epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Syphilis (Treponema pallidum) remains a significant bacterial sexually transmitted infection in Germany, with 9,519 reported cases in 2024, up from 9,159 in 2023 (3.9% rise). Most infections were acquired domestically; Berlin and Hamburg show the highest incidences (~36 and 30 per 100,000), above the national average of 11.2 per 100,000, while Brandenburg is lower (~4.5). Transmission occurs via unprotected genital, anal, or oral sex, with risk amplified by shared sex toys and, in some cases, shared injection equipment. Symptoms progress from a painless chancre 10–90 days post-infection to flu-like symptoms, lymphadenopathy, and a rash; untreated infection can damage nerves and organs. Penicillin remains effective; azithromycin resistance is high, so doxycycline is used with caution and a minimum two-hour interval from dairy products. Germany’s reporting is non-name-based; labs must notify the Robert Koch Institute within two weeks. Imported cases include Spain and Thailand, with Ukraine-linked data noted in 2022.

triage.headline_ja: 梅毒の再来：ドイツの静かな性感染症流行
triage.triage_reason: ドイツおよび対象国外での梅毒の増加報告であり、IHR基準は2つ未満（公衆衛生への深刻な影響の程度が限定的、国際的拡大リスクは明記されない）。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性と管理可能性に懸念がある程度だが、対象国（タイ）での実発生は明確でなく、主要な発生はドイツである。
triage.notes: Bluedotが付与した発生地域にはタイが含まれているが、記事サマリーではタイは「輸入例」として言及されるのみで、実際の流行地はドイツである。対象国リストにはドイツが含まれないため、verified_locationsはタイのみとしたが、タイでの実発生は明確でない。主発生地がドイツ（対象国外）であることがDISMISS判定の主因。

article.articleHeadline: Terinfeksi Virus Hanta, Pasien RSHS Bandung Meninggal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus-infected patient at Bandung's RSHS dies.
article.articleSummary: As of May 2026, Indonesia has 256 hantavirus cases (2024–May 2026), with 23 laboratory-confirmed infections across nine provinces and 20 recoveries; three deaths. In Bandung, Dr Hasan Sadikin Central General Hospital (RSHS) reported one hantavirus death among three hospitalized patients. The deceased was a 49-year-old male construction worker who experienced fever, intermittent right upper-quadrant pain, and jaundice, then developed dyspnea. On admission he remained febrile with jaundice and breathing difficulty; by day two his condition worsened, and the family declined intubation. Initial labs: Hb 12.7 g/dL; leukocytes 18,440 rising to 28,180/µL; platelets 31,000 then 47,000. Serology was negative for Hepatitis A/C and HIV; postmortem tests detected hantavirus and leptospirosis. Hantavirus is a rodent-borne zoonosis with no natural human immunity.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスに感染した患者、バンドン市のRSHS病院で死亡
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおいて2024年から2026年5月までに256例のハンタウイルス感染例が報告されており、23例が確認診断、3例の死亡が記録されている。ハンタウイルスは医学的に異常で重症度が高く、人口への継続的な曝露リスク（齧歯動物媒介ズーノーシス）がある。IHR基準2つ以上に該当し、WPRO基準複数に該当するシグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドネシアにおけるハンタウイルス感染事例の明確な集積を示している。ハンタウイルスはげっ歯動物由来で人人感染がなく、医療体制の異なる地域での管理可能性に関する情報が不足している。複数の疾患（肝炎A、ハンタウイルス、レプトスピラ、HIV）が列挙されているが、記事主題はハンタウイルスによる死亡事例である。

article.articleHeadline: M痘列法定傳染病4年首見 1個案境外染病 疾管署：他出國做「這事」 | 聯合新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox Becomes a Statutory Notifiable Disease for the First Time in Four Years; One Imported Case Abroad; Taiwan CDC: He Went Abroad to Do “This” | United News Network
article.articleSummary: Taiwan declares Monkeypox a statutory notifiable disease for the first time in four years. In May 2026, Taiwan CDC confirmed two new cases, including the country’s first infection with Monkeypox virus lineage Ib (Ib subclade) imported from Thailand; a northern Taiwan man in his 20s reported unsafe sex in Thailand and developed genital vesicles with hand/foot rash after returning, with lab confirmation. The second case is domestic; both patients are unvaccinated. By May 18, 2026, Taiwan had 14 new cases this year (12 locally, 2 imported), bringing the total to 530 confirmed since 2022 (493 local, 37 imported) across north, central, and south regions; most patients are young men with unsafe sexual behavior, about 90% unvaccinated. Globally, in March 2026, 48 countries reported 1,235 new cases and 5 deaths; Africa accounts for ~70%. Ib-type is sexually transmissible; since 2024, multiple countries have outbreaks beyond Africa. Vaccination: two doses ~90% protection; one dose ~40–80%; 312 clinics offer funded vaccination; eight travel-medicine clinics provide self-pay options.

triage.headline_ja: M痘（サル痘）4年ぶりに法定伝染病に指定、1件の境外感染例が確認 台湾CDC：患者はタイで「あること」をしていた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2項目以上該当（異常性・予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）。タイからの輸入症例確認と台湾での局所伝播により、地域的な懸念が顕在化。WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。
triage.notes: タイからの輸入症例確認のため、タイを verified_locations に含める。台湾は対象国外であり除外。グローバルデータ（アフリカ48カ国）の言及もあるが、記事の主題はアジア地域（特にタイ・台湾の感染確認）。性的接触による伝播リスク（Ib系統）と高い未接種率が懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: O que o vírus do ebola faz no corpo humano? Entenda efeitos da doença que levou OMS a lançar alerta internacional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What does the Ebola virus do to the human body? Understand the effects of the disease that led the WHO to issue an international alert.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is linked to the Bundibugyo variant, a rare strain seen in 2007 and 2012. The World Health Organization has issued an international alert, but global risk remains low and the situation is not comparable to COVID-19. The region faces armed conflict, mass displacement, and challenges tracing contacts. Ebola virus disease is a severe, multi-organ illness; the virus initially targets immune cells and then damages the liver and kidneys and other tissues. Incubation is 2–21 days. Early symptoms resemble influenza—fever, abrupt weakness, muscle pain, sore throat—progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, rash, liver and kidney dysfunction, coagulation problems, and sometimes internal or external bleeding. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood, secretions, bodily fluids, or contaminated objects; fruit bats are natural reservoirs. For Bundibugyo, there are no approved vaccines or specific drugs yet; care is supportive. Early detection improves survival; high mobility complicates containment. The DRC has more outbreak experience than during 2014–2016.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスは人間の体に何をするのか？WHOが国際的警告を発令した病気の影響を理解する
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）のコンゴ民主共和国での発生、WHO国際警告の発令、ヒト-ヒト感染リスク、および複数のIHR基準該当によりシグナルとして認識。
triage.notes: WHO国際警告が発令されている。Bundibugyo株は2007年および2012年に確認された稀な株である。武装紛争、大量難民、接触者追跡困難という複雑な地域社会的文脈がある。ワクチンおよび特異的薬物がまだ承認されていない。グローバルリスクは現在低いとされているが、モニタリング継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Már 131 halottja van Kongóban az ebolajárványnak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo has already claimed 131 lives.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-19, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have led to 131 confirmed deaths among more than 500 suspected infections, with the total suspected cases at 513. The outbreak appears to have spread over a wider area than previously, with reports of at least two cases and one death in neighboring Uganda. An American doctor among the Congo patients has been evacuated to Germany for treatment. The World Health Organization declared a public health emergency of international concern over the Congo outbreak, but stated that it does not meet COVID-19-style pandemic criteria and did not recommend border closures. Ebola spreads through contact with body fluids and causes severe, often fatal disease. The WHO attributes this outbreak to the rare Bundibugyo virus strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行で既に131人の死亡者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）による131名の死亡、513名の疑似患者が報告されており、既にウガンダへの国際的拡大が確認されている。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言しており、極めて重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでの2例と1名の死亡が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ドイツでの医者の治療受け入れは輸送先で、発生地ではない。Bundibugyo株は稀な株であり、流行の規模と地理的拡大が重要な懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC declares Ebola outbreak 'continental health emergency' | News.az
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda prompted the Africa CDC to declare a public health emergency of continental security as of May 19, 2026. In the DRC, about 395 suspected Ebola cases have been reported with 106 associated deaths, concentrated in Mongwalu, Rwampara, and Bunia health zones. In Uganda, Kampala has recorded 2 cases and 1 death. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no strain-specific vaccine is available and which carries a high risk of regional transmission. The declaration aims to strengthen regional coordination, mobilize emergency resources, and accelerate preparedness in neighboring countries. Officials warned that intense cross-border movement, ongoing insecurity in affected regions, and weak infection control could fuel wider spread, and emergency response teams have already been deployed to support containment.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、エボラ出血熱の流行を「大陸規模の保健上の緊急事態」と宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の多国間流行（DRC、ウガンダ）、高い死亡率、ワクチン未対応株、地域感染拡大リスク、アフリカCDCによる大陸規模緊急事態宣言。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが示唆したウガンダ、ルワンダについて：記事サマリーではウガンダ（カンパラで2例1死亡）が確認されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。ルワンダについても同様。DRCのみが対象国（ID: 203312）として該当。エボラ出血熱の流行は最高レベルの公衆衛生上の脅威であり、ワクチン未対応のBundibugyo株の関与、境界線を越えた移動のリスク、周辺国での準備加速の必要性が強調されている。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情釀百死 1美籍確診...CDC啟動入境管制 | 聯合新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak claims hundreds of lives; one American diagnosed with Ebola... CDC activates entry controls
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak has killed nearly 120 people; by May 18, Ituri and North Kivu provinces report 300+ suspected cases and 118 deaths. One American working in Congo tested positive; he and six other U.S. nationals with exposure were sent to Germany for treatment. CDC has intensified public health screening and traveler surveillance; non-U.S. passport holders who visited Uganda, Congo, or South Sudan in the past 21 days face entry controls under a Title 42 order for up to 30 days. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain has been confirmed in a U.S. physician, Peter Stafford, who treated patients in a Congo hospital; his wife and three other hospital staff are asymptomatic. The first Ebola death occurred April 24 in Bunia, Ituri. Symptoms include fever, headache, vomiting, severe weakness, abdominal pain, nosebleeds, hematemesis; incubation 2–21 days (mean 8–10). No vaccine exists; care is supportive; CFR 25–50%. WHO declared PHEIC on May 17.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行が百人以上の死者を出す。米国籍者1名が確診...CDCが入境管制を開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱は重大な公衆衛生上の影響を伴う異常事象であり、国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限をもたらしている。WHO既にPHEIC宣言済み。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから確認される発生地はコンゴ民主共和国のItturi州およびNorth Kivu州。米国籍者の発症ならびに米国CDC等による対応は記載されているが、実際の感染症イベント発生地はDRCのみ。UgandaおよびSudan経由での渡航制限言及があるが、これらは管理措置であり発生地ではない。WHO既にPHEIC(Public Health Emergency of International Concern)を2026年5月17日に宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: TP HCM siết giám sát cửa khẩu để ngăn nguy cơ dịch xâm nhập dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City tightens border surveillance to prevent the risk of Ebola virus disease introduction.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City tightens border surveillance to prevent Ebola virus disease introduction. With WHO declaring an international public health emergency for Bundibugyo Ebola in Congo and Uganda, the city’s health authorities boost border screening, surveillance at checkpoints, and coordination with airlines, shipping, and quarantine services to enable early detection and safe isolation. Contacts must be monitored for 21 days and international travel restricted; confirmed cases discharged only after two consecutive negative tests 48 hours apart. Ongoing training in infection control, PPE, and handling of suspected cases continues; WHO and MOH updates are routinely reviewed. WHO groups: outbreak countries (DRC and Uganda) require disaster-management activation and strict isolation; neighboring border countries must heighten readiness with 24-hour response; non-bordering countries should not close borders, with travel advisories and evacuation plans. Africa CDC reports 395 suspected cases and 106 deaths in Congo and Uganda; Bundibugyo is rare, with no specific vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市、エボラウイルス感染症の流入リスクを防ぐため国境監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言し、DRCとウガンダで確認されたブンディブギョエボラが複数国に拡大する可能性が高く、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言したブンディブギョエボラ。DRCとウガンダで395人の疑い例、106人の死亡が報告。ベトナム（ホーチミン市）は国境監視強化により防御的対応中だが、記事サマリーに基づく実発生地はDRCとウガンダ。ベトナムは予防的措置段階であり、verified_locationsに含める。Ho Chi Minh CityはベトナムにあるためVietnamのみを対象国として記載。

article.articleHeadline: ইবোলা কি ফের ছড়াচ্ছে? কেন বিশ্ব জুড়ে সতর্কতা জারি করল হু, কতটা ভয়াবহ এই ভাইরাস?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is Ebola spreading again? Why did WHO issue warnings worldwide, and how deadly is this virus?
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-19, Ebola virus disease (EVD) alarms rose after a cruise-ship hantavirus incident in the Atlantic led to renewed warnings. The World Health Organization cautioned that Ebola outbreaks could spread globally, with West African nations affected. In the Republic of the Congo, 118 deaths have been reported and over 300 people infected, while India has not seen transmission to date. Authorities stress that international travel from West Africa keeps the risk high. Ebola transmission begins when the fruit bat reservoir passes the virus to animals and then to humans through contact with infected blood or body fluids; early symptoms include fever, bleeding from eyes, nose and mouth, body pains, headache, and stomach distress, progressing to organ failure and death. Isolation is standard; some vaccines exist but are still under study. India’s National Institute of Virology in Pune and Delhi’s National Centre for Disease Control have been asked to bolster infrastructure.

triage.headline_ja: エボラは再び広がっているのか？WHOが世界中に警告を発令した理由と、このウイルスがどれほど致命的であるかについて
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4/4該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国での確認事例とWHOの公式警告により、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴで118人の死亡と300人以上の感染が報告されており、インドは現在のところ伝播なしとされている。ただし、西アフリカからの国際渡航が高いリスクを維持しており、WHOが世界的な警告を発令している点が重要。対象国リスト内ではDRCとインドが確認される。米国（アイオワ州）やアンゴラの記事言及は確認されるが、サマリーの主焦点はコンゴとインドであるため、対象国のみを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Οι ΗΠΑ ανακοίνωσαν την επιβολή υγειονομικών ελέγχων στα σύνορα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The United States announced the imposition of border health screenings.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, an Ebola outbreak is centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), affecting Ituri and North Kivu provinces, with 91 deaths and about 350 suspected cases reported; two deaths have occurred in Uganda. The Bundibugyo strain is implicated, and health officials warn the outbreak may have circulated for weeks before detection. The World Health Organization has declared the event a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The United States announced enhanced border health screenings for air travelers from affected African countries and temporarily restricted visas for foreigners who have traveled to Uganda, the DRC, or South Sudan within the past 21 days; the U.S. embassy in Kampala suspended visa services. An American physician infected while working in Bunia has been diagnosed and will be repatriated to Germany for treatment. The CDC says immediate risk to the U.S. public remains low, but will continue to deploy staff and support testing and contact tracing as the situation evolves.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：米国は国境での衛生検査の実施を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOがPHEIC宣言を発出したエボラ出血熱の多国間アウトブレイク。国際的に高い関心と対応が継続中。
triage.notes: Bluedotが列挙した発生地域には米国、ドイツ、スーダン、ウガンダが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCが主要な発生地域であり、ウガンダは2死亡報告のみ、米国とドイツは対応国・治療国。WHO PHEC宣言済み。Bundibugyo株は高い致命率と国際拡散リスクを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolas vīrusa izplatība pieņemas spēkā; izsludināta globāla ārkārtēja situācija
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The spread of the Ebola virus is intensifying; a global state of emergency has been declared.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed at least 118 people, with suspected infections exceeding 390 as of Tuesday. New infections have been detected in Ituri and North Kivu provinces, and in Goma, the DRC’s third-largest city. In Uganda, two infections and one death have been confirmed, according to the CDC. The World Health Organization has declared the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak a global health emergency. Among the infected is a US doctor who worked with a medical missionary group in the DRC; he has been transported to Germany for treatment, making this an exported case.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの感染拡大が加速；グローバルな緊急事態が宣言される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルスの国際的な拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、ドイツでの輸出症例）、深刻な死亡率（118人以上の死亡、390以上の疑い患者）、WHO緊急宣言、国際渡航制限のリスク。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda（226074）とGermany（2921044）が含まれていますが、DRCが流行の中心地です。ウガンダの2症例（1死亡）は確認されていますがサマリーではDRCが主たる発生地です。対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとしました。ドイツの症例は米国医師の輸出症例であり、DRCでの流行が主題です。WHO緊急宣言により国際的な懸念が非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: اخبارك نت | خبراء: الفيروسات مثل هانتا وإيبولا أصبحت أكثر شيوعا وفتكا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Akhbarak Net | Experts: viruses such as Hantavirus and Ebola have become more common and deadly.
article.articleSummary: Experts warn that infectious diseases such as Hantavirus and Ebola have become more common and deadly in recent years as authorities rush to contain them. A Global Preparedness Monitoring Board report says outbreaks are more frequent and lethal, and that epidemic risks outpace preparedness investments; the world is not safer. The board links rising outbreak probability to the climate crisis and armed conflicts, while geopolitical divisions and narrow commercial interests undermine collaboration. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola outbreaks prompted a public health emergency of international concern a day earlier, with at least 87 deaths reported. WHO reports stockpiles exhausted in Kinshasa and plans to ship supplies from a Nairobi depot. An urgent WHO science meeting will consolidate knowledge about the virus and focus on vaccines, tests, and drugs. Early testing missteps reportedly delayed responses, underscoring the need for equitable access and public trust.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家: ハンタウイルスおよびエボラなどのウイルスがより一般的で致命的になった
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。DRCでのエボラ発生は国際保健上の懸念事項として既に宣言されており、複数国での死亡報告と資材不足が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事はハンタウイルスとエボラの両者を言及しているが、サマリーの具体的な発生報告はDRCのエボラアウトブレイク（87人以上の死亡確認、WHO医療供給品不足、国際保健上の懸念事項として既に宣言）に限定。ナイロビ（ケニア）は医療物資の配送地点として言及されているが、感染症イベントの発生地ではない。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため、verified_locationsに含める。

article.articleHeadline: UNICEF * : "EBOLA IN CONGO E UGANDA, MOBILITATI AIUTI PER PROTEGGERE I BAMBINI, DICHIARATA EMERGENZA SANITARIA INTERNAZIONALE" - Agenzia giornalistica Opinione. Notizie da Italia - Mondo / Trentino Alto Adige
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNICEF *: "EBOLA IN CONGO AND UGANDA, AID MOBILIZED TO PROTECT CHILDREN, INTERNATIONAL HEALTH EMERGENCY DECLARED" - Opinione News Agency. News from Italy - World / Trentino Alto Adige.
article.articleSummary: May 18, 2026: Ebola outbreaks confirmed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province) and Uganda; WHO declares an emergency. By May 18, 246 suspected cases and 80 suspected deaths were reported in Ituri, with 2 cases and 1 death in Uganda. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain is involved; there are no approved vaccines or cures, and transmission may have begun in late April. Instability and high mobility raise cross-border spread risk, especially for children facing disrupted services and caregiver loss. UNICEF has mobilized about 50 tons of aid (soap, disinfectants, PPE, water purification tablets, Bunia water tanks) and is deploying a Rapid Emergency Response team for risk communication and community engagement. Over 2,000 community health workers are active; more resources are urgently needed. Level 3 Emergency activation expands funding, staffing, and field coordination with WHO and Africa CDC to support government responses and reach affected communities in Eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: UNICEF：「コンゴとウガンダでのエボラ、子どもたちを保護するため支援が動員され、国際保健緊急事態宣言」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが国際保健緊急事態を宣言したエボラ感染症の多国間発生。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべて該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda（GeoNames ID 226074）が含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。記事サマリーではコンゴとウガンダ両国での発生が述べられているが、評価対象はコンゴのみ。WHOの国際保健緊急事態宣言、Bundibugyo Ebolaウイルス株、ワクチン・治療法なし、高い越境感染リスク、不安定な治安状況が認識されている。

article.articleHeadline: Southeast Asia's largest economies screen travelers from Ebola outbreak-affected countries - VnExpress International
article.articleSummary: Indonesia, Southeast Asia's largest economy, is screening travelers from Ebola outbreak-affected countries. The Health Ministry said suspected Ebola cases will be referred to designated hospitals and reported through the national emergency response system, per May 18 statements. Officials are coordinating with hospitals and public health agencies to strengthen early detection and response capacities. The move follows heightened border screening amid Ebola concerns. Indonesia recorded 3.44 million foreign arrivals in Q1, up 8.62% year-on-year, the strongest quarterly performance since 2020. The measures illustrate intensified surveillance to prevent importation and enable rapid investigation and isolation if cases appear, as part of broader regional public health efforts in Southeast Asia.

triage.headline_ja: 東南アジア最大経済国、エボラ流行国からの渡航者をスクリーニング - VnExpress International
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアがエボラ流行国からの渡航者スクリーニングを開始しているが、インドネシア国内でのエボラ発症例の報告はなく、予防的な対応段階。国際的な懸念と公開情報があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はインドネシアの予防的対応（スクリーニング強化）であり、インドネシア国内でのエボラ流行や確定症例の報告はない。他地域でのエボラ流行に対応する国境措置という文脈。IHR基準では渡航制限関連の言及があるが、実際の流行地域での公衆衛生影響を直接示すシグナルではない。スクリーニング段階での情報収集の位置付けとなるため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Congo opens more treatment centers as 'rare' Ebola kills 120
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo's eastern Ituri province is escalating its response to a rare Ebola virus strain outbreak, which has no approved vaccines or treatments. As of 19 May 2026, at least 120 deaths have occurred and hundreds of suspected cases are under investigation. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a global health emergency due to its potential for regional spread. To strengthen isolation and care, authorities plan to open three additional Ebola treatment centers in Ituri. The presence of a rare strain, high fatality, and ongoing transmission highlight a significant ongoing public health threat in the region. The outbreak's status and international response remain under close international attention.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴが治療センターを増設、『稀な』エボラが120人を殺害
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。稀なエボラウイルス株による大規模発生で、WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言済み。フルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 稀なエボラウイルス株でワクチン・治療法が未承認。既に120人の死亡が報告され、数百の疑い患者が調査中。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態として宣言しており、地域的拡大の可能性がある。DRCは対象国リストに含まれており、イトゥリ州はDRC東部に位置する。記事サマリーから確実にDRCでの発生が確認された。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Soroti Wabah Ebola-Hantavirus, Dunia Dinilai Masuk Masa 'Berbahaya'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Highlights Ebola-Hantavirus Outbreak as the World Enters a 'Dangerous' Era
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the World Health Assembly opening in Geneva highlighted Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Andes virus hantavirus on the MV Hondius cruise ship as signals the world is entering a dangerous era. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that concurrent crises—conflict, economic turmoil, climate change, and shrinking international aid—are heightening the risk of cross-border transmission. The two outbreaks have drawn global attention to the possibility of diseases spreading beyond borders, underscoring the need for heightened vigilance, preparedness, and sustained international cooperation amid ongoing health threats. The remarks emphasize robust public health measures to prevent further spread; no specific case counts were cited in the briefing.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラ出血熱-ハンタウイルス流行を指摘、世界が「危険な」時代に突入していると評価
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱はコンゴで、ハンタウイルスは国際クルーズ船で発生しており、WHOが国際保健上の脅威として警告している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、エボラ出血熱の発生地としてコンゴ民主共和国が明示されており、ハンタウイルス（アンデスウイルス）は国際クルーズ船MV Hondiusで報告されている。ジュネーブはWHA開催地として言及されているが、疾患発生地ではない。スイスは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsに含めない。WHOの警告により社会的・政治的関心が高く、複数のIHR基準を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: 3 Kasus Hantavirus Positif Ditemukan di Jakarta, Pemerintah Diminta Perkuat Surveilans
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 3 Positive Hantavirus Cases Found in Jakarta, Government Urged to Strengthen Surveillance
article.articleSummary: Three laboratory-confirmed hantavirus cases and six suspected cases remain under intensive monitoring in Jakarta as of May 19, 2026. The DKI Jakarta Health Agency has followed a Ministry of Health alert, designated sentinel hospitals for tighter oversight, and deployed a rapid-response team to strengthen surveillance. Public guidance emphasizes rodentborne transmission via aerosolized urine, feces, or saliva; inhalation of contaminated dust; or direct contact with contaminated secretions or bites. Cleaning rodent-infested areas requires good ventilation and disinfection with household bleach before removing droppings. Epidemiologist Dicky Budiman notes that, although vigilance is warranted, hantavirus is rarely transmitted human-to-human, and current cases do not indicate a widespread outbreak except in high-density environments. Risk factors include population density, sanitation gaps, poor drainage, floods, markets, and urban rodent populations; authorities urge active case finding, contact tracing, hospital and primary-care surveillance, and spatial epidemiology to map hotspots and exposure risks.

triage.headline_ja: ジャカルタでハンタウイルス陽性3件が確認、政府に監視体制強化を要求
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染症による3件の実験室確認例および6件の疑い例がインドネシア・ジャカルタで報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、流行の可能性、管理可能性）の複数に該当。公衆衛生当局による能動的対応（サーベイランス強化、ラピッドレスポンスチーム展開）が進行中であり、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: ハンタウイルスは通常ヒト-ヒト感染は稀であるが、高人口密度地域（ジャカルタ）における齧歯動物媒介感染のリスク有。当局が積極的感染者探索、接触者追跡、空間疫学的ホットスポット把握を展開中。現時点で国際的拡大の明らかな兆候はないが、継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: أمريكا تتحرك للحد من خطر "إيبولا" بعد إصابة أحد مواطنيها في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States Moves to Curb the Risk of Ebola After One of Its Citizens Was Infected in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompts the United States to tighten precautions. As of May 19, 2026, the CDC announced enhanced measures, including screening travelers from affected areas, a temporary suspension of visa services for some countries, and evacuation of six individuals for medical monitoring. The actions accompany the WHO’s declaration of Ebola as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Satish Pillay of WHO stated that a U.S. citizen was infected while working in the DRC. U.S. officials assess the overall risk as low. These steps aim to curb cross-border transmission and bolster the ongoing outbreak response in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ感染事例後、エボラのリスク軽減に向けて行動
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが公衆衛生上の国際的に懸念される事象(PHEIC)を宣言している。エボラウイルス病は最高レベルの危険病原体であり、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限が既に発生している。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の国際的流行が確認されており、WHOがPHEIC宣言を発出している重大事象。米国を含む複数国での対応が進行中。DRCが対象国に含まれるため verified_locations に DRC のみ記載。米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC declares Ebola outbreak public health emergency of continental security
article.articleSummary: DRC and Uganda Ebola outbreak declared a public health emergency of continental security by Africa CDC. As of 2026-05-19, about 395 suspected Ebola cases and 106 associated deaths have been reported in DRC, concentrated in Mongwalu, Rwampara, and Bunia health zones, with two cases and one death in Kampala, Uganda. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which no strain-specific vaccine is currently available, raising the risk of regional spread. The declaration seeks to strengthen regional coordination, mobilize emergency resources, and accelerate preparedness in neighboring countries at risk of transmission. Cross-border movement, insecurity in affected areas, and weak infection control could worsen spread. Africa CDC has deployed emergency response teams to support containment and underscores that Africa's health security is indivisible.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCがエボラアウトブレイクを大陸的公衆衛生上の緊急事態と宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重篤な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国での確認例、死亡例、ワクチン未対応のBundibugyo型、区域調整要請など、高リスク特性を複合的に満たす。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ（Kampala、Kampala Province）とルワンダ（Kigali Province）も列挙されているが、記事サマリーでは主要な感染地はDRC（Mongwalu、Rwampara、Bunia）であり、ウガンダではKampalaでの2例・1死亡のみとの記載。ルワンダについては本文に具体的な確認例の記載がないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみに限定。Africa CDCによる公式宣言、Bundibugyo型（ワクチン未対応）、区域調整・緊急資源動員、準備加速の呼びかけなどにより、継続的な監視と支援要請が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Инкубационный период вируса Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Incubation Period of the Ebola Virus.
article.articleSummary: Incubation period for the Ebola virus is 2–21 days, according to infectious disease physician Yulia Ermolaeva of the NSU Institute of Medicine and Medical Technologies. Evidence does not show strong variation by strain, though some data suggest shorter periods in children than adults. The main risk is for travelers to Africa (business or tourism); protection centers on avoiding contact with sick people and animals. triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの潜伏期間
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重大な感染症だが、本記事はコンゴ民主共和国における既知の発生状況についての医学情報記事であり、新規シグナルやイベント情報としての緊急性は限定的である。ロシアへの拡大リスク言及があるが推測的である。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアのメディア（vm.ru）によるエボラの潜伏期間に関する医学情報であり、コンゴ民主共和国での約120人の死亡と3つの新治療センター設立が言及されているが、これらは既存の流行状況の紹介である。ロシアへの拡大可能性は記事内で「potential to reach Russia」と述べられているが、具体的なリスク評価ではなく一般的な議論である。スクリーニング基準は複数該当するが、IHR基準2つ以上の該当がなく、新規シグナルとしての緊急性に欠けるため、WATCH段階とする。続報で実際の拡大の兆候があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 汉坦与伊波拉双重爆发 WHO示警：全球新危机　 - 国际 - 即时国际
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantaan and Ebola Dual Outbreaks: WHO Warns of a New Global Crisis
article.articleSummary: May 19, 2026: At the World Health Assembly in Geneva, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns of a dual deadly-virus crisis—an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo declared an International Public Health Emergency (PHEIC), and a hantavirus outbreak on the Dutch-flagged cruise ship Hondius, involving Andes virus. Canada confirms the first North American case—a passenger in his 70s who tested positive—indicating cross-continental spread. Andes hantavirus is noted for potential human-to-human transmission. Tedros frames these concurrent outbreaks as emblematic of a fragile era shaped by conflict, economic strain, climate change, and aid reductions, highlighting challenges to global public health infrastructure amid this crisis."

triage.headline_ja: ハンタンとエボラの二重爆発：WHO警告「新たな世界的危機」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、かつWPRO基準でも複数該当。エボラはPHEIC宣言済み、ハンタウイルスは国際的な流行拡大の兆候あり。社会的・政治的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事はスイス（ジュネーブ）でのWHA開催地を示しているが、実際の感染イベント発生地はDRC（エボラ）とカナダ/オランダ船籍（ハンタウイルス）。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。エボラはすでにPHEIC宣言済みであり、ハンタウイルスのANDV(アンデスウイルス)の人間から人間への伝播可能性、カナダでの確認は国際的拡大を示唆。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية: ارتفاع الوفيات جراء فيروس إيبولا بالبلاد إلى 131
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Ebola virus deaths in the country rise to 131.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused at least 131 deaths with over 513 suspected infections. New cases have been detected in Nyankondi (Ituri), Butembo (North Kivu), and Goma. Uganda reports two confirmed cases and one death, per the CDC. An American physician working in the DRC has been confirmed among the new cases. There are no licensed vaccines or approved treatments for this strain. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on Sunday. The Bundibugyo strain is circulating; initial testing targeted the Zaire strain and was negative before Bundibugyo confirmation on May 14–15. The first Ebola-related death occurred April 24 in Bunia, with the body moved to Mongbalu, accelerating spread. MSF officials describe the situation as highly alarming and fast-moving.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラウイルスによる死亡者数が131人に上昇
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（131名の死亡、513名の疑い例）、異常で予想外のウイルス株（Bundibugyo strain）、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダで確認例）、WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の大規模感染拡大。Bundibugyo株というまれなウイルス株が流行しており、初期のZaire株検査は陰性だった。WHOはPHEICを宣言済み。ウガンダへの国際的拡大も確認。MSFが「極めて深刻かつ急速に進行中」と評価。アメリカ人医師も感染確認。ワクチンおよび承認治療法が存在しない状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : origine, symptômes, traitements... le profil d'un virus tueur qui sévit de nouveau en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: origin, symptoms, treatments... the profile of a deadly virus that is once again ravaging the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks again in DRC: Ituri province in north-east hit by Bundibugyo variant; no vaccine for this strain. About three weeks into the outbreak, Africa CDC provisional tally as of May 16 reports 88 deaths among 336 suspected cases, with one death reported in Uganda. There is no vaccine for Bundibugjo (Bundibugyo variant); emphasis on public health measures and humanitarian aid rather than vaccination, per experts. Antoine Flahault, public health professor at Université Paris-Cité, stresses urgent humanitarian assistance as the current priority. The resurgence follows a decade since the last major Ebola outbreak in Africa. Reporting highlights cross-border risk to Uganda and the ongoing need for rapid containment and support for affected populations.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：起源、症状、治療法...コンゴ民主共和国で再び蔓延している致命的なウイルスの概要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる現在の流行は、対象国DRCで複数の死亡者を出し、ウガンダへの越境感染が報告されており、フルRRAに進む必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（Ituri州）における現在のエボラ流行を主題としている。ウガンダでの1死亡事例も報告されているが、サマリー上の主要な発生地はDRCであり、ウガンダは対象国外である。Bundibugyo型（ワクチンなし）による336疑い症例中88死亡（Africa CDC 5月16日現在）という死亡率の高さ、および越境感染リスクから高優先度判定。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Intensifies Surveillance As Ebola Outbreak Spreads in Central Africa - NCDC
article.articleSummary: Nigeria's NCDC reports no confirmed Ebola case but heightened vigilance as an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and a confirmed imported case in Uganda prompt intensified surveillance. Ebola Virus Disease incubation is 2–21 days; symptoms include fever, weakness, headache, muscle pain, sore throat, progressing to vomiting, diarrhoea and, in severe cases, bleeding. As of 16 May, the WHO declared the Bundibugyo-strain outbreak in DRC and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with eight laboratory-confirmed cases, 246 suspected infections, and 80 suspected deaths in Ituri Province (Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbwalu). In Uganda, two confirmed cases, including one death, in Kampala within 24 hours; both recently travelled from DRC, marking international spread. There are no approved vaccines or targeted treatments for Bundibugyo. Nigeria has strengthened nationwide surveillance, lab readiness, infection prevention, event-based monitoring, and risk communication; urged clinicians to maintain high suspicion and promptly report unusual illnesses.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、中央アフリカのエボラ感染症が拡大する中で監視体制を強化 - NCDC
triage.triage_reason: WHOが2026年5月16日にBundibugyo株のエボラアウトブレイクを国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）と宣言。DRC及びウガンダで確認症例と死亡が報告され、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの輸入例）が存在。IHR基準4つ全て該当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアの警戒体制強化であるが、実際の確認症例はDRC（Ituri Province: Bunia, Mongbwalu）及びウガンダ（Kampala）に限定される。ナイジェリアは現在のところ確認症例なし。RwandaはKigali Provinceが地域として指定されているが、記事サマリーでの言及がないため除外。Bundibugyo株によるアウトブレイクはWHOにより2026年5月16日にPHEIC宣言され、国際拡大リスク（ウガンダへの輸入例）が顕在化している。

article.articleHeadline: الولايات المتحدة تفرض إجراءات مشددة على حدودها بعد تفشي إيبولا في دول أفريقية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States imposes stringent border measures after Ebola outbreaks in African countries.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the United States imposes tighter border controls to curb Ebola virus disease spread after the WHO declared a global health emergency amid outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The CDC says direct risk to Americans remains low but may be adjusted as more information becomes available. WHO Ebola incident manager Satish Pillai said a U.S. citizen contracted the virus while working in the DRC; symptoms appeared over the weekend and testing was positive on Sunday evening. The patient is being transferred to Germany for treatment, and six others are being evacuated for health monitoring. CDC will restrict entry for non-U.S. passport holders who traveled to Uganda, the DRC, or South Sudan in the prior 21 days, with intensified airport screening. No licensed vaccine or specific treatment exists for this strain, with roughly 350 suspected cases, predominantly ages 20–39 and over 60% female.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、アフリカ諸国のエボラ流行後、国境での厳格な措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO健康緊急事態宣言、複数国での流行、米国市民の感染が確認され、国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ流行に言及しているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダ、スーダン、米国、ドイツは記事に登場するが対象国外。WHO健康緊急事態宣言済み、米国市民の感染確認、約350疑似症例、ワクチン/特異的治療なしという深刻な状況。フルRRA実施が強く推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Погрешни тестови ја сокрија епидемијата на ебола во Конго - Trn.mk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Faulty tests hid the Ebola epidemic in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Faulty diagnostics, poor sample transport, and traditional burial practices enabled Bundibugyo Ebola to spread in the Democratic Republic of Congo for weeks before detection. In Ituri Province, 246 suspected cases and 80 deaths occurred across three health zones. GeneXpert cartridges calibrated for the Ebola Zaire strain failed to identify Bundibugyo, delaying alarms as specimens traveled over 1,000 km to Kinshasa for confirmation amid inadequate cold storage. Local burial rituals involving direct contact further fueled transmission. The first registered case was a nurse who developed symptoms on 24 April; many contacts died before isolation. WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; there is no approved vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo Ebola. The outbreak underscores fragile health systems amid conflict and highly mobile populations, with over 60% of suspected cases in women, reflecting household caregiving roles.

triage.headline_ja: 誤った検査がコンゴのエボラ流行を隠蔽 - 数週間にわたってレーダー下で拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOがPublic Health Emergency of International Concern（PHEIC）を宣言した新規エボラ流行。Bundibugyo型での複数州での患者・死亡確認、診断遅延による数週間の未検知期間、国際拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola型での新規流行で、診断困難性（Zaire型用GeneXpert検査が陽性反応せず）、長距離検体輸送の課題、伝統的埋葬慣行による感染拡大、紛争地域での脆弱な保健システムが懸念される。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。ワクチン・特異的治療法なし。Ituri Province他での検証された症例・死亡数あり。

article.articleHeadline: Behörden: Zahl der Ebola-Toten in der DR Kongo auf mehr als 130 gestiegen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Authorities: Ebola death toll in DR Congo has risen to more than 130.
article.articleSummary: 131 people have died among 513 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of May 19, 2026, amid an outbreak driven by the Bundibugyo variant in Ituri province in the northeast, near Uganda and South Sudan. The tally previously stood at 91 deaths and 350 infections, underscoring rapid transmission. The World Health Organization has declared a health emergency of international concern (PHEIC) over the outbreak, the second-highest level of alert. There is no vaccine or targeted therapy for Bundibugyo Ebola virus, complicating containment in the Ituri epicenter.

triage.headline_ja: 当局：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数が130人以上に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み、Bundibugyo変異体による急速な伝播、有効なワクチン/治療法なし、国際的拡大リスク高。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言済み。Bundibugyo Ebola変異体は有効なワクチンおよび標的療法が存在しない。ウガンダおよび南スーダンとの国境近くのIturi州が震源地。短期間での死亡数と感染数の急速な増加（91→131死亡、350→513感染）。フルRRAの実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: コンゴ民主共和国滞在のアメリカ人、エボラ出血熱の陽性反応...患者治療していた医師
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American staying in the Democratic Republic of the Congo tests positive for Ebola hemorrhagic fever... the doctor who treated the patient.
article.articleSummary: {"description":"An American physician staying in the Democratic Republic of the Congo tested positive for Ebola virus disease. The male doctor, who treated patients in a DR Congo hospital, is being prepared for transport to Germany for treatment, with CDC coordinating with the U.S. State Department. His wife and another doctor in the DRC are under observation but asymptomatic. In the DRC, Ebola infections confirmed: 11; suspected: 336; related deaths: 88, marking ongoing transmission in central Africa. The case represents an imported event involving a U.S. national seeking care abroad, highlighting international cooperation in diagnosis, isolation, and patient management. Monitoring and public health measures continue as authorities respond to this outbreak."}

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国滞在のアメリカ人、エボラ出血熱の陽性反応...患者治療していた医師
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の確認症例、国際的な患者移動（米国医師がドイツへ搬送予定）、DRC内での継続的感染（確認11例、疑い336例、死亡88例）、渡航・医療体制への影響が明白。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUSAとGermanyが含まれているが、米国医師はDRC滞在中に感染し、ドイツへの搬送予定段階であり、実際の感染イベント発生地はDRCのみ。DRC内での継続的なエボラ伝播（疑い症例336例、死亡88例）が記載されており、これは地域の公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威。CDC・米国国務省・ドイツが関与し、国際的な協調対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: At least 120 dead in Ebola outbreak in DR Congo, official says
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports an outbreak of the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola in Ituri and North Kivu with at least 120 confirmed deaths among more than 300 suspected cases; one death and a suspected case reported in Uganda. The first death occurred April 24 in Bunia; Ebola was confirmed May 14, with Bundibugyo identified May 15. Delayed detection occurred after initial tests targeted the wrong strain, allowing spread to Bunia, Goma, Mongbwalu, Butembo and Nyakunde. Symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhoea, and unexplained bleeding. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment; experimental therapies may become available soon. Authorities plan three new Ebola treatment centres in Ituri; WHO is deploying expert teams; cross-border screening and heightened surveillance are underway. An American doctor is infected and being treated; seven Americans are moved to Germany for monitoring. The region hosts over 270,000 displaced people, complicating response.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴのエボラ出血熱感染症で少なくとも120人が死亡、当局者が発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行で120人以上の死亡、300人以上の疑い例、ウガンダへの拡大報告、国際的な関心と対応が発生している。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスのBundibugyo株による大規模流行。初期診断の遅延が複数都市への拡大を招いた。ウガンダでも死亡例と疑い例が報告されており、国際的な保健危機である。WHO専門家チームが展開中、複数国からの支援体制構築中。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα σε Κονγκό και Ουγκάντα: Τα CDC εκτιμούν ως πολύ χαμηλό τον κίνδυνο μόλυνσης στις ΗΠΑ, αλλά λαμβάνουν περιοριστικά μέτρα διάρκειας τριάντα ημερών - iefimerida.gr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo and Uganda: The CDC assesses the risk of infection in the United States as very low, but is taking restrictive measures lasting thirty days.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda prompts US CDC to assess immediate risk to the U.S. population as very low, while imposing restrictive measures for 30 days beginning May 18, 2026. Enhanced airline screening and entry restrictions for nationals from the affected regions accompany public health actions to prevent entry amid an East/Central African outbreak. In early May, a Bunia, northeastern DRC hospital cluster of severe illness among health care workers prompted testing; initial Kinshasa samples were negative, but by May 15 eight of 13 samples were positive and five inconclusive. Genomic typing identified Bundibugyo ebolavirus, one of four Ebola viruses; historical case fatality rate 25–50%. Classic symptoms include fever, headache, vomiting, severe weakness, abdominal pain, epistaxis, and hematemesis. The CDC issued travel notices; no vaccine exists for Bundibugyo, only supportive care. Seek care within 21 days of travel if symptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴとウガンダのエボラ：CDCは米国への感染リスクを非常に低いと評価するが、30日間の制限措置を講じる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当（重症度・流行可能性・管理可能性）。ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスの新規アウトブレイク（病原体タイプの異常性）と国際的対応（米国のCDC行動）により、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴとウガンダでのエボラ発生を述べているが、詳細な疾病情報と確認事例はすべてDRC（キンシャサ・ブニア地域）に限定されている。ウガンダについては言及されるのみで、具体的な症例や検査陽性の記録がないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙。ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスは歴史的にまれで、このウイルス型でのアウトブレイク確認は異常性が高い。米国CDCによる30日間の入国制限措置と航空スクリーニングの実施は国際的な懸念レベルの高さを示す。

article.articleHeadline: Смртоносна епидемија се шири во Конго, здравствените власти на нозе - Навалица
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A deadly epidemic is spreading in Congo, health authorities on their feet - Surge
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo intensifies as cases rise and spread to new areas in the eastern regions, including Ituri, North Kivu, and the city of Goma. Uganda also reports confirmed cases, prompting international surveillance due to regional transmission risks if chains of transmission are not interrupted. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, a rare form that complicates response. An American clinician treating patients in DRC has tested positive for Ebola and is slated for transfer for treatment in Germany; his wife and another colleague, exposed but asymptomatic, are quarantined. Authorities stress isolation, contact tracing, and rapid response, with new treatment centers opening and international assistance essential. The major challenge remains timely detection in areas of instability, poverty, and weak healthcare access, underscoring a fragile regional health security situation.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的な流行がコンゴに広がり、保健当局が対応中 - ナバリカ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認例があり、IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国への拡大、国際的なサポートが必要な状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでの確認例も言及されているが、主要な発生地はDRCであり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。ドイツに転院する患者については治療目的の移動であり、ドイツでの実際の流行発生ではないため除外。Bundibugyo株の稀な特性、不安定地域での検出困難性、脆弱な保健体制など複数の懸念要因あり。

article.articleHeadline: В Китае тестируют экспериментальную вакцину против штаммов лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In China, an experimental vaccine against Ebola virus strains is being tested.
article.articleSummary: Chinese researchers from multiple universities and research centers announced an experimental broad-spectrum messenger RNA vaccine against multiple Ebola virus variants, including Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The study, reported in PNAS on June 19, suggests the vaccine may be effective against the most aggressive strains. Preclinical testing in cell cultures, mice, and hamsters showed vaccinated models developed robust neutralizing antibody responses and activated T-cells, with significantly reduced viral loads and preserved organ function after exposure to diverse ebolaviruses. Development began in 2021 following an Ebola outbreak in Uganda, under China’s strategic priority-research program. The vaccine combines genetic material from several viral proteins into a single formulation, incorporating surface glycoproteins from multiple strains with a conserved internal protein, enabling both antibody-mediated neutralization and clearance of infected cells. Uganda’s 2022 Sudan ebolavirus outbreak highlighted limitations of existing vaccines against certain strains.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で複数のエボラウイルス株に対する実験的ワクチンが試験されている
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はエボラウイルス対策としての実験的ワクチン開発の進展についての報道であり、新規の感染症発生イベントではない。中国での基礎研究段階の開発報告であり、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準の対象となる公衆衛生危機イベントには該当しない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが発生地域にUgandaを含めているのは、記事中でウガンダの2022年エボラ発生が背景情報として言及されているためと推測される。しかし、本記事の主題はあくまで中国での実験的ワクチン開発であり、ウガンダでの新規発生イベントではない。したがって verified_locations には China のみを記載した。シグナルトリアージの対象は「新規の感染症発生イベント」の探知であり、ワクチン開発段階の報道は該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola patient isolated at Hoima hospital - The Observer
article.articleSummary: A 50-year-old man from Runga landing site on Lake Albert in Hoima district is isolated at Hoima regional referral hospital with Ebola-like symptoms as of 2026-05-19. He has severe headache, fever, loss of appetite, vomiting blood and epistaxis. Blood samples have been collected and sent to the Central Emergency Surveillance and Response Support Laboratory in Wandegeya for testing and confirmation. Authorities have intensified surveillance around Lake Albert, deploying teams at landing sites and border entry points to screen entrants from the Democratic Republic of Congo by lake waters. Contact tracing for the suspected patient has begun. Ebola Virus Disease is described as a severe illness transmitted via direct contact with blood or body fluids, contaminated surfaces, corpses, and infected animals. Public health guidance emphasizes calm, hand hygiene, and prompt reporting of suspected symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: ホイマ病院でエボラ疑い患者が隔離される - The Observer
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い患者が報告され、IHR基準3項目該当（重症度、予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）。ウガンダとDRCの国境地域での発生でリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの地理的分析：患者はウガンダのホイマ地区レクア着陸地点（Lake Albert）に位置しており、ウガンダで発生している。しかし、Bluedot APIの発生地域にはウガンダが含まれていない（226074は結果リスト内だが対象国リストに含まれない）。対象国リストを参照すると、DRC（203312）のみが対象国に該当する。記事はDRCとの国境での監視強化を述べているため、DRCを verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。この症例は両国にまたがる懸念があり、フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: SitRep N°1 de l'Epidémie de la Maladie à Virus Ebola (Bundibugyo) en Ituri (15 mai 2026)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Situation Report No. 1 for the Ebola Virus Disease outbreak (Bundibugyo) in Ituri (May 15, 2026).
article.articleSummary: Situation Report No. 1 on the Ebola Virus Disease outbreak (Bundibugyo) in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, dated May 15, 2026. Ituri Province in NE DRC borders Uganda and South Sudan, with over 8 million residents and more than 1 million internally displaced amid chronic conflict and humanitarian crises. Mongbwalu health zone, one of 36 zones in Ituri and located in Djugu Territory, is considered the outbreak’s starting point. Mongbwalu lies about 70 km from Bunia, the provincial capital, and experiences frequent population movements toward Uganda. The locality hosts several ongoing worksites that attract people from other districts and neighboring provinces. The report references a prior Ebola outbreak in September 2018 in North Kivu Province. As of 19 May 2026, no case counts are provided in the text.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州におけるエボラウイルス病（ブンディブギョ型）の流行に関する状況報告書第1号（2026年5月15日）
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の新規流行報告であり、IHR基準で異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクに該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。DRCは対象国であり、ウガンダ・南スーダンとの境界地域で高い国際的波及リスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月19日配信だが報告日は5月15日。具体的な症例数は本サマリーに記載されていない。イツリ州はウガンダ及び南スーダンと国境を接し、難民・人口移動が多く、国際的波及リスクが高い。過去2018年の北キブ州エボラ流行にも言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫：人类身处危险分裂时代 伊波拉汉坦病毒只是最新危机|光华网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Humanity is living in a dangerous era of fragmentation; Ebola hantavirus is just the latest crisis
article.articleSummary: On May 18, 2026, at the opening of the 79th World Health Assembly in Geneva, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus highlighted a new Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and a hantavirus outbreak linked to the Hondius cruise ship in the Canary Islands as the latest crises in a dangerous, fragmented era. Although not on the WHA agenda, these outbreaks dominated day-one discussions as signals of broader insecurity—from war and economic distress to climate change and shrinking aid. Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez urged collective responsibility: protecting others protects all, and no country can be left out; Spain has evacuated passengers and crew from the Hondius near the Canary Islands. Swiss health minister noted about 21% budget cuts at the WHO, roughly $1 billion, prompting program reductions, job losses, and deeper reform.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：人類は危険な分裂の時代を生きている。エボラ・ハンタウイルスは最新の危機に過ぎない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。2つの複合感染症アウトブレイク（DRC のエボラ、カナリア諸島のハンタウイルス）が報告され、国際舞台（WHA）での高レベル協議対象となっており、複数国にまたがるリスクが存在。
triage.notes: 記事に記載されている発生地域としてスイス（WHA開催地）、スペイン（カナリア諸島：クルーズ船ハンタウイルスアウトブレイク）が挙げられているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に追加していない。DRC のエボラアウトブレイクのみが対象国に該当。複合感染症イベント（エボラ＋ハンタウイルス）であり、国際的危機管理の枠組みで高度に関心化されている。WHO 予算削減（10億ドル規模）という深刻な管理問題も指摘されており、危機対応能力への懸念が明示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Śmiertelny wirus Ebola się rozprzestrzenia! Pilny komunikat MSZ do Polaków
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The deadly Ebola virus is spreading! Urgent communiqué from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to Poles.
article.articleSummary: WHO declared an international public health emergency on May 17 over Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. In Ituri Province, DRC, 80 deaths and 246 cases have been reported, eight laboratory-confirmed; this is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976, following the devastating 2018–2020 epidemic that caused over 1,000 deaths. The Polish Ministry of Foreign Affairs has advised against travel to multiple DRC provinces: Kasai, Kasai-Central, Kasai-Oriental, North Ubangi, South Ubangi, Bas-Uele, Upper Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Maniema, Tanganyika, and the northern part of Haut-Lomami, with broader advisories due to security concerns. On May 18, additional note cites new Ebola cases in Kasai near the Angolan border; travelers in the outbreak region should remain vigilant, practice hygiene, and seek immediate medical care for fever, fatigue, loss of appetite, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal/head/muscle pain, or bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的なエボラウイルスが拡大中！ポーランド外務省からポーランド国民への緊急通達
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱はWHOが国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言した極めて深刻な事象で、複数国での拡大リスク、渡航制限の発令、国際的な懸念を示している。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはウガンダ、ポーランド、アンゴラも含まれるが、記事サマリーの詳細な読み込みに基づき、確認された主たる発生国はDRCのみ。ウガンダはWHOの宣言に含まれるが、サマリーの詳細記述はDRCのIturi州を中心としている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。本事象はWHO国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言済みであり、フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: EAC urges alert over Ebola, Russia sends experts to Uganda
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease outbreak confirmed 15 May 2026 in Ituri Province, eastern DRC, centered on Mongwalu and Rwampara health zones with suspected cases in Bunia. As of 15 May, about 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths; lab testing confirmed at least 13 positives out of 20 tested, including four deaths. Two imported Bundibugyo cases linked to travelers from the DRC have been lab-confirmed in Uganda, with one death in Kampala. The EAC urges Partner States to heighten surveillance, border screening and cross-border coordination; activation of the EAC mobile lab network and UVRI Centre to bolster diagnostics. Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor will send epidemiologists to Kampala to investigate and provide testing capacity; Uganda will receive diagnostic tests. Transmission is via direct contact with blood or body fluids, contaminated surfaces, and bodies of the dead; incubation 2–21 days; CFR 25–70% depending on virus and care. No universal treatment; early supportive care helps; vaccines/therapeutics exist for some strains.

triage.headline_ja: EAC（東アフリカ共同体）がエボラ熱について警戒を呼びかけ、ロシアがウガンダに専門家を派遣
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。ブンディブギョエボラウイルスのアウトブレイクが確認され、複数国への波及、高い致命率、国際的対応が明確に示唆されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは東アフリカ地域の複数国（DRC、ウガンダ、ルワンダ）で言及されているが、発生地点はイトゥリ州（東部DRC）であり、ウガンダでは輸入症例が確認されている。対象国リストではDRCのみに該当。この事象は以下の理由からPICKUPが妥当：(1)Bundibugyo Ebolaウイルスの確認により異常かつ予想外、(2)246疑い例、65死亡、確認症例13例、致命率25-70%で深刻、(3)DRCからウガンダへの越境感染確認で国際的拡大のリスク実証、(4)EAC加盟国間での警戒・国境スクリーニング強化、ロシアの国際支援派遣により国際的対応が既に始動。境界スクリーニング強化に伴う渡航制限の可能性も高い。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: AS perketat pembatasan perjalanan untuk cegah masuknya penyakit Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US tightens travel restrictions to prevent the entry of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the US CDC tightens travel restrictions to prevent entry of Ebola caused by Bundibugyo virus amid an ongoing East–Central Africa outbreak. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 11 lab-confirmed Ebola cases and 336 suspected cases with 88 deaths have been reported; Uganda reports 2 confirmed cases including 1 death. No vaccine exists; treatment is supportive. Classic Ebola symptoms include fever, headache, vomiting, extreme weakness, abdominal pain, epistaxis, and hematemesis. Non-U.S. passport holders who have been in Uganda, the DRC, or South Sudan within the last 21 days are barred from entry. CDC plans enhanced port-of-entry health screenings, traveler monitoring, and coordination with airlines and international partners, plus strengthened contact tracing, laboratory capacity, and hospital preparedness, with CDC personnel deployed to affected regions. Immediate risk to the U.S. public remains low, though regional spillover risk has been flagged by CDC Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ病の流入を防ぐため渡航制限を厳格化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、アフリカ東中部での異常な流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施）。エボラウイルス感染症は高致死率の法定感染症であり、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは東中部アフリカでの流行が主題であり、DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでの発生が記述されている。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当する。米国は渡航制限の実施国であり、イベント発生地ではないため verified_locations に含めない。ウガンダはGeoNames IDリストに含まれておらず除外。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo種）による流行であり、高致死率（DRC側で報告された死亡率）、ワクチン未開発、支持療法のみという管理困難な状況が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. Travel Restrictions Related to the Bundibugyo Ebola Outbreak - Africa CDC
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebolavirus outbreak declared in Africa on 15 May 2026, affecting the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with South Sudan and Rwanda identified as at-risk. The United States issued a Level 4 Do Not Travel advisory for the DRC and entry restrictions for non-U.S. passport holders who have recently traveled to the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan. Africa CDC emphasizes that broad travel bans provide limited public health benefit and urges science-based, proportionate measures under IHR. The AHSS/Team Africa framework coordinates continental support, with Africa CDC mobilizing to assist DRC, Uganda, South Sudan, Rwanda, and other at-risk states. The agency highlights the lack of licensed vaccines or therapeutics for Bundibugyo Ebolavirus and calls for expanded laboratory diagnostics, genomic sequencing, epidemiological deployment, frontline worker support, and accelerated vaccine/therapeutic development for all Ebola strains. Declaration of the PHECS on 18 May 2026 aims to mobilize leadership and resources.

triage.headline_ja: バンディブギオエボラ大流行に関連した米国渡航制限 - Africa CDC
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、予想外の新規outbreak、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施済み）。WPRO基準も5項目全て該当。新規Ebolavirus outbreak宣言（2026年5月15日）、複数国での確認、致死性病原体、ワクチン・治療薬なし、米国を含む国際対応開始。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebolavirus（新規亜種）のoutbreak宣言。記事サマリーではDRC及びウガンダでの発生を確認しているが、対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当する。南スーダン・ルワンダはat-risk国として言及されているが、記事の主題となる確認・流行地はDRCおよびウガンダ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。米国の渡航制限・勧告は国際的対応を示す証拠だがUS自体の発生地ではない。PHECS宣言（2026年5月18日）によるリソース動員、ワクチン・治療薬不在の状況、複数国への迅速な拡大可能性、高い致死率を持つEbolaウイルスの特性から、最高レベルのリスク評価が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak went undetected 'for several weeks' as death toll rises, medical expert suggests
article.articleSummary: As of 19 May 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo went undetected for several weeks, with the World Health Organization warning it could become a much larger outbreak with regional spread. The virus has now reached Nyakunde in Ituri Province, Butembo in North Kivu, and the major city of Goma, signaling expansion across a wider area within the DRC. The outbreak has also crossed international borders, with Uganda reporting two confirmed Ebola cases and one death, according to the US CDC. Infections are being reported across an increasingly wide geographical area, raising the risk of further cross-border transmission. Authorities emphasize heightened surveillance and cross-border cooperation to contain spread and prevent a regional escalation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の発生が数週間検出されず、死亡者数が増加、医療専門家が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラは高致死性の国際的に懸念される感染症で、DRCからウガンダへの国際的拡大が確認されており、WHOも地域的拡大リスクを警告しており、フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRCでのエボラ発生を主として述べており、ウガンダの2例はDRCからの越境感染として言及されている。対象国リストではDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。エボラは極めて高い致死性と感染力を有し、既に複数の行政区域での感染と国際的越境が確認されている点、WHOが地域的拡大を警告している点から、最高度のリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: fokozódik a helyzet, az Egyesült Államok már evakuál
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the situation is worsening, the United States is already evacuating.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is worsening. The World Health Organization has declared an international emergency over the outbreak, which is caused by a previously rare Ebola variant for which there is no targeted treatment or vaccine. Mortality in the last two Ebola outbreaks has ranged from 30% to 50%. Recent reports indicate new infections are being registered across an expanding portion of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Current statistics show 118 deaths and more than 390 suspected cases in the country as of 2026-05-19. The article notes the absence of specific therapies or vaccines for this variant and underscores the expanding geographic spread and ongoing outbreak within the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：状況が悪化、米国はすでに避難を開始
