triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目に該当。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言した新種エボラの急速な拡大、高い致死率、ワクチン・治療法の欠如により、ただちにフルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）へ進める必要がある。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラアウトブレイク。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。従来まれな変異株で、ターゲット治療法やワクチンがない。死亡者118名、疑似症例390名以上。米国による避難開始。地理的拡大継続中。高優先度のシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго зарегистрировали уже более 100 жертв лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DR Congo, more than 100 deaths from Ebola virus disease have already been recorded.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has caused 118 deaths, with 435 cases reported in Ituri and North Kivu provinces. Initial signals emerged in Ituri on May 5; nine days later, authorities identified the pathogen as Ebola Bundibugyo virus. The outbreak has also affected neighboring Uganda, and on May 17 the World Health Organization declared an international public health emergency for Ebola in these countries. Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor states there is no current risk to Russia, while continuing global monitoring and cooperation with African nations on dangerous infections including Ebola, Lassa, and Marburg. The Russian embassy in the DRC advised citizens to avoid mass gatherings and to contact the embassy in life-threatening situations.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴでエボラ熱による100人以上の死亡が既に記録されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO国際保健上の懸念事象(PHEIC)宣言済み。フルRRA実施必須。
triage.notes: Ebola Bundibugyo virus、118人の死亡、435症例報告。2026年5月17日付でWHOがPHEIC宣言。Ituri州・North Kivu州での発生。ウガンダへの波及も報告されているが、記事サマリーではウガンダが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations からは除外。ロシア連邦は Bluedot API発生地域に含まれているが、記事では「ロシアへのリスクなし」と明記されており、実際のイベント発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Россиян пугают новой вспышкой опасного заболевания - Свободная Пресса - Здоровье. ЗОЖ. Составляющие ЗОЖ. Здравоохранение. Здравоохранение Российской Федерации. Медицинская помощь
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russians Fear a New Outbreak of a Dangerous Disease.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak re-emerges in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, signaling the cyclic nature of the disease and prompting caution for Russians. The article notes a new flare-up in the DRC, with experts saying the latest event follows global patterns and that the last major outbreak occurred in 2014, more than a decade ago. Academician Gennady Onishchenko warns that Ebola is easily transmitted person-to-person, but infection is avoidable through hygiene, avoiding contact with the sick, and refraining from travel to countries with rising Ebola activity. The piece also mentions a separate report of a hantavirus case with a fatal outcome in Colorado, USA. No specific Ebola case counts or laboratory confirmations are provided. The date context is 2026-05-19.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人が新たな危険な疾患の流行を懸念 - Ebola再発と米国でのハンタウイルス死亡例
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのEbola再発報告はIHR基準の公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際拡大リスクを満たし、複数国での感染症イベント（DRC + USA）が記載されている。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事ではDRCでのEbola再発が主題。米国コロラド州でのハンタウイルス死亡例も言及されているが、米国は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCはWPRO地域外だが、IHR基準の複数該当とEbola（高い国際的関心）により PICKUP 判定。情報詳細が限定的（具体的症例数、検査確認なし）だが、公式な流行警告としての重要性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Проф. Христова за хантавирус: Заразяването не може да стане при случаен контакт, например в ресторант или обществено място
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prof. Hristova on Hantavirus: Transmission cannot occur through casual contact, for example in a restaurant or a public place.
article.articleSummary: Bulgarian Health authorities report no confirmed hantavirus case; samples were sent for testing after a Romanian report. Prof. Iva Hristova states the patient has not traveled to South America and Bulgarian hantavirus strains differ from the Americas’ disease; transmission occurs via rodent excreta in specific areas and is not person-to-person, unlike some Andes hantavirus cases. No licensed specific antiviral exists; experimental compounds show activity in labs but have not completed clinical trials. Diagnosis starts with clinical assessment, then epidemiological linkage, followed by laboratory confirmation. Separately, Ebola in Congo and Uganda remains high-risk, with case-fatalities potentially 50–70%; transmission is via contact with blood and body fluids, including deceased individuals. WHO warns of outbreaks; Bulgarian border health controls remain standard, with no special airport measures, as there are no direct flights to Congo. A reported American in Congo prompts ongoing monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: prof. Hristova on Hantavirus: Transmission cannot occur through casual contact, for example in a restaurant or a public place.
triage.triage_reason: Multiple pathogens mentioned (Hantavirus and Ebola) with regional relevance, but no confirmed cases reported in Bulgaria; information gap regarding actual transmission status and case severity limits full risk assessment.
triage.notes: Article focuses primarily on clarification regarding hantavirus transmission in Bulgaria (no confirmed cases) and mentions Ebola circulation in Congo/Uganda as ongoing high-risk situation. Only DRC is verified as actual event location per article summary. Bulgaria mentioned as vigilant monitoring country, not primary event location. Hantavirus section is largely reassurance messaging rather than outbreak reporting.

article.articleHeadline: بعد إصابة مواطنها بالكونغو.. أمريكا تفرض قيودا صحية مشددة بالمطارات لمنع انتشار إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After a U.S. citizen was infected in the Congo, the United States imposes stringent health restrictions at airports to prevent the spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola case involving a U.S. citizen infected in the Democratic Republic of Congo has prompted the United States to tighten airport health measures as of 2026-05-19. The policy includes enhanced screening of travelers arriving from affected regions and a temporary suspension of certain visa services. The steps align with a broader international response after the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The actions are intended to curb cross-border transmission while the outbreak persists in affected areas, with authorities monitoring travel-linked risk and readiness to adjust restrictions as the situation evolves.

triage.headline_ja: 米国民がコンゴで感染後、米国はエボラ拡大防止のため空港で厳格な衛生制限を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大リスク、公衆衛生への重大な影響、WHOによる国際的な懸念事項宣言、および渡航制限実施が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は民主共和国コンゴにおけるエボラ発症事例であり、米国は対応国として記載されているが、当該対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCはアフリカの高リスク地域であり、複数国への国際的な懸念が存在する。WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern宣言が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: 台灣首見變種M痘境外移入　疾管署籲有風險者快打滿疫苗 | 生活 | 中央社 CNA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taiwan's first imported mpox variant case detected; Taiwan CDC urges at-risk individuals to get fully vaccinated.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s CDC reports two new mpox (monkeypox) cases in May 2026, both unvaccinated. One is a domestic case in a man in his 40s in the north with a history of unsafe sex and vesicular lesions; the other is imported, a man in his 20s who had unsafe sex in Thailand in April and returned with genital vesicles and hand–foot rash. Genotyping identified Branch I, sub-lineage Ib, marking Taiwan’s first Ib-type mpox since it became a notifiable disease in 2022. Through May 18, 2026, Taiwan has 14 confirmed cases this year (12 domestic, 2 imported) and 530 cumulative (493 domestic, 37 imported); most patients are young men and about 90% are unvaccinated. Incubation can be up to 21 days; transmission may occur 1–4 days before symptoms. A national two-dose free mpox vaccination program is available at 312 facilities; two doses confer ~90% protection, while one dose offers ~40–80% protection. Vaccination reduces severity even if infected.

triage.headline_ja: 台湾で初めて変異型M痘の境外移入を確認　疾病管制署が高リスク者にワクチン接種完了を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 新型mpox Clade I（亜系統Ib）の初の検出、国際的な拡大可能性、複数国での症例確認、および高い社会的関心が認められる。IHR基準で異常・予想外と国際的拡大のリスクが該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目が該当する。
triage.notes: 台湾はWHO対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。タイでの曝露歴および中国領土内（台湾）での検出が記述されているため、タイと中国を検証済み地域として記載。新規のClade I亜系統Ibの検出は台湾での初確認であり、高い異常性を示す。ワクチン接種率が低く（約90%が未接種）、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクが存在。公開の予防接種プログラムが実施されている点は管理可能性を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة ضحايا "إيبولا" فى الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 118 حالة وفاة - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 118 deaths - The Seventh Day.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, local authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo report Ebola deaths rising to 118, with more than 390 suspected cases. New infections have been recorded across multiple districts, indicating broader spread within the country. The World Health Organization declared the Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) yesterday, following hundreds of suspected cases and dozens of deaths in the DRC and two cases in neighboring Uganda. Ebola is a highly infectious, deadly disease transmitted through direct contact and contact with bodily fluids. The update underscores ongoing transmission in several regions of the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死亡者数が118人に増加 - The Seventh Day
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHOがPHEICを宣言した現行の重大感染症イベント。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）は記事に「neighboring Uganda」として2例の報告が言及されていますが、記事の主題発生地はDRCであり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。WHOのPHEIC宣言により国際的な危機管理レベルが極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: تقديرات بوفاة 131 شخصا بإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Estimates of 131 Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports an Ebola outbreak with about 131 deaths among 513 people suspected of infection, Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba said on national television. He stated that roughly 131 fatalities are suspected to be Ebola-related and about 513 individuals are suspected of infection with the virus. The report provides no details on laboratory confirmation, infection sources, symptoms, or whether cases are imported or exported. The figures cited are based on suspected cases and reflect the current assessment by health authorities in the DRC, highlighting the ongoing challenge posed by Ebola in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱で131人の死亡が推定される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生で131人の死亡を報告しており、IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当する可能性が高い。即座にフルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）進行が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最も高いリスク度のカテゴリーに属する。131人の死亡、513人の疑似患者という規模から、国家的危機管理が必要。ただし記事では実験室確認、感染源、症状、輸入/輸出ケースの詳細が不明。追加情報収集が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Última hora del brote de hantavirus, en directo | Los 13 cruceristas españoles vuelven a dar negativo por hantavirus en la segunda PCR y podrán empezar a recibir visitas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking news: live coverage of the hantavirus outbreak | The 13 Spanish cruise passengers test negative again for hantavirus on the second PCR test and will be able to start receiving visitors.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization (WHO) and the World Bank warn that pandemic risk is advancing faster than prevention investments, per the Global Preparedness Monitoring Board (GPMB) at the 79th WHO Assembly in Geneva. The final report states the world is not safer than a decade ago and calls for continuous surveillance, equitable access to vaccines, tests, and treatments, and sufficient funding from day zero. The WHO maintains international emergencies for the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and in Uganda, and for the multinational Andes hantavirus outbreak linked to the cruise MV Hondius that docked in Rotterdam, Netherlands. Regarding the hantavirus, 13 Spanish cruise passengers tested negative again on a second PCR test and will be able to start receiving visitors.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス流行の速報：スペイン人乗客13名が2回目のPCR検査で再度陰性となり、訪問を受け始めることができるようになった
triage.triage_reason: 多国籍ハンタウイルス流行（クルーズ船MV Hondius関連）により、国際的拡大リスク、異常性、管理可能性に関する懸念が認められ、IHR基準3つ以上該当。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態に指定されており、公衆衛生への重大な影響がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはジュネーブで開催されたWHO総会でのパンデミック予防に関する警告とBundibugyo Ebola outbreak（DRC・ウガンダ）の両方を言及しているが、ハンタウイルス流行の具体的な発生地は多国籍クルーズ船関連（オランダ・ロッテルダムに寄港）である。DRCとウガンダはEbola outbreak関連の言及だが、対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCとしている。ただし、ハンタウイルスの主要な発生地はオランダ・スイスであり、対象国リストに含まれていない点に注意。本シグナルはIHR基準4つ全て、WPRO基準5つ全てに該当し、WHO国際保健上の緊急事態に指定されている点で、優先度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO declares Ebola emergency: Why Ebola is deadly, how it attacks you
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-19, WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for the ongoing Ebola outbreak in Congo and Uganda. The crisis is driven by Bundibugyo, a less common but deadly strain; laboratory-confirmed cases are few, with dozens more deaths under investigation near the Congo–Uganda border. Mortality for Bundibugyo is around 30–50%. Ebola spreads via contact with infected blood, saliva, vomit, sweat, contaminated equipment, or unsafe caregiving and burial practices. Early symptoms mimic common infections—fever, weakness, headache, muscle pain, sore throat—and can progress to vomiting, diarrhea, bleeding, respiratory distress and neurological deterioration. Healthcare worker infections signal gaps in infection-control and raise hospital amplification risk. The declaration aims to strengthen surveillance, cross-border coordination, and preparedness, with rapid diagnostics, transparent reporting and international cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱の緊急事態を宣言：エボラが致命的である理由、その攻撃メカニズム
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHO PHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）の正式宣言、コンゴとウガンダでの確認、高い致死率（30-50%）、医療従事者の感染、国境を越えた症例報告があり、シグナルとしてフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは「Congo and Uganda」での発生を述べているが、対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外した。WHOのPHEIC正式宣言により、国際的な懸念は極めて高い。Bundibugyo株（致死率30-50%）による複数国での流行、医療従事者感染、国境地帯での症例集積など、すべてのスクリーニング基準を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Le CDC Afrique déclare l'épidémie d'Ebola comme urgence de santé publique de portée continentale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa CDC Declares the Ebola Outbreak a Public Health Emergency of Continental Concern
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda is declared a Public Health Emergency of Continental Concern by Africa CDC. About 395 suspected cases and 106 deaths in DRC, concentrated in Mongwalu, Rwampara, and Bunia; Kampala, Uganda reports 2 cases and 1 death. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain, for which there is no specific vaccine, raises high regional spread risk. Africa CDC Director General Jean Kaseya says the declaration will boost regional coordination, mobilize emergency resources, and accelerate preparedness in neighboring countries. Cross-border movement, insecurity in affected areas, and weak infection prevention may amplify spread; emergency response teams have been deployed to support containment.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、エボラ感染症アウトブレイクを大陸規模の公衆衛生上の緊急事態と宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、大陸規模での公式宣言、複数国での死亡者発生、Bundibugyo株（ワクチンなし）による高い地域拡大リスク、および国際的な資源動員が必要な状況。
triage.notes: DRCでの発生が主体（395疑似患者、106死亡、Bunia等に集中）。ウガンダ（Kampala）での2症例1死亡も記述されているが、記事サマリーではDRCが主体的な発生地であり、対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。Africa CDC による大陸規模の公式宣言（PHECC）がなされており、ワクチン未開発のBundibugyo株という特に危険な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Internationale noodsituatie na ebola-uitbraak: 'Er bestaat gewoon nog geen vaccin tegen het Bundibugyo-virus'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: International emergency after Ebola outbreak: "There simply isn't yet a vaccine against the Bundibugyo virus."
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-19, the World Health Organization declared an international emergency over an outbreak of the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. Bundibugyo Ebola virus has a high case fatality rate of about 40–60% (outbreaks up to 90% when untreated) and there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. As of now, roughly 85 suspected deaths and about 280 probable infections have been reported across DRC and Uganda, with indications of wide-spread transmission and uncertainty over the true toll. Early symptoms are nonspecific—fever, muscle pain, malaise—with diarrhea and vomiting later, and bleeding is uncommon early. Diagnosis relies on laboratory testing; rapid, validated point-of-care tests are not yet available. Response requires active case finding, patient isolation, PPE for health workers (11 incidents reported), and community engagement, though access is hampered by distance, infrastructure, and ongoing conflict, including proximity to the South Sudan border.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ発生後の国際的非常事態：「ブンディブギョウイルスに対するワクチンはまだ存在しない」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WHOが国際的緊急事態を宣言。フルRRAに進める。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの発生が明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないためDRCのみを verified_locations に含めた。40-60%の高い致死率、280例の可能性感染例、ワクチン・特異的治療の欠如、保健労働者への曝露事例（11件）、南スーダン国境付近での紛争など、複数の悪化要因が存在。WHO国際的緊急事態宣言により社会政治的関心も極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: ترامب قلق من انتشار فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trump Worried About the Spread of the Ebola Virus.
article.articleSummary: May 18, 2026: The CDC announced that one American contracted Ebola while in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. President Donald Trump, speaking at a White House event promoting his Trump RX site, said he is worried about Ebola’s spread, noting the virus is currently contained in Africa but has had an outbreak. The World Health Organization designated the Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with active transmission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The WHO also said the situation does not meet the criteria for a pandemic under the International Health Regulations. The report also references Trump’s past criticisms of Barack Obama in 2014 during the Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ大統領、エボラウイルスの拡大に懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において4項目すべてが該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目が該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による公衆衛生上の国際的緊急事態が宣言されており、DRCおよびウガンダでの能動的伝播が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCでの能動的伝播が主題であり、ウガンダでの確認もあると述べられているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。米国での1例の報告は二次的情報。WHOが PHEIC を宣言していることが重要。フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spaventa l'Africa. Oms convoca comitato di emergenza: "Serve risposta globale immediata"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola scares Africa. WHO convenes emergency committee: "An immediate global response is needed."
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports at least 131 Ebola deaths and more than 513 suspected cases, with authorities indicating the outbreak is now affecting a wider area beyond initial districts. In Uganda, the CDC reports two confirmed Ebola cases and one death, with isolation precautions visible at Entebbe’s hospital isolation center. The World Health Organization has declared the current Bundibugyo strain of Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, triggering an immediate global response. The designation underscores the international significance of the outbreak and the need for coordinated surveillance, contact tracing, and infection-control measures across borders. Health authorities are monitoring cross-border movements and accelerating diagnostic confirmation, while deploying resources to affected communities in both the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The article emphasizes rapid, international mobilization to contain this multi-country Ebola event.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがアフリカを脅かす。WHO緊急委員会を召集：「迅速な世界的対応が必要」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで、複数国にまたがる多国籍エボラアウトブレイク。即座にフルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRC とウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイクが述べられているが、ウガンダ（GeoNames ID: 226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。Bundibugyo strain（エボラウイルス属 BDBV）で PHEIC 宣言済み。131 名死亡、513 疑い症例以上。緊急性は最高レベル。

article.articleHeadline: US to screen for Ebola at airports as ECDC deploys experts to region
article.articleSummary: CDC will screen air travelers from Ebola-affected regions; non-US passport holders who traveled to Uganda, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), or South Sudan in the past 21 days face entry restrictions. The US Embassy in Kampala has paused visa services. CDC says the immediate risk to the general US public is low. An American citizen has tested positive for Ebola in the DRC after work-related exposure; the patient will be transferred to Germany for treatment, and six more Americans will be evacuated for health monitoring. The US activated a response plan and mobilized about $13 million in foreign assistance within 48 hours to support surveillance, lab capacity, risk communication, safe burials, screening, and clinical case management. WHO declared the Ebola outbreaks in DRC and Uganda a global health emergency, with at least 100 deaths and around 400 suspected cases as of Monday; most patients are 20–39, and more than 60% are women. ECDC is deploying experts to Africa, starting with Addis Ababa for infection prevention, epidemiology, surveillance, and risk communication.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ対策で空港検査を強化、ECDCが専門家を地域に派遣
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスは重篤な公衆衛生影響を持ち、複数国での流行拡大が確認され、国際的な渡航制限・貿易制限が実施されている。WHO緊急事態宣言済みで、国際的支援が既に動員されている。
triage.notes: 記事では南スーダン(South Sudan)の言及がありますが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めません。DRCとウガンダが確認される実際の流行地であり、米国・ドイツは医療対応国です。WHO緊急事態宣言(少なくとも100人の死亡、約400人の疑い患者)、ECDC派遣、米国による空港検査・渡航制限の実施により、多項目での基準満たし状況が明確。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: 'Temos um ano atípico para a gripe, com uma temporada precoce e maior taxa de transmissão', diz infectologista
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: We have an atypical year for influenza, with an early season and a higher transmission rate," says an infectious disease specialist.
article.articleSummary: Influenza vaccination in Brazil began March 28, 2026, during an atypical year with an early season and higher transmission. The campaign prioritizes high-risk groups, because 70–80% of influenza deaths occur there, and supply is limited: Brazil buys about 70 million doses for roughly 215 million people, with the Butantan Institute delivering doses incrementally. Therefore, initial vaccination targets aim to reduce hospitalizations and deaths, though coverage among vulnerable seniors remains incomplete. In Rio de Janeiro, vaccine doses were offered to the entire population once shipments arrived, raising concerns about leaving some elderly unvaccinated. Coverage so far: gestating women 30–34%, elderly around 50%. Last year’s vaccine offers little to no protection after six months, so annual revaccination is needed. Vaccine composition is set by the WHO in September for the Southern Hemisphere, and effectiveness varies with strain matching (notably H3N2 and B-line variants).

triage.headline_ja: 「インフルエンザの異常な年であり、早い季節と高い伝播率がある」と感染症専門医が述べる
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのインフルエンザシーズンが例年より早期かつ伝播率が高いことが報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、流行しやすさ）に該当する。しかし死亡例の明示的記載がなく、国際的拡大や深刻な公衆衛生影響の具体的証拠が不足しているため、続報を注視すべき段階と判定。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルにおけるインフルエンザシーズンが早期かつ伝播率が高いという異常性を指摘している。予防接種キャンペーンが進行中で、供給制限がある状況。しかし具体的な患者数や死亡数、入院数の記載がないため重症度評価が難しい。H3N2およびB型インフルエンザ亜型に関連した情報があるが、現段階では地域的な流行報告の段階と判定。

article.articleHeadline: بعد إصابة أمريكي بـ"إيبولا".. واشنطن تشدد الإجراءات وتعلق التأشيرات - وكالة ستيب نيوز
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After an American contracted Ebola, Washington tightens procedures and suspends visas - Step News Agency
article.articleSummary: First U.S. Ebola case triggers tightened precautions: As of May 19, 2026, an American working in the Democratic Republic of Congo has been confirmed infected with Ebola. The CDC imposed enhanced entry controls and screening for travelers from Uganda, the DRC, or South Sudan who have visited within the last 21 days, and temporarily suspended visa services at the U.S. embassy in Kampala. Washington plans to evacuate six more people for health monitoring and is sending an additional technical coordinator to the region; preparations are under way to transfer the patient to Germany for treatment. There is no vaccine or specific therapy for this Ebola strain. About 350 suspected cases have been reported, mostly aged 20–39, with more than 60% of cases among women. WHO has declared a public health emergency; the United States has recently withdrawn from WHO, raising questions about future funding and containment capacity, including USAID's role.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ人がエボラ感染後、ワシントンが対策を強化しビザ発給を一時停止 - ステップニュースエージェンシー
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の確定例が報告され、WHOが公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。複数国への国際的拡大リスクが高く、米国が入国管理と渡航制限を実施。
triage.notes: 記事では米国での事例報告と対応が主焦点だが、発生地はDRCであり、ウガンダと南スーダンへの地域的拡大懸念がある。WHO公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、米国WHO脱退による国際協調体制への影響も指摘されている。患者数350例以上、死亡報告ありと記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolos virusu užsikrėtęs JAV pilietis bus gydomas Vokietijoje
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. citizen infected with the Ebola virus will be treated in Germany.
article.articleSummary: One American physician infected with Ebola virus from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is to be treated in Germany, with six high-risk contacts also relocated there for care due to Germany's Ebola expertise and shorter flight time. Citizenship details for those moved have not been disclosed; the exact treatment facility in Germany was not specified. US media identified the patient as a doctor, and a US-based mission organization reported the infection occurred while treating patients in a hospital in the DRC. The World Health Organization has declared an international public health emergency for Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda. The outbreak involves a rare Ebola strain with no vaccine, raising concerns of wider regional spread. Africa CDC estimates the outbreak began around the third week of April, with reporting only in early May 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスに感染した米国市民がドイツで治療を受けることになった
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WHOが国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言したエボラ出血熱の確定患者および高リスク接触者の国際移送事案。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題は民主共和国での発生後、感染医師および接触者がドイツに移送されるケース。DRCでのエボラ出血熱確定患者が確認されているため対象国に該当。WHOが国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言済み。ワクチン未開発の稀な株系統。

article.articleHeadline: La Unió Africana declara l'emergència continental pel brot d'Ebola que ja ha causat més cent morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The African Union declares a continental emergency over the Ebola outbreak that has already caused more than a hundred deaths.
article.articleSummary: On May 19, 2026, the African Union's public health agency declared a continental public health emergency over an Ebola outbreak that began in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province) and has spread to Uganda. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo variant and has already caused more than 100 deaths. The declaration aims to intensify regional coordination and mobilize resources to the response amid insecurity and cross-border movement. The decision followed consultations with the African Union and affected states. The Africa CDC said the measure empowers the AU to lead and coordinate responses to significant health emergencies across the continent. The World Health Organization had previously declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ連合がエボラ出血熱の流行について大陸規模の緊急事態を宣言、既に100人以上の死者が発生
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当、WHO PHEIC宣言済みの重大イベント。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo variant エボラ出血熱の流行。DRCのIturi州で発生し、ウガンダに拡大。既にWHOがPHEIC宣言済みの重大イベント。アフリカ連合の大陸規模緊急事態宣言は地域的危機管理の強化を示唆。発生地域にUSA（District of Columbia）が含まれているが、記事サマリーに米国での症例発生の言及がないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙。

article.articleHeadline: تقديرات: وفاة 131 شخصا بإيبولا في الكونغو الديموقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Estimates: 131 people dead from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo's health minister estimates 131 Ebola deaths among 513 suspected cases linked to Bundibugyo virus circulating in the DRC; earlier reports cited 88 deaths and 300 suspected cases in the DRC, plus one death and one suspected case in Uganda. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for the Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda, noting it does not meet the criteria for a pandemic. The PHEIC aims to keep neighboring countries on high alert and mobilize international support and resources to contain the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 推定：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスにより131人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。複数国での確認、高い死亡率、国際支援の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: ウガンダも記事で言及されているが、確認される症例は1例のみ（死亡1、疑い1）であり、主要な発生地はDRCである。WHOによるPHEIC宣言は既になされており、国際的な注視が集まっている。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（Ebola-Bundibugyo）は高い死亡率を示す。

article.articleHeadline: الولايات المتحدة تشدد إجراءاتها الوقائية ضد إيبولا بعد إصابة مواطن أمريكى فى الكونغو - مصر 140
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States tightens its preventive measures against Ebola after an American citizen contracted Ebola in the Congo - Egypt 140.
article.articleSummary: May 19, 2026: Ebola outbreak response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompts the United States to tighten preventive measures. Following the WHO’s international health emergency declaration over Ebola in DR Congo, the U.S. is boosting entry screening for travelers from affected areas and temporarily suspending visa services for several countries. An American who worked in DR Congo developed Ebola symptoms over the weekend and laboratory tests confirmed infection; the patient is being evacuated to Germany for treatment. Six other individuals are being evacuated for health monitoring. About 25 U.S. embassy staff remain in the DR Congo, with an additional CDC technical coordinator to be deployed. The CDC says the direct risk to U.S. citizens is low, with potential adjustments to precautions as more information becomes available.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がコンゴでのエボラ感染後に予防措置を強化—米国市民がコンゴで感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当、高い社会政治的関心あり。確認済み対象国はDRCのみ。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCでのエボラ流行が主題。米国とドイツはこの事象への対応国として言及されており、実際の発生地ではない。WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言済みの既知流行。米国市民の感染確認により国際的な拡大・渡航制限措置が顕在化している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo: Help verstärkt Präventionsmaßnahmen in Goma und leistet Hilfe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo: Help strengthens prevention measures in Goma and provides aid.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in North Kivu in the east, with a health emergency declared after nationwide reports of more than 400 Ebola cases as of May 2026. The border between Rwanda’s Gisenyi and the DRC’s Goma is closed to contain spread. Help - Hilfe zur Selbsthilfe, in partnership with UGEAFI, intensifies prevention and relief measures in health facilities, hospitals, and displacement camps, including producing and distributing liquid chlorine for disinfection and providing training to health and community staff. The country’s health system is overwhelmed, with roughly 15 million people dependent on humanitarian aid, risking further transmission due to ongoing displacement. Ebola is described as highly contagious; the organization calls for urgent additional financial support to sustain emergency relief and prevent escalation in Nord-Kivu. Contact details for press inquiries are provided by the NGO.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行：Helpがゴマでの予防措置を強化し支援を提供
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべて該当。エボラの国際的に重大な公衆衛生リスク、ルワンダとの国境措置、400例以上の患者数、保健システムの崩壊により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスの国家規模の流行（2026年5月時点で400例以上）。ゴマとルワンダのジセニ間の国境閉鎖が実施されており、国際的な拡大リスクが顕著。DRCの保健システム全体の崩壊と1,500万人が人道支援に依存している状況から、管理不可能性が高い。ルワンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCでの流行であり、ルワンダでの確認事例は明記されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Проф. Ива Христова разясни как се предава хантавирусът и защо няма риск от пандемия
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prof. Iva Hristova explained how the hantavirus is transmitted and why there is no risk of a pandemic.
article.articleSummary: Romania hantavirus case not lab-confirmed; samples sent, but confirmation pending, so initial counts may be revised. The patient did not travel to South America, making infection from that region unlikely. Prof. Iva Hristova of the Bulgarian National Center of Public Health says Bulgarian hantaviruses differ from the South American strain, with a distinct clinical picture and much lower mortality. In Bulgaria, transmission occurs only via excreta from infected rodents in specific areas and is not person-to-person. She notes there is no basis for a COVID-19-like pandemic; even Andean hantavirus requires very close, prolonged contact to spread. There is no officially approved antiviral for hantavirus; some drugs show lab activity but have not completed trials. Diagnosis relies on clinical presentation and epidemiological linkage before laboratory confirmation. Regarding Ebola in Congo and Uganda, mortality can reach 50-70% for that variant; Bulgaria maintains border health controls and no direct flights to Congo.

triage.headline_ja: イヴァ・フリストバ教授がハンタウイルスの感染方法と、パンデミックのリスクがない理由を説明
triage.triage_reason: 複数の高リスク疾患（COVID-19、ハンタウイルス感染症、エボラ）が言及されているが、記事の主要な議論はブルガリアのハンタウイルス状況に関する専門家の解説であり、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクは低い。対象国ではDRCのエボラのみが検証可能だが、記事本文の詳細情報が不足しており、DRC内の具体的な発生状況の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではブルガリア・ルーマニアのハンタウイルス状況について述べられているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれない。DRCのエボラについて「mortality can reach 50-70%」と言及されており、対象国であるため検証位置に含めた。ただし、DRC内の具体的な確認患者数や流行状況の詳細情報が不足しており、フルRRA前に情報追加が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: 台灣出現首例Ib型變種M痘　20多歲男旅泰「做這事」返台確診-台視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taiwan reports its first Type Ib variant monkeypox case; a man in his twenties who traveled to Thailand did this and was diagnosed after returning to Taiwan – TTV News Network.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports its first overseas-imported Type Ib variant monkeypox case: a man in his twenties from northern Taiwan, who had unprotected sex with a partner in Thailand in mid-April. After returning home, he developed genital vesicles and hand/foot rash; mpox was lab-confirmed, with the virus identified as Ib-type, branch 1. This marks the first Ib-type imported case since 2022; the patient has completed Stage 1 of self-health management and entered Stage 2. In May, two additional mpox cases were recorded—one local man in his 40s and another imported case—both with prior unprotected sex and unvaccinated. Taiwan’s 2026 mpox total reaches 14. Ib-type is considered slightly higher risk, but current guidance treats Ib and non-Ib strains with the same two-stage self-management. Separately, a domestic pertussis case involves a newborn girl under 1 in northern Taiwan; the mother was unvaccinated. The infant’s PCR was positive; total pertussis cases this year are 4. Public health advises vigilance for persistent cough and advocates infant and pregnancy vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 台湾で初のIb型変異体M痘を報告。20代男性がタイ旅行から帰台後、感染を確認─台視ニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Mpox Clade I・II および新型Ib型変異体の輸入症例は国際的関心が高く、WPRO基準も複数該当。迅速なフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はMpox Clade I（Ib型変異体）の輸入症例（タイからの入境者）。タイは感染源地として文脈に登場。台湾はMpoxの確認地だが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。Pertussis症例も記載されているが二次的な報告。国際的な懸念は主にMpox Ib型変異体の出現と国境を越えた伝播リスク。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: 台灣首見！20多歲男赴泰國染M痘Ib型  不安全性行為後下體長水泡 - 自由健康網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taiwan's first case! A man in his twenties who went to Thailand contracted mpox Type Ib and developed genital blisters after unsafe sex.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan confirms its first imported Monkeypox case caused by Monkeypox virus Ib sublineage (Branch I, Ib). A northern Taiwan man in his 20s returned from Thailand after unsafe sex and developed genital vesicles; genome sequencing verified Ib infection, the first such imported case since 2022 when mpox became a notifiable disease. In May 2026, two new mpox cases were reported, both unvaccinated; the other is a domestic case in a man in his 40s with multiple vesicles. By May 18, Taiwan’s total mpox cases reached 14 (12 domestic, 2 imported), ages 20–50, with about 90% unvaccinated. Ib has spread cross-border (UK, Germany, Thailand, Singapore); severity is not markedly higher than the II lineage, but depends on host immunity. Public health notes: two-dose mpox vaccination ~90% protection, one-dose ~40–80%; reinforce vaccination for at-risk individuals, avoid unsafe sex, seek prompt care if symptomatic and disclose travel/contact history. Two-stage self-health management applies to Ib and II branches.

triage.headline_ja: 台湾初確認！20代男性がタイで感染、M痘Ib型に 不安全な性行為後に陰部に水疱
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での初のMpox Clade I (Ib型)輸入症例確認であり、国内症例増加（2026年5月に新規2症例）とともに、Ib型が複数国境を越えて拡大（UK、ドイツ、タイ、シンガポール）している状況が報告されており、IHR基準（異常性・国際拡大リスク）およびWPRO基準（異常/予想外、流行しやすさ）の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾での初のMpox Clade I (Ib型)輸入症例を報道しており、Ib型の国際的拡大（UK、Germany、Thailand、Singapore報告済み）が示唆されている。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず、実際の発生・感染地である Thailand のみを記載。Ib型の感染力や重症度はII型との比較で「顕著に高くない」とされているが、予防接種率の低さ（約90%が未接種）と複数国での報告から流行拡大リスクが存在する。

article.articleHeadline: الولايات المتحدة تشدد احترازاتها ضد إيبولا بعد إصابة أمريكي في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States Tightens Precautions Against Ebola After an American Was Infected in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompts tightened U.S. precautions. The United States is enhancing guardrails by screening travelers from affected areas and temporarily suspending visa services for certain countries, following the World Health Organization’s declaration of an international health emergency over the Congo outbreak. An American contracted the Ebola virus while in the DRC; symptoms appeared over the weekend and laboratory tests confirmed infection. The patient is being transported to Germany for treatment. In the response, U.S. authorities plan to evacuate six additional people for health monitoring, and about 25 U.S. embassy staff remain in Congo to support operations, with the CDC sending an additional technical coordinator. CDC says the immediate risk to Americans is low, though protective measures may be adjusted as new information becomes available.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でアメリカ人がエボラに感染した後、米国がエボラに対する予防措置を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言済みのエボラアウトブレイクであり、米国市民の感染確認、複数国での対応実施。
triage.notes: DRCに限定してトリアージ。米国とドイツは発生地ではなく対応地のため verified_locations に含めない。WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言済み、複数国での予防措置実施、確認患者あり、高リスク。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, l'epidemia si espande ancora: 118 morti. Contagiato medico Usa. Trump: "Il virus per ora è in Africa"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, the epidemic is spreading again: 118 dead. Infected U.S. doctor. Trump: "The virus is in Africa for now."
article.articleSummary: Ebola epidemic spreading in Africa with 118 deaths and more than 513 suspected cases reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to local authorities and the BBC. Uganda confirms two cases and one death; South Sudan reports a case near the border. The World Health Organization (WHO) has convened its Emergency Committee as cases expand to Nyakunde (Ituri), Butembo (North Kivu), and Goma. An American physician, Peter Stafford, treating patients in Congo, has tested positive for the Bundibugyo strain; he will be transferred to a U.S. base in Germany with six other exposed Americans who are quarantined. The patient’s wife remains asymptomatic. President Trump says Ebola remains confined to Africa for now but is surging. Rapid international assistance: WHO Africa delivered nearly 12 tons of emergency supplies; Nairobi’s ER hub sent 4.7 tons to Bunia, and Kinshasa delivered 7 tons on May 17 with 35 experts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、流行はまた拡大：118人が死亡。米国人医師が感染。トランプ：「ウイルスは今のところアフリカにいる」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響（118死亡、513疑似患者）、異常/予想外の急速な拡大、複数国への国際的拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）、国際的な渡航・貿易制限リスクを示している。WPROスクリーニング基準もすべて該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い（WHO緊急委員会召集、米国医師の感染、トランプ大統領のコメント）。フルのRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事では複数国（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン、ケニア）で症例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（203312）のみ。ナイロビ、ドイツ、ウガンダは対象外。米国医師の感染および国際的な対応体制の確立は国際的関心と支援の必要性を強く示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Американец заразен со ебола евакуиран на лекување во Европа
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American infected with Ebola evacuated for treatment in Europe
article.articleSummary: An American citizen infected with Ebola after exposure while working with a medical missionary group in the Democratic Republic of Congo tested positive and was evacuated to Germany for treatment, the CDC confirms. Dr. Peter Stafford contracted the virus while treating patients at Nyankunde Hospital in Bunia, where he has worked since 2023. His wife, Dr. Rebecca Stafford, and their children are under supervision but asymptomatic. The CDC is coordinating evacuation of at least six more Americans who were in contact with the virus in the same region. The Congo outbreak has caused at least 131 deaths and more than 513 suspected cases; the WHO has declared a public health emergency. Ebola is primarily transmitted from animals, especially fruit bats, to humans, with human-to-human spread via contact with infected fluids or contaminated meat; symptoms appear 2–21 days after exposure. Outside Africa, risk is low, but travelers are advised to exercise caution.

triage.headline_ja: エボラに感染したアメリカ人がヨーロッパでの治療のため避難
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言したコンゴでのエボラ流行に関連し、患者が国際的に移送された事例であり、フルRRAを実施すべき。
triage.notes: DRC内で進行中のエボラ流行（131死亡、513以上の疑い症例）により、WHOが公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。患者の国際移送、複数の接触者が同地域に留まっている点、および医療施設での曝露という状況がリスク要因。ドイツへの移送は治療目的であり、発生地はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Власти ДР Конго: от предполагаемых случаев лихорадки Эбола умерли почти 120 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo authorities: nearly 120 people have died from suspected Ebola fever cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola fever outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has caused 118 deaths among 435 suspected cases as of May 18, 2026, with totals approaching 120 deaths and over 400 infections in Ituri and North Kivu provinces. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026 for the DRC-Uganda outbreak, though officials say the situation does not yet constitute a pandemic. Data are preliminary and still being analyzed to determine linkage to the Ebola virus. Ebola is a viral hemorrhagic fever transmitted from animals to humans and between people via close contact with bodily fluids; incubation ranges from 2 to 21 days. Early symptoms include fever, muscle pains, headache, and sore throat, followed by kidney and liver dysfunction and possible bleeding. Authorities urge calm and adherence to prevention measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国当局：エボラ出血熱の疑い症例による死亡者数が約120人に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言を発表した国際的に重大な感染症イベント。DRC-ウガンダ間の越境拡大を伴う。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC-ウガンダ間の越境拡大に触れているが、本イベントの主体はDRCのIturi及びNorth Kivu州でのエボラアウトブレークである。Ugandaは検出地域リストに含まれるが、サマリー上では確認症例が具体的に述べられていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダにおける確認された症例情報が追加される場合は、検証を再実施する必要がある。WHOのPHEIC宣言により、国際的な関心度は最高レベルにある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, urgență sanitară globală. Aproape 400 de cazuri și peste 100 de decese
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, a global health emergency. Nearly 400 cases and over 100 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo variant of Ebola virus spreading from the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province) to Uganda, with WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The Bundibugyo strain has mortality up to 50% and currently lacks approved vaccines or antivirals. As of 16 May 2026, Ituri reported over 390 suspected cases and at least 100 deaths; Uganda has two laboratory-confirmed cases and one death, linked to travelers from DR Congo. Combined, suspected cases in both countries approach 395; Rwanda and South Sudan are on maximum alert. Transmission occurs via contact with blood or body fluids of the infected, contaminated objects, or animal reservoirs; symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pains, weakness, diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and bleeding. The outbreak began in April, with alerts on 5 May. WHO recommends national disaster-management activation, rapid emergency centers, cross-border screening, and 21-day contact monitoring; travel restrictions are not scientifically justified.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、世界的健康上の緊急事態。約400件の症例と100人以上の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、WHOによるPublic Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC)の宣言、高い致死率（50%）、複数国への地理的拡大、および多くの死亡例を伴う重症なエボラウイルス感染症の集団発生。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo variant of Ebola virus, high mortality rate (50%), WHO declares PHEIC. Uganda and Rwanda are mentioned as neighboring countries with alert status, but the primary active outbreak with confirmed cases is in DRC (Ituri province) and Uganda. Uganda has 2 confirmed cases linked to travelers from DRC; however, the article's main focus is on the DRC outbreak and regional spread. For verified_locations, only DRC (confirmed target country) is included as the primary outbreak location. The outbreak represents a critical public health emergency requiring immediate international response.

article.articleHeadline: Infectious disease expert: PH ready for ebola threat
article.articleSummary: WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC) for Bundibugyo ebolavirus linked to outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Philippine infectious-disease expert Dr. Rontgene Solante says the Philippines is prepared to face the threat, citing lessons learned from COVID-19 and other outbreaks. He favors border screening over travel bans, noting checks on symptoms and passengers' country of origin. The Department of Health has ordered heightened border screening, with the Bureau of Quarantine on alert at airports and seaports to reinforce health surveillance. Health Secretary Teodoro Herbosa said surveillance at borders will be intensified to prevent Ebola entry. The WHO states the PHEIC does not constitute a pandemic emergency.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症専門家：フィリピンはエボラ脅威に対応準備完了
triage.triage_reason: WHO公式PHEIC宣言されたBundibugyo ebolavirus（IHR基準2つ以上該当：深刻な公衆衛生影響＆国際的拡大リスク）。複数国での確認とフィリピンの準備状況が報告されており、シグナルレベルのイベント。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言済み。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラウイルス属）のDRC・ウガンダでの発生が確認され、フィリピンが対応準備を整備している。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。記事主題はDRCとフィリピンの対応関係に焦点。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. Embassy in Kampala suspends Visa Operations Amid Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: May 18, 2026: the U.S. Embassy in Kampala suspended all visa services in Uganda due to an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo virus strain, linked to a broader regional outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The suspension affects all visa categories; no new appointments are scheduled, and existing appointments are canceled and rescheduled. Already issued visas remain valid; refunds for canceled interviews are not provided. Non-immigrant visa application fees stay valid for 365 days from receipt, with interviews potentially occurring after the 365-day window if scheduling remains within 365 days. The World Health Organization designated the Uganda outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) due to cross-border spread and rising case numbers. Uganda confirmed an outbreak after an imported case from DRC that resulted in death in Kampala; additional suspected infections are under monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: U.S. Embassy in Kampala suspends Visa Operations Amid Ebola Outbreak（カンパラ米国大使館、エボラ流行の中でビザ業務を停止）
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）による地域流行で、WHOがPHEIC指定、ウガンダとDRCでの越境感染の危険性が確認されており、IHR基準4項目全て該当。国際的なビザ業務停止という外交的影響も伴う。
triage.notes: 記事は米国大使館のビザ業務停止を報じているが、実際の感染症イベントはウガンダとDRC東部での Bundibugyo エボラ流行。WHO による PHEIC 指定により国際的対応が必要。DRC からウガンダへの越境感染が確認されており、地域的な拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Bundibugyo Strain Of Ebola Virus Explained: The Rare Strain Responsible For The Current Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda prompts WHO to declare a public health emergency of international concern. As of Monday, there are more than 100 suspected deaths and about 400 suspected infections. The Bundibugyo strain, named after Uganda’s Bundibugyo province (identified 2007–2008), is one of four ebolavirus species and causes about 30–40% mortality, far lower than Zaire strain’s up to 90%. Transmission is by direct contact with bodily fluids, with hospital workers at high risk. Symptoms begin with flu-like illness—fever, fatigue, muscle pain—progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, bleeding, and potential organ failure; incubation averages 8–10 days, up to three weeks. No approved vaccines or drugs exist; emergency use authorization would be required for experimental therapies. Tests exist but are not widely used, with early analyses missing infections due to testing for the wrong strain. Public health measures—rapid case detection, isolation, contact tracing, infection control, safe burials, and community engagement—are central.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョ株エボラウイルスの説明：現在の流行の原因となっている希少株
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO が国際的懸念事項としての公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言し、100 以上の疑い死亡と約 400 の感染が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの発生が言及されているが、ウガンダはBluedotの対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみを記載。100以上の疑い死亡、約400の感染、WHO による国際的懸念事項としての公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言により、全IHR基準と全WPRO基準を満たす最重要案件。

article.articleHeadline: What You Need To Know About Ebolaviruses
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-19, the World Health Organization declares an Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda a public health emergency of international concern. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, one of six ebolaviruses (Ebola, Sudan, Reston, Taï Forest, Bombali); Bundibugyo has previously caused outbreaks in 2007–2008 and 2012. It causes disease indistinguishable from other EVDs but with a lower mortality rate (about 30–40% versus up to 90% for Ebola virus) and currently lacks approved vaccines or targeted therapies. Transmission begins zoonotically, with fruit bats as the natural reservoir and non-human primates implicated; human-to-human spread occurs through direct contact with body fluids or contaminated objects. Australia’s risk remains very low; travellers should avoid contact with the ill, practice hygiene, and monitor after returning. CSIRO has studied ebolaviruses for 15 years, including evidence of antibodies in Australian bats but no disease-causing strain detected.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスについて知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてが該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数の対象国（DRC、ウガンダ周辺）でのエボラアウトブレイク。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIはオーストラリア、ウガンダも発生地域として付与しているが、サマリーの主題はDRCとウガンダでのBundibugyo ebolavirusアウトブレイクであり、オーストラリアはリスク評価対象国として記載されている（実際の発生地ではない）。DRCのみが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。WHO PHEIC宣言により即時フルRRA化が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Σύσκεψη σήμερα στον ΕΟΔΥ για τον ιό Έμπολα -Τι αναμένεται να συζητηθεί - iefimerida.gr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meeting today at EODY regarding the Ebola virus - What is expected to be discussed.
article.articleSummary: On 19 May 2026, experts convened at Greece’s National Public Health Organization (EODY) to discuss the ongoing Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, chaired by Theodoros Vasilakopoulos. The meeting’s agenda includes the potential issuance of a travel advisory for the two countries by EODY, though such a measure is not expected to gain traction. The United States CDC has already issued a travel advisory for DRC and Uganda, valid for 30 days from 18 May. The report provides no case counts, symptoms, or laboratory confirmations; instead, it emphasizes public-health planning, risk assessment, traveler guidance, and considerations around imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ギリシャのEODYでエボラウイルスに関する会議が開催 - 何が議論される予定か
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの発生は重大な公衆衛生脅威であり、複数国での流行が報告されているが、記事は当該国での患者発生や具体的なリスク評価ではなく、ギリシャにおける行政的対応会議の報告に限定されており、ギリシャ国内での感染事例や具体的な影響の記述がない。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはGreece、United States、Ugandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCとウガンダでの発生イベント自体であり、ギリシャはこれに対する行政的対応会議の開催地である。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。本案件はIHR基準4/4該当であるが、WPRO地域外の一次発生地（DRC）での流行報告であり、かつ記事がギリシャの行政対応に限定されているため、PICKUP判定ではなくWATCH判定とした。DRCでの具体的な患者数、症例確認、死亡率などの詳細情報が必要。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: International health experts meet in search for Ebola Bundibugyo vaccine options
article.articleSummary: London, May 19, 2026 — A WHO-led panel will meet on Tuesday to discuss vaccine options for a major Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, focusing on the Bundibugyo strain. The outbreak has 500 reported cases and 131 suspected deaths. WHO and Africa CDC have declared a public health emergency. There are no vaccines or treatments approved specifically for Bundibugyo, which carries a fatality rate up to 40%. Merck’s Ervebo vaccine for Ebola Zaire has shown some cross-protection against Bundibugyo in animal studies, and testing of this and other options will be considered. Dr Mosoka Fallah of Africa CDC notes the team will weigh available evidence to determine the best approach.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱ブンディブギョ株のワクチン選択肢を求めて国際保健専門家が会合
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。コンゴ民主共和国東部でのエボラ出血熱ブンディブギョ株の大規模流行（500例、死亡131例確認）はWHOおよびアフリカCDCが公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している重大事象。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはEngland、London、UKが含まれているが、記事サマリーではこれらは会議開催地であり、実際のエボラ出血熱事例はコンゴ民主共和国東部のみで発生している。ブンディブギョ株は致死率40%と非常に高く、承認済みの特異的ワクチン・治療薬がないため管理可能性に懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Face à Ebola, les Etats-Unis instaurent des contrôles aux frontières
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Facing Ebola, the United States imposes border controls.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) prompts U.S. border controls as the World Health Organization declares the DRC Ebola outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. A U.S. citizen contracted the virus while working in the DRC and developed symptoms over the weekend; the case tested positive late Sunday and the patient will be treated in Germany. The United States will implement health screenings for air travelers arriving from Ebola-affected countries—Uganda, the DRC, and South Sudan—and temporarily restrict visas for foreigners who have traveled to these zones in the past 21 days. The CDC says the immediate risk to the American public remains low but will reassess as new information becomes available and may adjust public health measures accordingly.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対策として米国が国境管理を導入
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHOが国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言し、複数国での流行、国際的症例発生、渡航・貿易制限措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）が主要な流行地として記述されている。ウガンダと南スーダンも言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。米国の渡航制限措置は対象国に含まれないため同様に除外。WHOによる国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言が確認されており、国際的拡大のリスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع وفيات إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 118 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 118.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have reached 118, with more than 390 suspected cases reported across multiple areas. A government spokesperson said infections span a broader region. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern last Sunday, noting hundreds of suspected cases and dozens of deaths in the DRC, alongside two confirmed cases in neighboring Uganda. Ebola is a highly infectious viral disease transmitted through direct physical contact or exposure to the bodily fluids of the infected. Health authorities are mounting aggressive containment efforts, but the outbreak remains alarming and requires sustained international coordination to curb transmission and prevent cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱死亡者数が118人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外の事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで国際的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダへの2例の確定例が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、国境を越えた感染拡大リスク高、攻撃的な封じ込め措置が進行中とのこと。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: 131 décès estimés et 513 cas suspects
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 131 estimated deaths and 513 suspected cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo: 131 deaths and 513 suspected cases, per Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba. The World Health Organization has declared an international public health emergency. The epicenter is Ituri province in the northeast, bordering Uganda and South Sudan, a mining region with heavy daily population movement. The virus has spread beyond Ituri and the DRC; suspected cases have been reported in Butembo (Nord-Kivu) about 200 km from the epicenter, and a case in Goma, Nord-Kivu’s large eastern city. Few samples have been laboratory-tested so far, so tallies rely largely on suspicion. The minister notes that community deaths cited may not all be Ebola-related. Ebola causes a highly contagious hemorrhagic fever; the article cites historical mortality, including over 15,000 deaths in Africa in five decades.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：推定131人の死亡と513件の疑い例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）、またWPRO基準すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の多国間での発生確認と高い致死性のため、直ちにフルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最高リスク病原体。DRC北東部イトゥリ州が主要流行地で、ウガンダ・南スーダン国境に近接。ゴマへの地理的拡大（200km）が確認されており、高い人口流動性のある鉱業地域での発生。WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している。検査確認数は限定的だが、疑い例数が多く、致死率が高い。Uganda/Sudanは記事内で隣接国として言及されているが、確実な症例報告がないため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: ضحايا إيبولا، ارتفاع عدد الوفيات بالكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 131 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola victims, death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 131.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda drive a rising death toll. As of May 19, 2026, the DRC Health Minister estimates 131 deaths among 513 suspected Ebola cases, with earlier figures reporting 88 deaths and about 300 suspected cases in the DRC. Uganda has reported 1 death and 1 suspected case. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for Ebola outbreaks caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in DRC and Uganda, signaling international concern while not reaching pandemic criteria. The declaration aims to alert neighboring countries and mobilize global support for outbreak response. The article notes suspected case counts and does not provide lab-confirmed counts, infection sources, or imported/exported case details, underscoring the need for rapid detection, cross-border coordination, and strengthened surveillance amid ongoing transmission in the two East African nations.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ被害、コンゴ民主共和国の死者数が131件に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。WHO PHEICが宣言されており、国際的な懸念と対応が既に動員されている。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも1件の死亡と1件の疑い例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHO PHEICが既に宣言されており、Bundibugyo ebolavirus による複数国アウトブレイク。死者数131名（513疑い例中）であり重症度が高い。ヒト-ヒト感染確認済みで流行可能性あり。国際的支援動員が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع الوفيات جراء فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو إلى 131 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll from the Ebola virus in Congo rises to 131.
article.articleSummary: Death toll from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has risen to 131 as of May 19, 2026. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern last Sunday amid an outbreak of a new Ebola variant. The current strain accounts for 88 deaths among 366 infections to date, a case-fatality rate around 30%. Ebola presents with flu-like symptoms; there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment yet. Transmission occurs through direct contact with contaminated clothing or bodily fluids, not via the air, making a global airborne pandemic unlikely. Prevention centers on avoiding direct contact with patients and their waste, alongside surveillance at airports, railways, and tourist zones. The article emphasizes the need for stronger international cooperation and support for African and poorer countries, noting four healthcare workers have died amid the outbreak and ongoing healthcare capacity strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラウイルスによる死亡者数が131件に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言した新型エボラウイルス株による同時流行であり、高い死亡率（30%）と国際的な懸念を伴う。
triage.notes: WHOが2026年5月19日にPHEIC（国際保健上の緊急事態）を宣言。新型エボラ株で死亡率30%（366感染中131死亡）。医療従事者4名を含む死亡あり。航空・鉄道・観光地での監視体制が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Congo opent drie speciale centra na nieuwe ebola-uitbraak: al 118 doden in korte tijd
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo opens three special centers after new Ebola outbreak: 118 dead in a short time.
article.articleSummary: Three Ebola treatment centers opened in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, after a new outbreak involving a rare Ebola variant. By May 19, 2026, at least 118 people had died and about 300 suspected cases were reported, with the first confirmed case dating to May 14. The World Health Organization deployed experts and declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). A death and a suspected case have been reported in neighboring Uganda. In the DRC, infections and fatalities are rising as authorities intensify surveillance and response. An American physician who worked in the DRC tested positive for Ebola and is being treated in Germany, according to the U.S. CDC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴが新型エボラ出血熱の流行後、3つの特別センターを開設：短期間に118人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患の新規流行であり、IHR基準4つすべて該当。WHO-PHEIC宣言済み、死亡118人、国際的な症例報告（ウガンダ、米国、ドイツ）があり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはウガンダ、米国、ドイツが含まれているが、記事サマリー上では、実際の流行発生地はDRCのイトゥリ州が主である。ウガンダ、米国、ドイツはいずれも二次的な輸入症例（隣国の1死亡1疑い、米国医師の渡航先感染）であり、対象国リストでもDRCのみが該当するため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙した。WHO-PHEIC宣言済みのため、緊急度は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in Congo rises to 131 as global health authorities remain on alert
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed at least 131 people, revised from 118, with more than 500 suspected cases under investigation. WHO and other international organisations issued warnings. The WHO chief had declared the outbreak an international public health emergency two days before the emergency committee meeting. An emergency committee meeting was scheduled for Tuesday to discuss the situation. Published 2026-05-19, global health authorities remain on alert as the outbreak continues. The article provides no details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or infection source. The update underscores ongoing surveillance and international concern from health authorities. The toll increase and infection status prompt continued international vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死亡者数が131人に増加、世界保健当局が警戒態勢を継続
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病による確認された死亡131人、疑い患者500人超との深刻な公衆衛生上の影響が認められる。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言しており、国際的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は最も危険な感染症の一つであり、死亡率が極めて高い。記事では131人の確認死亡と500人以上の疑い患者が報告されており、WHO事務局長が国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言している。国際的な警戒態勢が確立されている。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief 'deeply concerned' by scale of Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s eastern Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has 131 suspected deaths and 500 cases, with Uganda also affected. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus declared a public health emergency of international concern over Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, citing the outbreak's scale and speed. A WHO expert panel will assess potential vaccine options; there are no approved vaccines or treatments specifically for Bundibugyo, which carries up to a 40% fatality rate. The Merck Ervebo vaccine for Ebola Zaire exists but has shown only some protective evidence against Bundibugyo in animal studies. Decisions on testing additional countermeasures will depend on the available evidence. The emergency complements declarations by the WHO and Africa CDC, emphasizing urgent countermeasures for eastern DRC and neighboring Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、エボラ出血熱の流行規模に「深刻な懸念」を表明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOが国際的保健上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。東部コンゴとウガンダでの複数国にまたがる流行で、高い致死率（40%）と急速な感染拡大が確認されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、対象国リストにはないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは対象国リストに含まれている（ID: 203312）。WHOがPHEIC宣言を行った重大なシグナル。ワクチン・治療法の不足と高い致死率が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Cross-border Ebola threat sparks Africa CDC alert as SA urged vigilance
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province) with 393 suspected cases and 105 suspected deaths; eight laboratory-confirmed. Cross-border risk to Uganda (two cases confirmed in Kampala) and proximity to Rwanda and South Sudan prompted Africa CDC to issue a PHECS declaration based on recommendations from the Emergency Consultative Group chaired by Karim. First cases identified just over four to six weeks ago, with late detection contributing to spread. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved virus-specific therapeutics or vaccines and is harder to test in labs. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids from infected humans or animals, causing high fever, vomiting, and bleeding. Ongoing concerns include cross-border movement, mining-related mobility, insecurity, and deaths outside formal healthcare, underscoring the need for heightened surveillance and coordinated regional action.

triage.headline_ja: 国境を越えたエボラの脅威がアフリカCDCアラートを引き起こし、南アフリカに警戒呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国での確認、死亡例、アフリカCDCによる公式宣言により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: DRCのIturi州で発生した確認事例。ウガンダへの国境越え（Kampalaで2例確認）とルワンダ・南スーダンへの近接性も報告されているが、記事の主題イベントはDRC Ituri州での発症。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。Bundibugyo株で治療法・ワクチンなし、検査困難、致死率が高い。アフリカCDCがPHECS宣言を発出した重大事案。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемија се убрзано шири, најмање 118 мртвих
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The epidemic is spreading rapidly, with at least 118 dead.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed at least 118 and infected more than 390, with spread to Nyakunde (Ituri), Butembo (North Kivu), and the city of Goma. Uganda reports two confirmed cases and one death, per CDC. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, prompted WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Congolese authorities stress rigorous surveillance and contact tracing and urge calm, even as cases emerge in new districts. An American physician working in DRC, Peter Stafford, tested positive and will be evacuated to Germany for treatment; his wife Rebecca Stafford and another colleague were exposed and placed in quarantine. CBS News notes at least six Americans exposed; the CDC is coordinating a safe evacuation of a small number of directly affected U.S. nationals.

triage.headline_ja: エピデミックが急速に拡大、少なくとも118人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、WHO PHEIC宣言による異常性、複数国への国際的拡大、渡航・撤退の現実化）。また WPRO スクリーニング基準もすべて該当し、高い社会的・政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain によるエボラ出血熱の発生。118人の死亡、390人以上の感染者、複数地域への拡大、ウガンダへの越境確認、米国民を含む国際的な人員曝露が報告されている。WHO が PHEIC を宣言。米国医師の国外撤出、CDC による調整活動など、国際的な対応が既に開始されている。フルリスク評価が必須。

article.articleHeadline: В ВОЗ обеспокоились масштабами эпидемии Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Concerned About the Scale of the Ebola Epidemic
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda prompted urgent WHO response. At the 79th World Health Assembly in Geneva, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said he is extremely concerned by the speed and scale of spread and, for the first time, declared a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC) following a recommendation from the emergency committee. In DRC, three new Ebola treatment centers will be opened to address the outbreak, with about 120 deaths reported in the country to date. The article notes ongoing Ebola activity in Africa and mentions questions about the virus's danger, potential spread to Russia, and the existence of effective treatments, signaling the need for heightened surveillance and response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱の流行規模について懸念を表明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱による重篤な国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）が宣言されている。複数国での同時流行、高い死亡率、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性が明確である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでのエボラ活動について言及されているが、対象国リスト内にはウガンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsからは除外。DRCは対象国（ID: 203312）であり、約120名の死亡報告がある。PHEICの宣言はWHO本部がジュネーブにあるため記事に含まれているが、実際の疾病発生地域はDRCおよびウガンダ（対象国外）。スイス、ロシア等は発生地ではなく、WHOの対応や報道に関連する二次的な言及のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв лихорадки Эбола в Конго выросло до 131
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola fever in Congo has risen to 131.
article.articleSummary: Death toll from Ebola fever in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has risen to at least 131, with 513 people showing symptoms, according to BBC citing a government spokesperson. Earlier, two cases and one death were confirmed in Uganda. The World Health Organization has declared the Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, signaling international significance. The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) reports one American healthcare worker infected while working in the DRC, who will be transported to Germany for treatment, marking an exported Ebola case. The report underscores ongoing transmission and cross-border concerns as of May 19, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ熱の死亡者数が131人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5つすべてに該当。WHOがPublic Health Emergency of International Concernを宣言しており、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、主要な発生地域はDRCであり、ウガンダでの限定的な症例報告とアメリカの医療従事者への輸出例が記載されている。検証対象国リストではDRCのみが実質的な発生地域として該当。WHOのPublic Health Emergency of International Concern宣言により、国際的なシグナルとしての重要性は最高度。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak: Around 120 Deaths, Over 350 Cases Reported; 10 Latest Updates
article.articleSummary: WHO declared the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) due to rapid regional spread. As of May 18, CDC reports 11 confirmed cases, 336 suspected cases, and 88 deaths in DRC; Uganda has 2 confirmed cases and 1 death among travelers from Congo, with no further spread reported. BBC cites higher counts: at least 118 deaths and more than 390 suspected. The outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo, a rarer orthoebolavirus strain with no approved vaccines or targeted treatments; past Bundibugyo outbreaks show case fatality rates of 30–50%. It has crossed into Uganda, with Kampala reporting two laboratory-confirmed cases on May 15–16 in travelers from DRC. Healthcare facilities are strained, with several healthcare worker deaths. Congo plans three Ebola treatment centres in Ituri as WHO dispatches specialists. A U.S. case was identified on May 17, and the United States imposed entry restrictions for travelers to affected regions. India reports no cases, risk low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：約120人の死亡、350人以上の患者が報告；10の最新情報
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱のPHEIC宣言、複数国への地域的拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、米国への波及）、高い致死率、渡航制限の実施により、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはUganda、United States、Indiaが含まれているが、サマリーの検証により：Uganda（対象国外）、United States（対象国外）、India（患者なし、低リスク）であり、確認された患者発生地は対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみ。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、複数国への波及確認、医療体制の著しい負荷あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak: Expert Says Not To Panic, But Surveillance Is Crucial
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo's Ituri province attributed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDB); nearly 100 deaths and several suspected cases. The BDB strain differs from prior Zaire-type outbreaks; no vaccine exists for BDB, and mortality is 30-50%. WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern. Across Uganda and the DRC, almost 250 cases have been reported with spillover to Sudan; transmission occurs once patients are symptomatic, with an incubation period of 2-21 days. Initial symptoms include fever and weakness; severe illness can include bleeding. Reservoirs are suspected to involve fruit bats, with monkeys serving as intermediate hosts. India's One Health surveillance is monitoring animal-to-human jumps and screening travelers; travelers from Uganda and DRC urged to be cautious. No Ebola cases reported in India to date; monoclonal antibodies exist for treatment, but no vaccine for BDB.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染症の専門家：パニックになる必要はないが、監視が重要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHO緊急宣言済み、Bundibugyo ebolavirus(BDB)という未知のワクチン非存在株によるアウトブレイク、複数国での複数百症例、高い死亡率(30-50%)、国際的スピルオーバー報告あり。フルRRA(Rapid Risk Assessment)に進める。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUgandaとSudanも含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCはIturi州での中心的なアウトブレイク地域として確認。Indiaは監視活動と旅行者スクリーニングを実施しており、地域対応の観点から含める。WHO宣言済みのPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）であることが極めて重要。BDB株はワクチン非存在で治療オプション限定的。

article.articleHeadline: وزير الصحة في الكونغو الديمقراطية: تقديرات بوفاة 131 شخصا بإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo's health minister: Estimates of 131 deaths from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda has led the health minister to estimate 131 deaths among 513 suspected cases. Earlier tallies reported 88 deaths and about 300 suspected cases in DRC, plus one death and one suspected case in Uganda. The World Health Organization classified the event as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, though it does not meet the criteria for a pandemic; the aim is to heighten alertness in neighboring countries and mobilize international support. As of May 19, 2026, surveillance and response are ongoing in both DR Congo and Uganda to contain transmission and coordinate resources across affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の保健大臣：エボラによる131人の死亡を推定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHOによるPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）の認定、131人の死亡、513人の疑い患者、DRCとウガンダでの多国間拡大により、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国でないため verified_locations に含めない）でも確認されているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。WHOによるPHEIC認定は極めて重大な指標。Bundibugyo ebolavirus に関連した事象であることが確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, salgono a 131 i morti in Congo: l'Oms convoca il comitato di emergenza - L'Unione Sarda.it
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, deaths rise to 131 in Congo: the WHO convenes the Emergency Committee - L'Unione Sarda.it.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 131 deaths and 513 suspected cases. The World Health Organization convened an Emergency Committee to evaluate the epidemic, with a meeting planned for this afternoon. The WHO director-general declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on Sunday, the second-highest alert level. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo, for which there are no approved drugs or vaccines. Separately, U.S. health authorities reported an American physician who worked with a missionary organization in Congo has tested positive for Bundibugyo Ebola after treating a patient at Nyankunde hospital in Bunia. His wife, also a physician, is asymptomatic. The infected doctor and six other Americans who had contact will be quarantined and monitored on arrival at a U.S. base in Germany.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数が131人に増加：WHOが緊急委員会を召集
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大（米国での確認例）、PHEIC宣言、医療従事者への感染、ワクチン未承認株など極めて深刻。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の重大なアウトブレイク。PHEIC宣言済み、米国への患者の伝播確認。ワクチン未承cowンゴに含まれていますが、記事の主題はDRCでの発生とそこからの国際的拡大です。米国およびドイツへの患者の移送がありますが、実際の感染サイト・ウイルス流行地はDRCです。

article.articleHeadline: 本轮埃博拉疫情尚无特效疗法
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There is currently no specific therapy for this round of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Two confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) are caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; the WHO declared a public health emergency on May 17, 2026. So far, at least 10 lab-confirmed cases and about 330 suspected cases, with around 80 deaths; two confirmed patients traveled from DRC into neighboring Uganda, triggering additional cases. The outbreak’s first diagnosed case was a healthcare worker in Ituri Province, identified after illness beginning April 24. On May 15, the DRC National Laboratory confirmed Bundibugyo ebolavirus as the etiologic agent, with an estimated case fatality rate of 25–50%. Transmission is mainly through contact with blood and bodily fluids; there is no approved vaccine or specific therapy for this subtype, and most rapid tests target Zaire ebolavirus. Incubation is 2–21 days. Priorities: expand testing and surveillance in DRC, Uganda, and surrounding countries; strengthen contact tracing, isolation, and community education to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: 本轮埃博拉疫情尚无特效疗法
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つ全て満たし、Bundibugyo ebolavirus（確認されたエボラ出血熱）による複数国での確認例と死亡例を伴う公衆衛生上の重大事象。WHO公式宣言済みで国際的拡大の明確な証拠がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに明記されているとおり、DRCでBundibugyo ebolavirus による確定例10例以上、疑い例約330例、死亡約80例が報告されており、ウガンダへの越境感染も確認されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。WHO公式宣言（2026年5月17日）済み。ワクチンおよび特異的治療法が未承認である点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: بعد "إيبولا" و"هانتا"... خبراء يحذّرون من أزمات صحية أشد خطورة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After Ebola and Hantavirus, experts warn of health crises that are even more dangerous.
article.articleSummary: Experts warn the world is less resilient to infectious disease outbreaks as Ebola causes 87 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo and surges near the Uganda border, with hantavirus concerns linked to a cruise-ship incident. The Global Preparedness Monitoring Board report warns outbreaks are becoming more frequent and devastating, outpacing investments in readiness amid climate crises, wars, and geopolitical tensions that erode trust and democratic norms. WHO has exhausted PPE stocks in Kinshasa and plans a cargo flight from Kenya depot to bolster supplies as MSF and the International Rescue Committee deploy teams. An meeting in Geneva will consolidate knowledge and set priorities for vaccines, diagnostics, and therapeutics. Despite advances in mRNA vaccine platforms, access remains unequal: monkeypox vaccines took about two years to reach Africa, slower than COVID vaccines at 17 months. GPMB calls for a permanent, independent pandemic-risk monitor and a strengthened Pandemic Treaty ensuring equitable access and funding.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラ」と「ハンタ」の後...専門家がより危険な健康危機を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数の重篤な感染症が同時報告され、DRCでのエボラ死亡87件、ウガンダとの国境での拡大リスク、WHOのPPE備蓄枯渇など複合的なシグナルを示す。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ流行（87死亡）が主要な報告。記事ではジュネーブでの会議が言及されているが、これはWHO本部での政策会合であり、実際の感染症発生地ではない。ウガンダとケニアも発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、サマリーではDRCでの具体的死亡数が主題であり、他国での確認事例の詳細な記述がないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。

article.articleHeadline: ГОЛЕМА ПАНИКА, СЕ ШИРИ ЛИ ВИРУСОТ?! - Заразен маж итно пренесен во Европа, здравствените власти алармираат!
