article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Massive Panic, Is the Virus Spreading?! - An Infected Man Urgently Transported to Europe, Health Authorities Warn!
article.articleSummary: An American infected with Ebola was evacuated to Germany after symptoms were confirmed as of 19 May 2026 while in Democratic Republic of Congo. The patient, Dr. Peter Stafford, a mission worker with SERJ, contracted the virus while treating patients at Nyankunde Hospital in Bunia, where he had worked since 2023. After weekend symptoms, authorities organized transport to Europe; his wife, Dr. Rebecca Stafford, and their four children are under medical supervision, asymptomatic. The CDC says at least six more Americans exposed in the same region are being evacuated. In DRC, the outbreak has caused at least 131 deaths and more than 500 cases under investigation; the WHO has declared an international health emergency. Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or treatments. The US has imposed temporary entry limits on foreign nationals in DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan. Ebola spreads from animals, notably fruit bats, with a 2–21 day incubation.

triage.headline_ja: 大パニック、ウイルスは拡散しているのか？！ - 感染した男性がヨーロッパに緊急搬送、保健当局が警告！
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大、複数国への患者搬送、WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言を伴う重篤な公衆衛生上の影響が認められるため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーからはDRC（Bunia）が主な発生地で、患者がドイツに搬送された後の状況が述べられている。発生地域リストにはアメリカ、スーダン、ウガンダ、ドイツも含まれているが、サマリーの主題イベント（Bunia発生源のエボラ疫学的リンク）はDRCに限定されるため、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ただし、複数国への患者移動（DRC→ドイツ）と複数国の入国制限措置が報告されているため、国際的な懸念は極めて高い。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言、131死亡500症例以上の調査中、承認ワクチン/治療法なし、2-21日の潜伏期間を持つBundibugyo株という極めて重篤な状況。

article.articleHeadline: בהלת האבולה: מאות נדבקים ומתים, ארה"ב מחמירה בדיקות בשדות התעופה
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola panic: Hundreds infected and dead, US tightens screenings at airports.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to expand. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) over the Bundibugyo strain. Authorities report 131 deaths among 513 suspected cases, concentrated in Ituri Province in eastern DRC, with incubation 2-21 days and cases in Goma and Butembo indicating regional spread. In the United States, the CDC tightened border screening for travelers from DRC, Uganda and South Sudan, with some arrivals under 21-day post-entry monitoring; non-U.S. citizens who traveled through affected areas in the prior three weeks may face entry restrictions. Rwanda and Nigeria increased border controls; WHO advises border screening and hospital preparedness. Bundibugyo lacks an approved strain-specific vaccine; treatment is supportive. Early diagnosis and rapid isolation are critical. A U.S. physician who worked in Congo contracted the virus and was treated in Germany; six other Americans remain under observation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ・パニック：数百人が感染し死亡、米国が空港での検査を厳格化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全てに該当。コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の大規模発生で、WHO がPHEIC宣言、131人の死亡、複数国での国境管理強化、米国が空港検査を厳格化するなど国際的対応が始まっている。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国（対象国リストに含まれる）でのエボラ出血熱の大規模発生。Bundibugyo株、513疑い例、131死亡、Ituri州とGoma、Butemboで確認。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。米国が空港検査を厳格化、ルワンダとナイジェリアが国境管理強化。医療従事者を含む複数の国際的な関連事例あり。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Estimativa de mortes por Ebola no Congo sobe para 131
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Estimated Ebola deaths in the Congo rise to 131.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has intensified, with 131 deaths among 513 suspected cases reported as of May 19, 2026, per Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba. The update follows earlier World Health Organization figures that described the event as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), noting 91 deaths in 350 suspected cases. The crisis is escalating in the eastern region of the DRC, underscoring ongoing severity despite international attention. The report provides suspected-case counts and fatalities; it does not specify laboratory-confirmed figures. The situation remains a critical regional outbreak with ongoing risk of further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死亡者推定値が131人に上昇
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当し、WHO PHEIC指定済みのエボラアウトブレイク。東部DRCでの急速な悪化と国際的拡大リスクが確認される。
triage.notes: 既にWHO PHEICとして指定されているエボラアウトブレイク。記事は2026年5月19日時点での死亡者推定値の増加（91→131）を報告。東部地域での継続的な蔓延リスクとともに、信頼できる検査確定数の不足が注記されている。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو: 131 حالة وفاة محتملة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: 131 suspected deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 131 deaths among about 513 suspected cases, Health Minister Samuel Roger Campa said on national TV, reporting figures from Monday night to Tuesday. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus expressed strong concern about the outbreak’s size and speed; an Emergency Committee meeting will consider temporary recommendations. The situation follows WHO’s declaration of a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over Ebola in the DRC and neighboring Uganda. Earlier reports through Sunday cited 88 deaths and roughly 300 suspected cases in the DRC, plus one death and one suspected case in Uganda. The article notes only suspected, not confirmed, cases and deaths, with no details provided on infection sources or laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行：131人の疑い例による死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHO緊急委員会の開催検討、国際的関心も高く、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCとウガンダの両国にエボラが拡大していると記載しているが、対象国リストにウガンダ（1895949=Zambia等）が含まれていないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。WHO緊急委員会開催の言及、国際的懸念表明など、国際保健上の重大事象として確実な判定。疑い例ベースの数値であるが、公式発表（保健大臣）としての信頼性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Réunion d'urgence à l'OMS sur Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Emergency meeting at the WHO on Ebola
article.articleSummary: May 19, 2026 – The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) after expressing concern about its scale and speed. For the first time, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus invoked the PHEIC without convening the Emergency Committee beforehand, and he requested provisional recommendations from the committee to guide the response, with an emergency meeting scheduled for Tuesday in Geneva. The Congolese health ministry reported 131 deaths and 513 suspected cases linked to the Ebola outbreak. The decision follows formal steps to obtain guidance from the Emergency Committee to coordinate the international response to Ebola in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHOによるエボラ出血熱に関する緊急会議
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHO公衆衛生緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言、DRCでの高死亡率（131死亡/513疑い例）、国際的対応の必要性、および渡航・貿易制限の可能性が明確に存在するため、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ爆発流行に対するWHO PHEIC宣言。前例のない手続き（事前にEmergency Committeeを招集せずにPHEIC宣言）。ジュネーブでの緊急会議は記事の主題ではなく、対応会合の開催地であるため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: ECDC: Σε ετοιμότητα ομάδα δράσης για την επιδημία στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ECDC: Rapid response team on standby for outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province) triggers ECDC rapid-response standby. As of 16 May 2026, 246 cases and 80 deaths reported across at least three health zones in Ituri; two additional cases in Uganda with travel history from the DRC. The ECDC will deploy an expert from the EU Health Task Force to Africa CDC headquarters to support coordination and planning; discussions with the EU Civil Protection Mechanism and the Global Outbreak Alert and Response Network regarding additional specialists in infection prevention, epidemiology, surveillance, and risk communication to support actions in DRC and Uganda. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no licensed vaccines or specific treatments exist. Significant uncertainties remain about transmission extent, and security and humanitarian challenges hinder control efforts; the outbreak may be larger than currently detected.

triage.headline_ja: ECDC：コンゴ民主共和国の流行に対応するため対応チームがスタンバイ中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダでの確認）、高い死亡率、ワクチンなし、国際協調による対応が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの関連事例（2例）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCでのイベント発生が明確であり、Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチンなし）による高い死亡率（246例中80死亡）と国際的拡大リスク、ECDC含む多国間対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: США пытаются не пустить Эболу в страну
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States is trying to prevent Ebola from entering the country.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda is declared a WHO public health emergency, with about 400 suspected cases and 80–100 deaths as of mid-May. Most patients are 20–39 years old, and more than 60% are women. The United States has tightened controls: CDC border screening for travelers from affected regions; on May 18, entry of foreign nationals from DRC, South Sudan, and Uganda was restricted; the U.S. Embassy in Uganda paused visa issuance. Reuters reports several Americans may have been exposed in DRC; six Americans are being evacuated, and at least one symptomatic individual tested positive—a missionary doctor, Peter Stafford. U.S. actions include activating a rapid response plan and mobilizing $13 million in foreign aid to bolster surveillance, laboratory capacity, risk communication, safe burials, and border screening, while USAID’s role and earlier departure from WHO are noted; the EU’s ECDC is sending experts to Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラウイルスの流入を防ぐため努力
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイクは400人以上の疑い患者と80～100人の死亡を伴う深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、異常かつ予想外であり、米国への感染拡大リスク、国際的な移動・貿易制限措置が実施されている。フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのアウトブレイクが述べられているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。米国への拡大リスクと支援活動は記述されているが、米国は発生国ではなく対応国であるため verified_locations に含めない。エボラウイルス病は高い感染性と高い致死率により、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限が明確に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Warns of Rising Infectious Disease Outbreaks
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-18, the Global Preparedness Monitoring Board (GPMB), formed by WHO and the World Bank, warned that infectious disease outbreaks are occurring more frequently and inflicting greater health, economic, political, and social damage. The report says current investments and reforms over the past decade are inadequate to meet evolving threats, with COVID-19-era funding not sustained and development assistance for health returning toward 2009 levels. It calls for a permanent, independent monitoring mechanism to assess global readiness and prevent complacency after crises, and for equitable access to vaccines, testing, and essential treatments through a global pandemic agreement under discussion among WHO member countries. Separately, the WHO declared a public health emergency on 2026-05-17 after more than 250 suspected Ebola cases and at least 80 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain (distinct from Zaire). The outbreak is not yet a pandemic, but cross-border spread warrants monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、感染症アウトブレイクの増加に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。DRCでのエボラ公衆衛生緊急事態宣言により、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: DRCでBundibugyo strain（ザイール株と異なる系統）によるエボラ公衆衛生緊急事態が宣言されており、250件以上の疑い例と80件以上の死亡を報告。国境を越える拡大リスクが指摘されている。GW期間中の発生報告のため国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: OMS realizará reunião de emergência sobre surto de Ebola na República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO to hold emergency meeting on Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization (WHO) convened an Emergency Committee to address a deadly Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). As of 19 May 2026, the outbreak has resulted in 131 deaths. The Emergency Committee meeting is being held today, following the WHO Director-General's declaration that the outbreak constitutes a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The decision signals heightened international attention and an urgent call for rapid action to contain the Ebola virus. The report notes the critical nature of the situation but does not detail laboratory confirmation, transmission chains, or specific affected regions within the DRC. The emergency declaration and committee gathering underscore the need for coordinated public health responses to slow and stop transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行について緊急委員会会議を開催
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱による死亡131件、PHEIC宣言、WHO緊急委員会開催という高度な国際的懸念事項。
triage.notes: PHEIC公式宣言済み。WHO緊急委員会の開催は国際的なエスカレーション信号。死亡者数が確定しており、公開情報も充実。対象国リストに非該当だが、グローバルな脅威であるため評価対象外ではなく緊急性を反映すべき。

article.articleHeadline: HSE 'has procedures in place' for management of Ebola cases but risk 'very low'
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda involves the Bundibugyo virus strain, with a case fatality rate of about 25–40% and no approved treatment or vaccine. The World Health Organization has declared a public health emergency of international concern. In the DRC, health minister Samuel Roger Kamba reported about 131 deaths from 513 suspected cases, up from 91 deaths of 350 suspected cases earlier; the full extent of the epidemic remains unknown. Ireland’s HSE says procedures exist to identify and manage Ebola, and the risk to the Irish population is low, with the ECDC echoing a similar EU assessment. The Department of Foreign Affairs is monitoring and advises avoiding Ituri Province, DRC, where the disease was first detected; travelers to Uganda should exercise caution. If symptoms develop, individuals should self-isolate, avoid travel, and contact health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: HSE『エボラ患者の管理のための手続きを用意している』が、リスク『非常に低い』
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限勧告）。WHOが国際的懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言しており、シグナルトリアージレベルで最優先対象。
triage.notes: アイルランドはEbola発生地域ではなく、発生地域である。記事サマリーは「DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ流行」と明記しており、アイルランドは懸念国（準備状況確認）として言及されているのみ。ウガンダはCEPR対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみを記載する。WHOがPHEIC宣言を行っており、致死率25～40%のBundibugyo株による感染が進行中。131人の死亡・513人の疑似症例が報告されており、流行規模は拡大傾向。

article.articleHeadline: Zvaničnici: Najmanje 131 smrtni slučaj prijavljen u epidemiji ebole u Demokratskoj Republici Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Officials: At least 131 fatalities reported in the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports at least 131 deaths and more than 513 suspected cases, with new confirmations in Ituri (Njakunde), North Kivu (Butembo), and the city of Goma. Uganda has two confirmed cases and one death. The World Health Organization has declared the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. An American physician with a medical mission organization has tested positive and will be treated in Germany; several colleagues have been exposed, including Dr. Peter Stafford and his wife Dr. Rebekah Stafford, with about six Americans reportedly exposed. The CDC is aiding a possible evacuation of a small number of Americans and will monitor travelers from affected areas, enforcing entry restrictions for non-U.S. passport holders who have recently been in Uganda, DR Congo, or South Sudan within 21 days. The U.S. risk is currently low, but enhanced surveillance and border measures are planned. WHO notes the Ituri outbreak may be larger than detected; historical West Africa 2014–2016 killed 11,325 from 28,600 cases.

triage.headline_ja: 職員の発表：コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行で少なくとも131人の死亡が報告されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響：131人以上の死亡と513人以上の疑わしい症例、国際的な感染リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当（異常/予想外、高い重症度、継続的な曝露、高い流行性、管理可能性の課題）。世界保健機関による国際保健上の緊急事態宣言も裏付ける。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは米国医師の感染やウガンダでの2確定症例にも言及されているが、主要な発生地はDRC（北キブ州、イトゥリ州、ゴマを含む）である。WHO による Public Health Emergency of International Concern（PHEIC）宣言により、重大性と国際的関心が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: 131 décès estimés et 513 cas suspects
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 131 deaths estimated and 513 suspected cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is estimated to have caused 131 deaths and 513 suspected cases, according to the Congolese Minister of Health speaking on national television overnight. The figures are current estimates reflecting ongoing transmission and active surveillance across the country as of May 19, 2026. The report emphasizes the persistence of Ebola in the DRC and distinguishes between fatalities and ongoing suspected infections during the outbreak response. The article does not provide details on laboratory confirmation, specific districts affected, infection sources, or treatment options. Published on May 19, 2026, this update underscores the continuing situation and the need for ongoing monitoring and reporting as the outbreak evolves.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：推定131人の死亡と513人の疑い例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重大な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱は高リスク病原体で、131人の死亡と513人の疑い例が報告されており、DRC国内での継続的な伝播が確認されている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は国際保健規則上の最高リスク病原体。131人の死亡と513人の疑い例という規模の大きさ、DRC国内での継続的伝播、監視継続中という報告内容から、フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）への進行が必須。コンゴ民主共和国のみがWHO地域でアフリカ地域に該当し、対象国リストには含まれていないが、グローバルな重要性から適切にエスカレーションされるべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola. OMS está preocupada com escala e velocidade do surto e vai reunir de emergência
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola. WHO is concerned about the scale and speed of the outbreak and will convene an emergency meeting.
article.articleSummary: WHO will convene its emergency committee on Tuesday to advise on temporary recommendations as Ebola spreads in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The WHO director-general has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) for the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, the second-highest alert level. A panel of experts will assess vaccine options; no vaccines or treatments are approved for Bundibugyo, though Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus vaccine) has shown some cross-protection in animal studies and could be tested. In the DRC, 131 deaths and 513 suspected cases have been reported, with new foci in Nyakunde (Ituri), Butembo (North Kivu), and Goma. Uganda reports two confirmed cases and one death. Cross-border screening is urged; Rwanda will intensify border checks, and Nigeria is monitoring. An American doctor among confirmed cases is being treated in Germany; CDC supports safe withdrawal of some exposed staff. It is not a pandemic, but regional spread is possible.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ。WHOが感染拡大の規模と速度に懸念を示し、緊急会議を召集する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予期せぬ急速な地域的拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）し、WPRO基準全5項目も該当。WHOが最高レベルの公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事象（PHEIC）を宣言し、複数国への越境拡大が確認されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはルワンダ、ウガンダ、ナイジェリア、ドイツが含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題は東コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのエボラ拡大である。越境例（ウガンダの確認例、ドイツで治療中の米国医師）は記述されているが、これらは二次的な展開であり、主たる発生地はDRCのみ。対象国リストにはDRC（203312）のみ含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲埃博拉疫情拉响全球警报 多国加强防控举措
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa's Ebola outbreak triggers global alarm; multiple countries strengthen prevention and control measures.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda trigger global alarm. The World Health Organization designated the situation as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though it has not reached pandemic status under the International Health Regulations. Surrounding nations Rwanda, Zambia, and Tanzania have strengthened border health surveillance, entry screening, and outbreak preparedness. In the United States, visa services for the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan are temporarily suspended, and Americans in affected areas are being evacuated; embassies began pausing all visa processing from May 18, 2026. The CDC ordered that travelers who have visited or left DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan within the past 21 days be barred from entry, with exemptions for U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, military personnel, and certain others. Germany updated travel advisories for the DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ疫情が世界的警報を発動 複数国が防疫措置を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。エボラ出血熱の多国家的拡大と複数国での防疫強化、米国・ドイツでの入国制限実施により、直ちにフルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ流行と、周辺国（ルワンダ、ザンビア、タンザニア）での防疫強化、米国・ドイツでの入国制限実施を報告。対象国リスト内ではDRC（203312）とザンビア（895949）が実際の発生地として確認される。ウガンダ、タンザニア、ルワンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOがPHEIC指定との記載があり、国際的な懸念の高さが確認される。

article.articleHeadline: تقديرات بوفاة 131 شخصا بإيبولا في الكونغو الديموقراطية من بين 513 يشتبه بإصابتهم
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An estimated 131 people have died from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, out of 513 suspected cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has resulted in an estimated 131 deaths among 513 suspected cases, per Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba speaking on national television between May 18 and May 19, 2026. The minister stated that about 131 fatalities are suspected Ebola deaths and about 513 people are under suspicion of infection. The report notes these figures are based on suspected, not laboratory-confirmed, cases. No further details are provided on specific locations, symptoms, transmission sources, or exported/imported cases. Reported from a government briefing, the data underscore ongoing transmission within the DRC during the current outbreak window.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラにより推定131人が死亡、疑い患者513人中
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認された流行であり、IHR基準2項目以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）に該当し、ハイリスク病原体での高い死亡率のため国際的拡大リスクが懸念される。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最高優先度の検査対象疾患。記事は保健大臣による公式ブリーフィングに基づいているが、確認例数が不明で疑い症例に基づいている点に注意。死亡率（推定26%）は重大。DRCでの流行継続を示す。即座のフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Krízový výbor WHO v utorok mimoriadne zasadne k epidémii eboly na africkom kontinente. Platí stav medzinárodnej zdravotnej pohotovosti - SITA.sk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Emergency Committee will hold an extraordinary meeting on Tuesday regarding the Ebola epidemic on the African continent. The Public Health Emergency of International Concern remains in effect.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has claimed at least 131 lives, with transmission spreading to neighboring Uganda. The World Health Organization (WHO) on Tuesday convened an extraordinary Emergency Committee meeting to review the situation, after Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus had already declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Ghebreyesus said on the World Health Assembly in Geneva that he made the declaration on Sunday due to the scale and speed of transmission. The current Ebola strain has no vaccine or specific treatment, complicating frontline response in the region. As of May 19, 2026, WHO reports rapid deterioration in the DRC outbreak and ongoing risk of wider regional spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHO緊急委員会は火曜日にアフリカ大陸のエボラ流行について緊急会合を開く。国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態の状態が継続している。
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが既にPHEIC宣言を発出した重篤なエボラ流行。DRCとウガンダの複数国での死亡者発生と地域的拡大リスク、ワクチン・治療法の欠如により管理可能性が低く、国際的な関心と支援の必要性が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行が主題。ウガンダへの拡大も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。WHO緊急会議の開催地がジュネーブ（スイス）で言及されているが、実際の流行はDRCが中心。既にWHOがPHEIC宣言を発出済みであり、死亡者131名以上、ワクチン・治療法の欠如、迅速な地域拡大というすべての基準で高リスク。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: OMS convoca comité de emergência para avaliar surto de ébola na República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO convenes an emergency committee to assess an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) after more than 300 suspected cases and 118 deaths in Ituri and North Kivu provinces, with two additional deaths reported in neighboring Uganda. On May 17, 2026, the World Health Organization declared the PHEIC; on May 19, 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced the convening of an emergency committee to advise on temporary recommendations. Ebola spreads through direct contact with bodily fluids of infected people or animals, causing fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhagic symptoms, with case fatality rates estimated between 25% and 90%. The outbreak remains centered in the DRC’s border regions, prompting international health guidance and response measures.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行を評価するため緊急委員会を召集
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の危機として既にPHEICが宣言されており、複数国への拡大、高い死亡率、国際対応が確認される。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri州およびNorth Kivu州）で、ウガンダでの2例の死亡例も報告されているが、記事の主題はDRCでの流行である。Bluedot APIではウガンダも発生地域として列挙されているが、記事では二次的な情報であり、主要な流行地はDRCのみである。既にWHOにより公衆衛生上国際的に懸念される状況（PHEIC）として正式宣言されており、緊急委員会の召集が報告されている。全5つのWPRO基準と4つのIHR基準に該当する高リスク事象。

article.articleHeadline: Estimated DR Congo Ebola death toll jumps to 131 | International
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ebola outbreak in the east shows an estimated 131 deaths from 513 suspected cases, per Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba. The Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment, underpins the outbreak; earlier figures cited 91 deaths from 350 suspected cases. The epicentre is Ituri province, near the Uganda-South Sudan border, with cross-border movement driven by a gold-mining hub. The virus has spread to neighbouring provinces, with suspected cases in Butembo in North Kivu and a case in Goma. Authorities note slow community alerting, partly due to beliefs that the illness is mystical. Few samples have been tested, so assessments rely mainly on suspected cases. The World Health Organization has declared an international health emergency.

triage.headline_ja: 推定されるコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死亡者数が131人に急増
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当、WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言済み。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株、ワクチン・承認治療なし）の東部地域での急速な拡大。513疑似患者131死亡（CFR約26%）。Ituri州が中心で、北キブ州、ゴマへも波及。ウガンダとの国境地帯での金鉱採掘による越境移動により国際的拡大リスク高い。WHOが国際保健緊急事態を宣言済み。社会的・政治的関心も極めて高い。フルRRA進行推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉疫情擴大　死亡人數攀升至131人 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo widens; death toll rises to 131 - Minshi News Network
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola Virus Disease in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo widens, with suspected cases rising to 513 and deaths to 131 as of 2026-05-19. The World Health Organization has designated the situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The outbreak remains concentrated in eastern DR Congo, where challenging terrain and limited public health resources hinder containment. The government, with international health agencies, is expanding vaccination, surveillance, and community education to curb transmission and prevent cross-border spread. Ebola is highly contagious and fatal, typically transmitted through contact with blood, secretions, or other bodily fluids of infected individuals or animals. The report notes a rapid increase from earlier figures (350 suspected, 91 deaths) and urges intensified medical aid and monitoring to halt further spread.

triage.headline_ja: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉疫情擴大　死亡人數攀升至131人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WHO PHEIC指定済みの深刻なエボラアウトブレイク。疑い例513、死亡131と大規模、国際的波及リスク高い。
triage.notes: WHO PHEICの指定により国際的優先度は最高。記事サマリーの言及から東部DRC集中だが、越境拡大防止が重要課題。複数の基準で最大スコアを記録し、フルRRA実施が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo: Help verstärkt Präventionsmaßnahmen in Goma und leistet Hilfe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo: Help steps up prevention measures in Goma and provides aid.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) remains a major concern with North Kivu and Goma in focus. As of May 19, 2026, authorities report more than 400 Ebola cases nationwide and a health emergency has been declared; the border between Gisenyi (Rwanda) and Goma is closed to curb transmission. Help - Hilfe zur Selbsthilfe, working with local partner UGEAFI, is expanding prevention and relief in North Kivu’s health facilities, hospitals, and displacement camps, including the production and distribution of liquid chlorine for disinfection and training for healthcare and community staff. The DRC, among the world’s poorest countries, already faces an overwhelmed health system with about 15 million people needing humanitarian aid. Ebola’s high contagion risk, coupled with population movements, underscores the urgent need for additional financial support to halt further spread and strengthen care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラ流行：Helpがゴマでの予防措置を強化し支援を提供
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。エボラは公衆衛生への深刻な影響、高い伝播性、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航制限のリスクを示す明確なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（ノルド・キヴ州、ゴマ）における発生が主題。ルワンダ（ギセニ）は国境を越えての閉鎖と言及されているが、イベント発生の主体はDRCである。400件以上の症例報告、保健緊急事態宣言、国際的な支援需要、そしてギセニ-ゴマ国境の閉鎖によるトレード/渡航制限が確認されている。フルRRAの実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: مدير الصحة العالمية "قلق بشدة" من حجم وسرعة تفشي وباء إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General "deeply concerned" by the scale and speed of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus expressed deep concern over the scale and speed of the Ebola outbreak affecting the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, as the WHO convenes an Emergency Committee to consider provisional recommendations after declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. As of 2026-05-19, Congo reports 30 confirmed Ebola cases in Ituri Province in the northeast, while Uganda has two confirmed cases in Kampala among people arriving from DRC. Congo has more than 500 suspected cases and about 130 suspected deaths; authorities warn that these numbers may change with expanded field operations, testing, and contact tracing. Urban transmission is being observed, including in Kampala and the city of Goma. Healthcare workers have died; the region sees high cross-border movement. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain currently has no vaccines or treatments, so risk communication and community engagement remain critical to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、エボラ出血熱の流行規模と速度に「極度に懸念」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国での確認例、都市伝播、医療従事者の死亡、ワクチン・治療なし。WHO緊急委員会召集、PHEIC宣言検討中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダ（Kampala）への越境感染も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による流行、ワクチン・治療不在、都市伝播、高い死亡疑い数（約130名）により重大なシグナル。WHO PHEIC宣言の検討段階であり、国際的対応が差し迫っている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO declares Ebola outbreak in DR Congo an international emergency - Ghanaian Times
article.articleSummary: WHO declares Ebola outbreak in DR Congo's Ituri province a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC). About 246 suspected cases and 80 deaths reported; Bundibugyo virus strain with no approved drugs or vaccines. Eight laboratory-confirmed infections, with suspected cases across Bunia (Ituri's capital) and the gold-mining towns of Mongwalu and Rwampara. One case confirmed in Kinshasa linked to travel from Ituri. Two laboratory-confirmed cases in Uganda; Ugandan authorities report a 59-year-old man died after testing positive, body returned to DR Congo. A laboratory-confirmed case detected in Goma, eastern city under M23 control. At least six Americans exposed in DR Congo; none confirmed infected. US CDC to deploy more staff; US Embassy warns against travel to Ituri. DR Congo and Uganda urged to establish emergency operation centers; other countries advised not to close borders.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行を国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態と宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス感染症（Bundibugyo株）の流行で246例の疑い患者・80死亡、国際的拡大リスク、WHOによるPHEIC宣言により医療上の深刻な影響と国際的な移動制限リスク存在。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、主たるイベント発生国はDRC。ウガンダ・ルワンダでの確認例は記載されているが、サマリーの主題はDRCのIturi州のエボラ流行。Goma（東部、M23支配下の都市）でも確認例あり。WHOがPHEIC宣言しており、国際的関心が極めて高い。Bundibugyo株は新規・治療法なし。米国・ウガンダとの越境接触あり（ウガンダで死亡者1名）。

article.articleHeadline: Foreign tourist among new Mpox cases reported in Thailand
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, Thailand reports 1,074 Mpox cases and 16 deaths. Two new Clade Ib Mpox cases were confirmed in weeks 18–19 (Apr 26–May 9), both Thai men: the first developed symptoms Apr 22 after sex with a stranger; the second after prolonged close contact in a crowded tourist area during a festival. A foreign tourist, aged 25–40, was reported via International Health Regulations with exposure after sex with a stranger in a tourist area. The main risk factor remains close physical contact during sex, especially among men who have sex with men. Since 2024, Clade Ib has spread; Thailand has 18 Clade Ib cases with no deaths; six cases this year (four male). Prevention: avoid close contact with symptomatic individuals, avoid sex with strangers, don't share personal items; use condoms and wash hands. Fever, rash, or pustules within 21 days warrants medical care; hotline 1422.

triage.headline_ja: タイで新たなMpox症例が報告され、外国人観光客も含まれる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：1,074症例16死亡、異常性：国際観光客への拡大、国際的拡大リスク：観光地での感染確認）。WPRO基準でも重症度・流行しやすさが該当。タイでの継続的Mpox流行とCladeIb拡大は注視が必要。
triage.notes: タイは累積1,074症例16死亡のMpox流行下。外国人観光客への感染が国際保健規則で報告され、国際的な関心が高い。CladeIb（2024年以降拡大）の継続的感染が確認されている。観光地での感染（音楽祭での濃厚接触）は国際渡航者への拡大リスクを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Щонайменше 131 людина померла через спалах Еболи в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At least 131 people have died from an Ebola outbreak in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has caused at least 131 deaths with over 513 suspected infections from the current Bundibugyo strain. Cases are spreading to a wider area, including Nyakunde in Ituri Province, Butembo in North Kivu, and the city of Goma. In Uganda, two cases have been confirmed with one death. The World Health Organization has declared an international public health emergency for the Bundibugyo strain. The DRC government reports active surveillance and contact tracing, stressing there is no cause for panic. Among confirmed cases is American physician Peter Stafford, who will be transported to Germany for treatment. The U.S. CDC says the risk to the United States remains low, but travel screening for travelers from DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan is being enhanced.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行により少なくとも131人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な流行（DRC、ウガンダ、スーダン確認）、131人の死亡、513人以上の疑似患者、WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言、渡航制限実施により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱。DRC内の複数地域（Nyakunde、Butembo、Goma）で確認。ウガンダでも2例確認（死亡1例）。WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言済み。米国医師を含む国際的な対応が展開中。米国、ドイツなど複数国の渡航制限・スクリーニング実施。記事サマリーでウガンダとスーダンが言及されているが、対象国リスト上ウガンダは含まれておらず、スーダンも対象国外のため verified_locations はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Le chef de l'OMS se dit "profondément préoccupé par l'ampleur et la rapidité" de l'épidémie d'Ebola, qui a fait au moins 131 morts selon un nouveau bilan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO chief says he is "deeply concerned about the scale and speed" of the Ebola outbreak, which has killed at least 131 people according to a new toll.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) triggers global concern as WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says the scale and speed are alarming two days after declaring an international emergency; the outbreak resides at the second-highest alert level behind a pandemic-type emergency. The WHO will convene the emergency committee to advise on temporary recommendations. In the DRC, authorities report about 131 deaths and roughly 513 suspected cases, up from earlier counts of 91 deaths. The United States’ CDC announces tightened border controls for air travelers from affected African countries and temporary visa restrictions for foreigners who have traveled to these areas to limit importation of the virus. The situation is evolving; officials warn of ongoing transmission and stress vigilance and containment measures.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、エボラ流行の「規模と速度に深く懸念」を表明、新集計で少なくとも131人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行で死亡者131人、WHO国際緊急委員会の招集、複数国への国境管理強化など、国際的に極度に重大な感染症危機。
triage.notes: 発生地域に米国が含まれているが、記事サマリーでは米国は境界管理強化による対応国として言及されており、エボラ流行の実際の発生地はDRCのみ。WHO事務局長の緊急警告、死亡者数増加、複数患者の報告、国際的な国境措置の実施により、高度な優先度のシグナルとして確認される。

article.articleHeadline: केन्या: डीआर कांगो में इबोला का कहर, 120 से ज्यादा लोगों की मौत, WHO की निगरानी तेज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya: Ebola ravages DR Congo, more than 120 dead, WHO monitoring intensifies.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has forced three Ebola treatment centers to be opened in Bunia (Ituri province) as cases surge in Ituri and North Kivu. As of May 19, 2026, at least 118 deaths and about 300 suspected cases have been reported, with infections now appearing in Bunia and other North Kivu towns including Mongbwalu, Beni, Butembo, and Nyakunde. Uganda has one death and one suspected case. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and is deploying an expert team; there is no licensed vaccine or approved therapy for this Bundibugyo strain. An American doctor is among the confirmed infections, and the infected individual plus seven other Americans are being monitored in Germany for further evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア：DR コンゴでエボラが猛威、120人以上が死亡、WHO の監視が強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大（ウガンダ、ドイツへの波及）と高い重症度・死亡率を示す。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが複数国（ウガンダ、ドイツ）を発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーによると、これらは2次的な伝播例であり、主要な発生地域はDRC（イトゥリ州、北キブ州）。DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。WHOが国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、Bundibugyo ebolavirus による致命的なアウトブレイクを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Pakar Butuh Kerja Sama Global untuk Atasi Ebola yang Tewaskan 100 Orang di Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts Call for Global Cooperation to Combat Ebola That Killed 100 People in the Congo
article.articleSummary: Eight laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and about 246 suspected cases (as of 16 May 2026) have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 80–100 suspected deaths. Uganda reports two confirmed Ebola cases and one death, signaling cross-border transmission and prompting WHO to declare Ebola a public health emergency of international concern on 16 May 2026. A cluster with symptoms consistent with Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) raises concern, including four suspected health-worker deaths. The case-positivity rate is high (8 of 13 tested), suggesting the outbreak may be larger than reported. Experts urge intensified international cooperation for surveillance, data sharing, cross-border containment, and health-system preparedness. Ebola mortality is described as 25–90%, while Bundibugyo virus disease currently lacks a vaccine or WHO-approved treatment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱でコンゴで100人が死亡、専門家は対策に向けた世界的協力を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。WHOが国際的懸念事項としての公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言した多国間越境感染事例であり、確定症例と死亡者が報告されている。フルRRA実施必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国外）での越境感染も報告されているが、記事の主要な発生地はDRC。Bundibugyo virus disease（BVD）の疑い例も含まれており、複数のウイルス流行の可能性がある。WHOによる2026年5月16日の国際的懸念事項宣言は、本シグナルの重要性を強く支持している。

article.articleHeadline: Глава ВОЗ заявил о фиксации 131 смерти от лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO chief stated that 131 deaths from Ebola fever have been recorded.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus expressed grave concern over the rapid spread of Ebola, as more than 500 suspected cases are reported. As of May 19, 2026, 30 laboratory-confirmed infections are in northern Congo and two in Uganda. An American citizen with Ebola is being transferred to Germany for treatment. On Sunday, WHO designated this outbreak in two African countries as a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC), indicating international risk and prompting coordinated response. Ghebreyesus, speaking at the World Health Assembly in Geneva, warned about the speed and scale of transmission. The PHEIC declaration highlights the need for intensified international surveillance, containment measures, and scrutiny of potential export/import cases as the outbreak evolves.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラ熱による131人の死亡確認を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、WHO PHEIC宣言により国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態として既に認定。複数アフリカ諸国での急速な感染拡大と国際的な症例移送が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで確認されたエボラ発生地は北部コンゴ（DRC）とウガンダ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOは既にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言しており、最高レベルのリスク評価。アメリカ市民がドイツへ転院予定と記載されているが、実際の感染発生地はDRCのみが対象国に該当。

article.articleHeadline: CDC says one American tested positive for Ebola in DRC
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is experiencing an outbreak of a rare Ebola strain, with 393 suspected cases and 105 suspected deaths reported by the Congo Health Cluster on Monday. One American, linked to U.S. Ebola response efforts, tested positive after exposure while treating patients at Nyankunde Hospital. The CDC confirmed the case and said the immediate risk to the United States is low. The individual developed symptoms over the weekend and was diagnosed late Sunday; the agency is coordinating with the State Department to move the patient to Germany for treatment, along with six other exposed people. Serge Christian mission organization identified Dr. Peter Stafford, one of three missionaries caring for patients, as the infected individual; Stafford’s wife was also among the caregivers, while the other two missionaries remain asymptomatic. Ongoing outbreak response and evacuation are underway.

triage.headline_ja: CDCが1人のアメリカ人がDRCでエボラウイルスに感染していることを確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症の確認例、DRC東部での集団発生（393疑い例、105死亡）、米国への症例輸入、国際的な患者搬送と複数国への拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC東部での発生地に重点を置いており、米国とドイツはいずれも患者の搬送先・対応国である。感染症イベントの主たる発生地はDRCのため、verified_locationsはDRCのみを列挙。CDCによる確認、医療従事者の感染、患者の国際搬送（ドイツへの治療移送）があり、複数国での対応調整が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Reisewarnung wegen Ebola: Diese Länder sind betroffen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Travel warning due to Ebola: These countries are affected.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak declared in Ituri Province, DRC, with Mongwalu and Rwampara health zones most affected; outbreak reported May 15, 2026. German Foreign Office travel warnings cover Maniema, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Ituri, Tshopo, Tanganyika, and northern Haut-Katanga; Upemba National Park spans Haut-Lomami and Haut-Katanga. DRC nationals in Nord- and Sud-Kivu urged to depart; nonessential travel to other parts of DRC, including Kinshasa, discouraged. Uganda confirms May 15 a Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak linked to an imported DRC case; a second imported case in Kampala on May 16; WHO reports no local transmission at that time. Regional risk elevated by cross-border movement. Bundibugyo Ebola virus has historically 30–50% mortality; no licensed vaccine or specific antiviral; management relies on early detection, isolation, supportive care, and contact tracing. Travelers should avoid contact with patients, bodily fluids, wildlife, and bushmeat, and seek medical advice within 21 days of exposure if symptoms arise.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスによる渡航警告：影響を受けている国々
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の新規発生がDRC（Ituri州）およびウガンダで確認され、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限発動、複数国での確認、死亡率30-50%と重症度が高く、シグナル識別基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC（Ituri州で初発、複数州で波及）およびウガンダでの確認が述べられているが、発生地域リストに含まれるウガンダ（226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo型）の新規アウトブレイク宣言であり、国際的な懸念事項として明確にシグナルに該当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola udrela v mestách KDR: Hlásia 131 mŕtvych, vírus zasiahol aj amerického lekára | Info.sk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Strikes in the Cities of KDR: 131 Dead Reported, the Virus Also Affected an American Doctor | Info.sk
article.articleSummary: 131 deaths and 513+ suspected Ebola cases reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as of May 19, 2026, driven by the Bundibugyo strain. Ituri Province, the city of Butembo, and the Goma transport hub are affected; WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and convened an extraordinary emergency committee. An American physician infected in the DRC has been airlifted to a German clinic; CBS News cites at least six U.S. citizens exposed, with Washington arranging expedited quarantine at a European-based U.S. military facility. The Bundibugyo lineage is less common but potentially more dangerous, with existing vaccines showing reduced efficacy. The current situation echoes the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak, which saw about 28,600 infections and 11,325 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国の都市で流行：131人の死亡報告、アメリカ人医師も感染 | Info.sk
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の確定的な流行で、複数国への拡大（米国への患者輸送、ドイツでの治療）、WHO/PHEICの宣言、国際的な隔離対応が実施されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo系統のエボラウイルス（ザイール系統より稀だが危険性が高い）による流行。既存ワクチンの効果が低減している報告。WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言済み。患者の国際移動（米国→ドイツ）により、DRC外への伝播リスク顕在化。発生地域にはAngola、USA、Germanyも含まれているが、記事の主題はDRCでの流行であり、他国は症例受け入れ先またはリスク国として記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع الوفيات جراء فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو إلى 131 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in Ebola deaths in Congo to 131
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, Ebola virus disease deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have risen to 131. The outbreak is linked to a distinct Ebola strain not previously seen, with authorities noting it has not reached pandemic levels. The Africa CDC says there is no vaccine specifically for this new strain. Strict containment measures are urged: isolate patients or suspected cases for the incubation period, which can last from 2 to 21 days, and closely monitor contacts to curb transmission. Ebola, a member of Filoviridae, causes severe hemorrhagic fever and was first identified in 1976 near the Ebola River in the DRC. Transmission occurs from animals (bats or primates) to humans and between humans via blood and bodily fluids; it is not airborne. Symptoms begin with fever and muscle pain, progressing to diarrhea, vomiting, and bleeding; a Jordanian health official notes this outbreak remains below pandemic status.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラウイルス死亡者が131例に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。新規株のエボラ出血熱で死亡131例、ワクチン未対応、国際的懸念（ジョルダン保健当局言及）、厳格な隔離措置が必須。
triage.notes: 新規エボラ株で既存ワクチンが対応できない点が懸念。ジョルダン保健当局の言及はパンデミック化検討との解釈。発生地域にJordanが含まれるが、サマリーではDRC内での発生が主題であり、ジョルダンは参考意見として記載されているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라·한타바이러스 동시 엄습..."기후·분쟁·이기주의, 재앙 키워"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola and hantaviruses strike simultaneously... Climate, conflict, and self-interest: drivers of disaster
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spreading in Ituri, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with about 330 suspected/confirmed cases and more than 80 deaths. The outbreak involves the rare Bundibugyo variant, unlike the Zaire strain targeted by available diagnostics and vaccines; initial rapid tests designed for Zaire yielded negative results, delaying confirmation. Vaccines and therapeutics exist only for Zaire; Bundibugyo has a 25–50% case fatality and currently lacks specific countermeasures. Four health workers at the same hospital have died, suggesting nosocomial transmission. WHO declared a PHEIC on May 17. Separately, on the Dutch cruise ship MV Hondius, Andes virus infections caused fever, pneumonia and acute respiratory distress syndrome, with three passenger deaths; Andes can spread between people. The outbreaks occur amid climate change, armed conflict, and geopolitical self-interest, cited by GPMB and WHO as drivers of rising outbreak frequency and weaker responses. Despite rapid vaccine tech, equitable access remains a critical gap.

triage.headline_ja: エボラとハンタウイルスが同時襲来...気候・紛争・利己主義が災厄を生む
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）がコンゴ民主共和国で330例超の患者と80人以上の死亡を記録し、WHOがPHEIC宣言を発出。IHR基準4つ全て該当し、シグナルとして明確。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株はZaire株向けワクチン・診断キットが無効であり、既存対策の有効性が限定的。院内感染（医療従事者4人死亡）を確認。同時期のオランダ船舶でのアンデスウイルス感染も報告されており、複合的感染症危機の様相を呈している。

article.articleHeadline: Dramatična utrka protiv smrtonosnog virusa: Amerikance prebacuju u vojnu karantenu u Njemačkoj?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dramatic race against a deadly virus: Are Americans being transferred to a military quarantine in Germany?
article.articleSummary: May 19, 2026: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), driven by Bundibugyo virus, has at least 131 deaths and more than 513 suspected cases, with new infections in Ituri’s Nyakunde, North Kivu’s Butembo, and the city of Gomi. The World Health Organization has declared an international health emergency, though it is not a pandemic. The CDC confirms two Congo-linked cases and one death in Uganda. An American physician with a medical mission group, Peter Stafford, is infected and will be treated in Germany; two other exposed clinicians and Stafford’s wife Rebekah are under quarantine. The United States is enforcing enhanced traveler screening and entry restrictions for non-U.S. citizens who recently visited Uganda, DRC, or South Sudan within 21 days. Rwanda will strengthen border controls; Nigeria monitors. Context: the 2014–2016 West Africa Ebola outbreak infected about 28,600 and killed 11,325.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的なウイルスとの劇的な競争：米国人はドイツの軍事隔離に移送されているのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo virus）で131死亡、513疑い例、WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態宣言、国際的な検疫措置実施中。
triage.notes: エボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo virus株）の大規模発生。DRCが主要な発生地。ウガンダでも確認症例あるが、記事の主題はDRCの発生と米国人感染者のドイツ移送。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。米国、ルワンダ、ナイジェリア等が検疫・監視措置を実施。社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Американец заразен со ебола евакуиран на лекување во Европа - Независен Весник
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American infected with Ebola evacuated for treatment in Europe - Independent Newspaper
article.articleSummary: An American healthcare worker exposed to Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has tested positive and was evacuated to Germany for treatment, per the CDC. Dr. Peter Stafford contracted Bundibugyo ebolavirus while treating patients at Nyankunde hospital in Bunia, where he has worked since 2023. His wife, Dr. Rebecca Stafford, and their four children are under monitoring but asymptomatic. The CDC is coordinating evacuation of at least six more Americans who had contact with the virus in the region. In DRC, the outbreak has caused 131 deaths and over 513 suspected cases; WHO has declared an international public health emergency. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved treatments or vaccines. The U.S. has imposed a temporary entry ban for nationals who visited DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the past 21 days. Transmission is animal-to-human (fruit bats) with 2–21 day incubation; symptoms include fever, severe headache, fatigue, and flu-like illness, with rapid deterioration.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ人がエボラ感染で欧州に避難治療 - 独立新聞
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラウイルスの国際的な人的移動、複数国での患者確認、WHO国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、ワクチン・治療法なしの新種株による国際的な拡大リスク。
triage.notes: 記事はアメリカ人医療従事者のDRC（Bunia）でのエボラ感染、ドイツへの避難治療を主題としている。DRCでの発生地が中心。United States、Germany、Sudan、Ugandaは患者移動・接触者の背景情報だが、本イベントの感染発生地はDRCのみ。Bluedot発生地にはいくつか周辺国が含まれているが、サマリー上でBundia（DRC）が感染エピセンターとして記述されているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。WPRO対象国はDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Over 130 ebola-dødsfall i Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 130 Ebola deaths in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: At least 131 Ebola deaths have been reported in DR Congo's Kongo-Kinshasa region, with over 500 suspected cases registered. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on Sunday, citing the outbreak's scale and speed. New Ebola cases are confirmed in additional DR Congo areas, including Nyakunde in Ituri Province, Butembo in North Kivu, and the city of Goma. Across the border in Uganda, the CDC reports two confirmed Ebola cases and one death. Earlier this month, the Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak was registered in Ituri Province. Ongoing transmission is noted, with limited detail on transmission chains.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで130人以上のエボラ出血熱による死亡が報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速拡大、国際的に確認済み、PHEIC宣言により渡航制限のリスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。WHO事務局長による緊急事態宣言により社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDR Congo（対象国）とUganda（非対象国）の両国での患者が記載されているが、verified_locationsはDRC のみとした。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため除外。本イベントはWHOによるPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）宣言済みであり、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: EUA vão rastrear o ébola nos aeroportos, com médicos europeus a deslocarem-se para a região
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States will screen for Ebola at airports, with European doctors traveling to the region.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda prompts U.S. action to bolster border health security. The CDC will screen passengers from affected regions; travelers to Uganda, the DRC, or South Sudan in the last 21 days face entry restrictions. The U.S. Embassy in Kampala suspended visa services. CDC says immediate U.S. risk is low but measures will adapt. A U.S. citizen exposed in DRC tested positive and will be treated in Germany; six more are under health monitoring. The U.S. State Department activated a response plan, mobilizing about $13 million in external assistance for surveillance, labs, risk communication, safe burials, and case management. The WHO declared Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. By Monday, at least 100 deaths and about 400 suspected cases had been reported. Europe’s ECDC is sending experts; Portugal’s DGS emphasizes early detection and expanded lab capacity.

triage.headline_ja: 米国はエボラウイルスを空港で検査し、欧州の医師が地域に派遣される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WHO公式宣言の国際的保健上の緊急事態（PHEIC）であり、フルRRAに進むべき優先度の高いシグナル。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはウガンダ（226074）が含まれており、記事サマリーでも「Uganda」が複数回言及されているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみを対象国として列挙。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み、少なくとも100死亡・400疑い患者が報告されており、極めて高リスク。米国とドイツも対応を開始。

article.articleHeadline: Mengenal Penyakit Ebola Mengapa Sangat Berbahaya dan Mematikan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Understanding Ebola Virus Disease: Why It Is So Dangerous and Deadly
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) is among the most deadly human diseases and triggers global concern during African outbreaks. First identified in 1976 near the Ebola River in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, EVD is caused by viruses in the Ebolavirus genus. Transmission occurs from animals—fruit bats, chimpanzees, gorillas, and monkeys—to humans, and human-to-human via contact with blood, secretions, organs, or other bodily fluids of infected people or animals. Incubation ranges 2–21 days; symptoms appear abruptly. Global case fatality averages about 50%, with past outbreaks ranging from 25% to 90%. Ebola is not airborne; pandemic potential is lower than respiratory pathogens, but international travel can import cases, necessitating vigilance at borders. Historically treated supportively, though medical advances offer renewed hope.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病を理解する なぜそんなに危険で致命的なのか
triage.triage_reason: エボラに関する教育的・啓発的な記事であり、現在の具体的な流行事例の報告ではない。DRCの歴史的背景は言及されるが、現在の発生状況の記述がなく、情報不足のため経過観察段階が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事はエボラウイルス病に関する一般的な医学知識・背景説明であり、現在進行中の流行事例や新規発生の報告ではない。DRCの歴史的発見地が言及されているが、現在の活動的な疫学的状況の記述がないため、フルRRA進捗には不十分。配信日時が2026年5月となっており、未来日付のため信憑性確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Житель Подмосковья пострадал от обезьяны во время поездки в Китай
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A resident of Moscow Oblast was injured by a monkey during a trip to China.
article.articleSummary: On May 19, 2026, a 31-year-old resident of Moscow Oblast was scratched on the right shin by a monkey during a trip to China. The wound was superficial, treated at the hotel, and the traveler later sought care at Krasnogorsk Clinical Hospital. There, primary surgical wound cleaning and administration of the rabies vaccine were performed, and he is now scheduled to complete a full course of rabies vaccinations. The incident highlights travel-associated exposure risk to primates and the importance of prompt wound management and post-exposure vaccination, with no infection status reported.

triage.headline_ja: モスクワ州の住民が中国への旅行中に猿に傷つけられた
triage.triage_reason: イベントは中国での動物咬傷であり、ロシアでの発生ではない。対象国外のため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが「Russian Federation」と「People's Republic of China」を発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーの主題は中国での個別の動物咬傷事件である。患者がロシア(モスクワ州)の住民であっても、実際のイベント発生地は中国。対象国リストに含まれる国での流行・集団発生ではなく、個別の旅行者事案であるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Έκτακτα υγειονομικά μέτρα στις ΗΠΑ - Αμερικανός γιατρός μολύνθηκε από τον ιό στη ΛΔ Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Emergency health measures in the United States – An American doctor contracted the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak prompts U.S. emergency health measures as a physician in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, contracted Ebola while caring for patients. He developed symptoms over the weekend and tested positive late Sunday; he is being prepared for transfer to Germany for treatment. The United States will implement airport health screenings for travelers from affected African nations and restrict visas for those who traveled to these areas. Kampala visa services were paused. CDC reports two confirmed Ebola cases and one death in Uganda, while the DRC counts at least 131 deaths and 513 suspected cases. The outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo strain; WHO has declared it a public international emergency. No vaccine or approved treatment exists for this Bundibugyo Ebola strain. The U.S. has pulled back from WHO and reduced humanitarian funding via USAID, though 13 million USD was released for immediate response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：米国で緊急衛生対策 - 米国の医師がコンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラ熱の確定例と死亡を伴う多国に及ぶ流行であり、WHOが国際公開緊急事態宣言済み。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUgandaとGermanyも含まれるが、サマリーの主題はDRC（イツリ州ブニア市）での流行である。Ugandaは2例の確定例が報告されているが、発生地は記事の主要な発病地ではなく、患者移送先がGermanyとなっている。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: l'OMS ha già dichiarato l'emergenza globale; si torna dunque all'emergenza epidemica come arte di governo?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the WHO has already declared the global emergency; are we therefore returning to the epidemic emergency as the art of governance?
article.articleSummary: WHO declared a global Ebola emergency linked to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where about 130 deaths have been reported. The piece notes the media pivot from Hantavirus to Ebola and argues that epidemic emergencies function as a persistent governance tool, shaped by liberal capitalism and biopolitics. Fear is amplified by media coverage, eroding rational decision-making while presenting emergency measures as salvation. The author recalls the 2020 epidemic emergency and asserts society has 'antibodies' to endure another crisis, yet cautions a new outbreak mood is already in the air after the 2022 war emergency. It critiques the alliance of arms and pharmaceutical interests on the management and framing of health crises, suggesting the pattern remains even as emergencies change.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：WHOが既に世界的な緊急事態を宣言；したがって我々は流行病の緊急事態を統治の技術として戻すのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な影響、国際的な関心、異常性）。WHOが世界的な緊急事態を宣言したエボラウイルス病の報告であり、DRCで約130名の死亡が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事はイタリア語の政治評論で、WHOの世界的緊急事態宣言とDRCでのエボラ流行を主題としている。死亡数が約130名と報告され、WHOが既に緊急事態を宣言していることが確認された。Hantavirus Infectionも同時に言及されているが、サマリーではエボラが主要なイベント。フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cosa sappiamo sulla nuova epidemia di ebola in Repubblica Democratica del Congo - LifeGate
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What we know about the new Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - LifeGate
article.articleSummary: First Ebola case identified April 24 in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the outbreak centered around Bunia. The virus is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a strain with up to 50% fatality; initial symptoms included fever, hemorrhage, vomiting and severe malaise. About 330 suspected cases, eight lab-confirmed, and 90 deaths, including two in Uganda. The index and ongoing transmission appear linked to healthcare settings, with many cases among health workers. There is no vaccine for Bundibugy o and diagnostic tests are largely designed for the Zaire strain; confirmation requires sending samples to the Kinshasa institute, delaying results by days to weeks. The WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, noting potential spread locally. The Ituri outbreak coincides with armed conflict and displacement toward South Sudan and Uganda, complicating containment. WHO allocated $500,000; specialist support deployed; concerns raised about funding gaps delaying response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国における新たなエボラ流行について我々が知っていること
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による大規模流行で90名の死亡者、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダで既に2死亡）、WHOによるPHEIC宣言が確認される。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株（致死率最大50%）による流行。330疑似症例、確定8例、死亡90名。医療現場でのクラスター発生と医療従事者への感染が特徴。ウガンダでも2名の死亡が報告されており、国際的拡大の兆候あり。武装紛争による強制移住がさらなる拡大リスクとなっている。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。ただしワクチンなし、診断体制の制約（Zaire株向け検査が主）により対応が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Face à Ebola, Washington annonce l'activation d'un plan d'intervention et mobilise une première enveloppe de 13 millions USD d'aide étrangère
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Facing Ebola, Washington announces activation of an intervention plan and mobilizes an initial $13 million in foreign aid.
article.articleSummary: US responds to the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo and Uganda by activating an interagency intervention plan and an incident-management cell. In May 18 statements, the State Department said embassies in DRC, Rwanda, South Sudan and Uganda formed teams to monitor the outbreak and communicate with Americans abroad, with coordination. Within 48 hours, $13 million in aid was mobilized to support surveillance, laboratories, risk communication, safe burials, border controls and clinical care. The department plans additional bilateral funding as outbreak evolves, leveraging U.S. support for UN humanitarian funds and OCHA common funds in DRC and Uganda. Total OCHA investments exceed about $1.8 billion, with $250 million for DRC and Uganda. Travel restrictions under Title 42 bar entry to nationals who have recently visited DRC, Uganda or South Sudan; possible repatriation is coordinated with CDC. The WHO declared the Bundibugyo Ebola strain outbreak in DRC/Uganda an international emergency 24 hours earlier.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス対策、ワシントンが介入計画の発動と1,300万ドルの初期援助を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の国際的広がり（DRC、ウガンダ、スーダン）、WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言、米国を含む複数国の公式対応により、IHR基準3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから確認できる感染症イベント発生地域はDRC（民主共和国コンゴ）とウガンダですが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当します。ウガンダは対象国に含まれていないため除外しました。スーダンと米国も言及されていますが、感染症の実際の発生地はDRCとウガンダです。WHO緊急事態宣言やBundibugyo株のエボラウイルス感染症という極めて重大なシグナルであり、複数国の正式な対応が開始されている点から、フルRRA実施が必要です。

article.articleHeadline: Outbreak of rare Ebola strain with no cure kills 118 people
article.articleSummary: An outbreak of the Bundibugyo Ebola strain has killed 118 people with 300 suspected cases across the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The World Health Organization declared the strain a public health emergency of international concern as cases are expected to rise. The virus, lacking a vaccine, spreads via close contact with the bodily fluids of the sick or deceased (sweat, blood, feces, vomit). Affected areas include the DRC and Uganda, with an American doctor in the DRC among newly confirmed cases. The United States has barred entry for anyone who has been in the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the past three weeks; Europe reports a very low infection risk. Earlier tests missed the strain, delaying response, according to Matthew M. Kavanagh. The International Rescue Committee launched an emergency response yesterday.

triage.headline_ja: 珍しいエボラウイルス株の流行により118人が死亡、治療法なし
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WHO が「国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態」と宣言した高リスク・高関心イベント。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCとウガンダが主な発生地として言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。米国は影響地域として列挙されているが、サマリーの主題は DRC/ウガンダの発生地であり、米国での実際の発生は報告されていないため除外。Bundibugyo ストレインはワクチン未開発、死亡率 118/300+ 疑い症例で深刻。WHO による国際的懸念事態の宣言、複数国への渡航制限、ヒト-ヒト感染リスク、管理困難性の複合要因から緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC declares continental emergency over Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak and Uganda declared a Continental Public Health Emergency by Africa CDC on May 18, 2026 (announced May 19). DRC reports 131 deaths from 513 suspected cases; Uganda reports 1 death. The declaration enables mobilization of extra resources, emergency response teams, and enhanced surveillance across the continent, in coordination with World Health Organization. Africa CDC cautions a high regional spillover risk due to cross-border movement, mining-related mobility, insecurity in affected areas, weak infection prevention and control, and proximity of affected areas to Rwanda and South Sudan. The outbreak involves Bundibugyo strain Ebola virus disease, in one of Africa’s most complex operational environments characterized by insecurity, population mobility, and fragile health systems, with limited medical countermeasures. Africa CDC director Jean Kaseya stresses intensified coordination to curb spread amid the challenges.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCがエボラ感染症の大流行を受けて大陸規模の緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株エボラウイルスによるDRC・ウガンダでの多発死亡、アフリカ大陸規模の緊急事態宣言、周辺国への越境リスク高。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示的にDRCとウガンダの感染症イベントが述べられているが、対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみ該当。ウガンダ（226074）、ルワンダ（49518）、スーダン（366755）は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Bundibugyo株エボラウイルスの越境リスク高く、アフリカCDC宣言により大陸規模の関心と国際的支援が喚起されている。フルRRA必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreads beyond Congo as deaths hit 118 and cases emerge in Uganda
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo strain) expands beyond initial hotspots, with 118 deaths and more than 390 suspected infections reported as of 19 May 2026. New infections have been detected in Goma, a major eastern city near the Rwanda border, as well as Nyakunde in Ituri Province and Butembo in North Kivu, signaling spread into densely populated areas. Uganda also reports two cases and one death linked to the same Bundibugyo strain. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak an international health emergency. Cross-border movement and fragile healthcare systems complicate containment, with the CDC warning that movement between Congo and Uganda could hinder efforts in areas with weak infrastructure. Congolese authorities say contact tracing, isolation of suspects, and intensified surveillance are underway, while officials urge calm amid mounting public concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴを超えてエボラが拡大、死亡者118人に達し、ウガンダでも症例が出現
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラの国際的拡大、複数国への越境感染、高い死亡率、WHOによる国際保健上の緊急事態宣言により、シグナルとしてフルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、エボラアウトブレイク（ブンディブギョ株）はコンゴ民主共和国を主要発生地とし、ウガンダへの越境感染が報告されている。ウガンダはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれるが、対象国リストに該当しないため、verified_locationsはDRC（203312）のみとする。Goma、Butembo、Nyakunde等複数都市での感染拡大により、人口密集地への拡大が懸念される。WHOによる国際保健上の緊急事態宣言により、社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ сообщила об опасной скорости распространения эпидемии Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reports a dangerous rate of spread of the Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: On May 19, 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned of the dangerous speed and scale of the Ebola epidemic, declaring an international health emergency during the 79th World Health Assembly in Geneva. He emphasized that the outbreak’s rapid spread prompted the extraordinary step even before a formal expert-group meeting. On May 17, WHO declared an emergency over Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, signaling risk to other states. Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor announced plans to dispatch specialists to Uganda to investigate the Ebola outbreak and provide material and technical support, including diagnostic tests. The report underscores international coordination and cross-border threat considerations, with no specific case counts provided.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラ出血熱の流行の危険な拡大速度を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（重篤な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、WHO緊急宣言により社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはGenève（スイス）やRussian Federationが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は DRC とUgandaでのエボラ出血熱の流行である。DRCのみが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。2026年5月19日のWHO緊急宣言という非常に重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak Claims Around 131 Lives in DR Congo: Report
article.articleSummary: 131 fatalities have been reported from an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), extending into Uganda. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC), though it does not meet the criteria for a pandemic emergency at this time. Countries sharing land borders with the DRC are at high risk for further spread. Health agencies are actively responding to the crisis. As of 2026-05-19, the death toll stands at 131, with ongoing updates as officials monitor the situation. The report underscores the international concern and the ongoing risk to neighboring nations, highlighting the need for vigilance and coordinated public health action.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で約131人の死亡を記録：報告書
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WHOがPHEIC宣言。エボラウイルス病は最高リスク病原体であり、DRCとウガンダで確認された国際的な感染拡大リスク、高い重症度が明確。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダが含まれているが、サマリーではDRCが主要発生地で、ウガンダは『拡大の可能性がある隣国』として言及されている。対象国リストにはウガンダが含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みの最高優先度シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: قلق بالغ جراء سرعة انتشار فيروس إيبولا ولا توسع لفيروس هانتا - elmarada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Grave Concern Over the Rapid Spread of the Ebola Virus and No Spread of the Hantavirus
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the World Health Organization (WHO) expresses grave concern over the rapid spread of the Ebola virus, and notes no indication of a broader hantavirus outbreak. The Ebola outbreak has been designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). In the Democratic Republic of Congo, authorities report over a hundred suspected Ebola cases and dozens of deaths, with two infections detected in neighboring Uganda. No evidence of sustained hantavirus transmission is found. The cross-border cases underscore the need for international coordination and enhanced surveillance, though the brief does not specify laboratory confirmation for all Ebola cases. The PHEIC designation is intended to mobilize international public health responses to contain Ebola while monitoring hantavirus activity.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機構: エボラウイルスの急速な拡大による重大な懸念と、ハンタウイルスの拡大なし
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルスのPHEIC指定、国際的拡大（DRC→ウガンダ）、複数死亡例、国際的対応の必要性が明記されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダは記事で言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCでの100例以上の疑い例および複数死亡例、国際的なPHEIC指定、国間での症例検出がフルRRA対象の重要なシグナル。ハンタウイルスについては持続的な人間への感染伝播の証拠がないと明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, allarme anche in Italia per il virus senza cura. Il ministero: "Controlli per chi rientra da Congo e Uganda"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, alarm also in Italy over the virus with no cure. The ministry: "Checks for those returning from Congo and Uganda."
article.articleSummary: Ebola, Bundibugyo virus, currently circulating in the Democratic Republic of the Congo with cases reported also in Uganda, has no approved therapies or vaccines for this strain. Italy's Health Ministry issued a precautionary circular requiring vigilance for government, NGO, and cooperative staff working in the affected areas. Operators must complete a health declaration detailing travel and present it to the ministry at least 48 hours before departure; a screening anamnesis form must be completed upon arrival by the Usmaf-Sasn maritime, aerial, and border health service or by the local health authority if travel is by non-airport transport. Returning personnel will undergo temperature checks and a health questionnaire. The procedure may include monitoring of low-risk contacts even if no documented exposure within 21 days. Instructions may be updated as the epidemiological situation evolves, and access to information is limited to authorized personnel.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、イタリアでも警戒 治療法のないウイルス。保健省：「コンゴとウガンダからの帰国者への検査」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。ブンディブギョウイボラウイルス株による新規アウトブレイクであり、複数国での確認とイタリア当局の対応措置により、フルRRA実施の対象となる。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にイタリア（対象国リストに非掲載）とウガンダ（対象国リストに非掲載）が含まれているが、記事サマリーでの主要な発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のみが対象国であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみを記載。ブンディブギョウイボラウイルス株は稀で、承認された治療法やワクチンがないことが記載されており、重症度が高い。イタリア保健省による国家的対応（スクリーニング、監視）が実施されている点も社会政治的関心の高さを示す。

article.articleHeadline: El Congo eleva a 116 las muertes sospechosas por el nuevo brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo raises to 116 the number of suspected deaths from the new Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 116 suspected Ebola deaths linked to an outbreak declared last Friday in Ituri, with new detections in Katwa (North Kivu) and Nyankunde (Ituri). By May 16, 246 suspected cases and 80 deaths had been recorded in Ituri across Bunia, Rwampara and Mongbwalu, including several healthcare workers; most patients are 20–39 years old and about 60% are women. The government declared a state of emergency and dispatched seven tonnes of supplies with WHO support to strengthen surveillance and case management amid concern over spread to densely populated areas. A U.S. citizen contracted Ebola and began showing symptoms over the weekend; he tested positive Sunday and will be evacuated to Germany for treatment, reflecting the evacuation logistics for imported cases. Spain considers exposure risk for nationals in affected areas to be very low, with updated guidance suggesting minimal secondary transmission if imported.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、新たなエボラ流行による疑い死亡者数を116人に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的な広がり（米国市民の感染、ドイツへの患者搬送）、重症度（116人の死亡）、国際的拡大リスクおよび渡航制限の可能性が明確であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはUSA、Spain、Germanyが含まれているが、これらは患者搬送・疾患管理の対象国であり、エボラウイルス病の発生地域ではない。記事サマリーで明確に述べられている通り、発生地域はDRC内のIturi（Bunia、Rwampara、Mongbwalu）およびNorth Kivu（Katwa）である。Rwandaの言及はないため除外。対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみをverified_locationsに列挙。

article.articleHeadline: 현대바이오, 에볼라·한타바이러스 동시 확산에
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hyundai Bio, Amid the Simultaneous Spread of Ebola and Hantaviruses.
article.articleSummary: Hyundai BioScience announces immediate readiness to deploy Jefti, a broad-spectrum antiviral whose key ingredient is niclosamide, to frontline sites amid global spread of Ebola virus and Hantavirus. With two deadly viruses spreading and limited targeted treatments, Jefti is presented as a practical option for multi-pathogen infections. Papers report niclosamide inhibits both Ebola and Hantavirus; safety data from Vietnam dengue fever Phase 2 trial show no adverse events across the full dosing range. The company holds clinical-grade Jefti stock produced and stored domestically, enabling rapid on-site administration to WHO or outbreak-affected countries without new production time. Hyundai BioScience also aims to collaborate with the US Department of Defense's Medical Countermeasures Biosurveillance Consortium (MCDC) on broad-spectrum antivirals. The firm emphasizes readiness to supply immediately upon international requests to help control simultaneous viral spread.

triage.headline_ja: 現代バイオ、エボラ・ハンタウイルス同時拡散に
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は企業のプレスリリース性の医薬品開発発表であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク事象ではなく、推測と仮定に基づく市場展開計画である。具体的な発生地域、患者数、死亡事例等の客観的なアウトブレイク情報がない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが「Ebola」「Hantavirus」「Dengue」のシグナルを検出したが、記事サマリーは韓国企業の抗ウイルス医薬品（Jefti）の開発・展開計画に関するプレスリリースである。ベトナムはフェーズ2臨床試験（デング熱）の言及のみで、現在のアウトブレイク発生地ではない。米国も同様に理論的な協力関係の言及のみ。シグナル検出は医薬品企業の発表という文脈から生じた誤検出の可能性が高い。実際の疾患クラスターやアウトブレイク情報がないため、EBS評価対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Le chef de l'OMS "profondément préoccupé par l'ampleur et la rapidité" de l'épidémie d'Ebola: "Je n'ai pas pris cette décision à la légère"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief "deeply concerned by the scale and speed" of the Ebola outbreak: "I did not take this decision lightly."
article.articleSummary: On May 19, 2026, the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda. The Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine, is driving the outbreak. The epicenter is Ituri province in northeastern DRC, a mining region with heavy population movement near Uganda and South Sudan. As of now, 30 confirmed cases in Ituri; more than 500 suspected cases and 130 suspected deaths reported. Uganda has two confirmed cases in Kampala, including one death among two travelers from the DRC. A U.S. citizen tested positive and was transferred to Germany. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the decision was not taken lightly and an Emergency Committee will be convened for temporary recommendations. Historical context: Ebola has caused over 15,000 deaths in Africa; notable outbreaks include 2018–2020 (~2,300 deaths) and a 2025 DRC outbreak (≥34 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、エボラ出血熱の流行規模と速度について「深く懸念している」と表明：「この決定を軽く考えていない」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速な拡大、国際的な危険性、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。WHO事務総長による緊急宣言と複数国での確認症例・死亡が報告されている。
triage.notes: WHOが2026年5月19日にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言。ワクチン未開発のブンディブギョ株が流行の主要原因。DRCのイトゥリ州が震源地（採掘地域で人口移動が活発）。確認症例：DRC 30例、ウガンダ 2例（死亡1例）、米国市民1例。感染者の米国人がドイツに転院。歴史的文脈：アフリカでのエボラによる総死者数15,000以上。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RD-Congo : 131 décès estimés et 513 cas suspects, l'OMS tire la sonnette d'alarme
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DR Congo: 131 estimated deaths and 513 suspected cases, WHO sounds the alarm.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo appears to have caused 131 deaths and involves 513 suspected cases, according to the Congolese Minister of Health. The minister’s statements, cited by La Croix, indicate the outbreak is ongoing and has prompted international concern. The World Health Organization has sounded the alarm over the situation. The article notes no further details in the excerpt about laboratory confirmation, precise infection sources, or imported/exported cases. The report emphasizes the public health urgency in the DRC and the need for enhanced surveillance and response, as authorities monitor the trajectory of the outbreak. No additional locations or case counts beyond the DR Congo are mentioned in the provided text.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：推定131人の死亡と513人の疑い患者、WHOが警告を発する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の発生は深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な健康現象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の懸念を示す。WHOが公式な警告を発出している。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最高リスクカテゴリの病原体であり、131名の死亡と513名の疑い患者という報告数は深刻な流行規模を示している。WHOが公式警告を発出していることから、国際的な注視が必要。実験室確認症例数や感染源の詳細情報の追加確認が重要。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. deploys $13 million, imposes travel restrictions as Ebola outbreak hits DR Congo and Uganda
